# وەرگێڕی هەڵبژێردراو و نوێبوونەوەی خێراتری زیندوو

لە «ڕێکخستنی دەنگ» کارتی «وەرگێڕی زمانەکان — جگە لە عەرەبی» زیاد کراوە:

1. **تەنها Google**: وەرگێڕانی دەق Gemini بانگ ناکات؛ کلیلی Gemini پێویست نییە.
2. **تەنها Gemini**: تەنها Gemini؛ ئەگەر کلیل، تۆڕ، quota یان وەڵام کێشەی هەبێت، هەڵە پیشان دەدرێت و Google خۆکارانە بەکارنایەت.
3. **Gemini؛ Google تەنها لە تەواوبوونی quota**: Gemini یەکەمە. Google هاوکات یان دوای چاوەڕوانییەکی دیاریکراو دەست پێناکات؛ تەنها دوای HTTP 429 ـی Gemini بەکار دێت. کلیلی دیکەی Gemini ئەگەر هەبێت پێش Google تاقی دەکرێتەوە. هەڵەی 400/401/403/404/500، پچڕانی تۆڕ یان وەڵامی ناتەواو ئەم گۆڕینە چالاک ناکەن.

هەڵبژاردنەکە دەپارێزرێت و بۆ داواکارییە نوێکانی زیندوو، شاشە، خۆکار، ڕووبەر و وەرگێڕانی کوردی بۆ ئینگلیزی بەکاردێت. بنەڕەت Google ـە. گۆڕینی دۆخ ڕستەی دەستپێکردوو دووبارە ناخوێنێتەوە. کلیلی Gemini لە هەمان خانەی پێشووی کلیل دادەنرێت؛ ناوی وەرگێڕ دەنگی هەڵبژێردراو ناگۆڕێت.

**دۆخی زمانی سەرچاوەی عەرەبی (`ar`)** ڕێگای OCR/وەرگێڕانی پێشوو و هەڵبژاردنە پێشووییەکانی خۆی دەپارێزێت. دوو checkbox ـی پێشووی Google/Gemini ـی زیندوو ئێستا بە ڕوونی «تایبەت بە عەرەبی» ناونراون. هەڵبژاردنی نوێ ئەوانە ناگۆڕێت. STT، چاکسازی نووسین و موتورەکانی دەنگ لەم هەڵبژاردنەدا ناگۆڕدرێن.

## نوێبوونەوەی خێراتر

تەنها لە دۆخی زیندووی زمانەکانی جگە لە `ar`:

- MediaProjection: نێوان گرتنی فرەیم لە 150ms بۆ 90ms؛ ڕامی کەم لە 220ms بۆ 140ms.
- Accessibility: لە 400ms بۆ 350ms؛ ڕامی کەم لە 550ms بۆ 450ms. سنووری نزیکەی 333ms ـی Android پارێزراوە.
- OCR: نێوانی کارەکان 120ms؛ کوردی 100ms. لە باگراوندی جووڵاودا سنووری چاوەڕوانی 250ms؛ کوردی 180ms.
- یەکەم OCR هەر دەستبەجێیە، OCR ـە هاوکاتەکان ڕێگەپێدراو نین، و شاشەی نەگۆڕاو دووبارە بێهۆکار OCR ناکرێت. وەستاندنی زیندوو نرخی ئاسایی گرتن دەگەڕێنێتەوە. دۆخی عەرەبی سنوورە پێشووییەکانی خۆی هەیە.

ئەم ژمارانە ڕێکخستنی کۆدن، نەک FPS یان دواکەوتنی پێوانەکراوی مۆبایل. تۆڕ، خزمەتگوزاری و توانای ئامێر هێشتا کاریگەرن. Google ـی بێ کلیل بەڵێنی بێ‌سنووری نییە.

## Implementation notes

- A shared provider enum/settings preference and typed routing policy replace the non-Arabic hedged race. Only a confirmed ApiException(429) enables Google in hybrid mode. The exception retains 429 through Gemini model selection; all configured keys can still be tried before provider fallback.
- After confirmed quota, hybrid requests for the same key set use Google for a 30-second process-local cooldown, then probe Gemini again. Changing keys uses a separate cooldown. Gemini-only ignores this hybrid cooldown. Credentials are never logged by the new router.
- Gemini-only and hybrid do not issue even Google's translation-based preconnect request before quota. Arabic keeps its legacy warmup behavior.
- Screen/auto/region use the same text translation policy. Region uses local OCR with crop-relative rectangles mapped back to the screen; the full-screen Accessibility shortcut is disabled for a cropped bitmap. Local Kurdish detection remains available, with owned probe copies and bounded waiting. Google mode does not skip local OCR in favor of an unused Gemini key.
- Streamed Gemini blocks are retained if later quota exhaustion occurs; Google translates only missing blocks and does not retranslate explicit empty/noise results. Non-quota failures and incomplete Gemini output never silently trigger Google. Arabic context translation keeps its old permissive fallback behavior.
- Live cache keys include language/provider; screen caches are likewise scoped. Gemini's own context cache stays separate from Google's. Request provider/credentials are captured before asynchronous work, so a UI switch applies to new requests without mixing modes inside one batch.
- Existing short-speech, no-replay, FIFO ordering, model weights and selected voice speed remain intact. Shared API additions are optional `quotaSensitive`/`strict` flags (default false) and `allowAccessibility` (default true); FrameSource has a no-op default live-refresh hook.

## Phone checks

- Select each provider, close/reopen settings and confirm it remains selected. Test live, screen, auto, region and the English-translation button on non-Arabic input.
- Google mode must work without a Gemini key. Gemini-only without a valid key must show an error, not silently use Google.
- Test a valid Gemini key in Gemini-only/hybrid. Test actual exhausted quota only if already available; do not consume quota deliberately to validate the UI. Automated fake-provider tests verify 429-only fallback, request ordering, cooldown and non-quota errors without charging an API.
- Switch provider while live mode is active. New subtitle requests should use the new mode; currently playing speech should not restart.
- Explicitly select Arabic and compare its previous scene/settings. The new selector should not change that path or its capture/OCR cadence.
- Compare the same live scene on the same phone/network. Also verify single-word speech and blank-scene non-replay still work.

No physical-phone UI/playback test or real keyed Gemini/Google translation test is claimed in this workspace. See VALIDATION.md for build/test evidence.

# Local Piper voice tones

Voice settings now include Original, Soft male and Soft feminine tone. They apply
only to the local Piper engine and retain the selected voice-output route. Existing
installations default to Original (no new pitch or smoothing settings applied).

Soft feminine is an effect on the current speaker, not a newly trained female
voice/model. The upstream config declares two speakers but documents only Berfin=0;
no unknown speaker embedding is promoted or relabeled. Model weights and speaker ID
remain unchanged.

- Original: pitch 1.00, existing two-stage low-pass 7000 Hz, target RMS 0.100.
- Soft male: pitch 1.00, low-pass 5600 Hz, target RMS 0.095.
- Soft feminine: pitch 1.22 (about +3.44 semitones), low-pass 6000 Hz, RMS 0.095.

The existing DC blocker, trim, fades, peak limit, signal rejection and queue remain.
There is no extra ONNX inference, model download, cloud call or processing loop.
Softening reuses the existing low-pass and gain passes. Native Android pitch shifting
adds platform-dependent CPU work/latency; this was not measured on a device.

The tone is captured once per speaking session and passed through render/prefetch
explicitly. Processed audio cache keys include tone ID so switching tones cannot
play another tone's cached audio. The low-latency flag, synthesis speed and chunking
retain their existing behavior.

Feminine pitch uses AudioTrack PlaybackParams pitch=1.22 and speed=1.00; it does not
use sample-rate retagging to speed up speech. Parameters are applied once after PCM
is queued, immediately before play, to avoid accidental early playback on Android
versions where setPlaybackParams can resume a track. An unsupported platform effect
reports through the existing playback-error path instead of silently changing tempo.

## Preview and validation limits

The preview WAVs derive from the exact same generated PCM as the previous clean
sample. Python mirrors the softening; FFmpeg Rubber Band shifts feminine pitch
with tempo=1 and shifted formants. The two previews have equal duration (3.78458s),
22050 Hz mono PCM16 and no full-scale/clipped samples.

Android's native pitch algorithm differs from Rubber Band: previews demonstrate
the intended tone and are NOT recordings of app playback. Naturalness/softness are
subjective and were not validated by a listening panel. No new female voice was
trained. No phone/AudioTrack effect, mobile latency, audio route or heat/battery test
was performed. App unit/source checks are documented in VALIDATION.md.

Use Voice settings -> local Kurdish neural voice -> voice tone; Save or Test.
The profile does not affect Pawan, Gemini or Android system TTS.

Source-only delivery. No APK assembled or supplied.

# Offline Kurdish Piper voice stability

This revision addresses code paths that can leave playback waiting or restart already spoken text. The user's exact quiet stretched-vowel sound was not recorded or reproduced on an Android device, so this is not a claim that every audible artifact is eliminated.

## Concrete fixes

- End-of-stream cannot be lost when the three-clip PCM queue is full. Previously `offer(endMark, 1 second)` could fail while the consumer was busy playing a long clip; later polls would wait forever. Completion is now separate from queue capacity, while a marker still wakes an idle consumer.
- Nonblocking AudioTrack writes and final draining check actual playback-head progress. A playing track with pending frames and no progress for two seconds returns an error and releases its buffer instead of spinning indefinitely. An empty track waiting for synthesis is not considered stalled. Timing is monotonic and playback-head counters are treated as unsigned, including wraparound.
- Pause/stop immediately pause and flush the current track. Playback startup shares a short lock with stop, so a late writer cannot restart a track after cancellation.
- Piper records whether playback may have begun. System-voice fallback and live sentence retries remain allowed before playback; a partially played paragraph is not automatically read again from its beginning after a failure. A playback failure is reported, then the live queue can advance. This does not reconstruct or guarantee recovery of an unspoken tail after a native audio-device failure.
- Offline completion/error callbacks check their run ID when delivered on the UI thread. Canceled queued jobs cannot synthesize or finish a newer job.

## Work and resource use

Warmup, rendering and prefetch share a synthesis gate, including cache lookup, so concurrent misses do not synthesize the same clip twice. Warmup is skipped once native inference has succeeded. Prefetch has one running job and at most one latest queued job; old pending work is cleared on stop. Prefetch waits without spinning when inference is busy and does not cold-load the model at background thread priority.

CPU synthesis runs at ordinary priority rather than urgent audio priority. The PCM consumer uses audio priority and restores its original priority afterward. The existing voice speed, chunking, native inference thread count and short-word punctuation retries are retained. No network request or arbitrary normal-playback delay is added. These changes reduce unnecessary competing work; device temperature, power draw and end-to-end speed were not measured.

Native session loading/closing shares the inference gate. Shutdown closes the model on a daemon after active inference finishes, avoiding a session-close race and a UI wait. ONNX session options are released after session creation.

## PCM check

Constant DC output is rejected by checking AC energy in addition to peak/RMS/active samples. This protects against non-speech offsets being mistaken for quiet speech. It is not a general vowel/tone detector: legitimate sustained speech is not discarded simply because it sounds like a vowel. Invalid raw long-clip output is checked before polishing/caching.

## Validation

Full Android source compilation and JVM tests are recorded in VALIDATION.md. Added tests cover full-queue completion, temporary empty queues, frozen/advancing/unsigned/wrapping playback heads, partial-playback retry suppression, and DC rejection. The new PCM and short-word checks accepted all seven existing recorded outputs from the user's model on the first attempt. These were recorded files, not new on-device inference or playback tests; the local validation harness/result is in `verification/`.

Device checks still needed: sustained live use on the affected phone, the exact low buzzing sound, speech during CPU load, pause/resume during synthesis and playback, short words, and a long multi-clip paragraph. The source-only ZIP contains no APK.

========== END OF FILE: VOICE_STABILITY.md ==========

android {

    compileSdk = 34

    defaultConfig {
        applicationId = "com.mangatranslator.app"
        minSdk = 26
        targetSdk = 34
        versionCode = 201
        versionName = "1.3.32"

        // تەنها مۆبایلی ٦٤ بیت: APK بچووکتر دەبێت
        ndk {
            abiFilters += listOf("arm64-v8a")
        }
    }

    // ناوی APK ـەکە
    applicationVariants.all {
        outputs.all {
            (this as com.android.build.gradle.internal.api.BaseVariantOutputImpl).outputFileName = "وەڕگێڕی_شاشە.apk"
        }
    }

    // واژۆی جێگیر: workflow ی GitHub کلیلی manga لە secret دەنووسێتەوە بۆ app/manga-release.keystore (پشکنینی پەنجەمۆر لەوێ دەکرێت).
    // هەموو وەشانەکان بەم کلیلە واژۆ دەکرێن، بۆیە update بێ سڕینەوەی ئەپەکە کار دەکات.
    // بیلدی ناوخۆیی بێ ئەو فایلە: debug.keystore ی کۆن.
    signingConfigs {
        getByName("debug") {
            val manga = file("manga-release.keystore")
            storeFile = if (manga.exists()) manga else file("debug.keystore")
            storePassword = "android"
            keyAlias = if (manga.exists()) "manga" else "androiddebugkey"
            keyPassword = "android"
        }
    }

    buildTypes {
        release {
            isMinifyEnabled = false
        }
    }

    compileOptions {
        sourceCompatibility = JavaVersion.VERSION_17
        targetCompatibility = JavaVersion.VERSION_17
    }

    // مۆدێلە ONNX ـەکان لە APK دا فشار نادرێن (خێراتر)
    androidResources {
        noCompress += listOf("onnx")
    }

    kotlinOptions {
        jvmTarget = "17"
    }
}

dependencies {
    implementation("androidx.core:core-ktx:1.13.1")

    // کۆروتین بۆ وەرگێڕان (هەڵوەشاندنەوە و کۆدی ڕیزبەند)
    implementation("org.jetbrains.kotlinx:kotlinx-coroutines-android:1.8.1")

    // دەنگی نیورالی Piper/VITS (ONNX) بە onnxruntime

package com.mangatranslator.app

import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.HandlerThread
import android.util.Log
import android.view.Display
import androidx.annotation.RequiresApi
import java.util.concurrent.Executor

/**
 * گرتنی شاشە بە Accessibility (takeScreenshot)؛ بێ پەنجەرەی ڕێگەپێدانی MediaProjection.
 * سنووری سیستەم: نزیکەی ٣ وێنە لە چرکەیەکدا، بۆیە لە دۆخی خۆکار ~٤٠٠ms جارێک فرەیم دەدات.
 * ئەپە FLAG_SECURE ـەکان وێنەی ڕەش دەدەن (وەک MediaProjection).
 */
@RequiresApi(30)
class AccessibilityCapturer(
    context: Context,
    private val onFirstFrame: () -> Unit,
    private val onUnavailable: () -> Unit
) : FrameSource {

    private val load = CaptureLoad(context)
    @Volatile private var liveRefresh = false
    override fun setLiveRefresh(enabled: Boolean) { liveRefresh = enabled }
    private val thread = HandlerThread("a11y-capture").apply { start() }
    private val handler = Handler(thread.looper)
    private val executor = Executor { handler.post(it) }

    @Volatile private var released = false
    @Volatile private var capturePaused = false
    private var tickGeneration = 0
    @Volatile private var inFlight = false
    @Volatile private var inFlightSince = 0L
    private var last: Bitmap? = null
    private var firstNotified = false

    @Volatile
    override var frameListener: ((Bitmap) -> Unit)? = null

    private val tick = object : Runnable {
        override fun run() {
            if (released || capturePaused) return
            val l = frameListener
            if (l == null || !load.interactive) { handler.postDelayed(this, IDLE_MS); return }
            val generation = tickGeneration
            shoot { bmp ->
                if (bmp != null) {
                    if (!released && !capturePaused && generation == tickGeneration && frameListener === l) l(bmp)
                    else bmp.recycle()
                }
                if (released || capturePaused || generation != tickGeneration) return@shoot
                handler.postDelayed(this, if (liveRefresh) LiveRefresh.accessibilityMs(DeviceProfile.low)
                                         else if (DeviceProfile.low) ACTIVE_MS_LOW else ACTIVE_MS)
            }
        }
    }

    override fun start() { handler.post(tick) }

    override fun setCapturePaused(paused: Boolean) {
        capturePaused = paused
        if (paused) handler.post {
            tickGeneration++
            handler.removeCallbacks(tick)
        } else requestFreshFrame {}
    }

    override fun requestFreshFrame(onReady: () -> Unit) {
        capturePaused = false
        handler.post {
            if (released || capturePaused) return@post
            tickGeneration++
            handler.removeCallbacks(tick)
            onReady()
            val wait = (RETRY_MS - (android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - inFlightSince)).coerceAtLeast(0L)
            handler.postDelayed(tick, wait)
        }
    }

    /** یەک وێنە؛ cb لە thread ی گرتنەوە. bitmap ی دراو هی cb ـە. */
    private fun shoot(cb: (Bitmap?) -> Unit) {
        val svc = MangaAccessibilityService.instance
        if (svc == null) { cb(null); if (!released) onUnavailable(); return }
        if (inFlight) {
            // ئەگەر takeScreenshot هەرگیز callback ی نەکرد، ڕایبگرە تا خۆکار بۆ هەمیشە نەوەستێت
            if (android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - inFlightSince > 4000) inFlight = false
            else { cb(null); return }
        }
        inFlight = true
        inFlightSince = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
        try {
            svc.takeScreenshot(Display.DEFAULT_DISPLAY, executor,
                object : android.accessibilityservice.AccessibilityService.TakeScreenshotCallback {
                    override fun onSuccess(r: android.accessibilityservice.AccessibilityService.ScreenshotResult) {
                        var out: Bitmap? = null
                        try {
                            val hb = r.hardwareBuffer
                            val hw = Bitmap.wrapHardwareBuffer(hb, r.colorSpace)
                            val soft = hw?.copy(Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888, false)
                            hw?.recycle()
                            hb.close()
                            if (soft != null) {
                                val sc = if (DeviceProfile.low) SCALE_LOW else SCALE
                                out = Bitmap.createScaledBitmap(
                                    soft, (soft.width * sc).toInt().coerceAtLeast(2),
                                    (soft.height * sc).toInt().coerceAtLeast(2), true
                                )
                                if (out !== soft) soft.recycle()
                            }
                        } catch (t: Throwable) {
                            Log.e(TAG, "screenshot convert failed", t)
                        }
                        inFlight = false
                        if (out != null && !firstNotified) { firstNotified = true; onFirstFrame() }
                        // کۆپییەکە تەنها بۆ requestFrame ی یەدەگە؛ لە دۆخی خۆکار (listener هەیە) ناکرێت تا ٦MB لە هەر فرەیمێک نەخرێتە سەر ڕام
                        if (out != null && frameListener == null) { last?.recycle(); last = out.copy(Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888, false) }
                        cb(out)
                    }

                    override fun onFailure(errorCode: Int) {
                        Log.w(TAG, "takeScreenshot failed: $errorCode")
                        inFlight = false
                        cb(null)
                    }
                })
        } catch (t: Throwable) {
            Log.e(TAG, "takeScreenshot threw", t)
            inFlight = false
            cb(null)
        }
    }

    override fun requestFrame(delayMs: Long, cb: (Bitmap?) -> Unit) {
        fun attempt(left: Int) {
            shoot { bmp ->
                when {
                    bmp != null -> cb(bmp)
                    left > 0 && !released -> handler.postDelayed({ attempt(left - 1) }, RETRY_MS)
                    else -> cb(last?.copy(Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888, false))
                }
            }
        }
        handler.postDelayed({ attempt(4) }, delayMs)
    }

    override fun release() {
        released = true
        frameListener = null
        handler.post { last?.recycle(); last = null }
        thread.quitSafely()
    }

    companion object {
        private const val TAG = "A11yCapturer"
        private const val SCALE = 0.75f
        private const val SCALE_LOW = 0.55f
        private const val ACTIVE_MS_LOW = 550L
        private const val ACTIVE_MS = 400L   // سنووری سیستەم ≈ ٣٣٣ms
        private const val IDLE_MS = 700L
        private const val RETRY_MS = 380L
    }
}

========== END OF FILE: app/src/main/java/com/mangatranslator/app/AccessibilityCapturer.kt ==========

package com.mangatranslator.app

import android.content.Context
import android.content.SharedPreferences
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import android.os.SystemClock
import java.io.File
import java.io.PrintWriter
import java.io.StringWriter
import java.net.SocketTimeoutException
import java.net.UnknownHostException
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService
import java.util.concurrent.Executors
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong

/**
 * لۆگی چالاکییەکان: هەموو شت بە بێدەنگی لە پاشبنەما دەنووسرێت (هیچ popup، overlay یان ئاگادارکردنەوەیەک نییە).
 * - یەک thread ی تایبەت هەموو خوێندن/نووسین/سڕینەوە ڕێک دەخات، بۆیە کۆدی ئەپەکە هەرگیز چاوەڕێی I/O ناکات.
 * - ڕووداوەکان پێش پاشەکەوتکردن پاک دەکرێنەوە (LogSanitizer) و تەنها لە ئامێرەکەدا دەمێننەوە.
 * - سنوور: ٢٠٠٠ ڕووداو / ٢MB؛ کۆنترینەکان خۆکارانە دەسڕدرێنەوە.
 */
object ActivityLog {
    private const val MAX_EVENTS = 2000
    private const val MAX_BYTES = 2_000_000L

    private val exec: ExecutorService = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor { r ->
        Thread(r, "activity-log").apply { isDaemon = true; priority = Thread.MIN_PRIORITY }
    }
    private val main = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
    private val fileLock = Any()
    private val seq = AtomicLong()
    private val opSeq = AtomicLong()
    private val throttle = ConcurrentHashMap<String, LongArray>()   // [lastMs, suppressed]

    private val events = ArrayList<LogEvent>()      // تەنها لە exec دەگۆڕدرێت
    private var bytes = 0L
    @Volatile private var store: EventStore? = null
    @Volatile private var prefs: SharedPreferences? = null
    @Volatile private var appVersion = ""
    @Volatile private var platform = ""
    @Volatile var appName = "App"
        private set
    @Volatile var versionLabel = ""
        private set

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ دەستپێک

    fun init(context: Context) {
        if (store != null) return
        val ctx = context.applicationContext
        try {
            val pm = ctx.packageManager
            val pi = pm.getPackageInfo(ctx.packageName, 0)
            @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
            val code = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 28) pi.longVersionCode else pi.versionCode.toLong()
            appVersion = (pi.versionName ?: "?") + " ($code)"
            versionLabel = appVersion
            appName = ctx.applicationInfo.loadLabel(pm).toString()
        } catch (_: Throwable) {}
        platform = "Android ${Build.VERSION.RELEASE} (API ${Build.VERSION.SDK_INT}), ${Build.MANUFACTURER} ${Build.MODEL}"
        val st = EventStore(File(ctx.filesDir, "activity_log/events.log"), MAX_EVENTS, MAX_BYTES)
        prefs = ctx.getSharedPreferences("activity_log_state", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        store = st
        installCrashHandler()
        exec.execute {
            try {
                events.addAll(st.load())
                bytes = events.sumOf { st.sizeOf(it) }
                val p = prefs
                val prev = p?.getString("state", null)
                val crashed = p?.getBoolean("crashed", false) == true
                if (crashed) {
                    p?.edit()?.putBoolean("crashed", false)?.apply()     // ڕووداوی crash پێشتر نووسراوە
                } else if (prev == "fg") {
                    add(make(LogCategory.APPLICATION, LogSeverity.WARNING, "Previous session ended unexpectedly",
                        "The app was in the foreground when the previous process ended without a recorded shutdown " +
                            "(killed by the system, force-stopped, or the device restarted). No crash was captured.",
                        "ActivityLog", "session", "UNEXPECTED_TERMINATION", "", null, "", emptyMap()))
                }
                add(make(LogCategory.APPLICATION, LogSeverity.INFO, "Application started",
                    "Process started.", "MangaApp", "session", "STARTED", "", null, "", emptyMap()))
            } catch (_: Throwable) {}
        }
    }

    fun setForeground(fg: Boolean) {
        try { prefs?.edit()?.putString("state", if (fg) "fg" else "bg")?.apply() } catch (_: Throwable) {}
    }

    fun newOpId(prefix: String): String = prefix + "-" + java.lang.Long.toString(System.currentTimeMillis(), 36) + "-" + opSeq.incrementAndGet()

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ نووسین

    fun log(
        category: LogCategory, severity: LogSeverity, title: String, description: String = "",
        component: String = "", operation: String = "", status: String = "", error: String = "",
        throwable: Throwable? = null, opId: String = "", meta: Map<String, String> = emptyMap(),
        throttleKey: String? = null, throttleMs: Long = 0L
    ) {
        try {
            if (store == null) return
            var metaOut = meta
            if (throttleKey != null && throttleMs > 0) {
                val now = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
                val entry = throttle.getOrPut(throttleKey) { longArrayOf(0L, 0L) }
                synchronized(entry) {
                    if (entry[0] != 0L && now - entry[0] < throttleMs) { entry[1]++; return }
                    if (entry[1] > 0) metaOut = LinkedHashMap(meta).apply { put("similarEventsSuppressed", entry[1].toString()) }
                    entry[0] = now; entry[1] = 0
                }
                if (throttle.size > 500) throttle.clear()
            }
            val ev = make(category, severity, title, description, component, operation, status, error, throwable, opId, metaOut)
            exec.execute { try { add(ev) } catch (_: Throwable) {} }
        } catch (_: Throwable) {}
    }

    fun info(component: String, title: String, description: String = "", category: LogCategory = LogCategory.APPLICATION,
             operation: String = "", status: String = "", meta: Map<String, String> = emptyMap()) =
        log(category, LogSeverity.INFO, title, description, component, operation, status, meta = meta)

    fun success(component: String, title: String, description: String = "", category: LogCategory = LogCategory.USER_OPERATION,
                operation: String = "", opId: String = "", meta: Map<String, String> = emptyMap()) =
        log(category, LogSeverity.SUCCESS, title, description, component, operation, "SUCCESS", opId = opId, meta = meta)

    fun warn(component: String, title: String, description: String = "", category: LogCategory = LogCategory.APPLICATION,
             operation: String = "", throwable: Throwable? = null, opId: String = "", meta: Map<String, String> = emptyMap(),
             throttleKey: String? = null, throttleMs: Long = 0L) =
        log(category, LogSeverity.WARNING, title, description, component, operation, "WARNING", throwable = throwable,
            opId = opId, meta = meta, throttleKey = throttleKey, throttleMs = throttleMs)

    fun error(component: String, title: String, throwable: Throwable? = null, description: String = "",
              category: LogCategory = LogCategory.APPLICATION, operation: String = "", opId: String = "",
              meta: Map<String, String> = emptyMap(), throttleKey: String? = null, throttleMs: Long = 0L) =
        log(category, LogSeverity.ERROR, title, description, component, operation, "FAILED", throwable = throwable,
            opId = opId, meta = meta, throttleKey = throttleKey, throttleMs = throttleMs)

    private fun make(
        category: LogCategory, severity: LogSeverity, title: String, description: String, component: String,
        operation: String, status: String, error: String, throwable: Throwable?, opId: String, meta: Map<String, String>
    ): LogEvent {
        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
        val err = when {
            error.isNotBlank() -> error
            throwable != null -> throwable.javaClass.name + (throwable.message?.let { ": $it" } ?: "")
            else -> ""
        }
        val stack = throwable?.let {
            val sw = StringWriter()
            it.printStackTrace(PrintWriter(sw))
            sw.toString()
        } ?: ""
        val cleanMeta = LinkedHashMap<String, String>()
        for ((k, v) in meta) cleanMeta[k.filter { c -> c.isLetterOrDigit() || c == '_' || c == '.' || c == '-' }.take(40)] =
            LogSanitizer.clean(v, 300)
        return LogEvent(
            id = "$now-${seq.incrementAndGet()}", time = now, category = category, severity = severity,
            title = LogSanitizer.clean(title, 200), description = LogSanitizer.clean(description, 2000),
            component = LogSanitizer.clean(component, 80), operation = LogSanitizer.clean(operation, 80),
            status = LogSanitizer.clean(status, 60), error = LogSanitizer.clean(err, 1000),
            stack = LogSanitizer.clean(stack, 6000), opId = opId.take(60),
            appVersion = appVersion, platform = platform, meta = cleanMeta
        )
    }

    /** exec thread */
    private fun add(e: LogEvent) {
        val st = store ?: return
        events.add(e)
        bytes += st.sizeOf(e)
        synchronized(fileLock) { st.append(e) }
        val trimmed = st.trimmed(events, bytes)
        if (trimmed != null) {
            events.clear(); events.addAll(trimmed)
            bytes = events.sumOf { st.sizeOf(it) }
            synchronized(fileLock) { st.rewrite(events) }
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ crash

    private class CrashHandler(val prev: Thread.UncaughtExceptionHandler?) : Thread.UncaughtExceptionHandler {
        override fun uncaughtException(t: Thread, e: Throwable) {
            try { recordCrash(t, e) } catch (_: Throwable) {}
            prev?.uncaughtException(t, e)
        }
    }

    private fun installCrashHandler() {
        val prev = Thread.getDefaultUncaughtExceptionHandler()
        if (prev is CrashHandler) return
        Thread.setDefaultUncaughtExceptionHandler(CrashHandler(prev))
    }

    /** ڕاستەوخۆ و هاوکات دەنووسرێت چونکە پرۆسەکە دەمرێت */
    private fun recordCrash(t: Thread, e: Throwable) {
        val ev = make(LogCategory.CRASH, LogSeverity.CRITICAL, "Unhandled exception",
            "Uncaught exception on thread \"${t.name}\".", t.name, "crash", "CRASH", "", e, "", emptyMap())
        synchronized(fileLock) { store?.append(ev) }
        prefs?.edit()?.putBoolean("crashed", true)?.commit()
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ خوێندنەوە و سڕینەوە

    /** کۆپییەکی ئێستای هەموو ڕووداوەکان (کۆن ← نوێ)؛ callback لە main thread */
    fun snapshot(cb: (List<LogEvent>) -> Unit) {
        exec.execute {
            val copy = ArrayList(events)
            main.post { cb(copy) }
        }
    }

    /** ڕووداوەکان لە ڕام و لە فایلەکەوە ڕاستەقینە دەسڕێنەوە. cb(ژمارەی سڕاو, سەرکەوتوو) */
    fun deleteWhere(pred: (LogEvent) -> Boolean, cb: (Int, Boolean) -> Unit) {
        exec.execute {
            var removed = 0
            var ok = true
            try {
                val it = events.iterator()
                while (it.hasNext()) if (pred(it.next())) { it.remove(); removed++ }
                if (removed > 0) {
                    val st = store
                    bytes = events.sumOf { e -> st?.sizeOf(e) ?: 0L }
                    ok = synchronized(fileLock) { st?.rewrite(events) ?: false }
                }
            } catch (_: Throwable) { ok = false }
            main.post { cb(removed, ok) }
        }
    }

    fun deleteIds(ids: Set<String>, cb: (Int, Boolean) -> Unit) = deleteWhere({ it.id in ids }, cb)

    fun lastStorageError(): String? = store?.lastError
}

/** یارمەتیدەری داواکاریی تۆڕ: ژمارەی HTTP، ماوە و هەڵەکان. URL ەکان پاک دەکرێنەوە (query و کلیل دەسڕدرێنەوە). */
object NetLog {
    fun now(): Long = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()

    private fun meta(url: String, t0: Long) = mapOf("url" to LogSanitizer.url(url), "durationMs" to (now() - t0).toString())

    /** وەڵامی سەرکەوتوو (2xx)؛ بۆ ڕێگری لە زۆربوون، هەر ١٥ چرکە یەک جار */
    fun ok(component: String, op: String, url: String, code: Int, t0: Long) {
        if (code !in 200..299) return
        ActivityLog.log(LogCategory.NETWORK, LogSeverity.SUCCESS, "Network request completed",
            "Response headers received.", component, op, "HTTP $code", meta = meta(url, t0) + ("httpStatus" to code.toString()),
            throttleKey = "net-ok|$component|$op", throttleMs = 15_000)
    }

    fun fail(component: String, op: String, url: String, t0: Long, e: Throwable) {
        if (e is java.util.concurrent.CancellationException) return
        val code = (e as? ApiException)?.code
            ?: Regex("""HTTP (\d{3})""").find(e.message.orEmpty())?.groupValues?.get(1)?.toIntOrNull()
        val (title, sev) = when {
            e is SocketTimeoutException -> "Network request timed out" to LogSeverity.WARNING
            e is UnknownHostException || e is java.net.ConnectException -> "Connection failed" to LogSeverity.WARNING
            code == 429 -> "API rate limit reached" to LogSeverity.WARNING
            code != null && code >= 500 -> "Server error response" to LogSeverity.ERROR
            code != null -> "API error response" to LogSeverity.ERROR
            else -> "Network request failed" to LogSeverity.ERROR
        }
        val m = LinkedHashMap(meta(url, t0))
        if (code != null) m["httpStatus"] = code.toString()
        ActivityLog.log(LogCategory.NETWORK, sev, title, "", component, op,
            if (code != null) "HTTP $code" else "FAILED", throwable = e, meta = m,
            throttleKey = "net-fail|$component|$op|${e.javaClass.simpleName}|${code ?: 0}", throttleMs = 5_000)
    }
}

        // ---- ئاگادارییەکی inline (کۆپی، سڕینەوە...) ----
        statusText = TextView(this).apply {
            textSize = 13f; setTextColor(Color.WHITE); visibility = View.GONE
            setPadding(dp(12), dp(8), dp(12), dp(8))
            background = GradientDrawable().apply { cornerRadius = dp(12).toFloat(); setColor(pal.a1) }
        }
        col.addView(statusText, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -2).apply { bottomMargin = dp(6) })

        // ---- پشتڕاستکردنەوەی inline ----
        confirmBar = LinearLayout(this).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL; visibility = View.GONE
            setPadding(dp(12), dp(10), dp(12), dp(10))
            background = GradientDrawable().apply { cornerRadius = dp(12).toFloat(); setColor(0x33FF5C6C); setStroke(dp(1), Color.parseColor("#FF5C6C")) }
        }
        confirmText = TextView(this).apply { textSize = 13.5f; setTextColor(textMain) }
        confirmBar.addView(confirmText)
        val confirmRow = LinearLayout(this).apply { orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL }
        confirmRow.addView(actionBtn("Confirm", danger = true) {
            val run = pendingRun; pendingRun = null; confirmBar.visibility = View.GONE; run?.invoke()
        }, margin(r = dp(8), t = dp(8)))
        confirmRow.addView(actionBtn("Cancel") { pendingRun = null; confirmBar.visibility = View.GONE }, margin(t = dp(8)))
        confirmBar.addView(confirmRow)
        col.addView(confirmBar, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -2).apply { bottomMargin = dp(6) })

        // ---- گەڕان ----
        val search = EditText(this).apply {
            hint = "Search events, errors, components…"; textSize = 14f
            setTextColor(textMain); setHintTextColor(textDim)
            setSingleLine(true)
            setPadding(dp(14), dp(8), dp(14), dp(8))
            background = GradientDrawable().apply { cornerRadius = dp(14).toFloat(); setColor(cardBg); setStroke(dp(1), cardStroke) }
            addTextChangedListener(object : TextWatcher {
                override fun beforeTextChanged(s: CharSequence?, a: Int, b: Int, c: Int) {}
                override fun onTextChanged(s: CharSequence?, a: Int, b: Int, c: Int) {}
                override fun afterTextChanged(s: Editable?) {
                    query = s?.toString().orEmpty()
                    ui.removeCallbacks(searchApply); ui.postDelayed(searchApply, 200)
                }
            })
        }
        col.addView(search, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, dp(44)).apply { bottomMargin = dp(8) })

        // ---- فیلتەرەکان ----
        catRow = LinearLayout(this).apply { orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL }
        col.addView(HorizontalScrollView(this).apply { isHorizontalScrollBarEnabled = false; addView(catRow) },
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -2).apply { bottomMargin = dp(6) })
        sevRow = LinearLayout(this).apply { orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL }
        col.addView(HorizontalScrollView(this).apply { isHorizontalScrollBarEnabled = false; addView(sevRow) },
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -2).apply { bottomMargin = dp(8) })

        // ---- کردارەکان ----
        val actions = LinearLayout(this).apply { orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL }
        sortBtn = actionBtn("↓ Newest first") { newestFirst = !newestFirst; applyFilter() }
        actions.addView(sortBtn, margin(r = dp(6)))
        actions.addView(actionBtn("Copy filtered") { copyReports(shown, "filtered") }, margin(r = dp(6)))
        actions.addView(actionBtn("Copy all") { copyReports(all, "all") }, margin(r = dp(6)))
        actions.addView(actionBtn("Share") { shareReports(shown) }, margin(r = dp(6)))
        actions.addView(actionBtn("Select") { enterSelection(null) }, margin(r = dp(6)))
        actions.addView(actionBtn("Clear category", danger = true) { clearCategory() }, margin(r = dp(6)))
        actions.addView(actionBtn("Clear all", danger = true) { clearAll() }, margin(r = dp(6)))
        col.addView(HorizontalScrollView(this).apply { isHorizontalScrollBarEnabled = false; addView(actions) },
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -2).apply { bottomMargin = dp(8) })

        // ---- بارەی هەڵبژاردن ----
        selectBar = LinearLayout(this).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL; gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL; visibility = View.GONE
            setPadding(dp(10), dp(6), dp(10), dp(6))
            background = GradientDrawable().apply { cornerRadius = dp(12).toFloat(); setColor(cardBg); setStroke(dp(1), cardStroke) }
        }
        selectCount = TextView(this).apply { textSize = 13f; setTextColor(textMain) }
        selectBar.addView(selectCount, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, -2, 1f))
        selectBar.addView(actionBtn("Select all shown") { for (e in shown) selected.add(e.id); refreshSelection() }, margin(r = dp(6)))
        selectBar.addView(actionBtn("Delete selected", danger = true) { deleteSelected() }, margin(r = dp(6)))
        selectBar.addView(actionBtn("Done") { exitSelection() })
        col.addView(selectBar, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -2).apply { bottomMargin = dp(8) })

        // ---- لیست ----
        list = ListView(this).apply {
            divider = null; dividerHeight = dp(8); setSelector(android.R.color.transparent)
            adapter = this@ActivityLogsActivity.adapter
        }
        col.addView(list, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, 0, 1f))

        frame.addView(col, FrameLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -1))
        setContentView(frame)
        renderChips()
    }

    private fun renderChips() {
        catRow.removeAllViews()
        for (c in CategoryFilter.values()) catRow.addView(pill(c.label, c == cat) { cat = c; renderChips(); applyFilter() }, margin(r = dp(6)))
        sevRow.removeAllViews()
        sevRow.addView(pill("All severities", sev == null) { sev = null; renderChips(); applyFilter() }, margin(r = dp(6)))
        for (s in LogSeverity.values()) sevRow.addView(pill(s.name, s == sev) { sev = s; renderChips(); applyFilter() }, margin(r = dp(6)))
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ داتا

    private fun reload() {
        ActivityLog.snapshot { list ->
            all = list
            val ids = list.mapTo(HashSet()) { it.id }
            selected.retainAll(ids); expanded.retainAll(ids)
            applyFilter()
        }
    }

    private fun applyFilter() {
        val f = all.filter { LogFilter.matches(it, cat, sev, query) }
        shown = if (newestFirst) f.asReversed() else f
        sortBtn.text = if (newestFirst) "↓ Newest first" else "↑ Oldest first"
        adapter.notifyDataSetChanged()
        countText.text = "Saved: ${all.size}   ·   Showing: ${shown.size}"
        if (selecting) refreshSelection()
    }

    private fun say(msg: String, warn: Boolean = false) {
        (statusText.background as? GradientDrawable)?.setColor(if (warn) Color.parseColor("#B45309") else pal.a1)
        statusText.text = msg
        statusText.visibility = View.VISIBLE
        ui.removeCallbacks(statusClear)
        ui.postDelayed(statusClear, 3500)
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ کۆپی / شەیر

    private val maxClip = 150_000

    private fun report(list: List<LogEvent>) = ActivityReport.format(list, ActivityLog.appName, ActivityLog.versionLabel, System.currentTimeMillis())

    private fun copyReports(list: List<LogEvent>, what: String) {
        if (list.isEmpty()) { say("Nothing to copy", warn = true); return }
        val text = report(list)
        if (text.length > maxClip) {
            say("Too large to copy (${text.length / 1024} KB). Use Share to export it as a file.", warn = true)
            return
        }
        copyText(text, list.size)
    }

    private fun copyText(text: String, count: Int) {
        try {
            (getSystemService(Context.CLIPBOARD_SERVICE) as ClipboardManager).setPrimaryClip(ClipData.newPlainText("Activity report", text))
            say("Copied $count report${if (count == 1) "" else "s"}")
        } catch (t: Throwable) {
            say("Copy failed: ${t.message ?: t.javaClass.simpleName}", warn = true)
        }
    }

    private fun shareReports(list: List<LogEvent>) {
        if (list.isEmpty()) { say("Nothing to share", warn = true); return }
        val text = report(list)
        if (text.length <= 60_000) {
            startActivity(Intent.createChooser(Intent(Intent.ACTION_SEND).apply {
                type = "text/plain"
                putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_SUBJECT, "${ActivityLog.appName} activity report")
                putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_TEXT, text)
            }, "Share report"))
            return
        }
        say("Preparing file…")
        io.execute {
            try {
                val dir = File(cacheDir, "log_exports")
                dir.mkdirs()
                dir.listFiles()?.forEach { it.delete() }
                val f = File(dir, "activity-report-${System.currentTimeMillis()}.txt")
                f.writeText(text, Charsets.UTF_8)
                val uri = FileProvider.getUriForFile(this, "$packageName.logshare", f)
                ui.post {
                    if (isDestroyed) return@post
                    startActivity(Intent.createChooser(Intent(Intent.ACTION_SEND).apply {
                        type = "text/plain"
                        putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_STREAM, uri)
                        addFlags(Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION)
                    }, "Share report file"))
                }
            } catch (t: Throwable) {
                ui.post { say("Could not create the file: ${t.message ?: t.javaClass.simpleName}", warn = true) }
            }
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ سڕینەوە

    private fun ask(msg: String, run: () -> Unit) {
        confirmText.text = msg
        pendingRun = run
        confirmBar.visibility = View.VISIBLE
    }

    private fun afterDelete(removed: Int, ok: Boolean) {
        if (!ok) say("Deleted $removed, but local storage could not be fully updated.", warn = true)
        else say("Deleted $removed report${if (removed == 1) "" else "s"}")
        reload()
    }

    private fun deleteOne(e: LogEvent) = ask("Delete this report? It will be permanently removed from local storage.") {
        ActivityLog.deleteIds(setOf(e.id)) { n, ok -> expanded.remove(e.id); selected.remove(e.id); afterDelete(n, ok) }
    }

    private fun deleteSelected() {
        val ids = HashSet(selected)
        if (ids.isEmpty()) { say("Select at least one report", warn = true); return }
        ask("Delete ${ids.size} selected report${if (ids.size == 1) "" else "s"}? This cannot be undone.") {
            ActivityLog.deleteIds(ids) { n, ok -> exitSelection(); afterDelete(n, ok) }
        }
    }

    private fun clearCategory() {
        if (cat == CategoryFilter.ALL) { say("Choose a category first, or use Clear all", warn = true); return }
        val n = all.count { LogFilter.categoryMatches(it, cat) }
        if (n == 0) { say("No reports in ${cat.label}", warn = true); return }
        val c = cat
        ask("Clear all $n report${if (n == 1) "" else "s"} in “${c.label}”? This cannot be undone.") {
            ActivityLog.deleteWhere({ LogFilter.categoryMatches(it, c) }) { r, ok -> afterDelete(r, ok) }
        }
    }

    private fun clearAll() {
        if (all.isEmpty()) { say("There are no saved reports", warn = true); return }
        ask("Clear all ${all.size} saved reports? This cannot be undone.") {
            ActivityLog.deleteWhere({ true }) { r, ok -> exitSelection(); afterDelete(r, ok) }
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ هەڵبژاردن

    private fun enterSelection(first: String?) {
        selecting = true
        first?.let { selected.add(it) }
        selectBar.visibility = View.VISIBLE
        refreshSelection()
    }

    private fun exitSelection() {
        selecting = false
        selected.clear()
        selectBar.visibility = View.GONE
        adapter.notifyDataSetChanged()
    }

    private fun refreshSelection() {
        selectCount.text = "${selected.size} selected"
        adapter.notifyDataSetChanged()
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ لیست

    private fun detailText(e: LogEvent): String =
        ActivityReport.formatEvent(e, 0).lines().drop(3).joinToString("\n").trim()

    private fun buildHolder(): Holder {
        val root = LinearLayout(this).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
            background = GradientDrawable().apply { cornerRadius = dp(14).toFloat(); setColor(cardBg); setStroke(dp(1), cardStroke) }
        }
        val stripe = View(this)
        root.addView(stripe, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(dp(5), -1))
        val check = TextView(this).apply { textSize = 20f; setTextColor(textMain); gravity = Gravity.CENTER; visibility = View.GONE }
        root.addView(check, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(dp(34), -2).apply { gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL })
        val body = LinearLayout(this).apply { orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL; setPadding(dp(12), dp(10), dp(12), dp(10)) }
        val title = TextView(this).apply { textSize = 14.5f; typeface = Typeface.DEFAULT_BOLD; setTextColor(textMain) }
        val sub = TextView(this).apply { textSize = 11.5f; setTextColor(textDim) }
        val detail = TextView(this).apply {
            textSize = 11.5f; typeface = Typeface.MONOSPACE; setTextColor(textMain); visibility = View.GONE
            setPadding(0, dp(8), 0, dp(4))
        }
        val actions = LinearLayout(this).apply { orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL; visibility = View.GONE }
        val copy = actionBtn("Copy report") {}
        val del = actionBtn("Delete", danger = true) {}
        actions.addView(copy, margin(r = dp(8), t = dp(4)))
        actions.addView(del, margin(t = dp(4)))
        body.addView(title); body.addView(sub); body.addView(detail); body.addView(actions)
        root.addView(body, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, -2, 1f))
        return Holder(root, stripe, check, title, sub, detail, actions, copy, del)
    }

    private inner class Adapter : BaseAdapter() {
        override fun getCount() = shown.size
        override fun getItem(position: Int) = shown[position]
        override fun getItemId(position: Int) = position.toLong()

        override fun getView(position: Int, convertView: View?, parent: ViewGroup): View {
            val h = (convertView?.tag as? Holder) ?: buildHolder().also { it.root.tag = it }
            val e = shown[position]
            h.stripe.setBackgroundColor(sevColor(e.severity))
            h.title.text = e.title
            val head = SpannableStringBuilder(e.severity.name)
            head.setSpan(ForegroundColorSpan(sevColor(e.severity)), 0, head.length, Spanned.SPAN_EXCLUSIVE_EXCLUSIVE)
            head.append("  ·  ").append(e.category.name)
            if (e.component.isNotBlank()) head.append("  ·  ").append(e.component)
            head.append("\n").append(ActivityReport.time(e.time).substringBeforeLast(' '))
            h.sub.text = head
            val open = e.id in expanded
            h.detail.visibility = if (open) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE
            if (open) h.detail.text = detailText(e)
            h.actions.visibility = if (open && !selecting) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE
            h.check.visibility = if (selecting) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE
            h.check.text = if (e.id in selected) "☑" else "☐"
            h.copy.setOnClickListener { copyText(ActivityReport.format(listOf(e), ActivityLog.appName, ActivityLog.versionLabel, System.currentTimeMillis()), 1) }
            h.delete.setOnClickListener { deleteOne(e) }
            h.root.setOnClickListener {
                if (selecting) { if (!selected.add(e.id)) selected.remove(e.id); refreshSelection() }
                else { if (!expanded.add(e.id)) expanded.remove(e.id); notifyDataSetChanged() }
            }
            h.root.setOnLongClickListener { if (!selecting) enterSelection(e.id); true }
            return h.root
        }
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import android.content.Context

/**
 * فەرهەنگی وشە ناڕوونەکان (assets/ferhenga-nerun.txt).
 * وەک «ئاماژەی ڕێنمایی» بۆ Gemini بەکاردێت، نەک وەک فەرهەنگی جێگیری جێگرتنەوە:
 * تەنها ئەو وشانەی لە دەقی ئێستای شاشەدا هەن دەنێردرێن (پرۆمپت بچووک دەمێنێتەوە = خێراتر)،
 * و Gemini بەپێی ڕستەی تەواو ماناکە هەڵدەبژێرێت.
 * بەش ١ (وشە ئینگلیزییە فرەماناکان) + بەش ٤ (چەمکە بێ وەرگێڕانی ڕاستەوخۆکان) بەکاردێن.
 */
object AmbiguityGlossary {

    private class Entry(val key: String, val meanings: String, val concept: Boolean)

    @Volatile
    private var entries: List<Entry>? = null

    /** وشە زۆر باوەکان کە ئاماژەکەیان تەنها دەنگەدەنگ دروست دەکات */
    private val STOP = setOf(
        "can", "may", "just", "even", "well", "fine", "last", "long", "hard", "close",
        "live", "left", "right", "mine", "second", "fall", "case", "check", "kind",
        "mean", "present", "state", "order", "change", "match", "face", "head", "light"
    )

    private val WORD = Regex("[a-z][a-z']*")

    private fun load(ctx: Context): List<Entry> {
        entries?.let { return it }
        synchronized(this) {
            entries?.let { return it }
            val out = ArrayList<Entry>()
            try {
                ctx.applicationContext.assets.open("ferhenga-nerun.txt").bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8).useLines { lines ->
                    for (line in lines) {
                        val l = line.trim()
                        if (l.isEmpty() || l.startsWith("#")) continue
                        val p = l.split("|").map { it.trim() }
                        if (p.size < 3) continue
                        val n = p[0].toIntOrNull() ?: continue
                        val concept = n in 215..264
                        if (!(n in 1..148 || concept)) continue
                        val key = p[1].lowercase()
                        if (key.isEmpty() || key in STOP) continue
                        if (key.any { it.code > 0x24F }) continue
                        out.add(Entry(key, p[2], concept))
                    }
                }
            } catch (_: Throwable) {
            }
            entries = out
            return out
        }
    }

    /**
     * ئاماژەکانی ئەو وشانەی لە [texts] دا هەن (کۆمەڵێک دێڕ) یان "" ئەگەر هیچ نەبوو.
     * چەمکەکان (accountability...) یەکەمن، پاشان وشە درێژترەکان.
     */
    fun hintsFor(ctx: Context, texts: List<String>, max: Int = 10, maxChars: Int = 900): String {
        val all = load(ctx)
        if (all.isEmpty()) return ""
        val joined = texts.joinToString(" ").lowercase()
        if (joined.none { it in 'a'..'z' }) return ""
        val words = HashSet<String>()
        for (m in WORD.findAll(joined)) {
            val w = m.value
            words.add(w)
            if (w.length > 3 && w.endsWith("s")) words.add(w.dropLast(1))
            if (w.length > 5 && w.endsWith("ing")) words.add(w.dropLast(3))
        }
        val hits = all.filter { e ->
            if (e.key.contains(' ') || e.key.contains('-')) joined.contains(e.key) else e.key in words
        }.sortedWith(compareByDescending<Entry> { it.concept }.thenByDescending { it.key.length })
        if (hits.isEmpty()) return ""
        val sb = StringBuilder()
        for (e in hits.take(max)) {
            val line = "- ${e.key}: ${e.meanings}\n"
            if (sb.length + line.length > maxChars) break
            sb.append(line)
        }
        return sb.toString().trimEnd()
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject
import java.io.IOException
import java.net.HttpURLConnection
import java.net.URL

/**
 * وەرگێڕانی دەقی عەرەبی ← سۆرانی بە Gemini (زۆر باشتر لە Google Translate بۆ عەرەبی).
 * هەموو دەقە دۆزراوەکانی شاشە لە یەک داواکاریدا دەنێردرێن، بۆ ئەوەی Gemini ناوەڕۆکی هەموو پەڕەکە ببینێت
 * (ناوەکان و واتا یەکدەگرنەوە) و خێراتریش بێت.
 * لە thread ی پاشبنەما بانگ بکرێت. هەڵە دەگەڕێنێتەوە ئەگەر شکستی هێنا (بانگکەر دەتوانێت Google بەکاربهێنێت).
 */
object ArabicGemini {

    private const val PROMPT =
        "You translate Arabic text that was read from a phone screen by OCR (manga, webtoon, game, chat, video subtitles, app or web page) " +
            "into natural, fluent, SPOKEN Central Kurdish (Sorani, Arabic script). " +
            "The input is a JSON array of objects {\"id\": number, \"text\": string}; each object is one separate text block, in screen order, so use the other blocks as context. " +
            "The Arabic may be Modern Standard Arabic or any dialect (Egyptian, Gulf, Levantine, Iraqi, Maghrebi...), and may have small OCR mistakes or missing diacritics: infer the intended meaning. " +
            "Translate the MEANING, not word by word; keep the tone (casual, angry, formal, funny). " +
            "Use correct Sorani letters (ی ک ە ێ ۆ ڵ ڕ ڤ), never Persian/Arabic ي ك ى. " +
            "Keep names consistent as Kurdish-script transliterations. Keep numbers, emoji and Latin-script words as they are. " +
            "Write plain text only: no markdown, no numbering, no added quotation marks, no notes. " +
            "If a block is already Sorani Kurdish, copy it unchanged. " +
            "Return ONLY a JSON array of objects {\"id\": number, \"kurdish\": string}: exactly one object per input block with the SAME id. " +
            "Never merge, split, skip or add blocks; if a block is meaningless noise, return an empty string for it.\n\nInput:\n"

    private val cache = object : LinkedHashMap<String, String>(256, 0.75f, true) {
        override fun removeEldestEntry(eldest: MutableMap.MutableEntry<String, String>?) = size > 500
    }

    /** دەگەڕێتەوە لیستێک بە درێژیی هاوشێوەی `texts`. بەتاڵ = ئەو دەقە وەرنەگێڕدرا (بانگکەر بە Google وەریدەگێڕێت). */
    fun translate(texts: List<String>, keysRaw: String, fast: Boolean): List<String> {
        if (texts.isEmpty()) return emptyList()
        if (keysRaw.isBlank()) throw IOException("no Gemini key")
        val clean = texts.map { it.replace('\n', ' ').replace(Regex("\\s+"), " ").trim() }

        val result = arrayOfNulls<String>(clean.size)
        val todo = ArrayList<Int>()
        synchronized(cache) {
            for ((i, t) in clean.withIndex()) {
                val hit = cache[t]
                if (hit != null) result[i] = hit else todo.add(i)
            }
        }
        if (todo.isNotEmpty()) {
            val src = todo.map { clean[it] }
            val got = GeminiKeys.withKeys(keysRaw) { key ->
                GeminiModels.call(fast) { m, think -> post(body(src, m, think), key, m) }
            }
            val arr = parse(got, src.size)
            synchronized(cache) {
                for ((k, i) in todo.withIndex()) {
                    val out = TextPrep.finish(arr[k])
                    result[i] = out
                    if (out.isNotBlank()) cache[clean[i]] = out
                }
            }
        }
        return result.map { it ?: "" }
    }

    /**
     * دەرچوون بە `id` دەگەڕێتەوە نەک بە ڕیز: ئەگەر Gemini بلۆکێک بپەڕێنێت یان ڕیزبەندی بگۆڕێت، هەر بلۆکێک
     * تەنها بۆ خۆی دەگەڕێتەوە و بلۆکی ونبوو بەتاڵ دەمێنێتەوە (بانگکەر بە Google بۆی دەگەڕێت). ژمارەی نابەرابەر چیتر هەموو شتێک ناشکێنێت.
     */
    internal fun parse(raw: String, expected: Int): List<String> {
        val t = raw.trim().removePrefix("```json").removePrefix("```").removeSuffix("```").trim()
        val a = try {
            JSONArray(t)
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            throw IOException("Gemini JSON هەڵەیە")
        }
        val out = arrayOfNulls<String>(expected)
        var matched = 0
        for (i in 0 until a.length()) {
            val o = a.optJSONObject(i) ?: continue
            val id = o.optInt("id", -1)
            if (id < 0 || id >= expected || out[id] != null) continue   // id ی نادروست یان دووبارە
            out[id] = o.optString("kurdish", "")
            matched++
        }
        if (matched == 0) throw IOException("Gemini id ی بلۆکەکانی نەگەڕاندەوە")
        return out.map { it ?: "" }
    }

    private fun body(src: List<String>, model: String, think: Boolean): String {
        val item = JSONObject()
            .put("type", "OBJECT")
            .put(
                "properties",
                JSONObject()
                    .put("id", JSONObject().put("type", "INTEGER"))
                    .put("kurdish", JSONObject().put("type", "STRING"))
            )
            .put("required", JSONArray().put("id").put("kurdish"))
        val gen = JSONObject()
            .put("temperature", 0.3)
            .put("maxOutputTokens", 4096)
            .put("responseMimeType", "application/json")
            .put("responseSchema", JSONObject().put("type", "ARRAY").put("items", item))
        if (think) gen.put("thinkingConfig", GeminiModels.thinking(model))
        val input = JSONArray().also { a -> src.forEachIndexed { i, t -> a.put(JSONObject().put("id", i).put("text", t)) } }.toString()
        return JSONObject()
            .put(
                "contents",
                JSONArray().put(
                    JSONObject().put("parts", JSONArray().put(JSONObject().put("text", PROMPT + input)))
                )
            )
            .put("generationConfig", gen)
            .toString()
    }

    private fun post(body: String, key: String, model: String): String {
        val t0 = NetLog.now()
        val c = URL("https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/$model:generateContent")
            .openConnection() as HttpURLConnection
        try {
            c.requestMethod = "POST"
            c.connectTimeout = 8_000
            c.readTimeout = 25_000
            c.doOutput = true
            c.setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
            c.setRequestProperty("x-goog-api-key", key)
            c.outputStream.use { it.write(body.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)) }
            val code = c.responseCode
            NetLog.ok("ArabicGemini", "generateContent", c.url.toString(), code, t0)
            val resp = (if (code in 200..299) c.inputStream else c.errorStream)
                ?.bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8)?.use { it.readText() }.orEmpty()
            if (code !in 200..299) {
                val why = try {
                    JSONObject(resp).getJSONObject("error").getString("message")
                } catch (_: Exception) {
                    resp
                }
                throw ApiException(code, "Gemini $code ${why.take(140)}".trim())
            }
            return try {
                val parts = JSONObject(resp).getJSONArray("candidates").getJSONObject(0)
                    .getJSONObject("content").optJSONArray("parts")
                val sb = StringBuilder()
                if (parts != null) for (i in 0 until parts.length()) sb.append(parts.getJSONObject(i).optString("text", ""))
                sb.toString()
            } catch (_: Exception) {
                throw IOException("Gemini وەڵامی بەتاڵی دایەوە")
            }
        } catch (e: Throwable) {
            NetLog.fail("ArabicGemini", "generateContent", c.url.toString(), t0, e)
            throw e
        } finally {
            c.disconnect()
        }
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.Rect

/** ڕەنگی باگراوندی دەورووبەری دەقێک لە وێنەکەدا دەخوێنێتەوە (ڕەنگی زاڵ)، بۆ ئەوەی وەرگێڕانەکە وەک Google بەسەر بابلەکەدا بنووسرێت. */
object BgSampler {

    /** ARGB ی ڕەنگی زاڵ، یان 0 ئەگەر نەتوانرا. */
    fun sample(bmp: Bitmap, r: Rect): Int {
        return try {
            if (bmp.isRecycled) return 0
            val m = 3
            val l = (r.left - m).coerceIn(0, bmp.width - 1)
            val t = (r.top - m).coerceIn(0, bmp.height - 1)
            val rr = (r.right + m).coerceIn(0, bmp.width - 1)
            val b = (r.bottom + m).coerceIn(0, bmp.height - 1)
            if (rr <= l || b <= t) return 0
            val counts = HashMap<Int, IntArray>()  // bucket -> [n, sumR, sumG, sumB]
            fun add(x: Int, y: Int) {
                val c = bmp.getPixel(x.coerceIn(0, bmp.width - 1), y.coerceIn(0, bmp.height - 1))
                val k = ((Color.red(c) shr 4) shl 8) or ((Color.green(c) shr 4) shl 4) or (Color.blue(c) shr 4)
                val a = counts.getOrPut(k) { IntArray(4) }
                a[0]++; a[1] += Color.red(c); a[2] += Color.green(c); a[3] += Color.blue(c)
            }
            val steps = 24
            for (i in 0..steps) {
                val x = l + (rr - l) * i / steps
                val y = t + (b - t) * i / steps
                add(x, t); add(x, b); add(l, y); add(rr, y)
            }
            val best = counts.values.maxByOrNull { it[0] } ?: return 0
            Color.rgb(best[1] / best[0], best[2] / best[0], best[3] / best[0])
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
            0
        }
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import android.graphics.Bitmap
import kotlin.math.abs

/**
 * ئاشکراکردنی گۆڕانی شاشە بە "ئیمزای" وێنەیەکی ٣٢×٣٢ی خۆڵەمێشی.
 * distance() ناوەندی جیاوازی ڕووناکییە (٠ تا ٢٥٥).
 */
object ChangeDetector {

    private const val N = 32

    fun signature(src: Bitmap): IntArray {
        val small = Bitmap.createScaledBitmap(src, N, N, true)
        val px = IntArray(N * N)
        small.getPixels(px, 0, N, 0, 0, N, N)
        if (small !== src) small.recycle()
        return IntArray(N * N) { i ->
            val c = px[i]
            val r = (c shr 16) and 0xFF
            val g = (c shr 8) and 0xFF
            val b = c and 0xFF
            (r * 299 + g * 587 + b * 114) / 1000
        }
    }

    /**
     * ڕێژەی ئەو خانانەی (لە ٣٢×٣٢) کە بە ڕوونی گۆڕاون: ٠ = هیچ، ١ = هەموو شاشە.
     * بۆ ئەوە بەکاردێت کە تەنها کاتێک نوێبکرێتەوە کە بڕێکی دیاریکراوی شاشە (بۆ نموونە ٥٠٪) گۆڕابێت.
     */
    fun changedFraction(a: IntArray, b: IntArray, cellDiff: Int = 24): Float {
        var n = 0
        for (i in a.indices) if (abs(a[i] - b[i]) > cellDiff) n++
        return n.toFloat() / a.size
    }

    fun distance(a: IntArray, b: IntArray): Float {
        var sum = 0L
        for (i in a.indices) sum += abs(a[i] - b[i])
        return sum.toFloat() / a.size
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import android.animation.ValueAnimator
import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Canvas
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.Paint
import android.graphics.Path
import android.graphics.RectF
import android.graphics.Typeface
import android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable
import android.view.Gravity
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.widget.FrameLayout
import android.widget.LinearLayout
import android.widget.ScrollView
import android.widget.TextView

/** یەک هەنگاوی ڕێنمایی: چوارگۆشەی چالاک + نووسین + دەقی دەنگ (بێ ژمارە، بۆ Piper). */
class CoachStep(val target: () -> View?, val text: String, val speech: String)

/**
 * ڕێنمایی جوان (coach marks): شاشە تاریک دەبێت، ئەو بەشە ڕووناک دەکرێتەوە، و کارتێک ڕوونکردنەوە دەدات.
 * کاتێک voice = true بێت، هەر هەنگاوێک یەکسەر بە دەنگی ئۆفلاین دەخوێنرێتەوە و دوای تەواوبوون خۆی دەچێتە دواتر.
 */
class CoachOverlay(
    ctx: Context,
    private val pal: Palette,
    private val steps: List<CoachStep>,
    private val scroll: ScrollView?,
    private val voice: Boolean,
    private val onClosed: () -> Unit
) : FrameLayout(ctx) {

    private fun dp(v: Int): Float = v * resources.displayMetrics.density

    private val dim = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply { color = 0xD0000000.toInt() }
    private val ring = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        style = Paint.Style.STROKE; strokeWidth = dp(3); color = Color.WHITE
    }
    private val glow = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        style = Paint.Style.STROKE; strokeWidth = dp(10)
        color = (pal.a2 and 0x00FFFFFF) or 0x55000000
    }
    private val dimPath = Path()
    private val hole = RectF()
    private var hasHole = false
    private var holeAnim: ValueAnimator? = null
    private var idx = -1
    private var tok = 0

    private val msg = TextView(ctx).apply {
        textSize = 17f
        typeface = Typeface.DEFAULT_BOLD
        setTextColor(0xFF8AB4FF.toInt())
        gravity = Gravity.START
        setLineSpacing(0f, 1.3f)
    }
    private val counter = TextView(ctx).apply {
        textSize = 13f
        setTextColor(0xFF7C879B.toInt())
        layoutDirection = View.LAYOUT_DIRECTION_LTR
    }
    private val skipTv = TextView(ctx).apply {
        text = "تێپەڕاندن"
        textSize = 13f
        setTextColor(0xFF9DB2D6.toInt())
        setPadding(dp(12).toInt(), dp(8).toInt(), dp(12).toInt(), dp(8).toInt())
        setOnClickListener { finish() }
    }
    private val nextBtn = TextView(ctx).apply {
        textSize = 15f
        typeface = Typeface.DEFAULT_BOLD
        gravity = Gravity.CENTER
        setTextColor(0xFF8AB4FF.toInt())
        setPadding(dp(26).toInt(), dp(14).toInt(), dp(26).toInt(), dp(14).toInt())
        background = GradientDrawable().apply {
            cornerRadius = dp(16); setColor(0xFF161C28.toInt())
        }
        setOnClickListener { go(idx + 1) }
    }
    private val card = LinearLayout(ctx).apply {
        orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
        layoutDirection = View.LAYOUT_DIRECTION_RTL
        setPadding(dp(22).toInt(), dp(22).toInt(), dp(22).toInt(), dp(18).toInt())
        background = GradientDrawable().apply {
            cornerRadius = dp(28); setColor(0xF2090B10.toInt()); setStroke(dp(1).toInt(), 0xFF2B3140.toInt())
        }
        alpha = 0f
    }

    init {
        isClickable = true
        setWillNotDraw(false)
        layoutDirection = View.LAYOUT_DIRECTION_RTL

        card.addView(msg, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -2).apply { bottomMargin = dp(18).toInt() })
        val row = LinearLayout(ctx).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
        }
        row.addView(counter)
        row.addView(skipTv)
        row.addView(View(ctx), LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, 1, 1f))
        row.addView(nextBtn)
        card.addView(row, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -2))
        addView(card, FrameLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -2).apply {
            gravity = Gravity.TOP
            leftMargin = dp(20).toInt(); rightMargin = dp(20).toInt()
        })
    }

    fun start() = go(0)

    /** ئایکۆنی دووبارەکردنەوە: هەنگاوی ئێستا دووبارە دەخوێنێتەوە. */
    fun replay() {
        if (idx in steps.indices) speakStep(idx, voice)
    }

    fun finish() {
        tok++
        holeAnim?.cancel()
        Narrator.stop()
        (parent as? ViewGroup)?.removeView(this)
        onClosed()
    }

    private fun go(i: Int) {
        if (i >= steps.size) { finish(); return }
        idx = i
        val my = ++tok
        Narrator.stop()
        val st = steps[i]
        msg.text = st.text
        counter.text = "${i + 1} / ${steps.size}"
        nextBtn.text = if (i == steps.size - 1) "تەواو" else "دواتر"
        card.animate().alpha(0f).setDuration(120).start()

        val t = st.target()
        var wait = 90L
        val sc = scroll
        if (t != null && sc != null && isInside(t, sc) && sc.childCount > 0) {
            val y = topInScroll(t, sc)
            val maxScroll = maxOf(0, sc.getChildAt(0).height - sc.height)
            val desired = (y - (sc.height - t.height) / 3).coerceIn(0, maxScroll)
            if (Math.abs(desired - sc.scrollY) > 4) {
                sc.smoothScrollTo(0, desired)
                wait = 480L
            }
        }
        postDelayed({
            if (my != tok) return@postDelayed
            val r = if (t != null && t.isShown) targetRect(t) else null
            animateHole(r)
            placeCard(r)
            card.animate().alpha(1f).setDuration(220).start()
            if (voice) speakStep(i, true)
        }, wait)
    }

    private fun speakStep(i: Int, advance: Boolean) {
        val my = ++tok
        Narrator.speak(context, steps[i].speech) { ok ->
            if (my == tok && advance) {
                postDelayed({ if (my == tok) go(i + 1) }, if (ok) 1300L else 5000L)
            }
        }
    }

    private fun isInside(t: View, sc: ScrollView): Boolean {
        var p = t.parent
        while (p != null) {
            if (p === sc) return true
            p = p.parent
        }
        return false
    }

    private fun topInScroll(t: View, sc: ScrollView): Int {
        val content = sc.getChildAt(0)
        var y = 0
        var v: View = t
        while (v !== content) {
            y += v.top
            v = v.parent as? View ?: break
        }
        return y
    }

    private fun targetRect(t: View): RectF {
        val a = IntArray(2)
        val b = IntArray(2)
        t.getLocationInWindow(a)
        getLocationInWindow(b)
        val pad = dp(6)
        val l = (a[0] - b[0]).toFloat()
        val tp = (a[1] - b[1]).toFloat()
        return RectF(l - pad, tp - pad, l + t.width + pad, tp + t.height + pad)
    }

    private fun animateHole(to: RectF?) {
        holeAnim?.cancel()
        if (to == null) { hasHole = false; invalidate(); return }
        val from = if (hasHole) RectF(hole) else RectF(to.centerX(), to.centerY(), to.centerX(), to.centerY())
        hasHole = true
        holeAnim = ValueAnimator.ofFloat(0f, 1f).apply {
            duration = 320
            addUpdateListener {
                val f = it.animatedValue as Float
                hole.set(
                    from.left + (to.left - from.left) * f,
                    from.top + (to.top - from.top) * f,
                    from.right + (to.right - from.right) * f,
                    from.bottom + (to.bottom - from.bottom) * f
                )
                invalidate()
            }
            start()
        }
    }

    private fun placeCard(target: RectF?) {
        card.measure(
            View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(width - dp(40).toInt(), View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY),
            View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(0, View.MeasureSpec.UNSPECIFIED)
        )
        val h = card.measuredHeight.toFloat()
        val bottomLimit = height - dp(104)
        val y = if (target == null) (height - h) / 2f else {
            var yy = target.bottom + dp(18)
            if (yy + h > bottomLimit) yy = target.top - h - dp(18)
            yy
        }
        card.translationY = y.coerceIn(dp(28), maxOf(dp(28), bottomLimit - h))
    }

    override fun dispatchDraw(canvas: Canvas) {
        dimPath.reset()
        dimPath.fillType = Path.FillType.EVEN_ODD
        dimPath.addRect(0f, 0f, width.toFloat(), height.toFloat(), Path.Direction.CW)
        if (hasHole && hole.width() > 1f) {
            val rad = minOf(dp(18), minOf(hole.width(), hole.height()) / 2f)
            dimPath.addRoundRect(hole, rad, rad, Path.Direction.CW)
            canvas.drawPath(dimPath, dim)
            canvas.drawRoundRect(hole, rad, rad, glow)
            canvas.drawRoundRect(hole, rad, rad, ring)
        } else {
            canvas.drawPath(dimPath, dim)
        }
        super.dispatchDraw(canvas)
    }
}
