package com.mangatranslator.app

import android.content.Context
import android.util.Log
import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject
import java.io.IOException
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch
import java.util.concurrent.Executors

/**
 * وەرگێڕانی دەقی OCR → سۆرانی بە Gemini، بۆ هەموو زمانەکان (ئینگلیزی، جاپانی، چینی، کۆری، عەرەبی، هیندی، خۆکار).
 *
 *  - هەموو بابلەکانی شاشە لە یەک داواکاریدا دەنێردرێن، بۆ ئەوەی Gemini ڕستەی تەواو و دراوسێکان ببینێت
 *    (ڕێگری لە وەرگێڕانی وشە بە وشە و ماناگۆڕینی وشە فرەماناکان).
 *  - هەر بابڵێک ژمارەی خۆی (i) هەیە: ئەگەر مۆدێل بابڵێک بپەڕێنێت، تەنها ئەو یەک بابڵە دەچێتە یەدەگ (Google)، نەک هەمووی.
 *  - stream: هەر بابڵێک هەر کە ئامادە بوو لەسەر شاشە دەردەکەوێت.
 *  - فەرهەنگی وشە ناڕوونەکان وەک ئاماژەی ڕێنمایی (نەک جێگرتنەوە) دەنێردرێت.
 * لە thread ی پاشبنەما بانگ بکرێت.
 */
object ContextTranslator {

    private const val TAG = "ContextTranslator"
    private const val CHUNK_ITEMS = 28
    private const val CHUNK_CHARS = 3500

    /** ڕێساکانی وەرگێڕان: بۆ وەرگێڕانی دەق (لێرە) و بۆ پرۆمپتی وێنەی ڕووبەر (RegionTranslator) هاوبەشن */
    const val VISION_RULES =
        "Translate the MEANING of each whole sentence in context, never word by word or literally. " +
            "Words with several unrelated meanings (bank, light, spring, bat, match, bar, fan, ring, scale, plant...) must be understood " +
            "from the whole sentence and the neighbouring blocks; if still unclear prefer the meaning that fits manga, comics, stories or app screens. " +
            "If one sentence continues across consecutive blocks, still output one item per block but make them read naturally together. " +
            "Abstract or modern concepts (accountability, privacy, burnout, user-friendly...) get a natural Kurdish equivalent that carries the idea, not a literal calque. "

    private val SYSTEM =
        "You are a professional translator into natural, fluent, SPOKEN Central Kurdish (Sorani, Arabic script). " +
            "The input is text read by OCR from ONE phone screen (manga, comics, webtoons, games, chat, video subtitles, apps, web pages). " +
            "It is a JSON array of {\"i\": number, \"t\": text}; every item is a separate text block in reading order and the blocks are context for each other.\n" +
            "RULES:\n" +
            "1. " + VISION_RULES + "Keep the tone (casual, angry, formal, funny, shouting).\n" +
            "2. OCR may have small mistakes (missing letters, look-alike characters, missing diacritics, hyphenated line breaks): infer the intended text. Arabic may be Modern Standard or any dialect.\n" +
            "3. Use correct Sorani letters (ی ک ە ێ ۆ ڵ ڕ ڤ), never Arabic/Persian ي ك ى. Keep names consistent as Kurdish-script transliterations. Keep numbers, emoji and Latin-script brand names unchanged.\n" +
            "4. Sound effects: a short natural Kurdish equivalent, or keep as is.\n" +
            "5. If a block is already Sorani Kurdish, copy it unchanged. If it is Sorani written in Latin letters, write the same sentence in Sorani script by meaning.\n" +
            "6. If a block is only noise (watermark, page number, stray symbols, UI button), return an empty string for it.\n" +
            "7. Optional disambiguation hints may follow: use a hint only when its meaning fits the context; never output the hint lists.\n" +
            "OUTPUT: only a JSON array with exactly one {\"i\", \"t\"} object per input item, same i values. Never merge, split, skip or add items."

    private val SCHEMA: JSONObject = JSONObject()
        .put("type", "ARRAY")
        .put(
            "items", JSONObject()
                .put("type", "OBJECT")
                .put(
                    "properties", JSONObject()
                        .put("i", JSONObject().put("type", "INTEGER"))
                        .put("t", JSONObject().put("type", "STRING"))
                )
                .put("required", JSONArray().put("i").put("t"))
        )

    private val WS = Regex("\\s+")

    private val cache = object : LinkedHashMap<String, String>(256, 0.75f, true) {
        override fun removeEldestEntry(eldest: MutableMap.MutableEntry<String, String>?) = size > 600
    }

    private fun langName(lang: String) = when (lang) {
        "en" -> "English"
        "ar" -> "Arabic"
        "ja" -> "Japanese (manga text may come from vertical lettering)"
        "zh" -> "Chinese"
        "ko" -> "Korean"
        "hi" -> "Hindi"
        else -> "unknown; detect it for each block (may be mixed)"
    }

    /** کلیلی cache: دەق + دراوسێکانی (چونکە هەمان وشە لە چوارچێوەی جیاواز مانای جیاوازە) */
    private fun cacheKey(lang: String, clean: List<String>, i: Int): String =
        "$lang|${clean.getOrNull(i - 1).orEmpty().hashCode()}|${clean[i]}|${clean.getOrNull(i + 1).orEmpty().hashCode()}"

    /**
     * دەگەڕێتەوە لیستێک بە درێژیی [texts]:
     *   دەق = وەرگێڕدراو، "" = ڕاگەیاندنی مۆدێل کە ئەوە دەق نییە (noise)، null = وەرنەگێڕدرا (بانگکەر Google بەکاربهێنێت).
     * [onItem] لە هەر thread ێکەوە بانگ دەکرێت هەر کە بابڵێک ئامادە بوو (index ی ناو [texts]).
     * هەڵە فڕێدەدات تەنها ئەگەر هیچ بابڵێک وەرنەگێڕدرابێت.
     */
    fun translate(
        ctx: Context,
        texts: List<String>,
        lang: String,
        keysRaw: String,
        fast: Boolean,
        strict: Boolean = false,
        onItem: (Int, String) -> Unit
    ): List<String?> {
        if (keysRaw.isBlank()) throw IOException("no Gemini key")
        val clean = texts.map { it.replace('\n', ' ').replace(WS, " ").trim() }
        val result = arrayOfNulls<String>(clean.size)
        val todo = ArrayList<Int>()
        for ((i, t) in clean.withIndex()) {
            if (t.isEmpty() || (t.length < 2 && !TextPrep.hasCjk(t))) {
                result[i] = ""
                continue
            }
            val hit = synchronized(cache) { cache[cacheKey(lang, clean, i)] }
            if (hit != null) {
                result[i] = hit
                onItem(i, hit)
            } else todo.add(i)
        }
        if (todo.isEmpty()) return result.toList()

        // دابەشکردن بۆ پارچەی گونجاو (بەزۆری تەنها یەک پارچە)
        val chunks = ArrayList<List<Int>>()
        var cur = ArrayList<Int>()
        var chars = 0
        for (i in todo) {
            if (cur.isNotEmpty() && (cur.size >= CHUNK_ITEMS || chars + clean[i].length > CHUNK_CHARS)) {
                chunks.add(cur); cur = ArrayList(); chars = 0
            }
            cur.add(i)
            chars += clean[i].length
        }
        if (cur.isNotEmpty()) chunks.add(cur)

        var firstError: Throwable? = null
        if (chunks.size == 1) {
            firstError = runChunk(ctx, clean, chunks[0], lang, keysRaw, fast, result, strict, onItem)
        } else {
            val errs = java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentLinkedQueue<Throwable>()
            val latch = CountDownLatch(chunks.size)
            val pool = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(chunks.size.coerceAtMost(3))
            try {
                for (c in chunks) pool.execute {
                    try {
                        runChunk(ctx, clean, c, lang, keysRaw, fast, result, strict, onItem)?.let { errs.add(it) }
                    } finally {
                        latch.countDown()
                    }
                }
                latch.await()
            } finally {
                pool.shutdownNow()
            }
            firstError = errs.peek()
        }

        if (strict && firstError != null) throw (firstError as? IOException ?: IOException(firstError.message, firstError))
        if (strict && todo.any { result[it] == null }) throw IOException("Gemini: وەرگێڕانەکە ناتەواوە")
        val delivered = todo.count { result[it] != null }
        if (delivered == 0 && firstError != null) throw (firstError as? IOException ?: IOException(firstError.message, firstError))
        return result.toList()
    }

    /** یەک پارچە. null = سەرکەوت (یان بەشێکی سەرکەوت)؛ Throwable = هەڵە */
    private fun runChunk(
        ctx: Context,
        clean: List<String>,
        idx: List<Int>,
        lang: String,
        keysRaw: String,
        fast: Boolean,
        result: Array<String?>,
        strict: Boolean,
        onItem: (Int, String) -> Unit
    ): Throwable? {
        val input = JSONArray()
        idx.forEachIndexed { k, g -> input.put(JSONObject().put("i", k).put("t", clean[g])) }
        val hints = try { AmbiguityGlossary.hintsFor(ctx, idx.map { clean[it] }) } catch (_: Throwable) { "" }
        val user = buildString {
            append("Source language: ").append(langName(lang)).append('\n')
            if (hints.isNotEmpty()) append("Disambiguation hints (only if the meaning fits):\n").append(hints).append('\n')
            append("Input:\n").append(input.toString())
        }

        fun body(model: String, think: Boolean): String {
            val gen = JSONObject()
                .put("temperature", 0.2)
                .put("maxOutputTokens", 4096)
                .put("responseMimeType", "application/json")
                .put("responseSchema", SCHEMA)
            if (think) gen.put("thinkingConfig", GeminiModels.thinking(model))
            return JSONObject()
                .put("systemInstruction", JSONObject().put("parts", JSONArray().put(JSONObject().put("text", SYSTEM))))
                .put(
                    "contents",
                    JSONArray().put(
                        JSONObject().put("role", "user")
                            .put("parts", JSONArray().put(JSONObject().put("text", user)))
                    )
                )
                .put("generationConfig", gen)
                .toString()
        }

        val got = BooleanArray(idx.size)
        return try {
            GeminiKeys.withKeys(keysRaw) { key ->
                GeminiModels.call(fast, quotaSensitive = strict) { m, think ->
                    RegionTranslator.streamPost(body(m, think), key, m) { o ->
                        val k = o.optInt("i", -1)
                        if (k in idx.indices && !got[k]) {
                            got[k] = true
                            val g = idx[k]
                            val out = TextPrep.finish(o.optString("t", ""))
                            result[g] = out
                            if (out.isNotBlank()) {
                                synchronized(cache) { cache[cacheKey(lang, clean, g)] = out }
                            }
                            if (strict || out.isNotBlank()) onItem(g, out)
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (got.any { !it }) Log.w(TAG, "model skipped ${got.count { !it }}/${idx.size} blocks → fallback")
            null
        } catch (t: Throwable) {
            Log.w(TAG, "Gemini text translate failed: ${t.message}")
            t
        }
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import android.app.ActivityManager
import android.content.Context

/**
 * دۆزینەوەی مۆبایلی ڕامی کەم (٤ یان ٦ گیگ و خاو).
 * هەموو بەشەکانی تر `DeviceProfile.low` دەپرسن و لەسەر ئەو بنەمایە سووکتر کار دەکەن.
 * تەنها یەکجار لە OverlayService/MainActivity بە `init(ctx)` ئامادە دەکرێت.
 */
object DeviceProfile {
    @Volatile private var cached: Boolean? = null

    /** true = مۆبایلی ڕامی کەم؛ ئەگەر init نەکرابێت false */
    val low: Boolean get() = cached ?: false

    fun init(ctx: Context) {
        if (cached != null) return
        refresh(ctx)
    }

    /** دوای گۆڕینی ڕێکخستنەکە دووبارە بانگ بکرێت */
    fun refresh(ctx: Context) {
        val app = ctx.applicationContext
        cached = when (TranslatorSettings(app).lowRamMode) {
            1 -> true
            2 -> false
            else -> detect(app)
        }
    }

    private fun detect(ctx: Context): Boolean = try {
        val am = ctx.getSystemService(Context.ACTIVITY_SERVICE) as ActivityManager
        val mi = ActivityManager.MemoryInfo()
        am.getMemoryInfo(mi)
        // مۆبایلی ٦ گیگ نزیکەی ٥.٥ گیگ نیشان دەدات، ٨ گیگ نزیکەی ٧.٤؛ سنوور = ٦.٨ گیگ
        am.isLowRamDevice || mi.totalMem <= 6_800_000_000L
    } catch (_: Throwable) {
        false
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import android.annotation.SuppressLint
import android.media.AudioFormat
import android.media.AudioRecord
import android.media.MediaRecorder
import android.media.audiofx.NoiseSuppressor
import android.util.Base64
import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
import java.io.IOException
import java.net.HttpURLConnection
import java.net.URL
import java.nio.ByteBuffer
import java.nio.ByteOrder

/**
 * قسەکردن بە کوردی ← نووسین (سۆرانی، پیتی عەرەبی) بە Gemini.
 * start() مایک دەکاتەوە؛ stop() دەنگەکە دەگەڕێنێتەوە؛ transcribe() دەیکات بە دەق.
 */
class Dictation {
    @Volatile
    private var rec: AudioRecord? = null
    private var thread: Thread? = null
    private val buf = ByteArrayOutputStream()
    private var ns: NoiseSuppressor? = null

    @Volatile
    var recording = false
        private set

    /** `onLimit` کاتێک بانگ دەکرێت کە ٦٠ چرکە تەواو بوو (خۆکارانە دەوەستێت). */
    @SuppressLint("MissingPermission")
    fun start(onLimit: () -> Unit): Boolean {
        if (recording) return true
        val min = AudioRecord.getMinBufferSize(RATE, AudioFormat.CHANNEL_IN_MONO, AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_16BIT)
        if (min <= 0) return false
        val r = try {
            AudioRecord(
                MediaRecorder.AudioSource.VOICE_RECOGNITION, RATE,
                AudioFormat.CHANNEL_IN_MONO, AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_16BIT, min * 4
            )
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
            return false
        }
        if (r.state != AudioRecord.STATE_INITIALIZED) {
            r.release()
            return false
        }
        buf.reset()
        try {
            r.startRecording()
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
            r.release()
            return false
        }
        rec = r
        recording = true
        thread = Thread {
            val chunk = ByteArray(4096)
            val maxBytes = RATE * 2 * MAX_SECONDS
            var cur = r
            var total = 0
            var peak = 0
            var checked = false
            while (recording) {
                val n = cur.read(chunk, 0, chunk.size)
                if (n > 0) synchronized(buf) { buf.write(chunk, 0, n) }
                if (n < 0) break
                if (n > 0 && !checked) {
                    total += n
                    var i = 0
                    while (i + 1 < n) {
                        val v = Math.abs((chunk[i + 1].toInt() shl 8) or (chunk[i].toInt() and 0xFF))
                        if (v > peak) peak = v
                        i += 2
                    }
                    // یەک چرکە تەواو بێدەنگ = سەرچاوەی VOICE_RECOGNITION لەسەر ئەم مۆبایلە کار ناکات ← MIC تاقی بکەرەوە
                    if (total >= RATE * 2) {
                        checked = true
                        if (peak == 0) {
                            val alt = openRecorder(MediaRecorder.AudioSource.MIC)
                            if (alt != null) {
                                try { cur.stop() } catch (_: Exception) {}
                                cur.release()
                                cur = alt
                                rec = alt
                                synchronized(buf) { buf.reset() }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (synchronized(buf) { buf.size() } >= maxBytes) {
                    recording = false
                    onLimit()
                    break
                }
            }
        }.also { it.start() }
        return true
    }

    @SuppressLint("MissingPermission")
    private fun openRecorder(source: Int): AudioRecord? {
        val min = AudioRecord.getMinBufferSize(RATE, AudioFormat.CHANNEL_IN_MONO, AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_16BIT)
        if (min <= 0) return null
        return try {
            val a = AudioRecord(source, RATE, AudioFormat.CHANNEL_IN_MONO, AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_16BIT, min * 4)
            if (a.state != AudioRecord.STATE_INITIALIZED) { a.release(); return null }
            a.startRecording()
            // پاککەرەوەی دەنگی دەوروبەری ئەندرۆید (ئەگەر مۆبایلەکە هەیبێت)
            try {
                ns?.release()
                ns = if (NoiseSuppressor.isAvailable()) NoiseSuppressor.create(a.audioSessionId)?.also { it.enabled = true } else null
            } catch (_: Throwable) { ns = null }
            a
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
            null
        }
    }

    /** مایک دادەخات و دەنگی گیراو (PCM16 16kHz) دەگەڕێنێتەوە. */
    fun stop(): ByteArray {
        recording = false
        try {
            thread?.join(500)
        } catch (_: Exception) {
        }
        thread = null
        rec?.let {
            try {
                it.stop()
            } catch (_: Exception) {
            }
            it.release()
        }
        rec = null
        try { ns?.release() } catch (_: Throwable) {}
        ns = null
        // دەنگی نزمی بەردەوامی دەوروبەر (با، ئامێر، گەڕانی ئۆتۆمبێل) لادەبرێت پێش ناردن بۆ هەر دوو مۆدێل
        return denoise(synchronized(buf) { buf.toByteArray() })
    }

    fun cancel() {
        stop()
    }

    companion object {
        private const val RATE = 16000
        private const val MAX_SECONDS = 60

        private const val PROMPT =
            "You are a professional Central Kurdish (Sorani) speech-to-text transcriber. " +
                "The audio is a person speaking Sorani Kurdish (Kurdistan Region of Iraq). The speaker may mix in English words, " +
                "names, brands, game titles or numbers. Transcribe EXACTLY what was said, word for word, in the speaker's own words, in " +
                "Arabic script (use ی ک ە ێ ۆ ڵ ڕ وو correctly; use ی not ي, ک not ك, ە not ه where needed). " +
                "The speaker may be poorly educated and speak colloquially or in a local dialect (Hawleri, Slemani, Garmiyan, Kirkuki...), with contractions, dropped sounds, non-standard grammar and borrowed Arabic/Persian/Turkish/English words. Write the words exactly as the speaker pronounced them: do NOT correct grammar, do NOT replace colloquial or dialect words with formal standard ones, do NOT add or remove words. " +
                "Write English words in the Latin alphabet as spoken (e.g. Player, GTA, RockStar), and numbers as digits. " +
                "When a person's name, place or brand is spoken, write it phonetically exactly as heard in Kurdish script (e.g. ئەحمەد، ڕێبین، دیلان); never replace a name with a similar common word, never translate it, never drop it. "+
                "Common Arabic/Islamic phrases used in Kurdish speech must be written in their standard spelling, e.g. السلام علیکم، وعلیکم السلام، ئینشائەڵڵا، ماشائەڵڵا، سوپاس، الحمدلله، بسم الله، نەخێر؛ never turn them into unrelated Kurdish words. "+
                "Add natural punctuation (، . ؟). Do not translate, summarize, explain or add anything. " +
                "Ignore background noise and music. Return ONLY the transcript text. If there is no clear speech, return an empty string."

        private fun vocabLine(vocab: String) =
            if (vocab.isBlank()) "" else " Reference spelling list of common Sorani words, names, places and brands (use ONLY as a spelling guide): " +
                "if a spoken word clearly sounds like a word in this list, write it with EXACTLY that spelling. " +
                "Never insert a word from the list that was not actually spoken, never force a list word over what the speaker really said, " +
                "and keep writing any other word as heard. List: " + vocab + "."

        private fun namesLine(names: List<String>) =
            if (names.isEmpty()) "" else " The speaker often says these names; whenever a spoken word sounds like one of them, write it with EXACTLY this spelling: " +
                names.joinToString("، ") + "."

        /** دەنگ بەرز دەکاتەوە بۆ ئاستی باش (نۆرماڵکردن) تا مۆدێل باشتر بیبیستێت. */
        /**
         * فیلتەری high-pass ی ٤ پلە (Butterworth، ١٨٠Hz): دەنگە نزمەکانی دەوروبەر لادەبات (<١٨٠Hz)
         * کە قسەی مرۆڤی تێدا نییە. هەروەها DC لادەبات. دەنگی قسە (٣٠٠–٣٤٠٠Hz) نەگۆڕدراو دەمێنێتەوە.
         */
        internal fun denoise(pcm: ByteArray): ByteArray {
            val n = pcm.size / 2
            if (n < 64) return pcm
            val inb = ByteBuffer.wrap(pcm).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
            val x = DoubleArray(n) { inb.getShort(it * 2).toDouble() }
            for (q in doubleArrayOf(0.5412, 1.3066)) highPass(x, 180.0, q)
            val out = ByteBuffer.allocate(pcm.size).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
            for (i in 0 until n) out.putShort(Math.round(x[i]).coerceIn(-32768L, 32767L).toInt().toShort())
            return out.array()
        }

        private fun highPass(x: DoubleArray, fc: Double, q: Double) {
            val w0 = 2.0 * Math.PI * fc / RATE
            val cs = Math.cos(w0)
            val alpha = Math.sin(w0) / (2.0 * q)
            val a0 = 1.0 + alpha
            val b0 = (1.0 + cs) / 2.0 / a0
            val b1 = -(1.0 + cs) / a0
            val a1 = -2.0 * cs / a0
            val a2 = (1.0 - alpha) / a0
            var x1 = 0.0; var x2 = 0.0; var y1 = 0.0; var y2 = 0.0
            for (i in x.indices) {
                val xi = x[i]
                val y = b0 * xi + b1 * x1 + b0 * x2 - a1 * y1 - a2 * y2
                x2 = x1; x1 = xi; y2 = y1; y1 = y
                x[i] = y
            }
        }

        private fun normalize(pcm: ByteArray): ByteArray {
            val n = pcm.size / 2
            val bb = ByteBuffer.wrap(pcm).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
            var peak = 1
            for (i in 0 until n) { val v = Math.abs(bb.getShort(i * 2).toInt()); if (v > peak) peak = v }
            // ئاستی قسەکە بە RMS ی فرەیمە بەرزەکان (نەک تەنها لووتکە) تا دەنگی دەوروبەر زۆر بەرز نەکرێتەوە
            val fl = 320
            val nf = n / fl
            var gRms = 8f
            if (nf >= 5) {
                val r = FloatArray(nf) { f ->
                    var sum = 0.0
                    for (i in f * fl until (f + 1) * fl) { val v = bb.getShort(i * 2).toDouble(); sum += v * v }
                    Math.sqrt(sum / fl).toFloat()
                }
                r.sort()
                gRms = (5000f / r[(nf * 0.9f).toInt().coerceAtMost(nf - 1)].coerceAtLeast(1f)).coerceAtLeast(1f)
            }
            val g = minOf(20000f / peak, gRms).coerceIn(1f, 8f)
            if (g <= 1.05f) return pcm
            val out = ByteBuffer.allocate(pcm.size).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
            for (i in 0 until n) out.putShort((bb.getShort(i * 2) * g).toInt().coerceIn(-32768, 32767).toShort())
            return out.array()
        }

        /** WAV ی نۆرماڵکراو بە base64، بۆ ناردنی دەنگ بۆ Gemini (چاککردنی دەستی). */
        fun wavBase64(pcm: ByteArray): String = Base64.encodeToString(wav(normalize(pcm)), Base64.NO_WRAP)

        private fun wav(pcm: ByteArray): ByteArray {
            val h = ByteBuffer.allocate(44).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
            h.put("RIFF".toByteArray()).putInt(36 + pcm.size).put("WAVE".toByteArray())
            h.put("fmt ".toByteArray()).putInt(16).putShort(1).putShort(1)
                .putInt(RATE).putInt(RATE * 2).putShort(2).putShort(16)
            h.put("data".toByteArray()).putInt(pcm.size)
            return h.array() + pcm
        }

        /** لە thread ی پاشبنەما بانگ بکرێت. بەتاڵ = هیچ قسەیەک نەبوو. */
        fun transcribe(pcm: ByteArray, keysRaw: String, names: List<String> = emptyList(), vocab: String = ""): String {
            if (pcm.size < RATE * 2 / 2) return ""   // کەمتر لە نیو چرکە
            val b64 = Base64.encodeToString(wav(normalize(pcm)), Base64.NO_WRAP)
            fun body(model: String, think: Boolean, cache: String?): String {
                val gen = JSONObject().put("temperature", 0)
                if (think) gen.put("thinkingConfig", GeminiModels.thinking(model))
                val o = JSONObject()
                    .put(
                        "contents",
                        JSONArray().put(
                            JSONObject().put("role", "user").put(
                                "parts",
                                JSONArray()
                                    .put(JSONObject().put("inlineData", JSONObject().put("mimeType", "audio/wav").put("data", b64)))
                                    .put(JSONObject().put("text", PROMPT + namesLine(names)))
                            )
                        )
                    )
                    .put("generationConfig", gen)
                if (cache != null) o.put("cachedContent", cache)
                return o.toString()
            }
            return GeminiKeys.withKeys(keysRaw) { key ->
                GeminiModels.call(false) { m, think ->
                    val cn = cacheFor(key, m, vocab)
                    try {
                        post(body(m, think, cn), key, m)
                    } catch (e: ApiException) {
                        // کاشەکە بەسەرچووە یان نەماوە ← یەک جار نوێی بکەرەوە و دووبارە هەوڵ بدە
                        val cacheProblem = cn != null && (e.code == 404 || e.code == 403 ||
                            (e.code == 400 && (e.message ?: "").contains("cache", true)))
                        if (!cacheProblem) throw e
                        caches.remove("$key|$m")
                        post(body(m, think, cacheFor(key, m, vocab)), key, m)
                    }
                }
            }.trim()
        }

        // ───────── کاشی فەرهەنگ (Gemini context caching) ─────────
        // لیستی وشەکان تەنها یەک جار دەنێردرێت و لای Gemini دەپارێزرێت؛ هەر دەنگێک تەنها ناوی کاشەکە دەنێرێت.
        // بۆ هەر (کلیل + مۆدێل) کاشێکی جیا؛ دوای ١٢ کاتژمێر یان دووبارە کردنەوەی ئەپ، یەک جار نوێ دەکرێتەوە.
        private const val CACHE_TTL_SEC = 12 * 3600
        private val caches = java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap<String, Pair<String, Long>>()
        private val noCache = java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet<String>()

        /**
         * لە کاتی قسەکردنی بەکارهێنەر (پێش ناردنی دەنگ) کاشی فەرهەنگ و پەیوەندیی TLS ئامادە دەکات،
         * بۆ ئەوەی دوای وەستان ئەو داواکارییە زیادەیە چاوەڕێ نەکرێت.
         */
        fun warmUp(keysRaw: String, vocab: String) {
            if (keysRaw.isBlank()) return
            Thread {
                try {
                    val key = GeminiKeys.withKeys(keysRaw) { it }
                    if (vocab.isNotBlank()) cacheFor(key, GeminiModels.firstModel(false), vocab)
                } catch (_: Throwable) {}
            }.start()
        }

        private fun cacheFor(key: String, model: String, vocab: String): String? {
            if (vocab.isBlank()) return null
            val id = "$key|$model"
            if (id in noCache) return null
            val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
            caches[id]?.let { if (now < it.second) return it.first }
            return try {
                val name = createCache(key, model, vocab)
                caches[id] = name to (now + (CACHE_TTL_SEC - 600) * 1000L)
                name
            } catch (e: ApiException) {
                // ئەم مۆدێلە کاش پشتگیری ناکات یان لیستەکە زۆر کورتە ← بێ لیست بەردەوام بە
                if (e.code == 400 || e.code == 403 || e.code == 404) noCache.add(id)
                null
            } catch (_: Throwable) {
                null
            }
        }

        private fun createCache(key: String, model: String, vocab: String): String {
            val body = JSONObject()
                .put("model", "models/$model")
                .put("ttl", "${CACHE_TTL_SEC}s")
                .put(
                    "contents",
                    JSONArray()
                        .put(JSONObject().put("role", "user").put("parts", JSONArray().put(JSONObject().put("text", vocabLine(vocab)))))
                        .put(JSONObject().put("role", "model").put("parts", JSONArray().put(JSONObject().put("text", "OK"))))
                )
                .toString()
            val t0 = NetLog.now()
            val c = URL("https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/cachedContents")
                .openConnection() as HttpURLConnection
            try {
                c.requestMethod = "POST"
                c.connectTimeout = 15_000
                c.readTimeout = 30_000
                c.doOutput = true
                c.setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
                c.setRequestProperty("x-goog-api-key", key)
                c.outputStream.use { it.write(body.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)) }
                val code = c.responseCode
                NetLog.ok("Dictation", "cachedContents", c.url.toString(), code, t0)
                val resp = (if (code in 200..299) c.inputStream else c.errorStream)
                    ?.bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8)?.use { it.readText() }.orEmpty()
                if (code !in 200..299) throw ApiException(code, "cache $code ${resp.take(120)}")
                return JSONObject(resp).getString("name")
            } catch (e: Throwable) {
                NetLog.fail("Dictation", "cachedContents", c.url.toString(), t0, e)
                throw e
            } finally {
                c.disconnect()
            }
        }

        private fun post(body: String, key: String, model: String): String {
            val t0 = NetLog.now()
            val c = URL("https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/$model:generateContent")
                .openConnection() as HttpURLConnection
            try {
                c.requestMethod = "POST"
                c.connectTimeout = 15_000
                c.readTimeout = 60_000
                c.doOutput = true
                c.setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
                c.setRequestProperty("x-goog-api-key", key)
                c.outputStream.use { it.write(body.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)) }
                val code = c.responseCode
                NetLog.ok("Dictation", "generateContent", c.url.toString(), code, t0)
                val resp = (if (code in 200..299) c.inputStream else c.errorStream)
                    ?.bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8)?.use { it.readText() }.orEmpty()
                if (code !in 200..299) {
                    val why = try {
                        JSONObject(resp).getJSONObject("error").getString("message")
                    } catch (_: Exception) {
                        resp
                    }
                    throw ApiException(code, "Gemini $code ${why.take(140)}".trim())
                }
                return try {
                    val parts = JSONObject(resp).getJSONArray("candidates").getJSONObject(0)
                        .getJSONObject("content").optJSONArray("parts")
                    if (parts == null || parts.length() == 0) "" else parts.getJSONObject(0).optString("text", "")
                } catch (_: Exception) {
                    throw IOException("Gemini وەڵامی بەتاڵی دایەوە")
                }
            } catch (e: Throwable) {
                NetLog.fail("Dictation", "generateContent", c.url.toString(), t0, e)
                throw e
            } finally {
                c.disconnect()
            }
        }
    }
}

========== END OF FILE: app/src/main/java/com/mangatranslator/app/Dictation.kt ==========


================================================================================
FILE: app/src/main/java/com/mangatranslator/app/Downloads.kt

package com.mangatranslator.app

import android.content.Context
import android.net.ConnectivityManager
import android.net.NetworkCapabilities
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import android.os.SystemClock
import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList
import java.util.concurrent.CancellationException
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean

/**
 * بەڕێوەبەری دابەزاندنی پێداویستییەکان (OCR، دەنگی کوردی، نووسینی ئۆفلاین) لە پاشبنەما.
 * - هەر پێداویستییەک دۆخی خۆی هەیە (ئامادە، دادەبەزێت، چاوەڕێی ئینتەرنێت، پچڕاو...) و لە شاشەی «داگرتنەکان» دەبینرێت.
 * - ئەگەر ئینتەرنێت نەما، چاوەڕێ دەکات و کاتێک گەڕایەوە خۆکارانە لەو شوێنەوە بەردەوام دەبێت کە وەستابوو.
 * - ئەگەر هەڵەیەک ڕوویدا، بە ماوەی زیاتر و زیاتر دووبارە هەوڵ دەدات.
 * - بەکارهێنەر دەتوانێت ڕایبگرێت (ڕاگرتنەکە دەمێنێتەوە) و دواتر بەردەوامی بکات.
 */
object Downloads {
    enum class Item(val title: String, val sizeMb: Float) {
        OCR_KU("ناسینەوەی دەقی کوردی (OCR)", 4f),
        OCR_TESS("OCR ی عەرەبی و جاپانیی ستوونی", 4f),
        VOICE("دەنگی کوردیی نیورالی", 60f),
        STT("نووسینی ئۆفلاینی کوردی", 291f),
        /** ئارەزوومەندانە: تەنها کاتێک پێویستە کە زمانی سەرچاوە عەرەبی بێت (یان بەکارهێنەر خۆی دایبەزێنێت) */
        OCR_AR("OCR ی عەرەبی (PP-OCRv5، ئۆفلاین)", 13f)
    }

    enum class State { READY, IDLE, QUEUED, RUNNING, NO_NET, PAUSED, FAILED }

    class Status(val state: State, val pct: Int, val message: String? = null)

    /** هەموو دابەزاندنەکان بەم قفڵەدا تێدەپەڕن، تا شاشەی ئامادەکردن و ئەم بەڕێوەبەرە هەمان فایل پێکەوە نەنووسن */
    val ioLock = Any()

    private const val PREFS = "downloads"
    private const val KEY_PAUSED = "paused"
    private const val MAX_FAIL_STREAK = 30

    private val running = AtomicBoolean(false)
    private val cancel = AtomicBoolean(false)
    private val restart = AtomicBoolean(false)
    private val wanted = ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet<Item>()
    private val pct = ConcurrentHashMap<Item, Int>()
    private val error = ConcurrentHashMap<Item, String>()
    private val failStreak = ConcurrentHashMap<Item, Int>()
    @Volatile private var current: Item? = null
    @Volatile private var offline = false

    private val listeners = CopyOnWriteArrayList<() -> Unit>()
    private val main = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
    @Volatile private var lastNotify = 0L

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ دۆخ

    fun isReady(ctx: Context, item: Item): Boolean = when (item) {
        Item.OCR_KU -> LocalKurdishOcr.isInstalled(ctx)
        Item.OCR_TESS -> TessOcr.allInstalled(ctx)
        Item.VOICE -> PiperTts.isInstalled(ctx)
        Item.STT -> VekolStt.isReady(ctx)
        Item.OCR_AR -> PpOcrArabic.isInstalled(ctx)
    }

    /** پێداویستییە سەرەکییەکان: OCR ی عەرەبی تەنها کاتێک دەژمێردرێت کە زمانی سەرچاوە عەرەبی بێت */
    fun required(ctx: Context): List<Item> {
        val arabic = try { TranslatorSettings(ctx.applicationContext).sourceLang == "ar" } catch (_: Throwable) { false }
        return Item.values().filter { it != Item.OCR_AR || arabic }
    }

    fun allReady(ctx: Context): Boolean = required(ctx).all { isReady(ctx, it) }

    fun isPaused(ctx: Context): Boolean =
        ctx.applicationContext.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE).getBoolean(KEY_PAUSED, false)

    private fun setPaused(ctx: Context, v: Boolean) {
        ctx.applicationContext.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE).edit().putBoolean(KEY_PAUSED, v).apply()
    }

    fun isRunning(): Boolean = running.get()

    /** ئایا ئینتەرنێت هەیە (ئەگەر نەتوانرا بپشکنرێت، وا دادەنرێت هەیە) */
    fun online(ctx: Context): Boolean = try {
        val cm = ctx.applicationContext.getSystemService(Context.CONNECTIVITY_SERVICE) as ConnectivityManager
        val n = cm.activeNetwork
        val caps = if (n != null) cm.getNetworkCapabilities(n) else null
        caps != null && caps.hasCapability(NetworkCapabilities.NET_CAPABILITY_INTERNET)
    } catch (_: Throwable) { true }

    /** ڕێژەی پێشکەوتنی یەک پێداویستی (٠..١٠٠) */
    private fun itemPct(ctx: Context, item: Item): Int {
        pct[item]?.let { if (running.get()) return it.coerceIn(0, 99) }
        // پێش دەستپێکردن یان دوای ڕاگرتن: فایلە نیوەچڵەکان ڕێژەکە دەدەن
        return when (item) {
            Item.STT -> (VekolStt.downloadedBytes(ctx) * 100f / VekolStt.TOTAL_BYTES).toInt().coerceIn(0, 99)
            else -> (pct[item] ?: 0).coerceIn(0, 99)
        }
    }

    fun status(ctx: Context, item: Item): Status {
        if (isReady(ctx, item)) return Status(State.READY, 100)
        val p = itemPct(ctx, item)
        val err = error[item]
        return when {
            isPaused(ctx) -> Status(State.PAUSED, p)
            running.get() && item in wanted -> when {
                current == item -> if (offline) Status(State.NO_NET, p) else Status(State.RUNNING, p)
                offline -> Status(State.NO_NET, p)
                err != null -> Status(State.FAILED, p, err)
                else -> Status(State.QUEUED, p)
            }
            err != null -> Status(State.FAILED, p, err)
            else -> Status(State.IDLE, p)
        }
    }

    /** null = هەموو شتێک ئامادەیە؛ ئەگەرنا ڕێژەی پێشکەوتن (0..100). */
    fun percent(ctx: Context): Int? {
        if (allReady(ctx)) return null
        val req = required(ctx)
        val total = req.sumOf { it.sizeMb.toDouble() }.toFloat()
        var done = 0f
        for (it in req) {
            done += if (isReady(ctx, it)) it.sizeMb else it.sizeMb * itemPct(ctx, it) / 100f
        }
        return (done / total * 100f).toInt().coerceIn(0, 99)
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ بەستنەوەی شاشە

    fun addListener(l: () -> Unit) { if (!listeners.contains(l)) listeners.add(l) }
    fun removeListener(l: () -> Unit) { listeners.remove(l) }

    private fun notifyChanged(force: Boolean = true) {
        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
        if (!force && now - lastNotify < 300) return
        lastNotify = now
        main.post { for (l in listeners) try { l() } catch (_: Throwable) {} }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ فەرمانەکان

    /** خۆکار (کاتی کردنەوەی ئەپەکە): هەر پێداویستییەک نەدابەزیبێت دایدەبەزێنێت، مەگەر بەکارهێنەر ڕایگرتبێت. */
    fun ensureAll(ctx: Context) {
        val app = ctx.applicationContext
        if (allReady(app) || isPaused(app)) return
        launch(app, required(app))
    }

    /** بەکارهێنەر دوگمەی دابەزاندن / دووبارە هەوڵدانەوەی داگرت */
    fun start(ctx: Context, items: List<Item> = Item.values().toList()) {
        val app = ctx.applicationContext
        ActivityLog.log(LogCategory.USER_OPERATION, LogSeverity.INFO, "Download requested by the user", "", "Downloads", "download", "REQUESTED",
            meta = mapOf("items" to items.joinToString(",") { it.name }))
        setPaused(app, false)
        for (i in items) { error.remove(i); failStreak.remove(i) }
        launch(app, items)
    }

    /** ڕاگرتن: فایلە نیوەچڵەکان دەمێنن و دواتر لەو شوێنەوە بەردەوام دەبێت */
    fun pause(ctx: Context) {
        ActivityLog.log(LogCategory.USER_OPERATION, LogSeverity.INFO, "Downloads paused by the user", "", "Downloads", "download", "PAUSE_REQUESTED")
        setPaused(ctx.applicationContext, true)
        cancel.set(true)
        notifyChanged()
    }

    private fun launch(app: Context, items: List<Item>) {
        wanted.addAll(items)
        if (!running.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
            // کارەکە لە ڕاگرتندایە: دوای وەستانی، خۆی دووبارە دەست پێدەکاتەوە
            if (cancel.get()) restart.set(true)
            notifyChanged()
            return
        }
        cancel.set(false)
        Thread { loop(app) }.apply { isDaemon = true; name = "downloads" }.start()
        notifyChanged()
    }

    private class Paused : CancellationException("paused")

    private fun checkCancel() { if (cancel.get()) throw Paused() }

    private fun sleepInterruptibly(ms: Long) {
        var left = ms
        while (left > 0 && !cancel.get()) {
            val step = minOf(left, 500L)
            try { Thread.sleep(step) } catch (_: InterruptedException) { Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); return }
            left -= step
        }
    }

    private fun loop(app: Context) {
        var backoff = 5_000L
        try {
            while (!cancel.get()) {
                val todo = Item.values().filter { it in wanted && !isReady(app, it) }
                if (todo.isEmpty()) break
                if (!online(app)) {
                    if (!offline) {
                        offline = true
                        ActivityLog.warn("Downloads", "Waiting for internet", "Downloads continue automatically when the connection returns.",
                            category = LogCategory.NETWORK, operation = "download", throttleKey = "dl-offline", throttleMs = 5_000)
                        notifyChanged()
                    }
                    sleepInterruptibly(3_000)
                    continue
                }
                if (offline) {
                    offline = false; backoff = 5_000L
                    ActivityLog.info("Downloads", "Internet is back; resuming downloads", category = LogCategory.NETWORK, operation = "download", status = "RESUMED")
                    notifyChanged()
                }
                var anyFailed = false
                for (item in todo) {
                    if (cancel.get()) break
                    if (isReady(app, item)) continue
                    current = item
                    error.remove(item)
                    val opId = ActivityLog.newOpId("dl")
                    val t0 = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
                    ActivityLog.log(LogCategory.BACKGROUND, LogSeverity.INFO, "Download started", item.title, "Downloads", "download", "STARTED",
                        opId = opId, meta = mapOf("item" to item.name, "attempt" to ((failStreak[item] ?: 0) + 1).toString()))
                    notifyChanged()
                    val err: String? = try {
                        synchronized(ioLock) { if (isReady(app, item)) null else runItem(app, item) }
                    } catch (t: Throwable) {
                        t.message ?: t.javaClass.simpleName
                    }
                    current = null
                    val took = (SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - t0).toString()
                    if (cancel.get()) {
                        ActivityLog.log(LogCategory.BACKGROUND, LogSeverity.INFO, "Download paused", item.title, "Downloads", "download", "PAUSED",
                            opId = opId, meta = mapOf("item" to item.name, "durationMs" to took))
                        break
                    }
                    if (err != null) ActivityLog.log(LogCategory.BACKGROUND, LogSeverity.WARNING, "Download failed", item.title, "Downloads",
                        "download", "FAILED", error = err, opId = opId, meta = mapOf("item" to item.name, "durationMs" to took))
                    else ActivityLog.log(LogCategory.BACKGROUND, LogSeverity.SUCCESS, "Download completed", item.title, "Downloads",
                        "download", "SUCCESS", opId = opId, meta = mapOf("item" to item.name, "durationMs" to took))
                    if (err != null) {
                        error[item] = err.take(160)
                        anyFailed = true
                        val streak = (failStreak[item] ?: 0) + 1
                        failStreak[item] = streak
                        if (streak >= MAX_FAIL_STREAK) wanted.remove(item)   // بەردەوام شکستی هێنا: وەستە تا بەکارهێنەر دووبارە هەوڵ بدات
                    } else {
                        error.remove(item); failStreak.remove(item); pct.remove(item)
                    }
                    notifyChanged()
                }
                if (cancel.get()) break
                if (anyFailed) {
                    sleepInterruptibly(backoff)
                    backoff = (backoff * 2).coerceAtMost(60_000L)
                } else backoff = 5_000L
            }
        } finally {
            current = null
            offline = false
            running.set(false)
            val again = restart.getAndSet(false)
            // پێداویستییەک لە کاتی کۆتایی هاتنی لووپەکە زیاد کرابێت (یان ڕاگرتن و بەردەوامبوون بەدوای یەکدا)
            val pending = !cancel.get() && wanted.any { !isReady(app, it) }
            notifyChanged()
            if ((again || pending) && !isPaused(app) && !allReady(app)) launch(app, wanted.toList())
        }
    }

    private fun runItem(app: Context, item: Item): String? = when (item) {
        Item.OCR_KU -> LocalKurdishOcr.download(app)
        Item.OCR_TESS -> {
            var e: String? = null
            for (l in TessOcr.FIRST_RUN) {
                checkCancel()
                if (!TessOcr.isInstalled(app, l)) {
                    val r = TessOcr.download(app, l)
                    if (r != null) e = r
                }
            }
            e
        }
        Item.VOICE -> {
            pct[item] = 0
            PiperTts.download(app) { p -> checkCancel(); pct[item] = p; notifyChanged(false) }
        }
        Item.OCR_AR -> {
            pct[item] = 0
            PpOcrArabic.download(app) { p -> checkCancel(); pct[item] = p; notifyChanged(false) }
        }
        Item.STT -> try {
            VekolStt.download(app) { done, total, _ ->
                checkCancel()
                pct[item] = if (total > 0) (done * 100 / total).toInt() else 0
                notifyChanged(false)
            }
            null
        } catch (t: Throwable) {
            if (cancel.get()) "paused" else "دابەزاندن پچڕا: " + (t.message ?: t.javaClass.simpleName).take(100)
        }
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import android.app.Activity
import android.content.res.ColorStateList
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.Typeface
import android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable
import android.os.Bundle
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import android.view.Gravity
import android.view.View
import android.widget.Button
import android.widget.FrameLayout
import android.widget.LinearLayout
import android.widget.ProgressBar
import android.widget.ScrollView
import android.widget.TextView
import java.util.concurrent.Executors

/**
 * شاشەی «داگرتنەکان»: هەموو پێداویستییەکان (OCR، دەنگی کوردی، نووسینی ئۆفلاین) لەگەڵ دۆخ و ڕێژەی پێشکەوتن.
 * بەکارهێنەر لێرەوە هەر کاتێک دەتوانێت دابەزاندن دەست پێبکات، ڕایبگرێت، یان دوای پچڕانی ئینتەرنێت دووبارە هەوڵ بداتەوە
 * (دابەزاندنەکە لەو شوێنەوە بەردەوام دەبێت کە وەستابوو). تێپەڕاندنی شاشەی یەکەم کردنەوە ئیتر کۆتایی نییە.
 */
class DownloadsActivity : Activity() {

    private class Row(
        val state: TextView, val bar: ProgressBar, val btn: Button, val item: Downloads.Item
    )

    private val ui = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
    private val bg = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor()
    private lateinit var pal: Palette
    private lateinit var summary: TextView
    private lateinit var netNote: TextView
    private lateinit var mainBtn: Button
    private val rows = ArrayList<Row>()
    @Volatile private var alive = false
    @Volatile private var refreshing = false

    private val listener: () -> Unit = { refresh() }
    private val tick = object : Runnable {
        override fun run() {
            if (!alive) return
            refresh()
            ui.postDelayed(this, 1000)
        }
    }

    private val textMain get() = if (pal.light) Color.parseColor("#0F172A") else Color.parseColor("#EAF2FF")
    private val textDim get() = if (pal.light) Color.parseColor("#475569") else Color.parseColor("#B4C4E4")

    private fun dp(v: Int) = (v * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        pal = Palettes.get(TranslatorSettings(this).theme)
        buildUi()
    }

    override fun onStart() {
        super.onStart()
        alive = true
        Downloads.addListener(listener)
        ui.post(tick)
    }

    override fun onStop() {
        alive = false
        Downloads.removeListener(listener)
        ui.removeCallbacks(tick)
        super.onStop()
    }

    override fun onDestroy() {
        bg.shutdown()
        super.onDestroy()
    }

    private fun buildUi() {
        val frame = FrameLayout(this)
        frame.addView(GlassBackground(this, pal), FrameLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -1))

        val col = LinearLayout(this).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
            layoutDirection = View.LAYOUT_DIRECTION_RTL
            val topSpace = if (resources.configuration.screenHeightDp < 700) 24 else 44
            setPadding(dp(20), dp(topSpace), dp(20), dp(28))
        }

        // ---- سەرەوە: گەڕانەوە + ناونیشان ----
        val top = LinearLayout(this).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
        }
        top.addView(TextView(this).apply {
            text = "←"
            textSize = 26f
            setTextColor(textMain)
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            setOnClickListener { finish() }
        }, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(dp(44), dp(44)))
        top.addView(TextView(this).apply {
            text = "⬇ داگرتنەکان"
            textSize = 22f
            typeface = Typeface.DEFAULT_BOLD
            setTextColor(textMain)
        }, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, -2, 1f).apply { marginStart = dp(6) })
        col.addView(top, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -2).apply { bottomMargin = dp(14) })

        summary = TextView(this).apply {
            textSize = 14f
            setTextColor(textDim)
        }
        col.addView(summary, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -2).apply { bottomMargin = dp(6) })

        netNote = TextView(this).apply {
            textSize = 12.5f
            setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#FFB020"))
            visibility = View.GONE
        }
        col.addView(netNote, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -2).apply { bottomMargin = dp(10) })

        mainBtn = Button(this).apply {
            textSize = 15f
            setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
            isAllCaps = false
            minHeight = dp(52)
            setPadding(dp(12), dp(12), dp(12), dp(12))
            background = GradientDrawable(
                GradientDrawable.Orientation.RIGHT_LEFT, intArrayOf(pal.a1, pal.a2)
            ).apply { cornerRadius = dp(16).toFloat() }
            setOnClickListener { onMainButton() }
        }
        col.addView(mainBtn, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -2).apply { bottomMargin = dp(16) })

        // ---- کارتی هەر پێداویستییەک ----
        val list = LinearLayout(this).apply { orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL }
        for (item in Downloads.Item.values()) {
            val card = LinearLayout(this).apply {
                orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
                setPadding(dp(16), dp(12), dp(16), dp(12))
                background = GradientDrawable().apply {
                    cornerRadius = dp(18).toFloat()
                    setColor(if (pal.light) 0x14000000 else 0x24FFFFFF)
                    setStroke(dp(1), if (pal.light) 0x22000000 else 0x30FFFFFF)
                }
            }
            val head = LinearLayout(this).apply {
                orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
                gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
            }
            head.addView(TextView(this).apply {
                text = item.title
                textSize = 15f
                typeface = Typeface.DEFAULT_BOLD
                setTextColor(textMain)
            }, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, -2, 1f))
            head.addView(TextView(this).apply {
                text = "≈ " + item.sizeMb.toInt() + " MB"
                textSize = 12f
                setTextColor(textDim)
                layoutDirection = View.LAYOUT_DIRECTION_LTR
            }, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-2, -2))
            card.addView(head, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -2))

            val bar = ProgressBar(this, null, android.R.attr.progressBarStyleHorizontal).apply {
                max = 100
                progressTintList = ColorStateList.valueOf(pal.a1)
                progressBackgroundTintList = ColorStateList.valueOf(if (pal.light) 0x22000000 else 0x30FFFFFF)
            }
            card.addView(bar, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, dp(8)).apply { topMargin = dp(10); bottomMargin = dp(8) })

            val foot = LinearLayout(this).apply {
                orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
                gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
            }
            val state = TextView(this).apply {
                textSize = 12.5f
                setTextColor(textDim)
            }
            foot.addView(state, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, -2, 1f))
            val btn = Button(this).apply {
                textSize = 13f
                isAllCaps = false
                setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
                background = GradientDrawable().apply {
                    cornerRadius = dp(12).toFloat()
                    setColor(pal.a1)
                }
                minHeight = dp(36)
                setPadding(dp(14), dp(6), dp(14), dp(6))
                setOnClickListener { Downloads.start(this@DownloadsActivity, listOf(item)); refresh() }
            }
            foot.addView(btn, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-2, -2))
            card.addView(foot, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -2))

            list.addView(card, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -2).apply { bottomMargin = dp(12) })
            rows.add(Row(state, bar, btn, item))
        }
        col.addView(list, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -2))

        col.addView(TextView(this).apply {
            text = "ئەگەر ئینتەرنێت پچڕا، دابەزاندنەکە دەوەستێت و کاتێک ئینتەرنێت گەڕایەوە خۆکارانە لەو شوێنەوە بەردەوام دەبێت کە وەستابوو."
            textSize = 12f
            setTextColor(textDim)
        }, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -2).apply { topMargin = dp(4) })

        frame.addView(ScrollView(this).apply {
            isFillViewport = true
            isVerticalScrollBarEnabled = false
            addView(col, FrameLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -2))
        }, FrameLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -1))
        setContentView(frame)
        refresh()
    }

    private fun onMainButton() {
        val app = applicationContext
        if (Downloads.isRunning() && !Downloads.isPaused(app)) Downloads.pause(app)
        else Downloads.start(app)
        refresh()
    }

    private class Snapshot(
        val statuses: List<Downloads.Status>, val online: Boolean, val running: Boolean, val paused: Boolean, val overall: Int?
    )

    /** دۆخەکان لە thread ی پاشبنەما دەخوێنرێنەوە (پشکنینی فایل)، پاشان UI نوێ دەکرێتەوە */
    private fun refresh() {
        if (refreshing) return
        refreshing = true
        val app = applicationContext
        try {
            bg.execute {
                val snap = try {
                    Snapshot(
                        Downloads.Item.values().map { Downloads.status(app, it) },
                        Downloads.online(app), Downloads.isRunning(), Downloads.isPaused(app), Downloads.percent(app)
                    )
                } catch (_: Throwable) { null }
                ui.post {
                    refreshing = false
                    if (snap != null && !isDestroyed) render(snap)
                }
            }
        } catch (_: Throwable) { refreshing = false }
    }

    private fun render(s: Snapshot) {
        val ready = s.statuses.count { it.state == Downloads.State.READY }
        val n = s.statuses.size
        summary.text = if (s.overall == null) "هەموو پێداویستییە سەرەکییەکان ئامادەن ✓"
        else "$ready لە $n ئامادەیە · کۆی گشتی " + s.overall + "%"

        val waitingNet = s.statuses.any { it.state == Downloads.State.NO_NET } || (!s.online && s.running)
        netNote.visibility = if (!s.online && s.overall != null) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE
        netNote.text = if (waitingNet) "ئینتەرنێت نییە — کاتێک گەڕایەوە خۆکارانە بەردەوام دەبێت"
        else "ئینتەرنێت نییە"

        mainBtn.visibility = if (s.overall == null) View.GONE else View.VISIBLE
        mainBtn.text = when {
            s.running && !s.paused -> "⏸  ڕاگرتن"
            s.paused -> "▶  بەردەوامبوون"
            else -> "⬇  دابەزاندنی هەمووی"
        }

        for ((i, r) in rows.withIndex()) {
            val st = s.statuses[i]
            r.bar.progress = st.pct
            r.bar.visibility = if (st.state == Downloads.State.READY) View.INVISIBLE else View.VISIBLE
            val (txt, color) = when (st.state) {
                Downloads.State.READY -> "✓ ئامادەیە" to Color.parseColor("#2EE57A")
                Downloads.State.RUNNING -> "دادەبەزێت… ${st.pct}%" to pal.a1
                Downloads.State.QUEUED -> "لە ڕیزدایە… ${st.pct}%" to textDim
                Downloads.State.NO_NET -> "چاوەڕێی ئینتەرنێت… ${st.pct}%" to Color.parseColor("#FFB020")
                Downloads.State.PAUSED -> "ڕاگیراوە · ${st.pct}%" to textDim
                Downloads.State.FAILED -> "هەڵە: " + (st.message ?: "") to Color.parseColor("#FF5C6C")
                Downloads.State.IDLE -> (if (st.pct > 0) "نیوەچڵ · ${st.pct}%" else "دانەبەزێندراوە") to textDim
            }
            r.state.text = txt
            r.state.setTextColor(color)
            when (st.state) {
                Downloads.State.IDLE, Downloads.State.PAUSED -> { r.btn.visibility = View.VISIBLE; r.btn.text = "دابەزاندن" }
                Downloads.State.FAILED -> { r.btn.visibility = View.VISIBLE; r.btn.text = "↻ دووبارە هەوڵبدەرەوە" }
                else -> r.btn.visibility = View.GONE
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject
import java.io.IOException
import java.net.HttpURLConnection
import java.net.URL
import java.net.URLEncoder

/**
 * وەرگێڕانی دەقی کوردیی سۆرانی ← ئینگلیزیی ڕەوان (بۆ ناردنی نامە بۆ کەسێک).
 * بەپێی وەرگێڕی هەڵبژێردراو؛ Google تەنها ئەگەر هەڵبژێردرابێت یان Gemini quota تەواو بووبێت.
 * لە thread ی پاشبنەما بانگ بکرێت. null = نەکرا.
 */
object EnglishTranslate {

    private const val PROMPT =
        "Translate the following Central Kurdish (Sorani) text into natural, fluent English, the way a person would " +
            "write it in a chat message to someone. Keep names, numbers and Latin-script words as they are. " +
            "Do not explain, comment or add anything. Return ONLY the English translation.\n\nText:\n"

    fun fromKurdish(text: String, keysRaw: String, provider: TranslationProvider = TranslationProvider.GOOGLE): String? {
        val src = text.trim()
        if (src.isEmpty()) return null
        return try {
            TranslationRouter.shared.run(provider, keysRaw,
                gemini = {
                    val out = GeminiKeys.withKeys(keysRaw) { key ->
                        GeminiModels.call(false, quotaSensitive = true) { m, think -> post(body(src, m, think), key, m) }
                    }.trim().trim('"', '`').trim()
                    if (out.isBlank()) throw IOException("Gemini وەڵامی بەتاڵی دایەوە")
                    out
                },
                google = { free(src).takeIf { it.isNotBlank() } })
        } catch (_: Exception) { null }
    }

    private fun body(src: String, model: String, think: Boolean): String {
        val gen = JSONObject().put("temperature", 0.2).put("maxOutputTokens", 1024)
        if (think) gen.put("thinkingConfig", GeminiModels.thinking(model))
        return JSONObject()
            .put(
                "contents",
                JSONArray().put(
                    JSONObject().put("parts", JSONArray().put(JSONObject().put("text", PROMPT + src)))
                )
            )
            .put("generationConfig", gen)
            .toString()
    }

    private fun post(body: String, key: String, model: String): String {
        val t0 = NetLog.now()
        val c = URL("https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/$model:generateContent")
            .openConnection() as HttpURLConnection
        try {
            c.requestMethod = "POST"
            c.connectTimeout = 8_000
            c.readTimeout = 25_000
            c.doOutput = true
            c.setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
            c.setRequestProperty("x-goog-api-key", key)
            c.outputStream.use { it.write(body.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)) }
            val code = c.responseCode
            NetLog.ok("EnglishTranslate", "generateContent", c.url.toString(), code, t0)
            val resp = (if (code in 200..299) c.inputStream else c.errorStream)
                ?.bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8)?.use { it.readText() }.orEmpty()
            if (code !in 200..299) {
                val why = try {
                    JSONObject(resp).getJSONObject("error").getString("message")
                } catch (_: Exception) {
                    resp
                }
                throw ApiException(code, "Gemini $code ${why.take(140)}".trim())
            }
            return try {
                val parts = JSONObject(resp).getJSONArray("candidates").getJSONObject(0)
                    .getJSONObject("content").optJSONArray("parts")
                if (parts == null || parts.length() == 0) "" else parts.getJSONObject(0).optString("text", "")
            } catch (_: Exception) {
                throw IOException("Gemini وەڵامی بەتاڵی دایەوە")
            }
        } catch (e: Throwable) {
            NetLog.fail("EnglishTranslate", "generateContent", c.url.toString(), t0, e)
            throw e
        } finally {
            c.disconnect()
        }
    }

    /** Google Translate ی بێ کلیل: ckb ← en */
    private fun free(text: String): String {
        val q = URLEncoder.encode(text, "UTF-8")
        val t0 = NetLog.now()
        val c = URL("https://translate.googleapis.com/translate_a/single?client=gtx&sl=ckb&tl=en&dt=t&q=$q")
            .openConnection() as HttpURLConnection
        try {
            c.connectTimeout = 5_000
            c.readTimeout = 10_000
            c.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "Mozilla/5.0")
            val code = c.responseCode
            NetLog.ok("EnglishTranslate", "freeTranslate", c.url.toString(), code, t0)
            if (code !in 200..299) throw IOException("HTTP $code")
            val res = c.inputStream.bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8).use { it.readText() }
            val parts = JSONArray(res).getJSONArray(0)
            val sb = StringBuilder()
            for (i in 0 until parts.length()) {
                val seg = parts.optJSONArray(i) ?: continue
                if (!seg.isNull(0)) sb.append(seg.getString(0))
            }
            return sb.toString().trim()
        } catch (e: Throwable) {
            NetLog.fail("EnglishTranslate", "freeTranslate", c.url.toString(), t0, e)
            throw e
        } finally {
            c.disconnect()
        }
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import kotlin.math.*

/** Mobile approximation of the 215-Hz audition, not Praat PSOLA or a new speaker.
 * Resampling raises pitch AND formants 4%; WSOLA restores the original duration.
 * Unlike the desktop audition, pitch is not independently reset to 215 Hz per sentence.
 * All processing is per utterance, off the playback thread, without Android dependencies.
 */
internal object FemaleVoiceRecipe {
    const val PROFILE_ID = 3
    const val MODEL_SHA256 = "b4485e8bb28e6b483007c9e64251dee24d09fbfd76a8417fb66ec247b445ea1d"
    const val PITCH_FORMANT_RATIO = 1.04

    fun process(input: FloatArray, rate: Int): FloatArray {
        require(rate >= 8000)
        if (input.isEmpty()) return input.copyOf()
        require(input.all { it.isFinite() })
        if (input.all { abs(it) < 1e-8f }) return input.copyOf()
        val shifted = FloatArray(max(1, (input.size / PITCH_FORMANT_RATIO).roundToInt())) { i ->
            val p = i * PITCH_FORMANT_RATIO
            val a = floor(p).toInt().coerceAtMost(input.lastIndex)
            val b = min(a + 1, input.lastIndex)
            (input[a] + (input[b] - input[a]) * (p - a)).toFloat()
        }
        val y = stretch(shifted, input.size, rate)
        highPass(90.0, 0.70710678, rate).apply(y)
        peakEq(min(4000.0, rate * .4), 1.0, 3.0, rate).apply(y)
        compress(y, rate)
        normalize(y, rate)
        // Avoid clicks at utterance boundaries without touching the natural phrase timing.
        val fade = min(rate / 200, y.size / 2)
        for (i in 0 until fade) {
            val gain = i.toFloat() / fade
            y[i] *= gain
            y[y.lastIndex - i] *= gain
        }
        return y
    }

    /** 40-ms Hann grains, 20-ms hops, normalized overlap-add with ±5-ms correlation search. */
    private fun stretch(x: FloatArray, size: Int, rate: Int): FloatArray {
        val window = max(32, rate * 40 / 1000)
        val hop = window / 2
        val overlap = window - hop
        val search = max(4, rate * 5 / 1000)
        val output = DoubleArray(size + window)
        val weights = DoubleArray(size + window)
        val hann = DoubleArray(window) { i -> .5 - .5 * cos(2 * PI * (i + .5) / window) }
        val stretch = size.toDouble() / x.size
        var out = -hop // pre-roll gives the beginning a fully supported window
        while (out < size) {
            val nominal = (out / stretch).roundToInt()
            var best = nominal
            if (out >= hop && nominal + window < x.size) {
                var bestScore = -Double.MAX_VALUE
                val reference = DoubleArray(overlap) { j ->
                    if (weights[out + j] > 1e-9) output[out + j] / weights[out + j] else 0.0
                }
                val referenceEnergy = reference.sumOf { it * it }
                if (referenceEnergy > 1e-10) {
                    for (candidate in max(0, nominal - search)..min(x.size - window, nominal + search) step 2) {
                        var dot = 0.0; var energy = 0.0
                        for (j in 0 until overlap step 4) {
                            val sample = x[candidate + j].toDouble()
                            dot += reference[j] * sample
                            energy += sample * sample
                        }
                        // Match the already-rendered overlap; favour the nominal position on ties.
                        val score = dot / sqrt(max(1e-20, energy * referenceEnergy / 4)) -
                            .002 * abs(candidate - nominal) / search
                        if (score > bestScore) { bestScore = score; best = candidate }
                    }
                }
            }
            for (j in 0 until window) {
                val dst = out + j; val src = best + j
                if (dst !in 0 until size || src !in x.indices) continue
                output[dst] += x[src] * hann[j]
                weights[dst] += hann[j]
            }
            out += hop
        }
        return FloatArray(size) { i -> if (weights[i] > 1e-9) (output[i] / weights[i]).toFloat() else 0f }
    }

    private class Biquad(val b0: Double, val b1: Double, val b2: Double,
                         val a1: Double, val a2: Double) {
        fun apply(y: FloatArray) {
            var z1 = 0.0; var z2 = 0.0
            for (i in y.indices) {
                val v = y[i].toDouble(); val out = b0 * v + z1
                z1 = b1 * v - a1 * out + z2
                z2 = b2 * v - a2 * out
                y[i] = out.toFloat()
            }
        }
    }

    private fun highPass(hz: Double, q: Double, rate: Int): Biquad {
        val w = 2 * PI * hz / rate; val c = cos(w); val alpha = sin(w) / (2 * q)
        val a0 = 1 + alpha
        return Biquad((1+c)/2/a0, -(1+c)/a0, (1+c)/2/a0, -2*c/a0, (1-alpha)/a0)
    }

    private fun peakEq(hz: Double, q: Double, gainDb: Double, rate: Int): Biquad {
        val a = 10.0.pow(gainDb / 40); val w = 2 * PI * hz / rate
        val alpha = sin(w) / (2*q); val c = cos(w); val a0 = 1 + alpha/a
        return Biquad((1+alpha*a)/a0, -2*c/a0, (1-alpha*a)/a0, -2*c/a0, (1-alpha/a)/a0)
    }

    private fun compress(y: FloatArray, rate: Int) {
        val attack = exp(-1.0 / (.015 * rate)); val release = exp(-1.0 / (.100 * rate))
        var envelope = 0.0
        for (i in y.indices) {
            val level = abs(y[i].toDouble()); val alpha = if (level > envelope) attack else release
            envelope = alpha * envelope + (1-alpha) * level
            // Peak detector, threshold 0.125, ratio 2:1. Not the desktop filter's exact knee.
            val gain = if (envelope > .125) sqrt(.125 / envelope) else 1.0
            y[i] = (y[i] * gain).toFloat()
        }
    }

    /** BS.1770-style K weighting and absolute/relative gates, mono; sample peak limited.
     * Not a certified true-peak limiter. The final exported fixture is checked with FFmpeg.
     */
    internal fun integratedLufs(input: FloatArray, rate: Int): Double {
        if (input.isEmpty()) return Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY
        val weighted = input.copyOf()
        val k = tan(PI * 1681.974450955533 / rate)
        val vh = 10.0.pow(3.999843853973347 / 20); val vb = vh.pow(.4996667741545416)
        val q = .7071752369554196; val a0 = 1+k/q+k*k
        Biquad((vh+vb*k/q+k*k)/a0, 2*(k*k-vh)/a0, (vh-vb*k/q+k*k)/a0,
            2*(k*k-1)/a0, (1-k/q+k*k)/a0).apply(weighted)
        highPass(38.13547087602444, .5003270373238773, rate).apply(weighted)
        val block = max(1, rate * 4 / 10); val step = max(1, rate / 10)
        val energies = ArrayList<Double>()
        if (weighted.size < block) energies.add(weighted.sumOf { it.toDouble()*it } / weighted.size)
        else for (start in 0..weighted.size-block step step) {
            var sum = 0.0
            for (j in start until start+block) sum += weighted[j].toDouble()*weighted[j]
            energies.add(sum/block)
        }
        val absolute = energies.filter { it > 10.0.pow((-70+.691)/10) }
        if (absolute.isEmpty()) return Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY
        val relative = absolute.average() * .1
        return -.691 + 10 * log10(absolute.filter { it >= relative }.average())
    }

    private fun normalize(y: FloatArray, rate: Int) {
        val lufs = integratedLufs(y, rate)
        if (!lufs.isFinite()) return
        val peak = y.maxOf { abs(it.toDouble()) }
        val gain = minOf(10.0.pow((-18-lufs)/20), .84/max(peak, 1e-12), 4.0)
        for (i in y.indices) y[i] = (y[i]*gain).toFloat()
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import android.graphics.Bitmap

/** سەرچاوەی فرەیمی شاشە: MediaProjection (ScreenCapturer) یان Accessibility (AccessibilityCapturer). */
interface FrameSource {
    /** لە thread ی گرتنەوە بانگ دەکرێت؛ وەرگر دەبێت bitmap recycle بکات. */
    var frameListener: ((Bitmap) -> Unit)?
    fun start()
    /** دوای `delayMs` فرەیمێک دەدات بە `cb` (لە thread ی گرتنەوە؛ cb دەبێت recycle ی بکات). null = نەگیرا. */
    fun requestFrame(delayMs: Long, cb: (Bitmap?) -> Unit)
    fun release()
    /** Faster sampling only for an explicitly enabled live, non-Arabic session. */
    fun setLiveRefresh(enabled: Boolean) {}
    /** Refresh after Play, rather than replaying a bitmap retained before Pause. */
    fun setCapturePaused(paused: Boolean) {}
    fun requestFreshFrame(onReady: () -> Unit) { kick(); onReady() }
    /** داوای فرەیمی دووبارە بکە (بۆ forceRescan کاتێک شاشە نەگۆڕاوە)؛ بنەڕەت: هیچ */
    fun kick() {}
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import java.io.IOException
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap

/** هەڵەی API ی Gemini لەگەڵ کۆدی HTTP، بۆ ئەوەی بزانین کلیلێک پشوو بدرێت یان نا. */
class ApiException(val code: Int, msg: String) : IOException(msg)

/**
 * چەند کلیلی Gemini (هەر یەکێک لە دێڕێک): بە نۆرە بەکاردێن و ئەگەر یەکێک تەواو بوو (429) یان هەڵە بوو،
 * کلیلی دواتر بەکاردێت.
 */
object GeminiKeys {
    private val sep = Regex("[\\s,;]+")
    private val cool = ConcurrentHashMap<String, Long>()
    private var rr = 0

    fun parse(raw: String): List<String> = raw.split(sep).filter { it.length > 10 }.distinct()

    fun next(raw: String): String = next(parse(raw))

    @Synchronized
    private fun next(ks: List<String>): String {
        if (ks.isEmpty()) return ""
        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
        for (i in ks.indices) {
            val k = ks[(rr + i) % ks.size]
            if ((cool[k] ?: 0L) <= now) {
                rr = (rr + i + 1) % ks.size
                return k
            }
        }
        val k = ks.minByOrNull { cool[it] ?: 0L }!!
        rr = (ks.indexOf(k) + 1) % ks.size
        return k
    }

    fun rest(key: String, code: Int) {
        val ms = when {
            code == 429 -> 30_000L
            code == 400 -> 2 * 60_000L
            code == 401 || code == 403 -> 10 * 60_000L
            code >= 500 -> 5_000L
            else -> return
        }
        cool[key] = System.currentTimeMillis() + ms
    }

    /** `block` بە هەر کلیلێک تاقی دەکاتەوە تا یەکێکیان سەرکەوت. */
    fun <T> withKeys(raw: String, block: (String) -> T): T {
        // Keep a request-local list: concurrent calls and cooldowns can otherwise
        // cause next(raw) to select a key that this request has already tried.
        val remaining = parse(raw).toMutableList()
        if (remaining.isEmpty()) throw IOException("no key")
        var last: ApiException? = null
        while (remaining.isNotEmpty()) {
            val k = next(remaining)
            remaining.remove(k)
            try {
                return block(k)
            } catch (e: ApiException) {
                rest(k, e.code)
                last = e
            }
        }
        throw last ?: IOException("no key")
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import android.animation.ValueAnimator
import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Canvas
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.LinearGradient
import android.graphics.Matrix
import android.graphics.Paint
import android.graphics.Path
import android.graphics.RectF
import android.graphics.Shader
import android.graphics.SweepGradient
import android.graphics.Typeface
import android.view.View
import android.view.animation.LinearInterpolator
import kotlin.math.sin

/**
 * لۆدینگی ستایلی Gemini: کاپسوڵێکی تاریکی شووشەیی بە لێوارێکی ڕەنگاوڕەنگی گەڕاو (شین ← مۆر ← پەمەیی)،
 * ئەستێرەی چوار-پەڕی لەرزۆک، و دەقێک کە درەوشانەوەیەکی تێدا دەڕوات.
 */
class GeminiLoader(ctx: Context, var label: String) : View(ctx) {

    private val d = resources.displayMetrics.density
    private val blue = 0xFF4285F4.toInt()
    private val purple = 0xFF9B72CB.toInt()
    private val pink = 0xFFD96570.toInt()

    private val bg = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply { color = 0xEE12162A.toInt() }
    private val border = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply { style = Paint.Style.STROKE; strokeWidth = 2.2f * d }
    private val glow = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply { style = Paint.Style.STROKE; strokeWidth = 5f * d }
    private val star = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG)
    private val text = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        textSize = 14f * d
        typeface = Typeface.DEFAULT_BOLD
        textAlign = Paint.Align.CENTER
    }
    private val rect = RectF()
    private val path = Path()
    private val mat = Matrix()
    private var phase = 0f

    private val anim = ValueAnimator.ofFloat(0f, 1f).apply {
        duration = 1800
        repeatCount = ValueAnimator.INFINITE
        interpolator = LinearInterpolator()
        addUpdateListener {
            phase = it.animatedValue as Float
            // ڕامی کەم + software layer: ٣٠ فرەیم لە چرکەیەکدا بەسە
            if (DeviceProfile.low) {
                val now = android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis()
                if (now - lastDraw < 33) return@addUpdateListener
                lastDraw = now
            }
            invalidate()
        }
    }
    private var lastDraw = 0L

    init { setLayerType(LAYER_TYPE_SOFTWARE, null) }

    override fun onAttachedToWindow() { super.onAttachedToWindow(); anim.start() }
    override fun onDetachedFromWindow() { anim.cancel(); super.onDetachedFromWindow() }

    override fun onDraw(c: Canvas) {
        val w = width.toFloat()
        val h = height.toFloat()
        val m = 6f * d
        rect.set(m, m, w - m, h - m)
        val r = rect.height() / 2f

        // لێواری گەڕاو
        val sweep = SweepGradient(w / 2f, h / 2f, intArrayOf(blue, purple, pink, purple, blue), null)
        mat.setRotate(phase * 360f, w / 2f, h / 2f)
        sweep.setLocalMatrix(mat)

        glow.shader = sweep
        glow.alpha = 70
        c.drawRoundRect(rect, r, r, glow)
        c.drawRoundRect(rect, r, r, bg)
        border.shader = sweep
        c.drawRoundRect(rect, r, r, border)

        // ئەستێرەی چوار-پەڕی
        val pulse = 0.5f + 0.5f * sin(phase * 6.2832f)
        val sx = rect.left + r + 2f * d
        val sy = h / 2f
        val sz = (7f + 2.5f * pulse) * d
        star.shader = LinearGradient(sx - sz, sy - sz, sx + sz, sy + sz, intArrayOf(blue, purple, pink), null, Shader.TileMode.CLAMP)
        path.reset()
        path.moveTo(sx, sy - sz)
        path.quadTo(sx, sy, sx + sz, sy)
        path.quadTo(sx, sy, sx, sy + sz)
        path.quadTo(sx, sy, sx - sz, sy)
        path.quadTo(sx, sy, sx, sy - sz)
        path.close()
        c.save()
        c.rotate(phase * 90f, sx, sy)
        c.drawPath(path, star)
        c.restore()

        // دەق + درەوشانەوە
        val tx = (sx + sz + rect.right) / 2f + 2f * d
        val tw = text.measureText(label)
        val bandX = (tx - tw / 2f) + (tw + 80f * d) * phase - 40f * d
        text.shader = LinearGradient(
            bandX - 40f * d, 0f, bandX + 40f * d, 0f,
            intArrayOf(0x99FFFFFF.toInt(), 0xFFFFFFFF.toInt(), 0x99FFFFFF.toInt()),
            floatArrayOf(0f, 0.5f, 1f), Shader.TileMode.CLAMP
        )
        c.drawText(label, tx, h / 2f + text.textSize / 3f, text)
    }
}
