package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject
import java.io.IOException
import java.net.HttpURLConnection
import java.net.URL

/**
 * چاکردنی هەڵە بچووکەکانی دەقی نووسراو (دوای مۆدێلی ئۆفلاینی Vekol) بە Gemini.
 *
 * بۆ ئەوەی خاو نەکاتەوە:
 *  - تەنها دەق دەنێرێت (نە دەنگ) و مۆدێلی خێرا (fast) + بیرکردنەوەی کەمترین ئاست بەکاردێنێت
 *  - کاتی چاوەڕێکردن کورتە (٤ چرکە پەیوەندی، ٧ چرکە وەڵام)
 *  - ئەگەر هەر شتێک هەڵە بوو یان وەڵامەکە گومانلێکراو بوو، null دەگەڕێتەوە و دەقە ئۆفلاینەکە وەک خۆی دەمێنێتەوە
 * لە thread ی پاشبنەما بانگ بکرێت.
 */
object KurdishTextFix {

    private const val PROMPT =
        "You are a proofreader for Central Kurdish (Sorani) text that was produced by a speech-to-text model. " +
            "Fix ONLY small mistakes: wrong or confused letters (ی not ي, ک not ك, ە, ێ, ۆ, ڵ, ڕ, وو), wrongly split or joined words, " +
            "obvious misheard words that are clearly wrong from context, and punctuation (، . ؟). " +
            "Do NOT rephrase, translate, summarize, shorten, extend or explain. Keep the meaning and the word order. " +
            "Keep English words in Latin letters and numbers as digits. " +
            "Personal names (people, places, brands) are NOT mistakes: never replace, translate or correct a name into a common word; keep every name exactly as spelled, in Kurdish script. If the text is already correct, return it unchanged. Return ONLY the corrected text on a single line.\n\nText:\n"

    private const val PROMPT_MANUAL =
        "You are an editor of Central Kurdish (Sorani). The text below was produced by a speech-to-text model and the speaker says it contains mistakes. " +
            "The speaker may be poorly educated and speak colloquially or in a local dialect (Hawleri, Slemani, Garmiyan, Kirkuki...), so non-standard grammar and colloquial or dialect words are NOT mistakes: keep them. " +
            "Fix ONLY: wrong or confused letters (ی not ي, ک not ك, ە, ێ, ۆ, ڵ, ڕ, وو), wrongly split or joined words, words that are clearly misheard or nonsense from context " +
            "(replace them with the word the speaker most likely said, in the speaker's own style), and punctuation (، . ؟). " +
            "Do NOT make the text more formal or literary, do NOT correct the grammar, do NOT translate, summarize, explain or add ideas. Keep English words in Latin letters and numbers as digits. " +
            "Personal names (people, places, brands) are NOT mistakes: never replace, translate or correct a name into a common word; keep every name exactly as spelled, in Kurdish script. Return ONLY the corrected text.\n\nText:\n"

    private const val AR = "Common Arabic/Islamic phrases used in Kurdish speech must be written in their standard spelling, e.g. السلام علیکم، وعلیکم السلام، ئینشائەڵڵا، ماشائەڵڵا، سوپاس، الحمدلله، بسم الله، نەخێر؛ never turn them into unrelated Kurdish words. "

    private const val PROMPT_AUDIO =
        "You are an expert Central Kurdish (Sorani) transcriber. You get (1) the original AUDIO of a person speaking and " +
            "(2) a draft transcript written by a speech-to-text model that may contain mistakes. LISTEN to the audio and use the draft as a hint: " +
            "write what was actually said, word for word, in Arabic script with the correct Sorani letters (ی not ي, ک not ك, ە, ێ, ۆ, ڵ, ڕ, وو) and natural punctuation (، . ؟). " +
            "The speaker may be poorly educated and speak colloquially or in a local dialect, so keep the speaker's own words, dialect and non-standard grammar; never replace them with formal standard words. " +
            "Keep the draft's wording wherever it matches the audio; change only what the audio shows is wrong. " +
            "Personal names, places and brands are NOT mistakes: write them phonetically as heard in Kurdish script, never replace them with common words. " +
            "$AR" +
            "Keep English words in Latin letters and numbers as digits. Do NOT translate, summarize, explain or add anything. " +
            "Return ONLY the final transcript on one line, no comments.\n\nText:\n"

    /**
     * ناوە نزیکەکانی فەرهەنگی ناو (KurdishEntities) وەک ئاماژە دەخاتە ناو ڕێنماییەکەوە.
     * Gemini تەنها کاتێک ناوەکە بەکاردەهێنێت کە وشەکە بە ڕوونی هەڵەنووسینی ئەو ناوە بێت.
     */
    private fun withHints(prompt: String, hints: List<String>): String {
        if (hints.isEmpty()) return prompt
        val head = prompt.substringBefore("\n\nText:\n")
        return head + " Possible proper names from a Kurdish names dictionary (its spellings may be informal): " +
            hints.joinToString("، ") + ". Use one ONLY if a word in the text is clearly a misspelling or mishearing of it, and then write it in correct standard Sorani spelling; " +
            "otherwise ignore this list. Never add a name that is not already in the text.\n\nText:\n"
    }

    /** ناوەکانی بەکارهێنەر: ئەگەر وشەیەک بە دەنگ لەو ناوانە بچێت، بە هەمان نووسین بنووسرێت. */
    private fun withNames(prompt: String, names: List<String>): String {
        if (names.isEmpty()) return prompt
        val head = prompt.substringBefore("\n\nText:\n")
        return head + " The speaker often says these names. Whenever a word in the text sounds like one of them (even if it also resembles a common word), write it with EXACTLY this spelling: " +
            names.joinToString("، ") + ".\n\nText:\n"
    }

    /**
     * چاککردنی دەستی (کاتێک بەکارهێنەر دووگمەی «چاک بکە» دادەگرێت): ئازادترە لە fix() و مۆدێلی بەهێزتر بەکاردێنێت.
     * دەقی چاککراو دەگەڕێنێتەوە (ڕەنگە هەمان دەق بێت)، یان null ئەگەر نەکرا. لە thread ی پاشبنەما بانگ بکرێت.
     */
    fun fixManual(text: String, keysRaw: String, pcm: ByteArray? = null, hints: List<String> = emptyList(), names: List<String> = emptyList()): String? {
        val src = text.trim()
        if (src.isEmpty() || keysRaw.isBlank()) return null
        return try {
            val out = GeminiKeys.withKeys(keysRaw) { key ->
                GeminiModels.call(false) { m, think ->
                    post(
                        body(src, m, false, withNames(withHints(if (pcm != null && pcm.size >= 16000 * 2) PROMPT_AUDIO else PROMPT_MANUAL, hints), names), 1024, pcm),
                        key, m, 10_000, 45_000
                    )
                }
            }.trim().trim('"', '`').trim()
            if (out.isEmpty()) return null
            val ratio = out.length.toFloat() / src.length
            val heard = pcm != null && pcm.size >= 16000 * 2   // بە دەنگەوە دەقە خراپەکە زۆر دەگۆڕێت، بۆیە سنوور فراوانترە
            if (ratio < (if (heard) 0.3f else 0.5f) || ratio > (if (heard) 2.5f else 1.8f)) return null
            // مۆدێل ڕێنمایی خۆی یان لێدوانی ئینگلیزی دەنووسێت (وەک "Keep the original...")؟ ڕەتی بکەرەوە.
            val srcLatin = src.count { it in 'a'..'z' || it in 'A'..'Z' }
            val outLatin = out.count { it in 'a'..'z' || it in 'A'..'Z' }
            if (outLatin - srcLatin > 6) return null
            val a = src.split(Regex("\\s+")).size
            val b = out.split(Regex("\\s+")).size
            if (!heard && b > a * 2 + 3) return null
            out
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
            null
        }
    }

    /** دەقی چاککراو، یان null ئەگەر نەکرا / متمانەی پێ ناکرێت. */
    fun fix(text: String, keysRaw: String, hints: List<String> = emptyList()): String? {
        val src = text.trim()
        if (src.length < 3 || keysRaw.isBlank()) return null
        return try {
            val out = GeminiKeys.withKeys(keysRaw) { key ->
                GeminiModels.call(true) { m, think -> post(body(src, m, think, withHints(PROMPT, hints)), key, m) }
            }
            accept(src, out)
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
            null
        }
    }

    internal fun body(src: String, model: String, think: Boolean, prompt: String = PROMPT, maxTokens: Int = 512, pcm: ByteArray? = null): String {
        val gen = JSONObject().put("temperature", 0).put("maxOutputTokens", maxTokens)
        if (think) gen.put("thinkingConfig", GeminiModels.thinking(model))
        return JSONObject()
            // ڕێنمایی لە system_instruction جیا دەکرێتەوە تا مۆدێل تێکەڵی دەقەکە نەکات و نەیگەڕێنێتەوە
            .put(
                "systemInstruction",
                JSONObject().put("parts", JSONArray().put(JSONObject().put("text", prompt.substringBefore("\n\nText:\n"))))
            )
            .put(
                "contents",
                JSONArray().put(
                    JSONObject().put("role", "user").put(
                        "parts",
                        JSONArray().apply {
                            if (pcm != null && pcm.size >= 16000 * 2) {
                                put(JSONObject().put("inlineData", JSONObject().put("mimeType", "audio/wav").put("data", Dictation.wavBase64(pcm))))
                            }
                            put(JSONObject().put("text", "Text:\n" + src))
                        }
                    )
                )
            )
            .put("generationConfig", gen)
            .toString()
    }

    /** پاراستن: دەبێت هێشتا هەمان دەق بێت (درێژی و ژمارەی وشە نزیک بێت)، نەک شرۆڤە یان وەرگێڕان. */
    private fun accept(src: String, raw: String): String? {
        val out = raw.trim().trim('"', '`').replace(Regex("\\s+"), " ")
        if (out.isEmpty()) return null
        val ratio = out.length.toFloat() / src.length
        if (ratio < 0.7f || ratio > 1.4f) return null
        val a = src.split(' ').size
        val b = out.split(' ').size
        if (kotlin.math.abs(a - b) > maxOf(2, a * 3 / 10)) return null
        return out
    }

    internal fun post(body: String, key: String, model: String, connectMs: Int = 4_000, readMs: Int = 7_000): String {
        val t0 = NetLog.now()
        val c = URL("https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/$model:generateContent")
            .openConnection() as HttpURLConnection
        try {
            c.requestMethod = "POST"
            c.connectTimeout = connectMs
            c.readTimeout = readMs
            c.doOutput = true
            c.setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
            c.setRequestProperty("x-goog-api-key", key)
            c.outputStream.use { it.write(body.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)) }
            val code = c.responseCode
            NetLog.ok("KurdishTextFix", "generateContent", c.url.toString(), code, t0)
            val resp = (if (code in 200..299) c.inputStream else c.errorStream)
                ?.bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8)?.use { it.readText() }.orEmpty()
            if (code !in 200..299) {
                val why = try {
                    JSONObject(resp).getJSONObject("error").getString("message")
                } catch (_: Exception) {
                    resp
                }
                throw ApiException(code, "Gemini $code ${why.take(140)}".trim())
            }
            return try {
                val parts = JSONObject(resp).getJSONArray("candidates").getJSONObject(0)
                    .getJSONObject("content").optJSONArray("parts")
                if (parts == null || parts.length() == 0) "" else parts.getJSONObject(0).optString("text", "")
            } catch (_: Exception) {
                throw IOException("Gemini وەڵامی بەتاڵی دایەوە")
            }
        } catch (e: Throwable) {
            NetLog.fail("KurdishTextFix", "generateContent", c.url.toString(), t0, e)
            throw e
        } finally {
            c.disconnect()
        }
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import android.content.Context

/**
 * فەرهەنگی شاراوەی وشەی سۆرانی بۆ باشترکردنی نووسینی ئۆفلاین (Vekol).
 * لیستەکە لە assets/kurdish_vocab.txt ـە و لە هیچ شوێنێکی ڕووکاردا نیشان نادرێت (نە لە خانەی «ناوەکانم»، نە لە ژمارەی «وشەی فێربوو»)،
 * و ناچێتە ناو داواکارییەکانی Gemini.
 *
 * چۆن کار دەکات: دوای ئەوەی Vekol دەقەکەی نووسی، هەر وشەیەک کە لە فەرهەنگەکەدا نییە و تەنها بە پیتە لێکچووەکان
 * (ە/ه، ی/ێ، و/ۆ، ر/ڕ، ل/ڵ، ف/ڤ...) لە وشەیەکی فەرهەنگەکە جیایە، دەگۆڕدرێت بەو وشەیە.
 * ئاسایشی: وشەی کورتتر لە ٥ پیت دەست لێ نادرێت؛ ئەگەر دوو وشەی فەرهەنگ دەگونجێن (نادڵنیایی) هیچ ناگۆڕدرێت؛
 * پاشگرە باوەکان (ەکە، ەکان، ان، ی، م، ت...) دەکرێنە لاوە و دووبارە دادەنرێنەوە.
 * لە thread ی پاشبنەما بانگ بکرێت (یەکەم جار ~٢٠KB دەخوێنێتەوە).
 */
object KurdishVocab {

    private const val MIN_LEN = 5
    private val CHUNK_SPLIT = Regex("[،,;؛\\n\\r]+")

    /** هەر دەستەیەک = پیتە لێکچووەکان (ئەو پیتەی یەکەم نوێنەرەکەیە). */
    private val CLASSES = arrayOf(
        "\u0647\u06D5\u062D",
        "\u06CC\u06CE",
        "\u0648\u06C6",
        "\u0631\u0695",
        "\u0644\u06B5",
        "\u0641\u06A4",
        "\u0626\u0639",
        "\u062E\u063A\u0642",
        "\u062A\u0637",
        "\u0633\u0635\u062B",
        "\u0632\u0638\u0636\u0630"
    )

    /** پاشگرەکان، درێژترین یەکەم (بە شێوەی ڕێکخراو). */
    private val SUFFIXES = arrayOf(
        "\u06D5\u06A9\u0627\u0646\u06CC\u0627\u0646",
        "\u06D5\u06A9\u0627\u0646\u062A\u0627\u0646",
        "\u06D5\u06A9\u0627\u0646\u0645\u0627\u0646",
        "\u06D5\u06A9\u06D5\u0645\u0627\u0646",
        "\u06D5\u06A9\u06D5\u06CC\u0627\u0646",
        "\u06D5\u06A9\u06D5\u062A\u0627\u0646",
        "\u06D5\u06A9\u0627\u0646\u0645",
        "\u06D5\u06A9\u0627\u0646\u062A",
        "\u06D5\u06A9\u0627\u0646\u06CC",
        "\u06D5\u06A9\u0627\u0646",
        "\u06D5\u06A9\u06D5\u0645",
        "\u06CC\u06D5\u0648\u06D5",
        "\u06D5\u06A9\u06D5\u06CC",
        "\u06D5\u06A9\u06D5\u062A",
        "\u062A\u0627\u0646",
        "\u06CC\u0627\u0646",
        "\u0645\u0627\u0646",
        "\u06D5\u06A9\u06D5",
        "\u06D5\u0648\u06D5",
        "\u06CE\u06A9\u06CC",
        "\u06CC\u06D5\u06A9",
        "\u06CE\u06A9",
        "\u06CC\u0634",
        "\u06D5\u06CC",
        "\u0627\u0646",
        "\u062F\u0627",
        "\u06CC\u0646",
        "\u06D5\u06A9",
        "\u0634",
        "\u06D5",
        "\u06CC",
        "\u0645",
        "\u06CE",
        "\u062A",
        ""
    )

    private val REP: Map<Char, Char> by lazy {
        val m = HashMap<Char, Char>()
        for (c in CLASSES) for (ch in c) m[ch] = c[0]
        m
    }

    @Volatile private var words: HashSet<String>? = null
    @Volatile private var bySkel: HashMap<String, ArrayList<String>>? = null

    private fun skel(s: String): String {
        val sb = StringBuilder(s.length)
        for (c in s) sb.append(REP[c] ?: c)
        return sb.toString()
    }

    @Synchronized
    private fun load(ctx: Context) {
        if (words != null) return
        val set = HashSet<String>(4096)
        val map = HashMap<String, ArrayList<String>>()
        fun add(w: String) {
            if (w.length < 2 || !set.add(w)) return
            if (w.length >= MIN_LEN) map.getOrPut(skel(w)) { ArrayList() }.add(w)
        }
        ctx.assets.open("kurdish_vocab.txt").bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8).useLines { lines ->
            for (line in lines) add(line.trim())
        }
        // لیستی زیادە (دەکرێت بە ڕێکخستنی نەکراوی، بە کۆما/دێڕ/ناونیشان جیا کرابێتەوە): assets/kurdish_vocab_extra.txt
        // هەر وشەیەک پاک دەکرێتەوە: نۆرماڵ، لاتینی/ژمارە/هێمای ناڕێک فڕێ دەدرێن، دووبارە نامێنێت.
        // ڕستەی چەند وشەیی (سەرۆکی پەرلەمان) وەک خۆی و وەک وشە جیاکانیش زیاد دەکرێت.
        try {
            ctx.assets.open("kurdish_vocab_extra.txt").bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8).useLines { lines ->
                for (line in lines) {
                    for (chunk in CHUNK_SPLIT.split(line)) {
                        val c = KurdishEntities.norm(chunk).trim()
                        if (c.isEmpty() || c.endsWith(":")) continue
                        for (w in c.split(' ')) {
                            val t = w.trim().trim('.', '،', ',', ':', '؛', '؟', '!')
                            if (t.length >= 2 && t.all { ch -> ch in '\u0621'..'\u06FF' && ch !in '\u0660'..'\u0669' && ch !in '\u06F0'..'\u06F9' }) add(t)
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (_: Throwable) { /* فایلی زیادە ئارەزوومەندانەیە */ }
        bySkel = map
        words = set
    }

    /**
     * دەقی ئۆفلاین چاک دەکات. [original] = دەقی خاوی Vekol؛ ئەگەر [text] لەسەر ئەو بنەمایە چاکرابێت (وشە فێربووەکان)،
     * ئەو وشانەی گۆڕدراون دەست لێ نادرێن. هەر هەڵەیەک ← دەقی ڕەسەن دەگەڕێتەوە.
     */
    fun fix(ctx: Context, text: String, original: String = text): String {
        if (text.isBlank()) return text
        return try {
            load(ctx)
            val ws = words ?: return text
            val idx = bySkel ?: return text
            val parts = text.split(' ')
            val orig = original.split(' ')
            val same = parts.size == orig.size
            var changed = false
            val out = ArrayList<String>(parts.size)
            for ((i, w) in parts.withIndex()) {
                if (same && w != orig[i]) { out.add(w); continue }
                val r = fixWord(w, ws, idx)
                if (r != w) changed = true
                out.add(r)
            }
            if (changed) out.joinToString(" ") else text
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
            text
        }
    }

    @Volatile private var promptCache: String? = null

    /**
     * لیستی وشەکان بۆ ناردن بۆ Gemini لە کاتی نووسینی دەنگ (نەک بۆ ڕاستکردنەوەی دەقی ئۆفلاین).
     * Gemini بە زیرەکی دەیانکاتە سەرچاوەی نووسینی ڕاست؛ تەنها کاتێک وشەکە لە دەنگەکەدا بیسترا.
     * ئەگەر هەڵە ڕووبدات، بەتاڵ دەگەڕێتەوە.
     */
    fun promptWords(ctx: Context): String {
        promptCache?.let { return it }
        return try {
            load(ctx)
            val list = (words ?: return "").filter { it.length >= 3 && it.all { c -> c in '\u0621'..'\u06FF' } }.sorted()
            val out = list.joinToString("، ")
            promptCache = out
            out
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
            ""
        }
    }

    private fun fixWord(w: String, ws: HashSet<String>, idx: HashMap<String, ArrayList<String>>): String {
        var a = 0
        var b = w.length
        while (a < b && !w[a].isLetter()) a++
        while (b > a && !w[b - 1].isLetter()) b--
        if (b - a < MIN_LEN) return w
        val core = KurdishEntities.norm(w.substring(a, b))
        for (c in core) if (c < '\u0621' || c > '\u06FF') return w     // لاتینی، ژمارە... دەست لێ نادرێت
        if (core.length < MIN_LEN || core in ws) return w
        // وشەی دروستی پاشگرداری وەک «ئەندازیارەکە»: دەمێنێتەوە
        for (suf in SUFFIXES) {
            if (core.length - suf.length < MIN_LEN || !core.endsWith(suf)) continue
            if (core.substring(0, core.length - suf.length) in ws) return w
        }
        for (suf in SUFFIXES) {
            if (core.length - suf.length < MIN_LEN || !core.endsWith(suf)) continue
            val fixed = nearest(core.substring(0, core.length - suf.length), idx) ?: continue
            return w.substring(0, a) + fixed + suf + w.substring(b)
        }
        return w
    }

    /** تەنها یەک وشەی فەرهەنگ کە بە ١ (یان ٢ بۆ وشەی درێژ) پیتی لێکچوو جیاوازە؛ ئەگەرنا null. */
    private fun nearest(stem: String, idx: HashMap<String, ArrayList<String>>): String? {
        val cands = idx[skel(stem)] ?: return null
        val limit = if (stem.length >= 7) 2 else 1
        var best: String? = null
        for (c in cands) {
            if (c.length != stem.length) continue
            var d = 0
            for (i in stem.indices) if (stem[i] != c[i]) d++
            if (d in 1..limit) {
                if (best != null && best != c) return null     // نادڵنیا: دوو وشە دەگونجێن
                best = c
            }
        }
        return best
    }

    // ---------- چاککردنی هەڵەی OCR (پیتە لێکچووەکانی خاڵ و شێوە) ----------

    private const val OCR_MIN = 4

    /** ئەو پیتانەی OCR تێکیان دەدات: خاڵەکان (ب پ ت ن ی ێ)، (ج چ ح خ)، (ک گ)، (ز ژ ر ڕ)، (ف ڤ ق)، ... */
    private val OCR_CLASSES = arrayOf(
        "\u0628\u067E\u062A\u0646\u06CC\u06CE\u062B",
        "\u062C\u0686\u062D\u062E",
        "\u06A9\u06AF\u0643",
        "\u0632\u0698\u0631\u0695",
        "\u0641\u06A4\u0642",
        "\u0648\u06C6",
        "\u0647\u06D5\u06BE",
        "\u0644\u06B5",
        "\u0633\u0634",
        "\u0635\u0636",
        "\u0637\u0638",
        "\u0639\u063A",
        "\u062F\u0630"
    )

    private val OCR_REP: Map<Char, Char> by lazy {
        val m = HashMap<Char, Char>()
        for (c in OCR_CLASSES) for (ch in c) m[ch] = c[0]
        m
    }

    private fun oskel(s: String): String {
        val sb = StringBuilder(s.length)
        for (c in s) sb.append(OCR_REP[c] ?: c)
        return sb.toString()
    }

    @Volatile private var byOcr: HashMap<String, ArrayList<String>>? = null

    @Synchronized
    private fun ocrIndex(ws: HashSet<String>): HashMap<String, ArrayList<String>> {
        byOcr?.let { return it }
        val m = HashMap<String, ArrayList<String>>()
        for (w in ws) if (w.length >= OCR_MIN) m.getOrPut(oskel(w)) { ArrayList() }.add(w)
        byOcr = m
        return m
    }

    /**
     * دەقی OCR چاک دەکات: وشەیەک کە لە فەرهەنگەکەدا نییە و تەنها بە پیتە لێکچووەکانی OCR (پ/ب، چ/ج، گ/ک، ژ/ز، ڤ/ف...)
     * لە یەک وشەی فەرهەنگ جیایە، دەگۆڕدرێت؛ ئەگەر دوو وشە دەگونجێن یان دڵنیا نییە، هیچ ناگۆڕدرێت.
     * هەر هەڵەیەک ← دەقی ڕەسەن.
     */
    fun fixOcr(ctx: Context, text: String): String {
        if (text.isBlank()) return text
        return try {
            load(ctx)
            val ws = words ?: return text
            val idx = ocrIndex(ws)
            KurdishOcrText.mapWords(text) { fixOcrWord(it, ws, idx) }
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
            text
        }
    }

    private fun fixOcrWord(w: String, ws: HashSet<String>, idx: HashMap<String, ArrayList<String>>): String {
        var a = 0
        var b = w.length
        while (a < b && !w[a].isLetter()) a++
        while (b > a && !w[b - 1].isLetter()) b--
        if (b - a < OCR_MIN) return w
        val core = w.substring(a, b)
        for (c in core) if (c < '\u0621' || c > '\u06FF') return w
        if (core in ws) return w
        for (suf in SUFFIXES) {
            if (core.length - suf.length < OCR_MIN || !core.endsWith(suf)) continue
            if (core.substring(0, core.length - suf.length) in ws) return w
        }
        for (suf in SUFFIXES) {
            if (core.length - suf.length < OCR_MIN || !core.endsWith(suf)) continue
            val fixed = nearestOcr(core.substring(0, core.length - suf.length), idx) ?: continue
            return w.substring(0, a) + fixed + suf + w.substring(b)
        }
        return w
    }

    private fun nearestOcr(stem: String, idx: HashMap<String, ArrayList<String>>): String? {
        val cands = idx[oskel(stem)] ?: return null
        val limit = if (stem.length >= 7) 2 else 1
        var best: String? = null
        for (c in cands) {
            if (c.length != stem.length) continue
            var d = 0
            for (i in stem.indices) if (stem[i] != c[i]) d++
            if (d in 1..limit) {
                if (best != null && best != c) return null
                best = c
            }
        }
        return best
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

/**
 * دەقی سۆرانی ← دەقێکی ئینگلیزیی ڕوون، کە دەنگی ئینگلیزیی ئۆفلاینی ناو مۆبایل بە نزیکترین دەنگ بۆ کوردی
 * بیخوێنێتەوە. تەنها بۆ خوێندنەوەیە، نەک نووسینی ڕەسمیی کوردی.
 *
 * ڕێساکان (هەموو بە شێوازی نووسینی ئینگلیزی، تا دەنگە ئینگلیزییەکە هەڵە نەخوێنێتەوە):
 *   ا = ah  ە = eh  ێ = ay  ۆ = oh  وو/و = oo  ی = ee  (y/w ئەگەر لە نێوان دەنگدارەکان بێت)
 *   چ = ch  ش = sh  ژ = zh  خ = kh  غ = gh  ج = j  ڕ = r  ڵ = l  ق = k  ڤ = v
 *   ئەو = ow ، ئاو = ow ، ەی = ay ، دەنگی کورتی «i» ی نەنووسراو لە کۆمەڵە پیتی بێدەنگ دەخرێتە ناو وشە
 */
object KurdishVoiceText {

    const val EN = 0
    const val PIPER = 4 // مۆدێلی نیورالی کوردی (Piper/ONNX) — دەقی سۆرانی بێ گۆڕین؛ بڕوانە PiperTts

    fun convert(text: String, mode: Int): String = when (mode) {
        PIPER -> text
        else -> toEnglish(text)
    }

    private val vowelLetters = setOf('ا', 'ە', 'ێ', 'ۆ', 'ی', 'و', 'ؤ')

    private val enCons = mapOf(
        'ب' to "b", 'پ' to "p", 'ت' to "t", 'ج' to "j", 'چ' to "ch",
        'ح' to "h", 'خ' to "kh", 'د' to "d", 'ر' to "r", 'ڕ' to "r",
        'ز' to "z", 'ژ' to "zh", 'س' to "s", 'ش' to "sh", 'غ' to "gh",
        'ف' to "f", 'ڤ' to "v", 'ق' to "k", 'ک' to "k", 'گ' to "g",
        'ل' to "l", 'ڵ' to "l", 'م' to "m", 'ن' to "n", 'ه' to "h",
        'ھ' to "h", 'ث' to "s", 'ذ' to "z", 'ص' to "s", 'ض' to "z",
        'ط' to "t", 'ظ' to "z", 'ك' to "k", 'ڪ' to "k", 'ع' to ""
    )

    private val digits = mapOf(
        '٠' to '0', '١' to '1', '٢' to '2', '٣' to '3', '٤' to '4',
        '٥' to '5', '٦' to '6', '٧' to '7', '٨' to '8', '٩' to '9',
        '۰' to '0', '۱' to '1', '۲' to '2', '۳' to '3', '۴' to '4',
        '۵' to '5', '۶' to '6', '۷' to '7', '۸' to '8', '۹' to '9'
    )

    private val punct = mapOf('،' to ",", '؟' to "?", '؛' to ";", '۔' to ".", '«' to "\"", '»' to "\"")

    private fun isArabicLetter(c: Char) = c in '\u0600'..'\u06FF' || c in '\u0750'..'\u077F'

    /** وشە باوەکان کە ڕێساکە بە باشی ناینووسێت؛ ڕاستەوخۆ بە شێوەی ڕوون دەنووسرێن. */
    private val common = mapOf(
        "ئەو" to "ow", "ئاو" to "ow", "ئەم" to "ehm", "ئەمە" to "ehmeh", "ئەوە" to "ehweh",
        "ئەوان" to "ehwahn", "ئێمە" to "aymeh", "ئێوە" to "aywe", "من" to "min", "تۆ" to "toh",
        "ئێستا" to "aystah", "ئەمڕۆ" to "ehmroh", "سڵاو" to "slow", "سوپاس" to "soopahs",
        "بۆ" to "boh", "بە" to "beh", "لە" to "leh", "کە" to "keh", "وە" to "weh", "و" to "oo",
        "نا" to "nah", "نەخێر" to "nehkhayr", "بەڵێ" to "behlay", "باشە" to "bahsheh",
        "چی" to "chee", "چۆن" to "chohn", "کێ" to "kay", "کوێ" to "kway", "کەی" to "kay",
        "زۆر" to "zohr", "هەموو" to "hehmoo", "هیچ" to "heech",
        "هاوڕێ" to "hahwray", "ئاوات" to "ahwaht", "هەناسە" to "hehnahseh", "گیان" to "gyahn",
        "دڵخۆش" to "dilkhohsh", "هاوسەر" to "hahwsehr", "ژوور" to "zhoor", "ئازا" to "ahzah"
    )

    fun toEnglish(text: String): String {
        val sb = StringBuilder()
        var i = 0
        val n = text.length
        while (i < n) {
            val c = text[i]
            if (!isArabicLetter(c) || c in punct || c in digits) {
                sb.append(digits[c] ?: punct[c] ?: c)
                i++
                continue
            }
            var j = i
            while (j < n && isArabicLetter(text[j]) && text[j] !in punct && text[j] !in digits) j++
            sb.append(englishWord(text.substring(i, j)))
            i = j
        }
        return sb.toString().replace(Regex("\\s+"), " ").trim()
    }

    private class Tok(val s: String, val vowel: Boolean)

    private fun englishWord(raw: String): String {
        val w = raw.filter { it !in '\u064B'..'\u065F' && it != 'ـ' && it != '\u200c' && it != '\u200d' }
            .replace('ك', 'ک').replace('ي', 'ی').replace('ى', 'ی').replace('ة', 'ە')
        common[w]?.let { return it }
        val toks = ArrayList<Tok>()
        var i = 0
        while (i < w.length) {
            val c = w[i]
            val next = w.getOrNull(i + 1)
            val prev = w.getOrNull(i - 1)
            val nextNext = w.getOrNull(i + 2)
            when {
                c == 'و' && next == 'و' -> { toks.add(Tok("oo", true)); i += 2; continue }
                // ەو / او لە کۆتای وشە: دووپیت (diphthong) = ow
                (c == 'ە' || c == 'ا') && next == 'و' && nextNext == null -> {
                    toks.add(Tok("ow", true)); i += 2; continue
                }
                // ەی: ay (کەی = kay)
                c == 'ە' && next == 'ی' && (nextNext == null || nextNext !in vowelLetters) -> {
                    toks.add(Tok("ay", true)); i += 2; continue
                }
                c == 'و' -> {
                    val nextIsVowel = next != null && next in vowelLetters
                    val afterVowel = prev != null && prev in setOf('ا', 'ە', 'ێ', 'ۆ')
                    if (nextIsVowel || afterVowel) toks.add(Tok("w", false)) else toks.add(Tok("oo", true))
                }
                c == 'ی' -> {
                    val nextIsVowel = next != null && next in vowelLetters && next != 'ی'
                    if (i == 0 || nextIsVowel) toks.add(Tok("y", false)) else toks.add(Tok("ee", true))
                }
                c == 'ێ' -> toks.add(Tok("ay", true))
                c == 'ە' -> toks.add(Tok("eh", true))
                c == 'ۆ' || c == 'ؤ' -> toks.add(Tok("oh", true))
                c == 'ا' -> toks.add(Tok("ah", true))
                c == 'ئ' || c == 'ء' -> { }
                else -> {
                    val s = enCons[c]
                    if (!s.isNullOrEmpty()) toks.add(Tok(s, false))
                }
            }
            i++
        }
        // دەنگی کورتی «i» کە سۆرانی ناینووسێت: bra → bira ، سێ بێدەنگ لە ڕیز → i لە ناوەڕاست
        val o = StringBuilder()
        var run = 0
        for ((idx, t) in toks.withIndex()) {
            if (!t.vowel) {
                run++
                if ((run == 2 && idx == 1) || run == 3) {
                    o.append('i')
                    run = 1
                }
            } else run = 0
            o.append(t.s)
        }
        return o.toString()
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import android.content.Context
import android.util.Log

/**
 * کوردیی نووسراو بە پیتی لاتینی (وەک چاتی فەیسبووک: "aw mawzw3a kwa 😂 xark esta ferbwwa...")
 * دەگۆڕێت بۆ کوردیی سۆرانی بە پیتی کوردی، پێش ئەوەی بنێردرێت بۆ tts.pawan.krd.
 *
 *  - ئەگەر Gemini چالاک بوو (کلیل هەیە)، وشە بە وشە بە مانا دەگۆڕدرێت («aw» = ئەو، نەک ئاو لە پیتەکانەوە).
 *  - ئەگەر Gemini نەبوو یان شکستی هێنا، ڕێسای سادەی ناوخۆیی بەکار دێت (نزیکە، نەک تەواو ڕاست).
 *  - ژمارەکان وەک پیت: 3 = ع، 7 = ح، 5 = خ، 2 = ئ.
 *  - دەکرێت لە ڕێکخستنەکان بکوژێندرێتەوە (TranslatorSettings.latinKurdish).
 */
object LatinKurdish {
    private const val TAG = "LatinKurdish"

    private val ENGLISH = setOf(
        "the", "and", "is", "are", "you", "to", "of", "in", "it", "that", "this", "for", "with", "was", "have",
        "not", "but", "my", "me", "your", "we", "they", "he", "she", "what", "how", "so", "do", "can", "will"
    )

    /** وشە باوەکانی کوردیی لاتینی؛ ئەگەر هەبوون، دەزانین ئینگلیزی نییە. */
    private val KU_HINTS = setOf(
        "aw", "ba", "la", "ke", "bo", "da", "ez", "nye", "nia", "xo", "esta", "chon", "chi", "kwa", "kwe", "ama",
        "ewa", "ema", "ewan", "min", "tu", "em", "wa", "ya", "le", "lew", "pe", "bas", "baw", "zor", "kam",
        "hamw", "hama", "xosh", "xwsh", "dakat", "dakre", "dakam", "dabe", "nabe", "bash", "xrap", "rast", "drw",
        "brat", "bram", "xoshm", "spas", "slaw", "ba", "hich", "hamu", "chawa", "chonet", "tkaya", "shtek", "shtana"
    )

    /** ووشە باوەکان: وشەی تەواو، ئەگەر لە لیستەکەدا بوو. */
    private val DICT = mapOf(
        "aw" to "ئەو", "ba" to "بە", "la" to "لە", "ke" to "کە", "bo" to "بۆ", "da" to "دا", "ez" to "ئەز",
        "nye" to "نییە", "nia" to "نییە", "xo" to "خۆ", "esta" to "ئێستا", "chon" to "چۆن", "chi" to "چی",
        "kwa" to "کوا", "ama" to "ئەمە", "ewa" to "ئەوە", "ema" to "ئەمە", "ewan" to "ئەوان", "min" to "من",
        "tu" to "تۆ", "em" to "ئەم", "wa" to "وا", "ya" to "یا", "le" to "لێ", "pe" to "پێ", "bas" to "باس",
        "zor" to "زۆر", "kam" to "کەم", "xosh" to "خۆش", "bash" to "باش", "xrap" to "خراپ", "rast" to "ڕاست",
        "brat" to "برات", "bram" to "برام", "spas" to "سوپاس", "slaw" to "سڵاو", "hich" to "هیچ", "hamu" to "هەموو",
        "chawa" to "چاوا", "shtek" to "شتێک", "shtana" to "شتانە", "ferbwwa" to "فێربووە", "bamash" to "بەمەش",
        "bren" to "بڕێن", "dakre" to "دەکرێ", "dakat" to "دەکات", "dakam" to "دەکەم", "dabe" to "دەبێ",
        "nabe" to "نابێ", "w" to "و", "u" to "و", "y" to "ی"
    )

    /** ئایا ئەم دەقە کوردیی لاتینییە و پێویستە بگۆڕدرێت؟ */
    fun needsConversion(settings: TranslatorSettings, text: String): Boolean {
        if (!settings.latinKurdish) return false
        var letters = 0
        var latin = 0
        for (ch in text) {
            if (!ch.isLetter()) continue
            letters++
            if (ch in 'a'..'z' || ch in 'A'..'Z') latin++
        }
        if (letters < 3 || latin * 100 < letters * 70) return false
        val words = text.lowercase().split(Regex("[^a-z0-9]+")).filter { it.isNotEmpty() }
        if (words.isEmpty()) return false
        if (words.any { it in KU_HINTS || (it.length > 2 && it.any { c -> c == '3' || c == '7' }) }) return true
        val eng = words.count { it in ENGLISH }
        return !(words.size >= 4 && eng * 100 >= words.size * 25)
    }

    /** ئیمۆجی و هێما لادەبات، چونکە ماڵپەڕەکە نایخوێنێتەوە. */
    fun clean(text: String): String {
        val sb = StringBuilder(text.length)
        var i = 0
        while (i < text.length) {
            val cp = text.codePointAt(i)
            val n = Character.charCount(cp)
            val isEmoji = cp in 0x1F000..0x1FAFF || cp in 0x2600..0x27BF || cp in 0xFE00..0xFE0F || cp == 0x200D || cp in 0x2B00..0x2BFF
            if (!isEmoji) sb.appendCodePoint(cp)
            i += n
        }
        return sb.toString().replace(Regex("[ \\t]+"), " ").trim()
    }

    /** دەقی ئامادە بۆ خوێندنەوە. بلۆک دەکات (thread ی پاشبنەما بانگ بکرێت ئەگەر needsConversion = true). */
    fun convert(ctx: Context, settings: TranslatorSettings, text: String): String {
        val src = clean(text)
        if (!needsConversion(settings, src)) return src
        if (settings.geminiTtsKey.isNotBlank()) {
            try {
                ai(src, settings.geminiTtsKey)?.let { return it }
            } catch (t: Throwable) {
                Log.w(TAG, "gemini convert failed: ${t.message}")
            }
        }
        return rough(src)
    }

    private const val PROMPT =
        "You convert Central Kurdish (Sorani) written in Latin letters (chat spelling, Arabizi style) into proper Sorani Kurdish in Arabic script, " +
            "so that a text-to-speech engine reads it correctly. Read each whole sentence and choose the right Sorani word by meaning and context, " +
            "not letter by letter (for example 'aw' = ئەو, 'esta' = ئێستا, 'ba' = بە, 'la' = لە). " +
            "Digits used as letters: 3 = ع, 7 = ح, 5 = خ, 2 = ئ. Common chat letters: x = خ, q = ق, w = و or وو, y = ی, sh = ش, ch = چ, zh/j = ژ, gh = غ, v = ڤ, " +
            "e can be ە or ێ, a can be ا or ە, i = ی, u = و. Use the correct Sorani letters (ی ک ە ێ ۆ ڵ ڕ). " +
            "Remove emojis. Keep numbers, punctuation and English words/brand names as they are. " +
            "If the text is already in Arabic script, or is entirely English, return it unchanged. " +
            "Do NOT translate, summarize or add anything. Return ONLY the converted text on one line.\n\nText:\n"

    private fun ai(src: String, keysRaw: String): String? {
        val out = GeminiKeys.withKeys(keysRaw) { key ->
            GeminiModels.call(true) { m, think ->
                KurdishTextFix.post(KurdishTextFix.body(src, m, think, PROMPT, 1024), key, m, 4_000, 9_000)
            }
        }.trim().trim('"', '`').replace(Regex("\\s+"), " ").trim()
        if (out.isEmpty()) return null
        if (out.equals(src, ignoreCase = true)) return src      // ئینگلیزی بوو، وەک خۆی
        var letters = 0
        var arabic = 0
        for (c in out) {
            if (!c.isLetter()) continue
            letters++
            if (c.code in 0x0600..0x06FF) arabic++
        }
        if (letters == 0 || arabic * 100 < letters * 50) return null
        val ratio = out.length.toFloat() / src.length
        if (ratio < 0.3f || ratio > 2.5f) return null
        return out
    }

    // ---------- ڕێسای ناوخۆیی (نزیکە) ----------

    private val DIGRAPH = mapOf(
        "sh" to "ش", "ch" to "چ", "kh" to "خ", "gh" to "غ", "zh" to "ژ", "ee" to "ێ", "oo" to "وو", "ww" to "وو",
        "ll" to "ڵ", "rr" to "ڕ", "aa" to "ا"
    )
    private val SINGLE = mapOf(
        'b' to "ب", 'c' to "چ", 'd' to "د", 'f' to "ف", 'g' to "گ", 'h' to "ه", 'j' to "ژ", 'k' to "ک",
        'l' to "ل", 'm' to "م", 'n' to "ن", 'p' to "پ", 'q' to "ق", 'r' to "ر", 's' to "س", 't' to "ت",
        'v' to "ڤ", 'w' to "و", 'x' to "خ", 'y' to "ی", 'z' to "ز", 'i' to "ی", 'u' to "و", 'o' to "ۆ",
        'e' to "ێ", '3' to "ع", '7' to "ح", '5' to "خ", '2' to "ئ"
    )

    private fun roughWord(w: String): String {
        val lw = w.lowercase()
        DICT[lw]?.let { return it }
        val sb = StringBuilder()
        var i = 0
        while (i < lw.length) {
            val two = if (i + 1 < lw.length) lw.substring(i, i + 2) else ""
            val d = DIGRAPH[two]
            if (d != null) { sb.append(d); i += 2; continue }
            val c = lw[i]
            val last = i == lw.length - 1
            if (c == 'a') {
                sb.append(if (i == 0) "ئا" else if (last) "ە" else "ا")
            } else if (i == 0 && (c == 'e' || c == 'i' || c == 'o')) {
                sb.append(if (c == 'e') "ئێ" else if (c == 'i') "ئی" else "ئۆ")
            } else {
                sb.append(SINGLE[c] ?: c.toString())
            }
            i++
        }
        return sb.toString()
    }

    /** گۆڕینی نزیک بەبێ ئینتەرنێت/Gemini. هەر وشەیەکی لاتینی دەگۆڕێت، ئەوانی تر وەک خۆیان. */
    fun rough(text: String): String {
        val sb = StringBuilder()
        val tok = Regex("[A-Za-z0-9]+|[^A-Za-z0-9]+")
        for (m in tok.findAll(text)) {
            val t = m.value
            sb.append(if (t[0].isLetterOrDigit() && t.any { it in 'a'..'z' || it in 'A'..'Z' }) roughWord(t) else t)
        }
        return sb.toString()
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

/**
 * «ئایا ئەم دێڕە هەمان ئەو دێڕەیە کە پێشتر خوێندرایەوە؟» — بۆ بڕیاری نەخوێندنەوە.
 * تەنگە بە ئەنقەست: ڕستەیەکی نوێ هەرگیز نابێت بە هەڵە وەک دووبارە بفڕێدرێت. تەنها هەڵەی بچووکی OCR قبوڵ دەکرێت
 * (یەک پیت لە ڕستەی ناوەند، ٧٪ لە ڕستەی درێژ)، و ڕستەی کورت (<١٥ پیت) دەبێت بە تەواوی یەکسان بێت.
 * ژمارەکان دەبێت یەکسان بن («چاپتەر ٣» ≠ «چاپتەر ٥»).
 * [a] و [b] دەبێت پێشتر norm کرابن (پیت و ژمارە، بێ بۆشایی، پیتی بچووک).
 */
object LineIdentity {
    fun same(a: String, b: String): Boolean {
        if (a.isEmpty() || b.isEmpty()) return false
        if (a == b) return true
        // جیاوازی تەنها لە پیتە لێکچووەکانی OCR (I/l/1، O/0، rn/m...) ← هەمان دێڕە، تەنانەت لە ڕستەی کورتیشدا
        val fa = fold(a)
        val fb = fold(b)
        if (fa == fb) return true
        val m = maxOf(a.length, b.length)
        if (m < 15) return false
        if (a.filter { it.isDigit() } != b.filter { it.isDigit() }) return false
        val allowed = if (m < 40) 1 else (m * 0.07f).toInt()
        if (kotlin.math.abs(a.length - b.length) > allowed) return false
        return lev(fa, fb, allowed) <= allowed
    }

    /** پیتە لێکچووەکانی OCR دەکاتە یەک شێوە (تەنها بۆ بەراورد، دەقی خوێندراو ناگۆڕێت) */
    internal fun fold(s: String): String {
        val sb = StringBuilder(s.length)
        for (c in s) sb.append(when (c) {
            'i', 'l', '1', 'j' -> 'l'
            '0' -> 'o'
            '5' -> 's'
            else -> c
        })
        return sb.toString().replace("rn", "m").replace("vv", "w")
    }

    /** دووریی Levenshtein، بە وەستان کاتێک لە [limit] تێپەڕی */
    private fun lev(a: String, b: String, limit: Int): Int {
        var prev = IntArray(b.length + 1) { it }
        var cur = IntArray(b.length + 1)
        for (i in 1..a.length) {
            cur[0] = i
            var rowMin = cur[0]
            for (j in 1..b.length) {
                val cost = if (a[i - 1] == b[j - 1]) 0 else 1
                cur[j] = minOf(cur[j - 1] + 1, prev[j] + 1, prev[j - 1] + cost)
                if (cur[j] < rowMin) rowMin = cur[j]
            }
            if (rowMin > limit) return rowMin
            val t = prev; prev = cur; cur = t
        }
        return prev[b.length]
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import android.app.Activity
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.Typeface
import android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import android.view.Gravity
import android.view.View
import android.widget.FrameLayout
import android.widget.ImageView
import android.widget.LinearLayout
import android.widget.ScrollView
import android.widget.TextView

/**
 * پرسیاری «خوێندەواریت؟» بە دیزاینی ئەپەکە (پاشبنەمای شووشەیی + کارتی شووشەیی).
 * دوو کارتی گەورە بە ژمارە: 1 = خوێندەوار، 2 = نەخوێندەوار. دەنگەکە ژمارەکان دەڵێت و هەر ١٨ چرکە دووبارە دەبێتەوە.
 */
object LiteracyPicker {

    class Handle(val view: View, val speakNow: () -> Unit)

    private const val SPEECH =
        "تۆ خوێندەواریت؟ ئەگەر خوێندەواریت، ژمارە یەک دابگرە. ئەگەر خوێندەوار نیت، ژمارە دوو دابگرە."

    fun show(act: Activity, host: FrameLayout, pal: Palette, onChosen: (Int) -> Unit): Handle {
        val ui = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
        val dens = act.resources.displayMetrics.density
        fun dp(v: Int) = (v * dens).toInt()

        val textMain = if (pal.light) Color.parseColor("#0F172A") else Color.WHITE
        val textDim = if (pal.light) Color.parseColor("#64748B") else Color.parseColor("#C5D5EE")
        val cardFill = Color.parseColor(if (pal.light) "#FFFFFF" else "#1AFFFFFF")
        val cardStroke = Color.parseColor(if (pal.light) "#E6EBF5" else "#40FFFFFF")

        val overlay = FrameLayout(act).apply { isClickable = true }
        overlay.addView(GlassBackground(act, pal), FrameLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -1))

        val col = LinearLayout(act).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL
            layoutDirection = View.LAYOUT_DIRECTION_RTL
            setPadding(dp(22), dp(48), dp(22), dp(40))
        }

        // لۆگۆ
        val logoWrap = FrameLayout(act).apply {
            setPadding(dp(10), dp(10), dp(10), dp(10))
            background = GradientDrawable().apply {
                shape = GradientDrawable.OVAL
                setColor(cardFill)
                setStroke(dp(1), cardStroke)
            }
        }
        logoWrap.addView(ImageView(act).apply {
            setImageResource(R.drawable.app_logo)
            scaleType = ImageView.ScaleType.FIT_CENTER
        }, FrameLayout.LayoutParams(dp(84), dp(84)))
        col.addView(logoWrap, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-2, -2).apply { bottomMargin = dp(18) })

        col.addView(TextView(act).apply {
            text = "تۆ خوێندەواریت؟"
            textSize = 26f
            typeface = Typeface.DEFAULT_BOLD
            setTextColor(textMain)
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
        }, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -2).apply { bottomMargin = dp(6) })
        col.addView(TextView(act).apply {
            text = "یەکێکیان دابگرە"
            textSize = 14f
            setTextColor(textDim)
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
        }, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -2).apply { bottomMargin = dp(26) })

        fun choose(n: Int) {
            TranslatorSettings(act).literacy = n
            ui.removeCallbacksAndMessages(null)
            Narrator.stop()
            host.removeView(overlay)
            onChosen(n)
        }

        fun option(n: Int, label: String, from: Int, to: Int): View {
            val row = LinearLayout(act).apply {
                orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
                gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
                layoutDirection = View.LAYOUT_DIRECTION_RTL
                setPadding(dp(14), dp(14), dp(20), dp(14))
                isClickable = true
                background = GradientDrawable().apply {
                    cornerRadius = dp(24).toFloat()
                    setColor(cardFill)
                    setStroke(dp(1), cardStroke)
                }
                setOnClickListener { choose(n) }
                elevation = if (pal.light) 6f * dens else 0f
            }
            row.addView(TextView(act).apply {
                text = n.toString()
                textSize = 34f
                typeface = Typeface.DEFAULT_BOLD
                setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
                gravity = Gravity.CENTER
                layoutDirection = View.LAYOUT_DIRECTION_LTR
                background = GradientDrawable(GradientDrawable.Orientation.TL_BR, intArrayOf(from, to)).apply {
                    shape = GradientDrawable.OVAL
                    setStroke(dp(2), Color.parseColor("#B3FFFFFF"))
                }
            }, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(dp(70), dp(70)).apply { marginEnd = dp(16) })
            row.addView(TextView(act).apply {
                text = label
                textSize = 21f
                typeface = Typeface.DEFAULT_BOLD
                setTextColor(textMain)
            })
            return row
        }

        col.addView(option(1, "خوێندەوارم", Color.parseColor("#14B87A"), pal.a2),
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -2).apply { bottomMargin = dp(14) })
        col.addView(option(2, "نەخوێندەوارم", Color.parseColor("#FF7A45"), Color.parseColor("#FFD166")),
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -2))

        overlay.addView(ScrollView(act).apply {
            isFillViewport = true
            isVerticalScrollBarEnabled = false
            addView(col, FrameLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -2, Gravity.CENTER))
        }, FrameLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -1))
        host.addView(overlay, FrameLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -1))

        val tick = object : Runnable {
            override fun run() {
                if (overlay.parent == null) return
                if (Narrator.isReady(act)) {
                    Narrator.speak(act, SPEECH)
                    ui.postDelayed(this, 18000)
                } else {
                    ui.postDelayed(this, 1500)
                }
            }
        }
        ui.postDelayed(tick, 700)

        return Handle(overlay) { if (Narrator.isReady(act)) Narrator.speak(act, SPEECH) }
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

/**
 * ڕووبەری ژێرنووس کاتێک شاشە دەسوڕێتەوە (یوتوب فوڵسکرین = لاندسکەیپ). فەنکشنی پاک، بێ Android، تاقیکراو.
 *
 * ڕووبەرەکە بە پیکسێلی شاشەی ئەو ئاراستەیە دیاری کراوە؛ لە ئاراستەیەکی تر واتای نییە (لە لاندسکەیپدا دەکەوێتە شوێنی هەڵە).
 * بۆیە بۆ هەر ئاراستەیەک ڕووبەرێکی جیاواز هەیە: ئەوەی بەکارهێنەر دیاری کردووە، یان ئەگەر نەبوو بارێکی بنەڕەتی
 * لە خوارەوەی ڤیدیۆ (شوێنی ئاسایی ژێرنووس).
 */
object LiveGeometry {
    class Box(val left: Float, val top: Float, val right: Float, val bottom: Float)
    class Size(val w: Int, val h: Int)

    /** قەبارەی شاشە لە ئاراستەی [landscape]، لەسەر بنەمای قەبارەی فیزیکی (ڕووبەری گرتن لە ئاراستەکانی تر هەمان پیکسێلە) */
    fun screenFor(landscape: Boolean, anyW: Int, anyH: Int): Size {
        val long = maxOf(anyW, anyH).coerceAtLeast(2)
        val short = minOf(anyW, anyH).coerceAtLeast(2)
        return if (landscape) Size(long, short) else Size(short, long)
    }

    /** باری بنەڕەتی: لاندسکەیپ = ژێرەوەی ڤیدیۆی فوڵسکرین؛ پۆرترەیت = خوارەوەی ڤیدیۆی سەرەوەی شاشە */
    fun defaultBand(w: Int, h: Int): Box =
        if (w > h) Box(w * 0.10f, h * 0.70f, w * 0.90f, h * 0.96f)
        else Box(w * 0.04f, h * 0.20f, w * 0.96f, h * 0.34f)
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

/** Service-owned lifecycle; a generation rejects callbacks from closed live runs. */
internal class LivePlaybackControl<T> {
    enum class Phase { STOPPED, RUNNING, PAUSED }
    @Volatile var phase = Phase.STOPPED
        private set
    @Volatile var generation = 0
        private set
    private var selection: T? = null

    @Synchronized fun start(value: T): Int {
        generation++
        selection = value
        phase = Phase.RUNNING
        return generation
    }
    @Synchronized fun pause(value: T): Boolean {
        if (phase != Phase.RUNNING) return false
        phase = Phase.PAUSED
        generation++
        selection = value
        return true
    }
    @Synchronized fun resume(): T? {
        if (phase != Phase.PAUSED) return null
        val value = selection ?: return null
        generation++
        phase = Phase.RUNNING
        return value
    }
    @Synchronized fun accepts(token: Int): Boolean = phase == Phase.RUNNING && generation == token
    @Synchronized fun withCurrent(token: Int, action: () -> Unit) {
        if (accepts(token)) action()
    }
    @Synchronized fun stop() {
        phase = Phase.STOPPED
        generation++
        selection = null
    }
}

/** The live control sits beside the existing stop button and stays on screen. */
internal object LiveControlLayout {
    data class Point(val x: Int, val y: Int)
    fun position(screenW: Int, screenH: Int, stopX: Int, stopY: Int, stopSize: Int, size: Int, gap: Int): Point {
        val right = stopX + stopSize + gap
        val x = if (right + size <= screenW) right else stopX - size - gap
        return Point(x.coerceIn(0, (screenW - size).coerceAtLeast(0)),
            stopY.coerceIn(0, (screenH - size).coerceAtLeast(0)))
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

/** Faster live sampling without overlapping OCR or exceeding Accessibility limits. */
internal object LiveRefresh {
    fun captureMs(low: Boolean) = if (low) 110L else 70L
    // Accessibility screenshots are rate-limited by Android, but the normal
    // path can safely ask again sooner than the old 350ms interval.
    fun accessibilityMs(low: Boolean) = if (low) 450L else 340L
    // Keep one OCR at a time, but sample a changed subtitle sooner so the
    // next line can enter translation while the current line is spoken.
    fun ocrGapMs(kurdish: Boolean) = if (kurdish) 60L else 70L
    fun forceMs(kurdish: Boolean) = if (kurdish) 70L else 100L
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

/** Main-thread speech lifecycle. Successful/uncertain finishes never replay audio. */
internal class LiveSpeechAttempt {
    var token = 0
        private set
    private var active = false
    private var text = ""
    private val retried = LinkedHashSet<String>()
    data class Failure(val retryText: String?)

    fun begin(value: String): Int {
        token++
        active = true
        text = value
        return token
    }
    fun isCurrent(value: Int): Boolean = active && value == token
    fun complete(value: Int): Boolean {
        if (!isCurrent(value)) return false
        active = false
        text = ""
        return true
    }
    fun fail(value: Int, sourceVisible: Boolean, retryAllowed: Boolean = true): Failure? {
        if (!isCurrent(value)) return null
        val failed = text
        complete(value)
        if (!retryAllowed || !sourceVisible || failed.isBlank() || !retried.add(failed)) return Failure(null)
        if (retried.size > 200) retried.remove(retried.first())
        return Failure(failed)
    }
    fun cancel() { active = false; text = ""; token++ }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

/** Early speech at sentence/clause boundaries; never cut an arbitrary word group. */
internal object LiveSpeechParts {
    private val sentences = Regex("(?<=[.!?؟…。！？])\\s+")
    private val clauses = Regex("(?<=[,،;؛:])\\s+")
    private val abbreviation = Regex("(?i)(?:.*\\s)?(?:mr|mrs|ms|dr|prof|sr|jr|st|[a-z]|(?:[a-z]\\.)+[a-z])\\.")
    fun split(text: String): List<String> {
        val whole = text.trim()
        val parts = ArrayList<String>()
        var previous = ""
        for (piece in whole.split(sentences).map { it.trim() }.filter { it.isNotEmpty() }) {
            previous = if (previous.isEmpty()) piece else "$previous $piece"
            if (abbreviation.matches(previous)) continue
            if (previous.length >= 100) {
                var chunk = ""
                for (clause in previous.split(clauses)) {
                    chunk = if (chunk.isEmpty()) clause else "$chunk $clause"
                    if (chunk.length >= 40) { parts.add(chunk); chunk = "" }
                }
                if (chunk.isNotEmpty()) {
                    if (parts.isNotEmpty() && chunk.length < 20) parts[parts.lastIndex] += " $chunk"
                    else parts.add(chunk)
                }
            } else parts.add(previous)
            previous = ""
        }
        if (previous.isNotEmpty()) parts.add(previous)
        while (parts.size > 4) {
            val last = parts.removeAt(parts.lastIndex)
            parts[parts.lastIndex] += " $last"
        }
        return if (parts.size >= 2) parts else emptyList()
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

/**
 * Length-aware speed for the live subtitle speech queue only.
 * The returned value is a multiplier over the user's configured speech speed.
 */
internal object LiveSpeechSpeed {
    fun boost(text: String, queueBoost: Float = 1f, baseSpeed: Float = 1f): Float {
        val base = baseSpeed.coerceIn(0.5f, 2f)
        val ceiling = maxOf(1.5f, base).coerceAtMost(2f)
        val clean = text.trim()
        if (clean.isEmpty()) return (maxOf(base, base * queueBoost).coerceAtMost(ceiling) / base)

        val words = clean.split(Regex("\\s+")).count { it.isNotBlank() }
        val lengthBoost = when {
            words >= 12 -> 1.5f
            words >= 8 -> 1.35f
            words >= 6 -> 1.25f
            else -> 1f
        }
        // Exact live-subtitle rule: under six words always keeps the user's
        // selected speed; queue backlog must not override that rule.
        val target = (base * lengthBoost).coerceAtMost(ceiling)
        return (target / base).coerceAtLeast(1f)
    }
}
