package com.mangatranslator.app

import android.annotation.SuppressLint
import android.content.Context
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import android.webkit.CookieManager
import android.webkit.JavascriptInterface
import android.webkit.WebView
import android.webkit.WebViewClient
import org.json.JSONObject

/**
 * خوێندنەوەی کوردی لە ڕێگەی tts.pawan.krd: WebViewـێکی شاراوە، دەق دەخاتە ناو چوارگۆشەکە و دوگمەی خوێندنەوە دادەگرێت.
 * کاربەر یەک جار لە PawanLoginActivity دەچێتە ژوورەوە و cookieـەکان لە CookieManager دەمێننەوە.
 * هەموو فەرمانەکان لە main thread بانگ بکرێن.
 */
object PawanTts {
    const val URL = "https://tts.pawan.krd/"
    private val ui = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())

    private var web: WebView? = null
    private var pageReady = false
    private var queued: (() -> Unit)? = null
    private var onState: ((Boolean) -> Unit)? = null
    private var onError: ((String) -> Unit)? = null
    private var gen = 0
    private var timeout: Runnable? = null

    /** کاتێک کوکی/چوونەژوورەوە بەسەرچوو (یان Cloudflare پشتڕاستکردنەوە دەوێت) بانگ دەکرێت؛ لەسەر main thread */
    @Volatile var onNeedLogin: (() -> Unit)? = null
    /** کاتێک PawanLoginActivity داخرا بانگ دەکرێت (main thread) */
    @Volatile var onLoginDone: (() -> Unit)? = null

    /** دوای چوونەژوورەوە: WebViewـی شاراوەی کۆن (کە لەوانەیە لەسەر پەڕەی Cloudflare مابێتەوە) دەسڕێتەوە تا بە cookieـی نوێ دووبارە بار بێت. */
    fun loginDone() {
        if (Looper.myLooper() != Looper.getMainLooper()) { ui.post { loginDone() }; return }
        try { web?.destroy() } catch (_: Throwable) {}
        web = null
        pageReady = false
        queued = null
        onLoginDone?.invoke()
    }

    /** ئایا ئینتەرنێتی کاراکراو هەیە */
    fun isOnline(ctx: Context): Boolean = try {
        val cm = ctx.applicationContext.getSystemService(Context.CONNECTIVITY_SERVICE) as android.net.ConnectivityManager
        val caps = cm.getNetworkCapabilities(cm.activeNetwork)
        caps != null && caps.hasCapability(android.net.NetworkCapabilities.NET_CAPABILITY_INTERNET) &&
            caps.hasCapability(android.net.NetworkCapabilities.NET_CAPABILITY_VALIDATED)
    } catch (_: Throwable) { false }

    fun hasCookie(): Boolean = !CookieManager.getInstance().getCookie(URL).isNullOrBlank()

    /** تەنها بۆ ئەوەی کاتی بەکارهێنانی یەکەم لەپێشەوە بار بکرێت. */
    fun warmUp(ctx: Context) { ensureWeb(ctx.applicationContext) }

    private class Bridge {
        @JavascriptInterface fun started() = ui.post { onState?.invoke(true) }
        @JavascriptInterface fun ended() = ui.post { finish() }
        @JavascriptInterface fun failed(m: String) = ui.post { fail(m) }
        /** پەڕەکە چوارگۆشەی دەق/دوگمەی نییە: Cloudflare یان بەسەرچوونی چوونەژوورەوە */
        @JavascriptInterface fun needLogin() = ui.post {
            fail("کۆکی Pawan بەسەرچووە؛ دوگمەی «چوونەژوورەوە» لەسەر شاشە دابگرە")
            onNeedLogin?.invoke()
        }
    }

    @SuppressLint("SetJavaScriptEnabled", "AddJavascriptInterface")
    private fun ensureWeb(app: Context): WebView {
        web?.let { return it }
        val w = WebView(app)
        w.settings.javaScriptEnabled = true
        w.settings.domStorageEnabled = true
        w.settings.mediaPlaybackRequiresUserGesture = false
        CookieManager.getInstance().setAcceptCookie(true)
        w.addJavascriptInterface(Bridge(), "AndroidTts")
        w.webViewClient = object : WebViewClient() {
            override fun onPageFinished(v: WebView, url: String?) {
                // هەموو دەنگێک کە ماڵپەڕەکە دەیپەخشێنێت بزانین کەی دەست پێدەکات و کەی تەواو دەبێت
                v.evaluateJavascript(HOOK_JS, null)
                pageReady = true
                queued?.also { queued = null }?.invoke()
            }
        }
        w.loadUrl(URL)
        web = w
        return w
    }

    fun speak(ctx: Context, text: String, onState: (Boolean) -> Unit, onError: (String) -> Unit) {
        val t = text.trim()
        if (t.isEmpty()) return
        if (!hasCookie()) {
            onError("کۆکی Pawan نییە یان بەسەرچووە؛ دوگمەی «چوونەژوورەوە» لەسەر شاشە دابگرە")
            ui.post { onNeedLogin?.invoke() }
            return
        }
        this.onState = onState
        this.onError = onError
        val my = ++gen
        val st = TranslatorSettings(ctx.applicationContext)
        val voice = st.pawanVoice
        val lang = st.pawanLang
        val gain = st.pawanGain / 100.0
        val rate = st.pawanRate / 100.0
        val soft = st.pawanSoft
        val w = ensureWeb(ctx.applicationContext)
        val run = {
            if (gen == my) {
                onState(true)
                w.evaluateJavascript(
                    "window.__pawanSpeak(${JSONObject.quote(t)},${JSONObject.quote(voice)},${JSONObject.quote(lang)},$gain,$rate,$soft)", null
                )
                timeout?.let { ui.removeCallbacks(it) }
                timeout = Runnable { if (gen == my) fail("کاتی خوێندنەوە تەواو بوو") }
                ui.postDelayed(timeout!!, 90_000)
            }
        }
        if (pageReady) run() else queued = run
    }

    fun stop() {
        if (Looper.myLooper() != Looper.getMainLooper()) { ui.post { stop() }; return }
        gen++
        queued = null
        timeout?.let { ui.removeCallbacks(it) }
        // دوگمەی خودی ماڵپەڕەکە لە کاتی خوێندنەوە دەبێتە «وەستاندن»؛ دەیگرین تا ڕاستەقینە بوەستێت
        web?.evaluateJavascript(
            "(function(){clearInterval(window.__pawanIv);" +
                "var b=document.getElementById('speak');" +
                "if(b&&b.hasAttribute('data-busy'))b.click();" +
                "document.querySelectorAll('audio').forEach(function(a){try{a.pause()}catch(e){}});})()", null
        )
        val cb = onState
        onState = null
        cb?.invoke(false)
    }

    private fun finish() {
        timeout?.let { ui.removeCallbacks(it) }
        onState?.invoke(false)
        onState = null
    }

    private fun fail(m: String) {
        timeout?.let { ui.removeCallbacks(it) }
        onState?.invoke(false)
        onState = null
        onError?.invoke(m)
    }

    private const val HOOK_JS = """
(function(){
  if (window.__pawanHooked) return; window.__pawanHooked = true;
  var P = HTMLMediaElement.prototype, origPlay = P.play;
  P.play = function(){
    var a = this;
    // ڕێکخستنی دەنگ: ئاستی دەنگ، تۆن/خێرایی، نەرمکردن (low-pass)
    try {
      var c = window.__pwCfg || {g: 1, r: 1, s: 0};
      a.volume = c.g;
      a.preservesPitch = false; a.webkitPreservesPitch = false; a.mozPreservesPitch = false;
      a.playbackRate = c.r;
      var freq = c.s > 0 ? (12000 - c.s / 100 * 9000) : 22000;
      if (a.__flt) { a.__flt.frequency.value = freq; }
      else if (c.s > 0) {
        var AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
        var cx = window.__pwCtx || (window.__pwCtx = new AC());
        var src = cx.createMediaElementSource(a), f = cx.createBiquadFilter();
        f.type = 'lowpass'; f.frequency.value = freq;
        src.connect(f); f.connect(cx.destination);
        a.__flt = f;
        if (cx.resume) cx.resume();
      }
    } catch (e) {}
    if (!a.__h) { a.__h = 1;
      a.addEventListener('ended', function(){ AndroidTts.ended(); });
      a.addEventListener('error', function(){ AndroidTts.failed('دەنگەکە پەخش نەکرا'); });
    }
    AndroidTts.started();
    return origPlay.apply(this, arguments);
  };
  window.__pawanSpeak = function(text, voice, lang, g, r, sf){
    window.__pwCfg = {g: g, r: r, s: sf};
    var t = document.getElementById('text'), b = document.getElementById('speak');
    if (!t || !b) { AndroidTts.needLogin(); return; }
    clearInterval(window.__pawanIv);
    document.querySelectorAll('audio').forEach(function(a){ try{ a.pause(); }catch(e){} });
    var busy = function(){ return b.hasAttribute('data-busy'); };
    // هەڵبژاردنی دەنگ (ئافرەت/پیاو) و زمان، وەک ماڵپەڕەکە
    var pick = function(sel){
      var e = document.querySelector(sel);
      if (e && e.getAttribute('aria-checked') !== 'true') { e.click(); return true; }
      return false;
    };
    var go = function(){
      var changed = pick('#langs [data-lang="' + lang + '"]');
      changed = pick('#voices .voice[data-voice="' + voice + '"]') || changed;
      setTimeout(function(){
        var setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype, 'value').set;
        setter.call(t, text);
        t.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles:true}));
        setTimeout(function(){
          b.click();
          var seen = false, n = 0;
          window.__pawanIv = setInterval(function(){
            n++;
            var playing = false;
            document.querySelectorAll('audio').forEach(function(a){ if (!a.paused && !a.ended) playing = true; });
            if (busy() || playing) { if (!seen) { seen = true; AndroidTts.started(); } }
            else if (seen) { clearInterval(window.__pawanIv); AndroidTts.ended(); }
            else if (n > 50) { clearInterval(window.__pawanIv); AndroidTts.failed('خوێندنەوە دەست پێنەکرد'); }
            if (n > 300) clearInterval(window.__pawanIv);
          }, 300);
        }, 120);
      }, changed ? 250 : 0);
    };
    if (busy()) {
      b.click();
      var w = 0, iv = setInterval(function(){ if (!busy() || ++w > 10) { clearInterval(iv); go(); } }, 200);
    } else go();
  };
})();
"""
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

/** Rejects silent/invalid synthesis without assuming a minimum word count. */
internal object PcmSignal {
    fun hasSignal(samples: FloatArray, sampleRate: Int): Boolean {
        if (sampleRate <= 0 || samples.isEmpty()) return false
        var energy = 0.0
        var sum = 0.0
        var peak = 0f
        var active = 0
        for (sample in samples) {
            if (!sample.isFinite()) return false
            val magnitude = kotlin.math.abs(sample)
            if (magnitude > peak) peak = magnitude
            if (magnitude >= 0.0001f) active++
            energy += sample.toDouble() * sample
            sum += sample
        }
        val mean = sum / samples.size
        val acEnergy = energy / samples.size - mean * mean
        return acEnergy >= 1e-10 && peak >= 0.0001f && energy / samples.size >= 1e-10 &&
            active >= (sampleRate / 50).coerceAtLeast(1)
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import android.os.SystemClock
import android.util.Log

/**
 * کاتپێوان بۆ دۆزینەوەی ئەوەی کات لە کوێ دەچێت.
 * بینینی ئەنجام: Logcat ← فلتەر بکە بە  tag:Perf
 * نموونە:  [region] +1830ms tesseract done found=false
 * هەر start() ی نوێ کاتەکە لە سفرەوە دەست پێدەکاتەوە.
 */
object Perf {
    private const val TAG = "Perf"
    @Volatile private var t0 = 0L
    @Volatile private var name = ""
    @Volatile private var lastMark = 0L

    fun start(n: String, label: String = "start") {
        t0 = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
        lastMark = t0
        name = n
        Log.d(TAG, "[$n] +0ms $label")
    }

    /** +Xms لە start ەوە، (+Yms) لە mark ی پێشووەوە */
    fun mark(label: String) {
        if (t0 == 0L) return
        val now = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
        Log.d(TAG, "[$name] +${now - t0}ms (+${now - lastMark}) $label")
        lastMark = now
    }

    /** یەکەم جار کە دەنگ دەست پێدەکات؛ پاشان دووبارە ناکرێتەوە تا start ی نوێ */
    @Volatile private var audioLogged = false
    fun audio(on: Boolean) {
        if (on && !audioLogged) { audioLogged = true; mark("★ دەنگ دەستی پێکرد (کۆی چاوەڕوانی)") }
    }
    fun resetAudio() { audioLogged = false }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.json.JSONObject

/** Keep legacy model tuning while honoring the reference voice's exported contract. */
internal object PiperModelConfig {
    const val REFERENCE_FORMAT = "sorani-reference-vits-v1"

    data class Inference(
        val referenceVoice: Boolean,
        val blankInterleaved: Boolean,
        val useModelTiming: Boolean,
        val noise: Float,
        val length: Float,
        val durationNoise: Float
    )

    fun inference(config: JSONObject): Inference {
        val reference = config.optString("format") == REFERENCE_FORMAT
        val timing = reference || config.optBoolean("use_model_timing", false)
        val inference = config.optJSONObject("inference")
        fun value(name: String, fallback: Float, min: Float, max: Float): Float {
            val raw = inference?.optDouble(name, fallback.toDouble())?.toFloat() ?: fallback
            return if (raw.isFinite() && raw in min..max) raw else fallback
        }
        return Inference(
            referenceVoice = reference,
            blankInterleaved = reference || config.optString("sequence_style", "piper") == "blank_interleaved",
            useModelTiming = timing,
            noise = if (reference) value("noise_scale", 0.3f, 0f, 1f) else 0.4f,
            length = value("length_scale", 1f, 0.5f, 2f) * if (timing) 1f else 1.08f,
            durationNoise = if (reference) value("noise_w", 0.3f, 0f, 1f) else 0.55f
        )
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import java.util.concurrent.ArrayBlockingQueue
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit

/** End-of-stream survives a full queue; finish never blocks the synth thread. */
internal class PiperPcmQueue(capacity: Int = 3) {
    private val queue = ArrayBlockingQueue<FloatArray>(capacity)
    private val end = FloatArray(0)
    @Volatile private var finished = false
    val isDrained: Boolean get() = finished && queue.isEmpty()
    fun offer(samples: FloatArray, timeoutMs: Long): Boolean =
        queue.offer(samples, timeoutMs, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)
    fun finish() {
        finished = true
        queue.offer(end) // Wake an idle consumer; a full queue relies on finished.
    }
    fun poll(timeoutMs: Long): FloatArray? {
        val value = if (finished) queue.poll() else queue.poll(timeoutMs, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)
        return if (value === end) null else value
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

/** Monotonic progress: a full buffer must never trap the writer forever. */
internal class PiperPlaybackProgress(private val stallMs: Long = 2000L) {
    var playedFrames = 0L
        private set
    private var lastUnsigned = 0L
    private var wraps = 0L
    private var pendingSince = -1L

    fun update(rawHead: Int, written: Long, playing: Boolean, now: Long): Boolean {
        val unsigned = rawHead.toLong() and 0xffffffffL
        if (unsigned < lastUnsigned && lastUnsigned - unsigned > 0x80000000L) wraps += 1L shl 32
        lastUnsigned = unsigned
        val head = wraps + unsigned
        if (head > playedFrames) {
            playedFrames = head
            pendingSince = if (playing && written > head) now else -1L
        }
        if (!playing || written <= playedFrames) { pendingSince = -1L; return true }
        val since = pendingSince
        if (since < 0L) { pendingSince = now; return true }
        return now - since < stallMs
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

/** Punctuation-only retries; never add words or slow down the requested rate. */
internal object PiperShortSpeech {
    fun render(
        sentence: String,
        bare: String,
        sampleRate: Int,
        synthesize: (String) -> FloatArray?,
        polish: (FloatArray) -> FloatArray
    ): FloatArray {
        for (variant in listOf(sentence, " $bare .", "$bare، .", " $bare ، .").distinct()) {
            val raw = synthesize(variant) ?: continue
            if (!PcmSignal.hasSignal(raw, sampleRate)) continue
            val result = polish(raw)
            if (PcmSignal.hasSignal(result, sampleRate)) return result
        }
        return FloatArray(0)
    }
}

internal object PiperPlayback {
    /** Keep the original two-second buffer for long audio; fit short audio. */
    fun bufferBytes(minBytes: Int, sampleRate: Int, firstSamples: Int): Int =
        maxOf(minBytes, minOf(sampleRate * 4, firstSamples * 2))

    /** Fill the actual native buffer with trailing silence if the first clip is tiny. */
    fun fillFirstBuffer(pcm: ShortArray, bufferFrames: Int): ShortArray =
        if (pcm.size < bufferFrames) pcm.copyOf(bufferFrames) else pcm
}

================================================================================
FILE: app/src/main/java/com/mangatranslator/app/PiperSpeechTiming.kt
================================================================================

package com.mangatranslator.app

import kotlin.math.*

/** Reference VITS input is capped at 180 characters. Keep a short first phrase,
 * then use longer, word-complete chunks to avoid repeated inference and extra pauses.
 * The legacy model's chunking and timing remain in PiperTts.
 */
internal object PiperSpeechTiming {
    const val FIRST_LIMIT = 40
    const val STEADY_LIMIT = 160

    fun chunks(text: String): List<String> {
        val normalized = text.trim().replace(Regex("\\s+"), " ")
        val sentences = normalized.split(Regex("(?<=[.!?؟])\\s*"))
            .map { it.trim() }.filter { it.isNotEmpty() }
        val result = ArrayList<String>()
        for (sentence in sentences) {
            var remaining = sentence
            while (remaining.isNotEmpty()) {
                val limit = if (result.isEmpty()) FIRST_LIMIT else STEADY_LIMIT
                if (remaining.length <= limit) { result.add(remaining); break }
                // Prefer a clause boundary near the end, rather than every comma.
                val minimum = if (result.isEmpty()) 28 else 80
                val clause = (minimum until limit).lastOrNull { i ->
                    remaining[i] in "،,٫" && remaining.getOrNull(i+1)?.isWhitespace() == true
                }
                val word = remaining.lastIndexOf(' ', limit)
                val end = if (clause != null) clause+1 else if (word>0) word else limit
                result.add(remaining.substring(0,end).trim())
                remaining = remaining.substring(end).trimStart()
            }
        }
        return result
    }

    /** Only explicit punctuation receives 20 ms; wrapping/newlines/technical splits add none. */
    @Suppress("UNUSED_PARAMETER")
    fun pauseMs(text: String, lowLatency: Boolean): Int =
        if (text.trimEnd().lastOrNull() in listOf('.', '،', '؟', '!', '٫', ',', '?')) 20 else 0

    /** Only trim boundary silence; never delete pauses inside speech or low-energy consonants.
     * 10-ms RMS frames, -40 dB relative threshold, 40-ms context on either side.
     */
    fun trimEdges(input: FloatArray, rate: Int): FloatArray {
        if (input.isEmpty()) return input.copyOf()
        val window=max(1,rate/100)
        val energy=DoubleArray((input.size+window-1)/window) { frame ->
            val start=frame*window;val end=min(input.size,start+window)
            var sum=0.0
            for (i in start until end) sum+=input[i].toDouble()*input[i]
            sqrt(sum/(end-start))
        }
        val peak=energy.maxOrNull() ?: return input.copyOf()
        if (peak<1e-8) return input.copyOf()
        val threshold=max(1e-6,peak*.01)
        val first=energy.indexOfFirst { it>=threshold };val last=energy.indexOfLast { it>=threshold }
        if (first<0 || last<first) return input.copyOf()
        val context=rate*40/1000
        val start=max(0,first*window-context)
        val end=min(input.size,(last+1)*window+context)
        return input.copyOfRange(start,end)
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import java.text.Normalizer

/** Preserve legacy Piper phonemes; exported MMS/VITS models use NFC characters and blanks. */
internal object PiperTextEncoding {
    fun encode(text: String, idMap: Map<String, Long>, blankInterleaved: Boolean,
               referenceVoice: Boolean = false): LongArray? {
        if (referenceVoice) return encodeReference(text, idMap)
        val cleaned = text.replace('ك', 'ک').replace('ي', 'ی').replace('ى', 'ی').replace('ة', 'ە')
            .replace("\u200c", "").replace("\u200d", "").replace("ـ", "")
        val t = Normalizer.normalize(cleaned, if (blankInterleaved) Normalizer.Form.NFC else Normalizer.Form.NFD)
        val pad = idMap["_"] ?: 0L
        val ids = ArrayList<Long>(t.length * 2 + 2)
        ids.add(if (blankInterleaved) pad else idMap["^"] ?: 1L)
        var any = false
        for (ch in t) {
            val id = idMap[ch.toString()] ?: continue
            if (ch == '^' || ch == '$' || ch == '_') continue
            ids.add(id); ids.add(pad)
            if (ch != ' ' && ch != '.' && ch != '!' && ch != '-' && ch != ':') any = true
        }
        if (!blankInterleaved) ids.add(idMap["$"] ?: 2L)
        return if (any) ids.toLongArray() else null
    }

    private fun encodeReference(text: String, idMap: Map<String, Long>): LongArray? {
        val normalized = Normalizer.normalize(text, Normalizer.Form.NFC)
            .replace('ک', 'ك').replace('ي', 'ی').replace('ھ', 'ه')
            .replace('أ', 'ئ').replace('إ', 'ئ')
        val special = setOf('^', '$', '_', '|')
        val cleaned = normalized.map { ch ->
            if (ch !in special && idMap.containsKey(ch.toString())) ch else ' '
        }.joinToString("").replace(Regex("\\s+"), " ").trim()
        if (cleaned.isEmpty()) return null
        val blank = idMap["_"] ?: 0L
        val ids = LongArray(cleaned.length * 2 + 1) { blank }
        cleaned.forEachIndexed { index, ch -> ids[index * 2 + 1] = idMap.getValue(ch.toString()) }
        return ids
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import ai.onnxruntime.OnnxTensor
import ai.onnxruntime.OrtEnvironment
import ai.onnxruntime.OrtSession
import android.content.Context
import android.media.AudioAttributes
import android.media.AudioFormat
import android.media.AudioTrack
import android.media.PlaybackParams
import android.net.Uri
import android.provider.OpenableColumns
import android.util.Log
import org.json.JSONObject
import java.io.File
import java.nio.FloatBuffer
import java.nio.LongBuffer
import java.util.concurrent.BlockingQueue
import java.util.concurrent.LinkedBlockingQueue
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference
import java.util.zip.ZipInputStream

/** پەیامێک بۆ ڕیزی خوێندنەوە: text == null واتە کۆتایی. */
class SpeechMsg(val text: String?)

/**
 * دەنگی کوردیی نیورالی ئۆفلاین (Piper / VITS بە ONNX، ڕاستەوخۆ بە onnxruntime).
 * مۆدێلەکە (model.onnx + model.onnx.json) پیتی کوردیی سۆرانی ڕاستەوخۆ دەخوێنێتەوە، بێ espeak.
 * مۆدێلەکە لە ڕێکخستنی دەنگ ← «هێنانی مۆدێل» دەهێنرێت و دەکرێتە filesDir/piper_kurdish/.
 */
class PiperTts(private val ctx: Context) {

    @Volatile private var env: OrtEnvironment? = null
    @Volatile private var session: OrtSession? = null
    private var loadedModelIdentity: String? = null
    @Volatile private var idMap: Map<String, Long> = emptyMap()
    @Volatile private var sampleRate = 22050
    // ڕێکخستنی ڕوونی دەنگ (بێ گۆڕینی مۆدێلەکە): noise کەمتر = دەنگی جێگیرتر، length زیاتر = کەمێک هێواشتر.
    // ئەگەر دەنگەکە زۆر «ڕۆبۆت» بوو TUNE_NOISE بەرەو 0.667 بەرز بکەرەوە.
    private val TUNE_NOISE = 0.4f
    private val TUNE_NOISE_W = 0.55f
    private val TUNE_LENGTH = 1.08f
    @Volatile private var noiseScale = TUNE_NOISE
    @Volatile private var lengthScale = 1.0f * TUNE_LENGTH
    @Volatile private var noiseW = TUNE_NOISE_W
    @Volatile private var hasSid = false
    @Volatile private var blankInterleaved = false
    @Volatile private var referenceVoice = false
    @Volatile private var femaleRecipeModel = false
    @Volatile private var useModelTiming = false
    @Volatile private var track: AudioTrack? = null
    @Volatile private var cancelled = false
    @Volatile private var closed = false
    @Volatile private var nativeWarmed = false
    private val synthesisGate = java.util.concurrent.locks.ReentrantLock()
    private val playbackLock = Any()
    private val workGeneration = java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger()
    @Volatile var playbackMayHaveStarted = false
        private set

    @Volatile var speaking = false
        private set

    /**
     * دۆخی دواکەوتنی کەم (ژێرنووسی زیندوو): دێڕی کورت هێندە هێواش ناکرێت و وچانی کۆتایی کورتترە،
     * بۆ ئەوەی دەنگەکە لە ئاخێوەری ڕەسەن دوا نەکەوێت.
     */
    @Volatile var lowLatency = false

    // cache ی دەنگی دروستکراو: هەمان ڕستە (دێڕی دووبارەی ژێرنووس، پەیامە جێگیرەکان) دووبارە دروست ناکرێتەوە.
    private val pcmCache = LinkedHashMap<String, FloatArray>(32, 0.75f, true)
    private var cacheFloats = 0

    private fun cacheGet(k: String): FloatArray? = synchronized(pcmCache) { pcmCache[k] }

    private fun cachePut(k: String, v: FloatArray) {
        synchronized(pcmCache) {
            if (v.size > CACHE_MAX_FLOATS / 4) return
            pcmCache.put(k, v)?.let { cacheFloats -= it.size }
            cacheFloats += v.size
            val it = pcmCache.entries.iterator()
            while (cacheFloats > CACHE_MAX_FLOATS && it.hasNext()) {
                val e = it.next()
                cacheFloats -= e.value.size
                it.remove()
            }
        }
    }

    /** پەیام دەگەڕێنێتەوە ئەگەر مۆدێل نەدۆزرایەوە یان بار نەبوو. */
    private fun ensureLoaded(): String? {
        synthesisGate.lockInterruptibly()
        try { return loadLocked() } finally { synthesisGate.unlock() }
    }

    private fun loadLocked(): String? {
        if (closed) return "Piper: engine closed"
        val dir = selectedModelDir(ctx)
        val identity = dir.absolutePath + "#" + modelEpoch.get()
        if (session != null && loadedModelIdentity == identity) return null
        if (session != null) {
            session?.close(); session = null
            nativeWarmed = false
            workGeneration.incrementAndGet()
            synchronized(pcmCache) { pcmCache.clear(); cacheFloats = 0 }
        }
        val onnx = File(dir, MODEL)
        val cfg = File(dir, CONFIG)
        if (!onnx.exists() || !cfg.exists()) {
            return "مۆدێلی کوردیی نیورالی نەهێنراوە. لە ڕێکخستنی دەنگ دوگمەی «هێنانی مۆدێل» دابگرە و فایلی zip ی مۆدێلەکە هەڵبژێرە"
        }
        return try {
            val j = JSONObject(cfg.readText())
            val m = j.getJSONObject("phoneme_id_map")
            val map = HashMap<String, Long>()
            for (k in m.keys()) map[k] = m.getJSONArray(k).getLong(0)
            idMap = map
            val inference = PiperModelConfig.inference(j)
            referenceVoice = inference.referenceVoice
            femaleRecipeModel = referenceVoice && matchesFemaleRecipeModel(onnx)
            blankInterleaved = inference.blankInterleaved
            useModelTiming = inference.useModelTiming
            sampleRate = j.optJSONObject("audio")?.optInt("sample_rate", 22050) ?: 22050
            noiseScale = inference.noise
            lengthScale = inference.length
            noiseW = inference.durationNoise
            val e = OrtEnvironment.getEnvironment()
            val opts = OrtSession.SessionOptions().apply {
                setIntraOpNumThreads(if (referenceVoice || DeviceProfile.low) 2 else 4)
                if (DeviceProfile.low) {
                    try { setCPUArenaAllocator(false) } catch (_: Throwable) {}
                    try { setMemoryPatternOptimization(false) } catch (_: Throwable) {}
                }
            }
            val s = try { e.createSession(onnx.absolutePath, opts) } finally { opts.close() }
            hasSid = s.inputNames.contains("sid")
            env = e
            session = s
            loadedModelIdentity = identity
            null
        } catch (e: Throwable) {
            Log.e(TAG, "load failed", e)
            "بارکردنی مۆدێلی کوردی سەرنەکەوت: ${e.message}"
        }
    }

    /** دەقی سۆرانی ← ID ـی پیتەکان (وەک Piper: ^ پیت _ پیت _ ... $). */
    private fun toIds(text: String): LongArray? =
        PiperTextEncoding.encode(text, idMap, blankInterleaved, referenceVoice)

    /** بێدەنگیی سەر و کۆتا دەبڕێت، fade ی کورت دەدات و ئاستی دەنگ یەکسان دەکات؛ endPauseMs = وەستانی دوای ڕستە. */
    private fun polish(x: FloatArray, rate: Int, endPauseMs: Int, profile: PiperVoiceProfile.Preset): FloatArray {
        if (profile.id == FemaleVoiceRecipe.PROFILE_ID) {
            val processed = FemaleVoiceRecipe.process(PiperSpeechTiming.trimEdges(x, rate), rate)
            return processed.copyOf(processed.size + rate * endPauseMs / 1000)
        }
        var peak = 0f
        for (v in x) { val a = Math.abs(v); if (a > peak) peak = a }
        if (peak < 1e-4f) return x
        val th = peak * 0.01f
        var st = 0
        while (st < x.size - 1 && Math.abs(x[st]) < th) st++
        var en = x.size - 1
        while (en > st && Math.abs(x[en]) < th) en--
        val a = maxOf(0, st - (rate * 0.04).toInt())
        val b = minOf(x.size, en + (rate * 0.06).toInt())
        if (b <= a) return x
        val pad = rate * endPauseMs / 1000
        val y = FloatArray(b - a + pad)
        System.arraycopy(x, a, y, 0, b - a)
        val len = b - a
        denoise(y, len, rate, profile.cutoffHz)   // DC و خشەی زیر (hiss) کەم دەکاتەوە
        VoiceShaper.apply(y, len, rate, profile.edge, profile.soft)   // گڕ + نەرمی (٠ = هیچ)
        val fade = minOf((rate * 0.015).toInt(), len / 2)
        for (i in 0 until fade) {
            val g = i / fade.toFloat()
            y[i] *= g
            y[len - 1 - i] *= g
        }
        var sum = 0.0
        var pk = 0f
        for (i in 0 until len) { val v = y[i]; sum += v.toDouble() * v; val q = Math.abs(v); if (q > pk) pk = q }
        val rms = Math.sqrt(sum / len).toFloat()
        if (rms < 1e-5f || pk < 1e-5f) return y
        val g = minOf(profile.targetRms / rms, 0.9f / pk, 2.5f)   // 4x خشەی بێدەنگی بەرز دەکردەوە
        for (i in 0 until len) y[i] *= g
        return y
    }

    /**
     * DC-blocker + دوو فلتەری نەرمی low-pass (~٧kHz): خشە و گزگزەی زیری VITS کەم دەکاتەوە بێ ئەوەی دەنگەکە کپ بکات.
     * تەنها بەشی [0, len) دەگۆڕێت (وەستانی کۆتایی دەست لێنادرێت).
     */
    private fun denoise(y: FloatArray, len: Int, rate: Int, cutoffHz: Float) {
        val r = 0.995f
        var px = 0f
        var py = 0f
        for (i in 0 until len) {
            val x = y[i]
            val o = x - px + r * py
            px = x
            py = o
            y[i] = o
        }
        val fc = minOf(cutoffHz, rate * 0.45f)
        val a = (1.0 - Math.exp(-2.0 * Math.PI * fc / rate)).toFloat()
        var s1 = 0f
        var s2 = 0f
        for (i in 0 until len) {
            s1 += a * (y[i] - s1)
            s2 += a * (s1 - s2)
            y[i] = s2
        }
    }

    private fun synth(ids: LongArray, speed: Float): FloatArray {
        val e = env ?: throw IllegalStateException("env")
        val s = session ?: throw IllegalStateException("session")
        val n = ids.size.toLong()
        val inputs = HashMap<String, OnnxTensor>()
        try {
            inputs["input"] = OnnxTensor.createTensor(e, LongBuffer.wrap(ids), longArrayOf(1, n))
            inputs["input_lengths"] = OnnxTensor.createTensor(e, LongBuffer.wrap(longArrayOf(n)), longArrayOf(1))
            val st = TranslatorSettings(ctx)
            val userNoise = st.piperNoiseScale / 100f
            val userLength = st.piperLengthScale / 100f
            val userNoiseW = st.piperNoiseW / 100f
            inputs["scales"] = OnnxTensor.createTensor(
                e, FloatBuffer.wrap(floatArrayOf(userNoise, userLength / speed.coerceIn(0.5f, 2f), userNoiseW)), longArrayOf(3)
            )
            if (hasSid) inputs["sid"] = OnnxTensor.createTensor(e, LongBuffer.wrap(longArrayOf(0)), longArrayOf(1))
            s.run(inputs).use { res ->
                val fb = (res[0] as OnnxTensor).floatBuffer
                val out = FloatArray(fb.remaining())
                fb.get(out)
                nativeWarmed = true
                return out
            }
        } finally {
            inputs.values.forEach { try { it.close() } catch (_: Exception) {} }
        }
    }

    /** مۆدێلەکە بار دەکات و یەک ڕستەی کورت دروست دەکات، تا یەکەم خوێندنەوە چاوەڕێی بارکردن نەکات. */
    fun warmUp() {
        if (closed || !synthesisGate.tryLock()) return
        try {
            if (!closed && ensureLoaded() == null && !nativeWarmed) {
                toIds("سڵاو.")?.let { synth(it, 1f) }
            }
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
        } finally { synthesisGate.unlock() }
    }

    /**
     * دەقی کورت بۆ Piper/Berfin: مۆدێلەکە ڕستەی زۆر کورت زۆرجار بێدەنگ یان نابیستراو دەردەچێت.
     * تەنها خاڵ زیاد دەکرێت؛ وشە زیاد یان دووبارە ناکرێتەوە.
     */
    private fun padShortKu(s: String): String {
        var t = s.trim()
        if (t.isEmpty()) return t
        val last = t.lastOrNull()
        val hasEnd = last == '.' || last == '!' || last == '؟' || last == '،'
        // هەموو ڕستەی کورت/مامناوەند خاڵ وەرگرن تا مۆدێل دەنگ دروست بکات
        if (t.length < 36 && !hasEnd) t = "$t."
        return t
    }

    /**
     * دەقی کورت: VITS ڕستەی زۆر کورت زۆرجار بێدەنگ یان زۆر کورت دەردەکات. چەند شێوەی جیاواز دەکرێت
     * (خاڵ، بۆشایی بۆ دەوروبەر، فاریزە) و یەکەمیان کە دەنگی بەس بوو هەڵدەبژێردرێت؛ دەنگەکە دووبارە ناکرێتەوە.
     */
    private fun synthShort(sentence: String, bare: String, spd: Float, pause: Int, profile: PiperVoiceProfile.Preset): FloatArray {
        return PiperShortSpeech.render(
            sentence, bare, sampleRate,
            synthesize = { variant -> toIds(variant)?.let { synth(it, spd) } },
            polish = { raw -> polish(raw, sampleRate, pause, profile) }
        )
    }

    /**
     * یەک ڕستە دەکات بە PCM (لە cache ەوە ئەگەر پێشتر دروست کرابوو). هەم speakStream و هەم prefetch بەکاریدەهێنن،
     * بۆیە ئەنجامی prefetch دەستبەجێ لە cache دا دەبێت کاتێک خوێندنەوەکە دەگاتە ئەو ڕستەیە.
     */
    private fun render(sentence: String, speed: Float, profile: PiperVoiceProfile.Preset, wanted: () -> Boolean = { true }): FloatArray? {
        synthesisGate.lockInterruptibly()
        try {
            if (closed || !wanted()) return null
            return renderLocked(sentence, speed, profile)
        } finally { synthesisGate.unlock() }
    }

    /** Cache check and inference share a gate, coalescing foreground/prefetch misses. */
    private fun renderLocked(sentence: String, speed: Float, profile: PiperVoiceProfile.Preset): FloatArray? {
        check(profile.id != FemaleVoiceRecipe.PROFILE_ID || femaleRecipeModel) {
            "ڕێکخستنی نموونەی ئافرەت تەنها بۆ مۆدێلی sorani-ckb-female-voice-onnx ـە؛ مۆدێلەکە هەڵبژێرە یان تۆنێکی تر بەکار بهێنە."
        }
        val ids = toIds(sentence) ?: return null
        val bare = sentence.replace(".", "").replace("؟", "").replace("!", "").replace("،", "").trim()
        // تا ~٤٠ پیت: ڕستەی کورت/مامناوەند (وەک «سڵاو ئەمڕۆ ویستم»)
        val short = bare.length < 40
        val low = lowLatency
        val spd = if (short && !useModelTiming) (speed * (if (low) 0.9f else 0.72f)).coerceAtLeast(0.55f) else speed
        // ژێرنووسی زیندوو: وچانی نێوان ڕستەکان کورت (پێشتر ١٤٠/١٠٠ms + بێدەنگی سەر و کۆتا = وەستانێکی بیستراو)
        val st = TranslatorSettings(ctx)
        val pause = if (low) minOf(st.piperEndPauseMs, 60) else st.piperEndPauseMs
        val ck = PiperVoiceProfile.cacheKey(speed, low, profile, sentence, st)
        cacheGet(ck)?.let { return it }
        val out = if (short) synthShort(sentence, bare, spd, pause, profile) else {
            val raw = synth(ids, spd)
            if (!PcmSignal.hasSignal(raw, sampleRate)) return null
            polish(raw, sampleRate, pause, profile)
        }
        // Silence is not successful synthesis and must not enter the cache.
        if (!PcmSignal.hasSignal(out, sampleRate)) return null
        if (out.isNotEmpty()) cachePut(ck, out)
        return out
    }

    // One running and one latest queued prefetch; outdated OCR cannot build
    // an unbounded background synthesis queue or compete with current speech.
    private val prefetchPool = java.util.concurrent.ThreadPoolExecutor(
        1, 1, 0L, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS, LinkedBlockingQueue<Runnable>(1),
        java.util.concurrent.ThreadFactory { r -> Thread({
            // BACKGROUND (cgroup پاشبنەما) CPU ی زۆر کەم وەردەگرێت؛ prefetch synthesisGate ی گرتووە و ڕستەی ئێستا چاوەڕێی دەکات
            // (priority inversion) ← خوێندنەوە خاو دەبوو. بۆیە هەمان priority ی ئاسایی.
            try { android.os.Process.setThreadPriority(android.os.Process.THREAD_PRIORITY_DEFAULT) } catch (_: Throwable) {}
            r.run()
        }, "piper-prefetch").apply { isDaemon = true } },
        java.util.concurrent.ThreadPoolExecutor.DiscardOldestPolicy()
    )

    /**
     * دەنگی ڕستەیەک پێشوەختە دروست دەکات (لە پاشبنەما) و دەیخاتە cache، لەکاتێکدا ڕستەی ئێستا دەپەخشرێت؛
     * بەم شێوەیە کاتێک خوێندنەوەی ڕستەی پێشوو تەواو بوو، ڕستەی دواتر بێ چاوەڕێی دروستکردن دەست پێدەکات.
     * `speed` دەبێت هەمان خێرایی بێت کە دواتر بۆ خوێندنەوە بەکاردێت (cache بە خێرایی کلیل دەکرێت).
     */
    fun prefetch(text: String, speed: Float) {
        val profile = PiperVoiceProfile.customized(TranslatorSettings(ctx))
        val generation = workGeneration.get()
        if (closed) return
        try {
            prefetchPool.execute {
                try {
                    if (closed || generation != workGeneration.get() || session == null) return@execute
                    for (sentence in chunks(padShortKu(KurdishSpeechPrep.prepare(text)))) {
                        if (closed || generation != workGeneration.get()) break
                        render(sentence, speed, profile) { generation == workGeneration.get() }
                    }
                } catch (_: Throwable) {
                }
            }
        } catch (_: java.util.concurrent.RejectedExecutionException) {
        }
    }

    /** بە ڕیز دەخوێنێتەوە؛ لەسەر thread ی کار بانگ بکرێت. null = سەرکەوتوو. */
    fun speakBlocking(texts: List<String>, speed: Float, isCurrent: () -> Boolean): String? {
        val q = LinkedBlockingQueue<SpeechMsg>()
        for (t in texts) q.add(SpeechMsg(t))
        q.add(SpeechMsg(null))
        return speakStream(q, speed, isCurrent)
    }

    /**
     * دەقەکان لە `source` وەردەگرێت تا کۆتایی (SpeechMsg(null)). دروستکردنی دەنگ (thread ی خۆی) و پەخشکردن
     * پێکەوە کار دەکەن: لە کاتی خوێندنەوەی ڕستەیەک، ڕستەی دواتر دروست دەکرێت، و بە یەک AudioTrack دەپەخشرێت بێ وچان.
     * لەسەر thread ی کار بانگ بکرێت. null = سەرکەوتوو.
     */
    fun speakStream(source: BlockingQueue<SpeechMsg>, speed: Float, isCurrent: () -> Boolean): String? {
        if (!isCurrent() || closed) return null
        playbackMayHaveStarted = false
        ensureLoaded()?.let { return it }
        val profile = PiperVoiceProfile.customized(TranslatorSettings(ctx))
        synchronized(playbackLock) {
            if (!isCurrent() || closed) return null
            cancelled = false
            speaking = true
        }
        val pcmQ = PiperPcmQueue()
        val consumerDone = java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean(false)
        fun active() = !cancelled && isCurrent() && !consumerDone.get()
        val err = AtomicReference<String?>(null)
        val producer = Thread({
            try {
                // CPU inference must not run at the mixer's urgent-audio priority, but a little above normal keeps
                // speech ahead of OCR/translation work competing for the CPU.
                try { android.os.Process.setThreadPriority(android.os.Process.THREAD_PRIORITY_DISPLAY) } catch (_: Throwable) {}
                loop@ while (active()) {
                    val m = source.poll(150, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS) ?: continue
                    val t = m.text ?: break
                    var produced = 0
                    for (sentence in chunks(padShortKu(KurdishSpeechPrep.prepare(t)))) {
                        if (!active()) break@loop
                        val samples = render(sentence, speed, profile) { active() } ?: continue
                        if (!active()) break@loop
                        if (samples.isEmpty()) continue
                        produced++
                        while (!pcmQ.offer(samples, 200)) {
                            if (!active()) break@loop
                        }
                    }
                    // ئەگەر هیچ دەنگێک دروست نەبوو، هەڵە بگەڕێنەوە بۆ fallback
                    if (produced == 0 && t.trim().isNotEmpty()) {
                        err.set("Piper: دەنگی ئەم دەقە دروست نەبوو")
                    }
                }
            } catch (e: Throwable) {
                if (active()) {
                    Log.e(TAG, "synth failed", e)
                    err.compareAndSet(null, "Piper: ${e.message}")
                }
            } finally {
                // A full queue must not lose its only end-of-stream signal.
                pcmQ.finish()
            }
        }, "piper-synth")
        producer.start()

        var at: AudioTrack? = null
        var toneApplied = false
        var written = 0L
        val progress = PiperPlaybackProgress()
        val oldPriority = try { android.os.Process.getThreadPriority(android.os.Process.myTid()) } catch (_: Throwable) { 0 }
        fun startPlayback(t: AudioTrack) = synchronized(playbackLock) {
            if (!cancelled && isCurrent() && t.playState != AudioTrack.PLAYSTATE_PLAYING) {
                // Apply only once, after PCM has been queued: setting playback
                // parameters may start a paused track on some Android versions.
                if (!toneApplied) {
                    if (profile.pitch != 1f) {
                        t.playbackParams = PlaybackParams().allowDefaults()
                            .setSpeed(1f).setPitch(profile.pitch)
                            .setAudioFallbackMode(PlaybackParams.AUDIO_FALLBACK_MODE_FAIL)
                    }
                    toneApplied = true
                }
                t.play()
                playbackMayHaveStarted = true
            }
        }
        fun checkProgress(t: AudioTrack) {
            if (!progress.update(t.playbackHeadPosition, written,
                    t.playState == AudioTrack.PLAYSTATE_PLAYING, android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime())) {
                throw IllegalStateException("Piper: پەخشکردنی دەنگ ڕاگیرا؛ بەفەر پێش ناکەوێت")
            }
        }
        try {
            try { android.os.Process.setThreadPriority(android.os.Process.THREAD_PRIORITY_AUDIO) } catch (_: Throwable) {}
            while (!cancelled && isCurrent()) {
                val samples = pcmQ.poll(100)
                if (samples == null) {
                    if (pcmQ.isDrained) break
                    // دروستکردنی ڕستەی دواتر درێژەی کێشا: ئەوەی هەیە بیپەخشێنە
                    at?.let { if (written > 0) { startPlayback(it); checkProgress(it) } }
                    continue
                }
                var pcm = ShortArray(samples.size) { i -> (samples[i].coerceIn(-1f, 1f) * 32767f).toInt().toShort() }
                var t = at
                if (t == null) {
                    t = newTrack(sampleRate, pcm.size)
                    // Some AudioTrack implementations wait for a full initial
                    // buffer even after play(). Pad PCM only, never the text.
                    pcm = PiperPlayback.fillFirstBuffer(pcm, t.bufferSizeInFrames)
                    at = t
                    synchronized(playbackLock) { if (!cancelled && isCurrent()) track = t }
                }
                var off = 0
                while (off < pcm.size && !cancelled && isCurrent()) {
                    val n = t.write(pcm, off, minOf(pcm.size - off, 2048), AudioTrack.WRITE_NON_BLOCKING)
                    if (n < 0) throw IllegalStateException("Piper: AudioTrack write failed ($n)")
                    if (n == 0) {
                        startPlayback(t)
                        checkProgress(t)
                        Thread.sleep(8)
                    } else {
                        off += n
                        written += n
                        checkProgress(t)
                    }
                }
                // دەست بە پەخش دەکات دوای ٠٫٣ چرکە دەنگ لە بەفەر (underrun = گزگزە)
                if (written >= minOf(sampleRate * 3L / 10, pcm.size.toLong())) startPlayback(t)
            }
            // ڕستەی کۆتایی هەتا کۆتایی دەپەخشرێت
            val t = at
            if (t != null && !cancelled && isCurrent()) {
                startPlayback(t)
                val deadline = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + written * 1000L / sampleRate + 1500
                while (!cancelled && isCurrent()) {
                    checkProgress(t)
                    if (progress.playedFrames >= written) break
                    if (android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() >= deadline) {
                        throw IllegalStateException("Piper: پەخشکردنی دەنگ تەواو نەبوو")
                    }
                    Thread.sleep(20)
                }
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            if (!cancelled && isCurrent()) err.set("Piper: ${e.message}")
        } finally {
            consumerDone.set(true)
            producer.interrupt()
            at?.let {
                // وەستاندن: دەنگی ماوە لە بەفەر فڕێ دەدرێت، نەک هەتا کۆتایی بپەخشرێت
                if (cancelled || !isCurrent() || err.get() != null) {
                    try { it.pause(); it.flush() } catch (_: Exception) {}
                }
                try { it.stop() } catch (_: Exception) {}
                try { it.release() } catch (_: Exception) {}
            }
            synchronized(playbackLock) { if (track === at) track = null }
            speaking = false
            try { android.os.Process.setThreadPriority(oldPriority) } catch (_: Throwable) {}
        }
        return err.get()
    }

    private fun newTrack(rate: Int, firstSamples: Int): AudioTrack {
        val minBuf = AudioTrack.getMinBufferSize(rate, AudioFormat.CHANNEL_OUT_MONO, AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_16BIT)
        return AudioTrack.Builder()
            .setAudioAttributes(
                VoiceOutput.attributes(TranslatorSettings(ctx).voiceOutput)
            )
            .setAudioFormat(
                AudioFormat.Builder()
                    .setSampleRate(rate)
                    .setChannelMask(AudioFormat.CHANNEL_OUT_MONO)
                    .setEncoding(AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_16BIT)
                    .build()
            )
            .setBufferSizeInBytes(PiperPlayback.bufferBytes(minBuf, rate, firstSamples))
            .setTransferMode(AudioTrack.MODE_STREAM)
            .build()
    }

    private fun splitSentences(s: String): List<String> =
        s.split(Regex("(?<=[.!?؟\\n])\\s*")).map { it.trim() }.filter { it.isNotEmpty() }

    /** ڕستەی درێژ دەکرێتە پارچەی کورت (لە فاریزە/بۆشایی)، بۆ ئەوەی دەنگی یەکەم پارچە زوو ئامادە بێت. */
    private fun chunks(s: String): List<String> {
        if (referenceVoice) return PiperSpeechTiming.chunks(s)
        val out = ArrayList<String>()
        for (sent in splitSentences(s)) {
            if (sent.length <= MAX_CHUNK) {
                out.add(sent)
                continue
            }
            val cur = StringBuilder()
            for (w in sent.split(' ')) {
                if (w.isEmpty()) continue
                if (cur.isNotEmpty()) cur.append(' ')
                cur.append(w)
                val endsComma = w.endsWith("،") || w.endsWith(",") || w.endsWith("؛")
                if (cur.length >= MAX_CHUNK || (endsComma && cur.length >= (if (out.isEmpty()) 18 else 35))) {
                    out.add(cur.toString())
                    cur.setLength(0)
                }
            }
            if (cur.isNotEmpty()) {
                if (cur.length < 8 && out.isNotEmpty()) out[out.size - 1] = out.last() + " " + cur else out.add(cur.toString())
            }
        }
        return out.filter { it.isNotEmpty() }
    }

    fun stop() {
        workGeneration.incrementAndGet()
        prefetchPool.queue.clear()
        synchronized(playbackLock) {
            cancelled = true
            speaking = false
            track?.let { try { it.pause(); it.flush() } catch (_: Exception) {} }
        }
    }

    fun shutdown() {
        closed = true
        stop()
        prefetchPool.shutdownNow()
        // Native inference cannot be closed underneath a producer. Closing on
        // a daemon avoids making the UI wait for an in-flight ONNX call.
        Thread({
            synthesisGate.lock()
            try {
                synchronized(pcmCache) { pcmCache.clear(); cacheFloats = 0 }
                try { session?.close() } catch (_: Throwable) {}
                session = null
            } finally { synthesisGate.unlock() }
        }, "piper-close").apply { isDaemon = true }.start()
    }

    companion object {
        private const val TAG = "PiperTts"
        private const val MODEL = "model.onnx"
        private const val CONFIG = "model.onnx.json"
        private const val MAX_CHUNK = 80
        /** سنووری cache: ≈١.٥ ملیۆن نموونە ≈ ٦MB ≈ ١.١ خولەک دەنگ */
        private const val CACHE_MAX_FLOATS = 1_500_000

        private val modelEpoch = java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger()
        private val preparedFirstUse = PreparedResource<PiperTts> { it.shutdown() }
        private val firstUseExecutor = java.util.concurrent.Executors.newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor { task ->
            Thread(task, "piper-first-use").apply { isDaemon = true }
        }

        private fun firstUseIdentity(ctx: Context) = selectedModelDir(ctx).absolutePath + "#" + modelEpoch.get()

        /** Called while the user is still in setup/main UI. No native work on the UI thread. */
        fun prepareFirstUse(ctx: Context) {
            val app = ctx.applicationContext
            val settings = TranslatorSettings(app)
            if (DeviceProfile.low || !settings.offlineTts || settings.pawanTts ||
                settings.offlineVoice != KurdishVoiceText.PIPER || !isInstalled(app)) return
            try {
                val engine = preparedFirstUse.preload(firstUseIdentity(app), { PiperTts(app) },
                    { it.warmUp() }, { task -> firstUseExecutor.execute { task() } })
                // Only an unclaimed engine may expire. A live reader owns its own lifecycle.
                firstUseExecutor.schedule({ preparedFirstUse.expire(engine) }, 5, TimeUnit.MINUTES)
            } catch (error: Exception) {
                Log.w(TAG, "background preparation failed", error)
            }
        }

        fun takePrepared(ctx: Context): PiperTts {
            val app = ctx.applicationContext
            return preparedFirstUse.take(firstUseIdentity(app)) { PiperTts(app) }
        }

        fun clearPrepared() = preparedFirstUse.clear()

        private fun matchesFemaleRecipeModel(file: File): Boolean {
            val digest = java.security.MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
            file.inputStream().buffered().use { input ->
                val buffer = ByteArray(64 * 1024)
                while (true) {
                    val n = input.read(buffer)
                    if (n < 0) break
                    digest.update(buffer, 0, n)
                }
            }
            return digest.digest().joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it.toInt() and 255) } ==
                FemaleVoiceRecipe.MODEL_SHA256
        }
        fun modelDir(ctx: Context) = File(ctx.filesDir, PiperModelChoice.directory(0))
        private fun selectedModelDir(ctx: Context) =
            File(ctx.filesDir, PiperModelChoice.directory(TranslatorSettings(ctx).piperModelVariant))
        private fun installedAt(dir: File) = File(dir, MODEL).exists() && File(dir, CONFIG).exists()
        fun isOriginalInstalled(ctx: Context) = installedAt(modelDir(ctx))
        fun isInstalled(ctx: Context) = installedAt(selectedModelDir(ctx))

        const val VOICE_URL = "https://github.com/Whiteheart00/manga-translator/releases/download/v1.0.1/kurdish_onnx_model.zip"

        /** دەنگی کوردی دادەبەزێنێت و دەیکاتەوە. null = باشە. لەسەر thread ی کار بانگ بکرێت. */
        const val CONFIG_URL = "https://github.com/Whiteheart00/manga-translator/releases/download/v1.0.1/model.onnx.json"
        /** ئەگەر v1.0.1 ی دیاریکراو 404 ی دا، دوایین Release (latest) تاقی دەکرێتەوە */
        private const val LATEST_BASE = "https://github.com/Whiteheart00/manga-translator/releases/latest/download/"

        private class Fetch(val error: String?, val notFound: Boolean = false)

        private fun fileOf(u: String) = u.substringBefore('?').substringAfterLast('/')

        /**
         * فایلێک دادەبەزێنێت بۆ [part] و ئەگەر نیوەچڵ بوو لەو شوێنەوە بەردەوام دەبێت (Range). 404/410 بە جیا دەگەڕێتەوە
         * تا ئەو بانگکەرە بزانێت سەرچاوەی تر تاقی بکاتەوە؛ پچڕانی ئینتەرنێت فایلە نیوەچڵەکە دەهێڵێتەوە.
         */
        private fun fetchResumable(url: String, part: File, progress: (Int) -> Unit): Fetch {
            var have = part.length()
            var u = url
            var c: java.net.HttpURLConnection
            var hops = 0
            var code: Int
            while (true) {
                c = java.net.URL(u).openConnection() as java.net.HttpURLConnection
                c.connectTimeout = 15_000
                c.readTimeout = 60_000
                c.instanceFollowRedirects = false
                c.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "MangaTranslator/1.0")
                c.setRequestProperty("Accept-Encoding", "identity")
                if (have > 0) c.setRequestProperty("Range", "bytes=$have-")
                code = c.responseCode
                if (code in 300..399 && hops++ < 6) {
                    val loc = c.getHeaderField("Location")
                    c.disconnect()
                    if (loc == null) return Fetch("HTTP $code بێ Location (${fileOf(url)})")
                    u = java.net.URL(java.net.URL(u), loc).toString()
                    continue
                }
                break
            }
            if (code == 416 && have > 0) {      // هەموو فایلەکە پێشتر دابەزێنرابوو
                c.disconnect()
                progress(100)
                return Fetch(null)
            }
            if (code != 200 && code != 206) {
                c.disconnect()
                if (code == 416) part.delete()
                return Fetch("HTTP $code (${fileOf(url)})", notFound = code == 404 || code == 410)
            }
            var total = c.contentLengthLong
            if (code == 206) {
                val m = Regex("bytes (\\d+)-(\\d+)/(\\d+)").matchEntire(c.getHeaderField("Content-Range").orEmpty())
                val start = m?.groupValues?.get(1)?.toLongOrNull()
                val all = m?.groupValues?.get(3)?.toLongOrNull()
                if (start != have || all == null) { c.disconnect(); part.delete(); return Fetch("Content-Range (${fileOf(url)})") }
                total = all
            } else {
                have = 0L   // سێرڤەر Range ی نەگرت: لە سەرەتاوە
            }
            var got = have
            var last = -1
            c.inputStream.use { ins ->
                java.io.FileOutputStream(part, code == 206 && have > 0).use { o ->
                    val buf = ByteArray(64 * 1024)
                    while (true) {
                        val n = ins.read(buf)
                        if (n < 0) break
                        o.write(buf, 0, n)
                        got += n
                        if (total > 0) {
                            val p = (got * 100 / total).toInt()
                            if (p != last) { last = p; progress(p) }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            c.disconnect()
            if (total > 0 && got != total) return Fetch("داگرتن پچڕا (${got / 1024 / 1024} / ${total / 1024 / 1024} MB)")
            return Fetch(null)
        }

        /** فایلێکی بچووک (model.onnx.json): دەبێت JSON بێت، نەک پەڕەی HTML */
        private fun fetchConfig(dir: File): String? {
            val target = File(dir, CONFIG)
            val part = File(dir, "$CONFIG.part")
            var lastErr: String? = null
            for (u in listOf(CONFIG_URL, LATEST_BASE + CONFIG)) {
                part.delete()
                val r = try { fetchResumable(u, part) {} } catch (e: Throwable) { return "داگرتن سەرنەکەوت: ${e.message}" }
                if (r.error != null) { lastErr = r.error; if (r.notFound) continue else return "داگرتن سەرنەکەوت: ${r.error}" }
                val head = try { part.inputStream().use { ins -> val b = ByteArray(64); val n = ins.read(b); if (n > 0) String(b, 0, n, Charsets.UTF_8).trimStart() else "" } } catch (_: Throwable) { "" }
                if (!head.startsWith("{")) { lastErr = "model.onnx.json JSON نییە"; continue }
                target.delete()
                if (part.renameTo(target)) return null
                lastErr = "model.onnx.json نەنووسرا"
            }
            part.delete()
            return "داگرتن سەرنەکەوت: ${lastErr ?: CONFIG}"
        }

        fun download(ctx: Context, url: String = VOICE_URL, progress: (Int) -> Unit): String? {
            val dir = modelDir(ctx)
            dir.mkdirs()
            // فایلی نیوەچڵ لە filesDir دەمێنێتەوە (نەک cache) تا ئەگەر ئینتەرنێت پچڕا یان ئەپەکە داخرا، لەو شوێنەوە بەردەوام بێت
            val z = File(ctx.filesDir, "ku_voice.zip.part")
            return try {
                if (!File(dir, MODEL).exists()) {
                    val sources = if (url == VOICE_URL) listOf(VOICE_URL, LATEST_BASE + "kurdish_onnx_model.zip") else listOf(url)
                    var done = false
                    var lastErr: String? = null
                    for ((i, src) in sources.withIndex()) {
                        if (i > 0) z.delete()   // سەرچاوەی جیاواز: فایلی نیوەچڵی پێشوو بەکار ناهێنرێت
                        val r = fetchResumable(src, z, progress)
                        if (r.error == null) { done = true; break }
                        lastErr = r.error
                        if (!r.notFound) return "داگرتن سەرنەکەوت: ${r.error}"   // ئینتەرنێت/سێرڤەر: دواتر لە هەمان شوێنەوە بەردەوام دەبێت
                    }
                    if (!done) return "داگرتن سەرنەکەوت: ${lastErr ?: "404"}"
                    try {
                        ZipInputStream(z.inputStream().buffered()).use { zin ->
                            while (true) {
                                val e = zin.nextEntry ?: break
                                if (e.isDirectory) continue
                                val base = e.name.substringAfterLast('/').lowercase()
                                val target = when {
                                    base.endsWith(".onnx.json") -> CONFIG
                                    base.endsWith(".onnx") -> MODEL
                                    else -> null
                                } ?: continue
                                val tmp = File(dir, "$target.tmp")
                                tmp.outputStream().use { zin.copyTo(it) }
                                File(dir, target).delete()
                                tmp.renameTo(File(dir, target))
                            }
                        }
                    } catch (e: Throwable) {
                        z.delete()   // zip تێکچووە: دەبێت لە سەرەتاوە دابەزێت
                        throw e
                    }
                    z.delete()
                }
                // model.onnx.json لە release دا فایلێکی جیایە؛ ئەگەر لە zip دا نەبوو، بە جیا دادەبەزێت
                if (!File(dir, CONFIG).exists()) {
                    val err = fetchConfig(dir)
                    if (err != null) return err
                }
                if (installedAt(dir)) { modelEpoch.incrementAndGet(); null }
                else "model.onnx یان model.onnx.json نەهات"
            } catch (e: Throwable) {
                Log.e(TAG, "download failed", e)
                "داگرتن سەرنەکەوت: ${e.message}"
            }
        }

        private fun displayName(ctx: Context, uri: Uri): String =
            try {
                ctx.contentResolver.query(uri, arrayOf(OpenableColumns.DISPLAY_NAME), null, null, null)?.use {
                    if (it.moveToFirst()) it.getString(0) else null
                }
            } catch (_: Exception) { null } ?: uri.lastPathSegment.orEmpty()

        /**
         * فایلە هەڵبژێردراوەکان دەهێنێت: zip (کە model.onnx و model.onnx.json ی تێدایە) یان .onnx / .json.
         * لەسەر thread ی کار بانگ بکرێت. null = سەرکەوتوو، ئەگینا پەیامی هەڵە.
         */
        fun importModel(ctx: Context, uris: List<Uri>): String? {
            val dir = selectedModelDir(ctx)
            dir.mkdirs()
            try {
                for (uri in uris) {
                    val name = displayName(ctx, uri).lowercase()
                    val input = ctx.contentResolver.openInputStream(uri) ?: return "فایلەکە نەکرایەوە"
                    input.use { ins ->
                        when {
                            name.endsWith(".zip") -> {
                                ZipInputStream(ins.buffered()).use { zin ->
                                    while (true) {
                                        val e = zin.nextEntry ?: break
                                        if (e.isDirectory) continue
                                        val base = e.name.substringAfterLast('/').lowercase()
                                        val target = when {
                                            base.endsWith(".onnx.json") -> CONFIG
                                            base.endsWith(".onnx") -> MODEL
                                            else -> null
                                        } ?: continue
                                        File(dir, target + ".tmp").outputStream().use { zin.copyTo(it) }
                                        File(dir, target).delete()
                                        File(dir, target + ".tmp").renameTo(File(dir, target))
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            name.endsWith(".onnx.json") || name.endsWith(".json") ->
                                File(dir, CONFIG).outputStream().use { ins.copyTo(it) }
                            name.endsWith(".onnx") ->
                                File(dir, MODEL).outputStream().use { ins.copyTo(it) }
                            else -> return "جۆری فایل نەناسراوە ($name). zip یان .onnx یان .json هەڵبژێرە"
                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch (e: Throwable) {
                Log.e(TAG, "import failed", e)
                return "هێنان سەرنەکەوت: ${e.message}"
            }
            return if (installedAt(dir)) { modelEpoch.incrementAndGet(); null }
            else "model.onnx یان model.onnx.json لە فایلەکاندا نەبوو"
        }
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

/** Preserve existing tones; the reference recipe is applied in PCM, not again at playback. */
internal object PiperVoiceProfile {
    data class Preset(val id: Int, val label: String, val pitch: Float,
                      val cutoffHz: Float, val targetRms: Float,
                      val edge: Int = 0, val soft: Int = 0)
    private val presets = listOf(
        Preset(0, "دەنگی ڕەسەن", 1f, 7000f, 0.1f),
        Preset(1, "پیاوانەی نەرم", 1f, 5600f, 0.095f),
        Preset(2, "تۆنی ژنانەی نەرم (گۆڕینی دەنگ)", 1.22f, 6000f, 0.095f),
        Preset(3, "نموونەی ئافرەت — ٢١٥ Hz", 1f, 7000f, 0.1f)
    )
    val labels: List<String> = presets.map { it.label }
    fun get(id: Int): Preset = presets.getOrElse(id) { presets[0] }
    fun customized(settings: TranslatorSettings): Preset {
        val base = get(settings.piperVoiceProfile)
        return base.copy(
            pitch = settings.piperPitch,
            cutoffHz = settings.piperCutoffHz.toFloat(),
            targetRms = 0.1f * settings.piperTargetRms / 100f,
            edge = settings.piperEdge,
            soft = settings.piperSoft
        )
    }
    /** Preserve the original helper API used by the existing unit tests/tools. */
    fun cacheKey(speed: Float, lowLatency: Boolean, preset: Preset, text: String) =
        "voice-pcm-v4|${(speed * 100).toInt()}|${if (lowLatency) 1 else 0}|tone=${preset.id}|p=${preset.pitch}|c=${preset.cutoffHz}|r=${preset.targetRms}|g=${preset.edge}|s=${preset.soft}|$text"

    fun cacheKey(speed: Float, lowLatency: Boolean, preset: Preset, text: String, settings: TranslatorSettings) =
        "voice-pcm-v4|${(speed * 100).toInt()}|${if (lowLatency) 1 else 0}|tone=${preset.id}|p=${(settings.piperPitch * 100).toInt()}|c=${settings.piperCutoffHz}|r=${settings.piperTargetRms}|n=${settings.piperNoiseScale}|l=${settings.piperLengthScale}|w=${settings.piperNoiseW}|e=${settings.piperEndPauseMs}|g=${settings.piperEdge}|s=${settings.piperSoft}|$text"
}
