package com.mangatranslator.app

import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.graphics.Rect
import android.os.SystemClock
import android.util.Log
import ai.onnxruntime.OnnxTensor
import ai.onnxruntime.OrtEnvironment
import ai.onnxruntime.OrtSession
import ai.onnxruntime.TensorInfo
import java.io.File
import java.net.HttpURLConnection
import java.net.URL
import java.nio.FloatBuffer
import java.security.MessageDigest
import kotlin.math.ceil
import kotlin.math.max
import kotlin.math.min
import kotlin.math.roundToInt

/**
 * Optional, offline-after-first-download Arabic OCR (PP-OCRv5 mobile detector + Arabic recognizer).
 * Uses the ONNX Runtime already included for Piper. Never blocks the UI thread.
 * On network/model/runtime failure the caller retains the original Tesseract/Gemini fallback.
 *
 * ONNX conversions: https://huggingface.co/vladadu/pp-ocrv5-arabic-mobile-onnx (Apache-2.0).
 * Based on PaddleOCR PP-OCRv5 by PaddlePaddle (Apache-2.0).
 */
internal object PpOcrArabic {
    private const val TAG = "PpOcrArabic"
    private const val BASE = "https://huggingface.co/vladadu/pp-ocrv5-arabic-mobile-onnx/resolve/main/"
    /** هەمان فایلەکان ئەگەر لە Release ی خۆت دابندرێن (v1.0.1)، یەکەم سەرچاوە ئەوەیە؛ ئەگەر 404 بوو، Hugging Face */
    private const val RELEASE = "https://github.com/Whiteheart00/manga-translator/releases/download/v1.0.1/"
    private const val DET = "PP-OCRv5_mobile_det.onnx"
    private const val REC = "arabic_PP-OCRv5_mobile_rec.onnx"
    private const val DICT = "arabic_PP-OCRv5_mobile_rec_dict.txt"
    private data class ModelFile(val name: String, val size: Long, val sha256: String)
    private val files = listOf(
        ModelFile(DET, 4_766_440L, "c8d9b07063420ce5365c74e42532de48238feeeedcdb7a330b195708bc38a93f"),
        ModelFile(REC, 7_994_035L, "4e2f4ae42104e1b272463966c56ddafa3c6ad98ce9d8c7ed765ce66666ea13e1"),
        ModelFile(DICT, 2_369L, "7f92f7dbb9b75a4787a83bfb4f6d14a8ab515525130c9d40a9036f61cf6999e9")
    )
    private val lock = Any()
    private val dlLock = Any()
    private var detector: OrtSession? = null
    private var recognizer: OrtSession? = null
    private var alphabet: List<String> = emptyList()
    private var retryAfterMs = 0L

    private fun directory(ctx: Context) = File(ctx.filesDir, "ocr/ppocrv5_arabic")

    fun isInstalled(ctx: Context): Boolean = files.all {
        File(directory(ctx), it.name).let { f -> f.isFile && f.length() == it.size }
    }

    /** Must run on the background OCR executor; never the main thread. */
    fun recognize(ctx: Context, bitmap: Bitmap, onNotice: (String) -> Unit): List<TextBox> = synchronized(lock) {
        try {
            if (!ensureModels(ctx, onNotice)) return@synchronized emptyList()
            val env = OrtEnvironment.getEnvironment()
            if (detector == null || recognizer == null) {
                val options = OrtSession.SessionOptions().apply {
                    setIntraOpNumThreads(if (DeviceProfile.low) 1 else 2)
                }
                try {
                    detector = env.createSession(File(directory(ctx), DET).absolutePath, options)
                    recognizer = env.createSession(File(directory(ctx), REC).absolutePath, options)
                } finally { options.close() }
                val chars = File(directory(ctx), DICT).readLines(Charsets.UTF_8)
                require(chars.size == 747) { "Arabic CTC dictionary is incomplete" }
                alphabet = listOf("") + chars + " " // CTC blank=0, last class is space
            }
            val regions = detect(env, detector!!, bitmap)
            val out = ArrayList<TextBox>()
            for (r in regions.take(if (DeviceProfile.low) 50 else 90)) {
                val result = readRegion(env, recognizer!!, bitmap, r) ?: continue
                val (text, confidence) = result
                if (confidence >= 0.55f && text.count { it.code in 0x0600..0x06FF } >= 2) {
                    out.add(TextBox(r, text))
                }
            }
            out.sortedWith(compareBy<TextBox> { it.rect.top / 26 }.thenByDescending { it.rect.right })
        } catch (t: Throwable) {
            Log.w(TAG, "Arabic ONNX OCR failed; using fallback", t)
            closeSessions()
            emptyList()
        }
    }

    private fun ensureModels(ctx: Context, notice: (String) -> Unit): Boolean {
        if (isInstalled(ctx)) return true
        if (SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() < retryAfterMs) return false
        notice("Arabic OCR: downloading (once)")
        val err = download(ctx) {}
        if (err == null && isInstalled(ctx)) { retryAfterMs = 0L; return true }
        retryAfterMs = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + 5 * 60_000L
        Log.w(TAG, "Arabic OCR download unavailable: $err")
        notice("Arabic OCR: download unavailable; using existing OCR")
        return false
    }

    /**
     * مۆدێلەکان دادەبەزێنێت (بەردەوامبوون لەو شوێنەوە کە وەستابوو). سەرچاوەکان: Release ی خۆت ← Hugging Face.
     * هەر فایلێک بە SHA-256 و قەبارە دەپشکنرێت پێش ئەوەی بخرێتە شوێنی کۆتایی. null = سەرکەوتوو.
     */
    fun download(ctx: Context, progress: (Int) -> Unit): String? = synchronized(dlLock) {
        val folder = directory(ctx)
        folder.mkdirs()
        val total = files.sumOf { it.size }.toFloat()
        var doneBytes = 0L
        try {
            for (spec in files) {
                val target = File(folder, spec.name)
                if (target.isFile && target.length() == spec.size && matchesHash(target, spec.sha256)) {
                    doneBytes += spec.size
                    progress((doneBytes / total * 100).toInt())
                    continue
                }
                val part = File(folder, "${spec.name}.part")
                var ok = false
                var lastErr: String? = null
                for (src in listOf(RELEASE + spec.name, BASE + spec.name + "?download=true")) {
                    val r = ResumableDownload.fetch(src, part) { p -> progress(((doneBytes + spec.size * p / 100f) / total * 100).toInt()) }
                    if (r.error != null) {
                        lastErr = r.error
                        if (!r.notFound) return@synchronized "داگرتن سەرنەکەوت: ${r.error}"   // ئینتەرنێت/سێرڤەر: دواتر لەو شوێنەوە بەردەوام دەبێت
                        part.delete()
                        continue
                    }
                    if (part.length() == spec.size && matchesHash(part, spec.sha256)) {
                        if (target.exists()) target.delete()
                        check(part.renameTo(target)) { "Unable to save OCR model" }
                        ok = true
                        break
                    }
                    part.delete()
                    lastErr = "checksum/size mismatch (${ResumableDownload.fileOf(src)})"
                }
                if (!ok) return@synchronized "داگرتن سەرنەکەوت: ${lastErr ?: spec.name}"
                doneBytes += spec.size
                progress((doneBytes / total * 100).toInt())
            }
            null
        } catch (t: Throwable) {
            Log.w(TAG, "Arabic OCR download failed", t)
            "داگرتن سەرنەکەوت: ${t.message ?: t.javaClass.simpleName}"
        }
    }

    private fun matchesHash(file: File, expected: String): Boolean {
        val digest = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
        file.inputStream().use { input ->
            val buffer = ByteArray(32 * 1024)
            while (true) {
                val n = input.read(buffer)
                if (n < 0) break
                digest.update(buffer, 0, n)
            }
        }
        return digest.digest().joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it.toInt() and 0xff) } == expected
    }

    // PaddleOCR detection: BGR, NormalizeImage(1/255, ImageNet mean/std), CHW.
    private fun detect(env: OrtEnvironment, model: OrtSession, src: Bitmap): List<Rect> {
        val shape = (model.inputInfo.values.first().info as TensorInfo).shape
        val maxSide = if (DeviceProfile.low) 640f else 960f
        val scale = min(1f, maxSide / max(src.width, src.height).coerceAtLeast(1))
        val requestW = max(32, ceil(src.width * scale / 32f).toInt() * 32)
        val requestH = max(32, ceil(src.height * scale / 32f).toInt() * 32)
        val w = if (shape.size >= 4 && shape[3] > 0) shape[3].toInt() else requestW
        val h = if (shape.size >= 4 && shape[2] > 0) shape[2].toInt() else requestH
        require(w in 32..2048 && h in 32..2048) { "Unsupported PP-OCR detector size" }
        val scaled = Bitmap.createScaledBitmap(src, w, h, true)
        val data = normalized(scaled, w, h, rec = false)
        if (scaled !== src) scaled.recycle()
        val input = OnnxTensor.createTensor(env, FloatBuffer.wrap(data), longArrayOf(1, 3, h.toLong(), w.toLong()))
        try {
            model.run(mapOf(model.inputNames.first() to input)).use { result ->
                val out = result[0] as OnnxTensor
                val dim = out.info.shape
                require(dim.size == 4 && dim[0] == 1L && dim[1] == 1L) { "Unexpected detector output shape" }
                val oh = dim[2].toInt()
                val ow = dim[3].toInt()
                require(oh in 32..2048 && ow in 32..2048) { "Unexpected detector output size" }
                val scores = FloatArray(oh * ow)
                out.floatBuffer.get(scores)
                return extractRegions(scores, ow, oh, src.width, src.height)
            }
        } finally { input.close() }
    }

    /** DB probability map: connected text regions with small rectangle expansion. */
    private fun extractRegions(score: FloatArray, w: Int, h: Int, origW: Int, origH: Int): List<Rect> {
        val visited = ByteArray(w * h)
        val queue = IntArray(w * h)
        val regions = ArrayList<Rect>()
        for (start in score.indices) {
            if (visited[start].toInt() != 0 || score[start] < 0.3f) continue
            var head = 0
            var tail = 1
            queue[0] = start
            visited[start] = 1
            var minX = start % w; var maxX = minX
            var minY = start / w; var maxY = minY
            var sum = 0f
            while (head < tail) {
                val id = queue[head++]
                val x = id % w; val y = id / w
                minX = min(minX, x); maxX = max(maxX, x)
                minY = min(minY, y); maxY = max(maxY, y)
                sum += score[id]
                for (dy in -1..1) for (dx in -1..1) {
                    if (dx == 0 && dy == 0) continue
                    val xx = x + dx; val yy = y + dy
                    if (xx !in 0 until w || yy !in 0 until h) continue
                    val next = yy * w + xx
                    if (visited[next].toInt() == 0 && score[next] >= 0.3f) {
                        visited[next] = 1
                        queue[tail++] = next
                    }
                }
            }
            if (tail < 8 || sum / tail < 0.55f) continue
            val bw = maxX - minX + 1; val bh = maxY - minY + 1
            if (bw < 5 || bh < 3 || bw * bh < 24) continue
            val padX = max(2f, bw * 0.18f)
            val padY = max(2f, bh * 0.32f)
            val left = ((minX - padX) * origW / w).toInt().coerceIn(0, origW - 1)
            val top = ((minY - padY) * origH / h).toInt().coerceIn(0, origH - 1)
            val right = ((maxX + 1 + padX) * origW / w).toInt().coerceIn(left + 1, origW)
            val bottom = ((maxY + 1 + padY) * origH / h).toInt().coerceIn(top + 1, origH)
            val rect = Rect(left, top, right, bottom)
            if (regions.none { overlaps(it, rect) > 0.7f }) regions.add(rect)
            if (regions.size >= 120) break
        }
        return regions
    }

    private fun overlaps(a: Rect, b: Rect): Float {
        val intersect = Rect()
        if (!intersect.setIntersect(a, b)) return 0f
        return intersect.width().toFloat() * intersect.height() / min(a.width() * a.height(), b.width() * b.height()).coerceAtLeast(1)
    }

    // PaddleOCR RecResizeImg: BGR; [3,48,320] with zero padding to the right.
    // Rec normalization is (channel / 255 - 0.5) / 0.5.
    private fun readRegion(env: OrtEnvironment, model: OrtSession, src: Bitmap, rect: Rect): Pair<String, Float>? {
        val inputShape = (model.inputInfo.values.first().info as TensorInfo).shape
        val h = if (inputShape.size >= 4 && inputShape[2] > 0) inputShape[2].toInt() else 48
        val fixedW = if (inputShape.size >= 4 && inputShape[3] > 0) inputShape[3].toInt() else 0
        if (h !in 32..96 || (fixedW != 0 && fixedW !in 80..1024)) return null
        // ئەم مۆدێلە پانیی گۆڕاوی هەیە: پانی بەپێی ڕێژەی دێڕەکە (وەک PaddleOCR). پێشتر هەموو شت بۆ ٣٢٠px دەپەستێنرا
        // و دێڕی درێژ تەنها ٢ پیتی لێ دەخوێندرایەوە (لە تاقیکردنەوەی مۆدێلی ڕاستەقینەدا).
        val ratio = rect.width().toFloat() / rect.height().coerceAtLeast(1)
        val w = if (fixedW > 0) fixedW else ceil(h * ratio).toInt().coerceIn(48, 960)
        val crop = Bitmap.createBitmap(src, rect.left, rect.top, rect.width(), rect.height())
        val fitW = min(w, max(1, (crop.width.toFloat() / crop.height * h).roundToInt()))
        val scaled = Bitmap.createScaledBitmap(crop, fitW, h, true)
        val data = normalized(scaled, w, h, rec = true)
        if (scaled !== crop) scaled.recycle()
        crop.recycle()
        val input = OnnxTensor.createTensor(env, FloatBuffer.wrap(data), longArrayOf(1, 3, h.toLong(), w.toLong()))
        try {
            model.run(mapOf(model.inputNames.first() to input)).use { result ->
                val out = result[0] as OnnxTensor
                val shape = out.info.shape
                if (shape.size != 3 || shape[0] != 1L) return null
                val steps = shape[1].toInt()
                val classes = shape[2].toInt()
                if (steps !in 1..2048 || classes != alphabet.size) return null
                val prediction = FloatArray(steps * classes)
                out.floatBuffer.get(prediction)
                val text = StringBuilder()
                var previous = -1
                var sumConfidence = 0f
                var count = 0
                for (t in 0 until steps) {
                    var best = 0
                    var score = Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY
                    for (c in 0 until classes) {
                        val value = prediction[t * classes + c]
                        if (value > score) { score = value; best = c }
                    }
                    if (best != 0 && best != previous) {
                        text.append(alphabet[best])
                        sumConfidence += score
                        count++
                    }
                    previous = best
                }
                if (count == 0) return null
                val logical = TextPrep.arabicVariants(reverseArabic(text.toString())).trim()
                return logical to (sumConfidence / count)
            }
        } finally { input.close() }
    }

    /** Mirrors PaddleOCR's pred_reverse: reverse Arabic units but keep Latin/numeric runs in order. */
    internal fun reverseArabic(visual: String): String {
        val groups = ArrayList<String>()
        val latin = StringBuilder()
        for (c in visual) {
            if (c in 'a'..'z' || c in 'A'..'Z' || c in '0'..'9' || c in " :*./%+-") {
                latin.append(c)
            } else {
                if (latin.isNotEmpty()) { groups.add(latin.toString()); latin.setLength(0) }
                groups.add(c.toString())
            }
        }
        if (latin.isNotEmpty()) groups.add(latin.toString())
        return groups.asReversed().joinToString("")
    }

    private fun normalized(src: Bitmap, width: Int, height: Int, rec: Boolean): FloatArray {
        val plane = width * height
        val data = FloatArray(3 * plane)
        val row = IntArray(src.width)
        val mean = floatArrayOf(.485f, .456f, .406f)
        val std = floatArrayOf(.229f, .224f, .225f)
        for (y in 0 until height) {
            if (y >= src.height) continue
            src.getPixels(row, 0, src.width, 0, y, src.width, 1)
            for (x in 0 until min(width, src.width)) {
                val pixel = row[x]
                val bgr = intArrayOf(pixel and 0xff, pixel shr 8 and 0xff, pixel shr 16 and 0xff)
                val offset = y * width + x
                for (c in 0..2) {
                    val v = bgr[c] / 255f
                    data[c * plane + offset] = if (rec) (v - .5f) / .5f else (v - mean[c]) / std[c]
                }
            }
        }
        return data
    }

    private fun closeSessions() {
        try { detector?.close() } catch (_: Throwable) {}
        try { recognizer?.close() } catch (_: Throwable) {}
        detector = null; recognizer = null; alphabet = emptyList()
    }

    fun release() = synchronized(lock) { closeSessions() }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

/** One unclaimed resource, with explicit ownership transfer. Heavy warmup is scheduled,
 * never awaited by take(). The resource must support disposal racing with warmup;
 * PiperTts already serializes native work/close through its synthesis gate.
 */
internal class PreparedResource<T : Any>(private val dispose: (T) -> Unit) {
    private class Entry<T>(val key: String, val value: T) {
        @Volatile var cancelled = false
        var claimed = false // guarded by lock
    }
    private val lock = Any()
    private var entry: Entry<T>? = null

    fun preload(key: String, create: () -> T, warm: (T) -> Unit,
                execute: (() -> Unit) -> Unit): T {
        var stale: Entry<T>? = null
        val next = synchronized(lock) {
            entry?.takeIf { it.key == key }?.let { return it.value }
            stale = entry
            stale?.cancelled = true
            Entry(key, create()).also { entry = it }
        }
        stale?.let { dispose(it.value) }
        try {
            execute {
                val shouldWarm = synchronized(lock) { !next.cancelled && !next.claimed }
                if (shouldWarm) warm(next.value)
            }
        } catch (error: Throwable) {
            expire(next.value)
            throw error
        }
        return next.value
    }

    fun take(key: String, create: () -> T): T {
        val stale = synchronized(lock) {
            entry?.takeIf { it.key == key }?.let {
                it.claimed = true
                entry = null // warmup may still finish; only the consumer now owns this resource
                return it.value
            }
            entry.also { entry = null; it?.cancelled = true }
        }
        stale?.let { dispose(it.value) }
        return create()
    }

    fun expire(value: T) {
        val stale = synchronized(lock) {
            if (entry?.value !== value) return
            entry.also { entry = null; it?.cancelled = true }
        }
        stale?.let { dispose(it.value) }
    }

    fun clear() {
        val stale = synchronized(lock) { entry.also { entry = null; it?.cancelled = true } }
        stale?.let { dispose(it.value) }
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

/**
 * «هیچ کات دووجار هەمان شت نەخوێندرێتەوە». فەنکشنی پاک، بێ Android، تاقیکراو.
 *
 * کاتێک ڕستەی A وەرگێڕدرا و خوێندرایەوە، پاشان شاشە «A B» نیشان دەدات (ڕستەی نوێ لەگەڵ ئەوی پێشوو لەسەر هەمان
 * شاشە، یان دەقەکە بە وشە بە وشە گەشە دەکات)، OCR ی «A B» وەک دەقی نوێ دەهات و A دووبارە وەردەگێڕدرا و دەخوێندرایەوە.
 * ئێستا: ئەو بەشەی لە سەرەتای دەقی نوێدا پێشتر وەرگێڕدراوە و خوێندراوەتەوە لادەبرێت و تەنها بەشی نوێ ([Result.text]) دەمێنێتەوە.
 *
 * ئاگاداری: تەنها لە سەرەتای دەقدا لادەبرێت (نەک ناوەڕاست)، و دەقی پێشووی زۆر کورت (<[MIN_NORM] پیت: «Yes»، «No») لادەنابرێت،
 * بۆ ئەوەی وشەیەکی ئاسایی لە ناو ڕستەیەکی نوێدا ون نەبێت.
 */
object ReadOnce {
    const val MIN_NORM = 5

    class Result(val text: String, val stripped: Boolean, val matched: List<String>)

    /**
     * @param handled دەقە سەرچاوە ئەم دواییە وەرگێڕدراو/خوێندراوەکان
     * @param norm ئاسایی کردنی دەق (بێ هێما، پیتی بچووک)
     * @param similar ئایا دوو دەقی ئاسایی کراو هەمان دێڕن (OCR ی کەمێک جیاواز)
     */
    fun strip(
        text: String,
        handled: List<String>,
        norm: (String) -> String,
        similar: (String, String) -> Boolean
    ): Result {
        var tokens = text.trim().split(Regex("\\s+")).filter { it.isNotEmpty() }
        if (tokens.size < 2 || handled.isEmpty()) return Result(text, false, emptyList())

        // درێژترینەکان پێشتر: «A B» لە پێش «A»
        val cands = handled
            .map { it to norm(it) }
            .filter { it.second.length >= MIN_NORM }
            .sortedByDescending { it.second.length }
        if (cands.isEmpty()) return Result(text, false, emptyList())

        val matched = ArrayList<String>()
        var progress = true
        while (progress && tokens.size >= 1) {
            progress = false
            for ((raw, n) in cands) {
                val pc = raw.trim().split(Regex("\\s+")).count { it.isNotEmpty() }.coerceAtLeast(1)
                for (k in intArrayOf(pc, pc - 1, pc + 1)) {
                    if (k < 1 || k > tokens.size) continue
                    val head = tokens.subList(0, k).joinToString(" ")
                    val hn = norm(head)
                    if (hn.length >= MIN_NORM && (hn == n || similar(hn, n))) {
                        matched.add(raw)
                        tokens = tokens.subList(k, tokens.size)
                        progress = true
                        break
                    }
                }
                if (progress) break
            }
        }
        if (matched.isEmpty()) return Result(text, false, emptyList())
        return Result(tokens.joinToString(" "), true, matched)
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

/**
 * ڕیزبەندی خوێندنەوەی بلۆکەکان: سەرەوە بۆ خوارەوە بە ١٢ ڕیز، و لەناو هەر ڕیزێکدا چەپ بۆ ڕاست (یان ڕاست بۆ چەپ ئەگەر [rtl]).
 * فەنکشنێکی پاکە (بێ Android) بۆ ئەوەی بتوانرێت تێستی یەکەی بۆ بکرێت.
 */
object ReadingOrder {
    const val ROWS = 12

    fun <T> sort(items: List<T>, frameH: Int, rtl: Boolean = false, top: (T) -> Int, left: (T) -> Int): List<T> {
        val h = frameH.coerceAtLeast(1)
        return items.sortedWith(
            compareBy<T> { top(it) * ROWS / h }
                .thenBy { if (rtl) -left(it) else left(it) }
        )
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

/** Region reading: borrowed Latin words do not change a Sorani paragraph's language. */
internal object RegionReadPolicy {
    private const val soraniLetters = "ەۆێڕڵڤ"
    private val tokens = Regex("\\s+")
    private val latinTerm = Regex("[A-Za-z0-9]+(?:[.+#_/-][A-Za-z0-9]+)*")
    private val camel = Regex("[a-z][A-Z]")

    fun isSorani(text: String): Boolean {
        var letters = 0
        var arabic = 0
        var special = 0
        for (c in text) {
            if (!c.isLetter()) continue
            letters++
            if (c.code in 0x0600..0x06ff || c.code in 0x0750..0x077f || c.code in 0xfb50..0xfeff) arabic++
            if (c in soraniLetters) special++
        }
        return arabic >= 2 && special >= 1 &&
            (arabic * 100 >= letters * 55 || special >= 2 && arabic * 100 >= letters * 35)
    }

    /** OCR/accessibility can place a product name in its own small text box. */
    fun nativeIndices(texts: List<String>): Set<Int> {
        val native = texts.indices.filterTo(LinkedHashSet()) { isSorani(texts[it]) }
        if (native.isEmpty() || !isSorani(texts.joinToString(" "))) return native
        for (i in texts.indices) {
            if (i in native) continue
            val text = texts[i].trim().trim('(', ')', '[', ']', ',', '،', '.', ':', '؛')
            val words = text.split(tokens).filter { it.isNotEmpty() }
            val term = words.isNotEmpty() && words.size <= 4 && words.all { latinTerm.matches(it) } &&
                (words.size == 1 || words.all { w -> w.all { !it.isLetter() || it.isUpperCase() } || camel.containsMatchIn(w) })
            val shortArabicFragment = text.length <= 32 && text.any { it.isLetter() } &&
                text.all { !it.isLetter() || it.code in 0x0600..0x06ff }
            if (term || shortArabicFragment) native.add(i)
        }
        return native
    }

    /** An OCR source is stronger evidence than a model's rewritten translation. */
    fun visionText(original: String, translated: String): String =
        if (isSorani(original)) original else translated
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import android.annotation.SuppressLint
import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Canvas
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.Paint
import android.graphics.RectF
import android.view.MotionEvent
import android.view.View

/**
 * شاشەی تەواو، کەمێک تاریک: بەکارهێنەر بە پەنجە ڕووبەرێک دەکێشێت.
 * کاتێک پەنجە هەڵدەگیرێت، onSelected بانگ دەکرێت. دوگمەی ✕ = پاشگەزبوونەوە.
 */
@SuppressLint("ViewConstructor")
class RegionSelectView(
    context: Context,
    private val onSelected: (RectF) -> Unit,
    private val onCancel: () -> Unit
) : View(context) {

    private val d = resources.displayMetrics.density
    private val dim = Paint().apply { color = Color.argb(110, 0, 0, 0) }
    private val clear = Paint().apply {
        color = Color.TRANSPARENT
        xfermode = android.graphics.PorterDuffXfermode(android.graphics.PorterDuff.Mode.CLEAR)
    }
    private val border = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        color = Color.parseColor("#FFB300")
        style = Paint.Style.STROKE
        strokeWidth = 2.5f * d
    }
    private val txt = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        color = Color.WHITE
        textSize = 16f * d
        textAlign = Paint.Align.CENTER
    }
    private val btnBg = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply { color = Color.parseColor("#C62828") }

    private var sx = 0f
    private var sy = 0f
    private var cx = 0f
    private var cy = 0f
    private var drawing = false
    private var cancelRect = RectF()

    init {
        setLayerType(LAYER_TYPE_HARDWARE, null)
    }

    override fun onSizeChanged(w: Int, h: Int, ow: Int, oh: Int) {
        val bw = 150f * d
        val bh = 44f * d
        cancelRect = RectF(w / 2f - bw / 2, 40f * d, w / 2f + bw / 2, 40f * d + bh)
    }

    private fun sel() = RectF(minOf(sx, cx), minOf(sy, cy), maxOf(sx, cx), maxOf(sy, cy))

    override fun onDraw(canvas: Canvas) {
        canvas.drawRect(0f, 0f, width.toFloat(), height.toFloat(), dim)
        if (drawing) {
            val r = sel()
            canvas.drawRect(r, clear)
            canvas.drawRect(r, border)
        } else {
            canvas.drawText("ڕووبەرەکە بکێشە (بە پەنجە)", width / 2f, height / 2f, txt)
        }
        canvas.drawRoundRect(cancelRect, 12f * d, 12f * d, btnBg)
        canvas.drawText("✕ پاشگەزبوونەوە", cancelRect.centerX(), cancelRect.centerY() + 6f * d, txt)
    }

    @SuppressLint("ClickableViewAccessibility")
    override fun onTouchEvent(e: MotionEvent): Boolean {
        when (e.action) {
            MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN -> {
                if (cancelRect.contains(e.x, e.y)) {
                    onCancel()
                    return true
                }
                sx = e.x; sy = e.y; cx = e.x; cy = e.y
                drawing = true
                invalidate()
            }
            MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE -> {
                cx = e.x; cy = e.y
                invalidate()
            }
            MotionEvent.ACTION_UP -> {
                if (!drawing) return true
                drawing = false
                cx = e.x; cy = e.y
                val r = sel()
                if (r.width() >= 40f * d && r.height() >= 30f * d) onSelected(r)
                else invalidate()   // زۆر بچووکە: دووبارە بکێشە
            }
            MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL -> {
                drawing = false
                invalidate()
            }
        }
        return true
    }
}

/** یەک پارچە دەق لە ڕووبەرە دیاریکراوەکە. rect بە پیکسێلی وێنەی ڕووبەرەکەیە (crop). */
data class RegionItem(
    val rect: Rect?,
    val original: String,
    val kurdish: String,
    val alreadyKurdish: Boolean

/**
 * وەرگێڕانی ڕووبەرێکی دیاریکراو بە Gemini (وێنە → دەق + وەرگێڕان بۆ سۆرانی) لە یەک داواکاریدا.
 * هەموو زمانێک (جاپانی، چینی، عەرەبی، ڕووسی...) پشتیوانی دەکات. ئەگەر دەقەکە خۆی سۆرانی بوو، وەرناگێڕدرێت.
 */
object RegionTranslator {
    // تێبینی: دۆخی ڕووبەر settings.sourceLang بەکارناهێنێت؛ هەموو زمانێک خۆکارانە دەناسرێتەوە.
    // هەڵبژاردنی زمانی دەق تەنها بۆ وەرگێڕانی خۆکار و شاشەیە (OcrEngine / GoogleTranslator / ArabicGemini).
    // سنووری وێنە بۆ Gemini: بەپێی کۆی پیکسێل (نەک تەنها درێژترین لا). نرخی Gemini و خێرایی بەپێی ڕووبەرە،
    // بۆیە ڕووبەری باریک و درێژ (webtoon/فیدی فەیسبووک) دەمێنێتەوە ڕوون، و گەورەکان بچووک دەکرێنەوە.
    private const val MAX_PIXELS = 920_000          // ≈ 960×960
    private const val MAX_PIXELS_LOW = 640_000      // ≈ 800×800
    private const val MAX_SIDE = 1600
    private const val MAX_SIDE_LOW = 1280
    private const val MAX_PIXELS_COMPACT = 1_700_000 // وەرگێڕانی خۆکار: دەقی بچووکتر = وردی زیاتر (≈ 1280×1280)

    private const val PROMPT =
        "This image is a cropped part of a phone screen (manga, comic, webtoon, game, video, app or web page). " +
            "Find every piece of readable text in it, in ANY language or script (including vertical text). " +
            "Ignore watermarks, page numbers and app buttons. Also ignore app interface text: timestamps and 'x minutes ago' labels, post dates, message times, usernames and handles, like/comment/share/reply/follow/send buttons, tab and menu labels, like/view counters, and chat status such as seen, typing, online (but DO keep the actual message and post text). " +
            "Return the text blocks in natural reading order (manga: right-to-left, top-to-bottom; otherwise by the script's direction). " +
            "For each block give: box = [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax] normalized to 0-1000 around the text; " +
            "original = the exact source text, keeping Latin words and numbers as written; lang = BCP-47 code of the source language (use ckb for Central/Sorani Kurdish in Arabic script); " +
            "kurdish = natural, spoken Central Kurdish (Sorani, Arabic script) translation. " +
            "If the text is ALREADY Sorani Kurdish, set lang to ckb and copy the ENTIRE block into kurdish verbatim, including all embedded Latin/English words, product names, acronyms and numbers. Do not translate just those words, omit the Kurdish body, expand acronyms, or transliterate names such as ERP, ERPNext and Nwebeen. Mixed Sorani with borrowed English terms is still ckb. " +
            "If the text is Sorani Kurdish written in LATIN letters (informal chat romanization, e.g. 'Slaw chony basit insaallah?', 'Khariky chit?', 'Mn yary online dakam', with ch/sh/kh/gh/w/y spellings, dakam, chony, zor, mn, to, nakam...), " +
            "it is NOT a foreign language: set lang to ckb and in kurdish write the SAME sentence transcribed into correct Sorani Arabic script, word for word, without translating or changing the meaning (keep colloquial wording; write Arabic loanwords in Kurdish script, e.g. insaallah = ئینشائەڵڵا; English words like online = ئۆنلاین). " +
            "If it is Kurmanji (Latin Kurdish with ç ş ê î û and Kurmanji grammar) or any other language, translate it to Sorani. " +
            "For foreign-language source text, keep names consistent as Kurdish-script transliterations; for already-Sorani text preserve its original spelling, including Latin names. " + ContextTranslator.VISION_RULES +
            "The translation rules apply only to foreign-language text. Already-Sorani mixed paragraphs must remain verbatim. Be brief: output only the JSON. If there is no text, return an empty array."

    /** پرۆمپتی کورت بۆ وەرگێڕانی خۆکار (عەرەبی): دەرچوونی کەمتر = خێراتر */
    private const val PROMPT_COMPACT =
        "Phone screenshot (manga, webtoon, video, chat, app or web page). Find every block of readable text (mostly Arabic). " +
            "Ignore watermarks, page numbers, status bar, buttons and app interface text (timestamps, 'x minutes ago', dates, usernames, like/comment/share/reply/follow labels, counters, chat status like seen/typing/online) but keep the actual message and post text. Keep reading order (manga: right-to-left, top-to-bottom). " +
            "For each block: box = [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax] normalized 0-1000, tight around the whole block; " +
            "kurdish = natural spoken Central Kurdish (Sorani, Arabic script) translation of the MEANING (not word by word), same tone, " +
            "names consistent, numbers unchanged. " + ContextTranslator.VISION_RULES + "If the text is already Sorani, copy the entire block unchanged, preserving embedded Latin names and acronyms. Ignore text that is cut off by the image edge. Output only the JSON array; empty array if no text."

    private fun schema(compact: Boolean = false): JSONObject {
        val box = JSONObject().put("type", "ARRAY").put("items", JSONObject().put("type", "INTEGER"))
        val str = JSONObject().put("type", "STRING")
        val props = JSONObject().put("box", box)
        if (!compact) props.put("lang", str).put("original", str)
        props.put("kurdish", str)
        val item = JSONObject()
            .put("type", "OBJECT")
            .put("properties", props)
            .put("required", if (compact) JSONArray().put("box").put("kurdish") else JSONArray().put("lang").put("original").put("kurdish"))
        return JSONObject().put("type", "ARRAY").put("items", item)
    }

    private fun encode(
        src: Bitmap,
        maxPixels: Int = if (DeviceProfile.low) MAX_PIXELS_LOW else MAX_PIXELS,
        maxSide: Int = if (DeviceProfile.low) MAX_SIDE_LOW else MAX_SIDE,
        quality: Int = 72
    ): String {
        val t0 = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
        var b = src
        val w = src.width
        val h = src.height
        // هیچ کات گەورە ناکرێتەوە (k ≤ 1)؛ هەم سنووری پیکسێل و هەم سنووری درێژترین لا
        val kPix = Math.sqrt(maxPixels.toDouble() / (w.toDouble() * h).coerceAtLeast(1.0))
        val kSide = maxSide.toDouble() / maxOf(w, h)
        val k = minOf(1.0, kPix, kSide).toFloat()
        if (k < 1f) {
            b = Bitmap.createScaledBitmap(b, (w * k).toInt().coerceAtLeast(1), (h * k).toInt().coerceAtLeast(1), true)
        }
        val out = ByteArrayOutputStream(64 * 1024)
        b.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, quality, out)
        val nw = b.width
        val nh = b.height
        if (b !== src) b.recycle()
        val bytes = out.toByteArray()
        Perf.mark("وێنە بۆ Gemini: ${w}x$h ← ${nw}x$nh، ${bytes.size / 1024}KB، ${android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - t0}ms")
        return Base64.encodeToString(bytes, Base64.NO_WRAP)
    }

    /** لە thread ی پاشبنەما بانگ بکرێت. `crop` دەمێنێتەوە (recycle ناکرێت). */
    fun run(crop: Bitmap, keysRaw: String, fast: Boolean = true): List<RegionItem> {
        val b64 = encode(crop)
        fun body(model: String, think: Boolean): String {
            val gen = JSONObject()
                .put("responseMimeType", "application/json")
                .put("responseSchema", schema())
            if (think) gen.put("thinkingConfig", GeminiModels.thinking(model))
            return JSONObject()
                .put(
                    "contents",
                    JSONArray().put(
                        JSONObject().put(
                            "parts",
                            JSONArray()
                                .put(JSONObject().put("inlineData", JSONObject().put("mimeType", "image/jpeg").put("data", b64)))
                                .put(JSONObject().put("text", PROMPT))
                        )
                    )
                )
                .put("generationConfig", gen)
                .toString()
        }

        val text = GeminiKeys.withKeys(keysRaw) { key ->
            GeminiModels.call(fast) { m, think -> post(body(m, think), key, m) }
        }
        return parse(text, crop.width, crop.height)
    }

    /**
     * وەک run، بەڵام هەر بلۆکێک کە تەواو بوو یەکسەر onItem بانگ دەکات (بێ چاوەڕێی وەڵامی تەواو)،
     * بۆ ئەوەی خوێندنەوە زوو دەست پێبکات. لە thread ی پاشبنەما بانگ بکرێت.
     */
    fun runStream(crop: Bitmap, keysRaw: String, fast: Boolean, compact: Boolean = false, onItem: (RegionItem) -> Unit): Int {
        // compact (وەرگێڕانی خۆکار): وێنەی گەورەتر بۆ دەقی بچووکی عەرەبی + پرۆمپتی کورت
        val b64 = if (compact) encode(crop, MAX_PIXELS_COMPACT, 1280, 80) else encode(crop)
        val w = crop.width
        val h = crop.height
        var emitted = 0
        fun body(model: String, think: Boolean): String {
            val gen = JSONObject()
                .put("responseMimeType", "application/json")
                .put("responseSchema", schema(compact))
            if (think) gen.put("thinkingConfig", GeminiModels.thinking(model))
            return JSONObject()
                .put(
                    "contents",
                    JSONArray().put(
                        JSONObject().put(
                            "parts",
                            JSONArray()
                                .put(JSONObject().put("inlineData", JSONObject().put("mimeType", "image/jpeg").put("data", b64)))
                                .put(JSONObject().put("text", if (compact) PROMPT_COMPACT else PROMPT))
                        )
                    )
                )
                .put("generationConfig", gen)
                .toString()
        }
        GeminiKeys.withKeys(keysRaw) { key ->
            GeminiModels.call(fast) { m, think ->
                var seen = 0 // ئەگەر دووبارە هەوڵ درایەوە، ئەوانەی پێشتر نێردران پشتگوێ دەخرێن
                streamPost(body(m, think), key, m) { obj ->
                    seen++
                    if (seen > emitted) {
                        toItem(obj, w, h)?.let { onItem(it) }
                        emitted = seen
                    }
                }
                ""
            }
        }
        return emitted
    }

    private val stripPool = Executors.newCachedThreadPool { r -> Thread(r, "gemini-strip").apply { isDaemon = true } }

    /**
     * خێراکردنی وەرگێڕانی خۆکار: شاشەکە بە ٢-٣ پارچەی ئاسۆیی (بە ٦٪ بەسەریەکدا چوون) دابەش دەکرێت و هەموو پارچەکان
     * بە پارالێل بۆ Gemini دەنێردرێن. کاتی Gemini زۆربەی کاتەکەیە و بەپێی ژمارەی دەقی دەرچوو دەخایەنێت،
     * بۆیە ٣ پارچە ≈ ٣ هێندە خێراتر. هەر پارچەیەک تەنها ئەو بلۆکانە دەدات کە ناوەڕاستیان لە بەشی خۆیەتی (بێ دووبارەبوونەوە).
     * بلۆکەکان هەر کە ئامادە بوون onItem بانگ دەکرێت (لە چەند thread ـێکەوە، onItem دەبێت thread-safe بێت)،
     * و ئەم فەنکشنە تا تەواوبوونی هەموو پارچەکان دەوەستێت (کەواتە bitmap ـەکە تا ئەو کاتە recycle نەکرێت).
     */
    fun runStripsStream(src: Bitmap, keysRaw: String, fast: Boolean, onItem: (RegionItem) -> Unit): Int {
        val w = src.width
        val h = src.height
        val n = when {
            h >= w * 1.6f -> 3
            h >= w * 1.1f -> 2
            else -> 1
        }
        if (n == 1) return runStream(src, keysRaw, fast, compact = true, onItem = onItem)

        val ov = (h * 0.06f).toInt()
        val emitted = AtomicInteger(0)
        val failed = AtomicInteger(0)
        val lastErr = AtomicReference<Throwable?>(null)
        val latch = CountDownLatch(n)
        for (i in 0 until n) {
            val ownTop = h * i / n
            val ownBot = h * (i + 1) / n
            val top = (ownTop - ov).coerceAtLeast(0)
            val bot = (ownBot + ov).coerceAtMost(h)
            stripPool.execute {
                try {
                    val strip = Bitmap.createBitmap(src, 0, top, w, bot - top)
                    try {
                        runStream(strip, keysRaw, fast, compact = true) { item ->
                            val r = item.rect
                            if (r != null) {
                                val cy = top + (r.top + r.bottom) / 2
                                if (cy >= ownTop && cy < ownBot) {
                                    onItem(item.copy(rect = Rect(r.left, r.top + top, r.right, r.bottom + top)))
                                    emitted.incrementAndGet()
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    } finally {
                        if (strip !== src) strip.recycle()
                    }
                } catch (t: Throwable) {
                    lastErr.set(t)
                    failed.incrementAndGet()
                } finally {
                    latch.countDown()
                }
            }
        }
        latch.await()
        // هەموو پارچەکان شکستیان هێنا و هیچ دەقێک نەهات ← هەڵە بدەرەوە بۆ ئەوەی Tesseract وەک یەدەگ بەکاربێت
        if (failed.get() > 0 && emitted.get() == 0) throw (lastErr.get() ?: IOException("Gemini failed"))
        return emitted.get()
    }

    /** پەیوەندی (DNS + TLS) بۆ Gemini پێشوەختە دەکاتەوە و لە pool ی keep-alive ی دەهێڵێتەوە. لە thread ی پاشبنەما. */
    fun preconnect() {
        try {
            val c = URL("https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/").openConnection() as HttpURLConnection
            c.connectTimeout = 4_000
            c.readTimeout = 4_000
            c.requestMethod = "HEAD"
            c.responseCode
            try { c.inputStream.close() } catch (_: Exception) { c.errorStream?.close() }
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
        }
    }

    internal fun streamPost(body: String, key: String, model: String, onObj: (JSONObject) -> Unit) {
        val t0 = NetLog.now()
        val c = URL("https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/$model:streamGenerateContent?alt=sse")
            .openConnection() as HttpURLConnection
        var ok = false
        try {
            c.requestMethod = "POST"
            c.connectTimeout = 15_000
            c.readTimeout = 60_000
            c.doOutput = true
            c.setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
            c.setRequestProperty("x-goog-api-key", key)
            val bytes = body.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)
            c.setFixedLengthStreamingMode(bytes.size)
            c.outputStream.use { it.write(bytes) }
            val code = c.responseCode
            NetLog.ok("RegionTranslator", "streamGenerateContent", c.url.toString(), code, t0)
            if (code !in 200..299) {
                val resp = c.errorStream?.bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8)?.use { it.readText() }.orEmpty()
                val why = try { JSONObject(resp).getJSONObject("error").getString("message") } catch (_: Exception) { resp }
                throw ApiException(code, "Gemini $code ${why.take(140)}".trim())
            }
            // دەرهێنانی ئۆبجێکتەکانی ناو ئارەیەکە هەر کە تەواو بوون
            val sb = StringBuilder()
            var depth = 0
            var inStr = false
            var esc = false
            var start = -1
            var pos = 0
            var any = false
            c.inputStream.bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8).useLines { lines ->
                for (line in lines) {
                    if (!line.startsWith("data:")) continue
                    val chunk = try {
                        JSONObject(line.substring(5).trim()).getJSONArray("candidates").getJSONObject(0)
                            .getJSONObject("content").getJSONArray("parts").getJSONObject(0).optString("text", "")
                    } catch (_: Exception) { "" }
                    if (chunk.isEmpty()) continue
                    any = true
                    sb.append(chunk)
                    while (pos < sb.length) {
                        val ch = sb[pos]
                        if (inStr) {
                            if (esc) esc = false
                            else if (ch == '\\') esc = true
                            else if (ch == '"') inStr = false
                        } else when (ch) {
                            '"' -> inStr = true
                            '{' -> { if (depth == 0) start = pos; depth++ }
                            '}' -> {
                                depth--
                                if (depth == 0 && start >= 0) {
                                    try { onObj(JSONObject(sb.substring(start, pos + 1))) } catch (e: org.json.JSONException) { }
                                    start = -1
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        pos++
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!any) throw IOException("Gemini وەڵامی بەتاڵی دایەوە")
            ok = true
        } catch (e: Throwable) {
            NetLog.fail("RegionTranslator", "streamGenerateContent", c.url.toString(), t0, e)
            throw e
        } finally {
            // دوای خوێندنەوەی تەواو disconnect ناکەین تا پەیوەندییەکە بۆ داواکاری دواتر بمێنێتەوە (keep-alive)
            if (!ok) c.disconnect()
        }
    }

    private fun toItem(o: JSONObject, w: Int, h: Int): RegionItem? {
        val original = o.optString("original", "")
        val ku = RegionReadPolicy.visionText(original, TextPrep.fixSorani(o.optString("kurdish", "")))
        if (ku.length < 2) return null
        val lang = o.optString("lang", "").lowercase()
        val box = o.optJSONArray("box")
        val rect = if (box != null && box.length() == 4) {
            val y0 = box.optInt(0).coerceIn(0, 1000)
            val x0 = box.optInt(1).coerceIn(0, 1000)
            val y1 = box.optInt(2).coerceIn(0, 1000)
            val x1 = box.optInt(3).coerceIn(0, 1000)
            if (y1 - y0 < 5 || x1 - x0 < 5) null
            else Rect(x0 * w / 1000, y0 * h / 1000, x1 * w / 1000, y1 * h / 1000)
        } else null
        return RegionItem(rect, original, ku, lang == "ckb" || RegionReadPolicy.isSorani(original))
    }

    private fun post(body: String, key: String, model: String): String {
        val t0 = NetLog.now()
        val c = URL("https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/$model:generateContent")
            .openConnection() as HttpURLConnection
        try {
            c.requestMethod = "POST"
            c.connectTimeout = 15_000
            c.readTimeout = 60_000
            c.doOutput = true
            c.setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
            c.setRequestProperty("x-goog-api-key", key)
            c.outputStream.use { it.write(body.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)) }
            val code = c.responseCode
            NetLog.ok("RegionTranslator", "generateContent", c.url.toString(), code, t0)
            val resp = (if (code in 200..299) c.inputStream else c.errorStream)
                ?.bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8)?.use { it.readText() }.orEmpty()
            if (code !in 200..299) {
                val why = try {
                    JSONObject(resp).getJSONObject("error").getString("message")
                } catch (_: Exception) {
                    resp
                }
                throw ApiException(code, "Gemini $code ${why.take(140)}".trim())
            }
            return try {
                JSONObject(resp).getJSONArray("candidates").getJSONObject(0)
                    .getJSONObject("content").getJSONArray("parts").getJSONObject(0).getString("text")
            } catch (_: Exception) {
                throw IOException("Gemini وەڵامی بەتاڵی دایەوە")
            }
        } catch (e: Throwable) {
            NetLog.fail("RegionTranslator", "generateContent", c.url.toString(), t0, e)
            throw e
        } finally {
            c.disconnect()
        }
    }

    internal fun parse(text: String, w: Int, h: Int): List<RegionItem> {
        val arr = try {
            JSONArray(text.trim())
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            throw IOException("وەڵامی Gemini تێنەگەیشتم")
        }
        val out = ArrayList<RegionItem>()
        for (i in 0 until arr.length()) {
            val o = arr.optJSONObject(i) ?: continue
            toItem(o, w, h)?.let { out.add(it) }
        }
        return out
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import java.io.File
import java.io.FileOutputStream
import java.net.HttpURLConnection
import java.net.URL

/**
 * دابەزاندنی فایلێک بۆ [part] بە بەردەوامبوون (HTTP Range): ئەگەر ئینتەرنێت پچڕا، دووبارە لەو شوێنەوە دەست پێدەکات.
 * 404/410 بە جیا دەگەڕێتەوە تا بانگکەر سەرچاوەیەکی تر تاقی بکاتەوە. (هەمان لۆجیکی دەنگی کوردی.)
 */
internal object ResumableDownload {
    class Result(val error: String?, val notFound: Boolean = false)

    fun fileOf(u: String) = u.substringBefore('?').substringAfterLast('/')

    fun fetch(url: String, part: File, progress: (Int) -> Unit): Result {
        part.parentFile?.mkdirs()
        var have = part.length()
        var u = url
        var c: HttpURLConnection
        var hops = 0
        var code: Int
        while (true) {
            c = URL(u).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection
            c.connectTimeout = 15_000
            c.readTimeout = 60_000
            c.instanceFollowRedirects = false
            c.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "MangaTranslator/1.0")
            c.setRequestProperty("Accept-Encoding", "identity")
            if (have > 0) c.setRequestProperty("Range", "bytes=$have-")
            code = c.responseCode
            if (code in 300..399 && hops++ < 6) {
                val loc = c.getHeaderField("Location")
                c.disconnect()
                if (loc == null) return Result("HTTP $code بێ Location (${fileOf(url)})")
                u = URL(URL(u), loc).toString()
                continue
            }
            break
        }
        if (code == 416 && have > 0) {      // هەموو فایلەکە پێشتر دابەزێنرابوو
            c.disconnect()
            progress(100)
            return Result(null)
        }
        if (code != 200 && code != 206) {
            c.disconnect()
            if (code == 416) part.delete()
            return Result("HTTP $code (${fileOf(url)})", notFound = code == 404 || code == 410)
        }
        var total = c.contentLengthLong
        if (code == 206) {
            val m = Regex("bytes (\\d+)-(\\d+)/(\\d+)").matchEntire(c.getHeaderField("Content-Range").orEmpty())
            val start = m?.groupValues?.get(1)?.toLongOrNull()
            val all = m?.groupValues?.get(3)?.toLongOrNull()
            if (start != have || all == null) { c.disconnect(); part.delete(); return Result("Content-Range (${fileOf(url)})") }
            total = all
        } else {
            have = 0L   // سێرڤەر Range ی نەگرت: لە سەرەتاوە
        }
        var got = have
        var last = -1
        c.inputStream.use { ins ->
            FileOutputStream(part, code == 206 && have > 0).use { o ->
                val buf = ByteArray(64 * 1024)
                while (true) {
                    val n = ins.read(buf)
                    if (n < 0) break
                    o.write(buf, 0, n)
                    got += n
                    if (total > 0) {
                        val p = (got * 100 / total).toInt()
                        if (p != last) { last = p; progress(p) }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        c.disconnect()
        if (total > 0 && got != total) return Result("داگرتن پچڕا (${got / 1024 / 1024} / ${total / 1024 / 1024} MB)")
        return Result(null)
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.graphics.Canvas
import android.graphics.PixelFormat
import android.hardware.display.DisplayManager
import android.hardware.display.VirtualDisplay
import android.media.ImageReader
import android.media.projection.MediaProjection
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.HandlerThread
import android.util.DisplayMetrics
import android.util.Log
import android.view.WindowManager

/**
 * گرتنی شاشە بە MediaProjection + ImageReader.
 *
 * VirtualDisplay تەنها یەکجار دروست دەکرێت و تا کۆتایی دەمێنێت (Android 14 ڕێگە نادات دووبارە دروست بکرێت).
 * هەر چەند ms جارێک (خێرا کاتێک frameListener هەیە، هێواش کاتێک نییە) دوایین فرەیم دەدات بە `frameListener`؛
 * ئەگەر شاشە نەگۆڕابێت هەمان فرەیم دووبارە دەدرێت، بۆیە ناوەستێت.
 * ئەو کەسەی فرەیمەکە وەردەگرێت خۆی دەبێت recycle ی بکات (کۆپییەکە دەدرێت).
 */
class ScreenCapturer(
    context: Context,
    private val projection: MediaProjection,
    private val onFirstFrame: () -> Unit,
    private val onProjectionStopped: () -> Unit
) : FrameSource {
    private val appContext = context.applicationContext
    private val load = CaptureLoad(appContext)
    @Volatile private var liveRefresh = false
    override fun setLiveRefresh(enabled: Boolean) { liveRefresh = enabled }
    private val thread = HandlerThread("screen-capture").apply { start() }
    private val handler = Handler(thread.looper)

    private var reader: ImageReader? = null
    private var display: VirtualDisplay? = null
    private var last: Bitmap? = null
    /** بۆ ڕیزی پڕکراوی ImageReader؛ یەکجار دروست دەکرێت و دووبارە بەکاردێتەوە (نەک هەر فرەیمێک) */
    private var padded: Bitmap? = null
    private var lastNewFrameAt = 0L
    @Volatile private var kickUntil = 0L
    private var lastRepeatAt = 0L
    private var firstFrameNotified = false
    @Volatile private var released = false

    /** لە thread ی گرتنەوە بانگ دەکرێت. */
    @Volatile
    override var frameListener: ((Bitmap) -> Unit)? = null

    /**
     * بێ کۆپی (زۆر خێراتر): `last` خۆی دەدرێت (نەک کۆپییەکی ٦MB)، و boolean = ئایا فرەیمی نوێیە.
     * وەرگر نابێت recycle ی بکات یان بیهێڵێتەوە، و دەبێت زوو تەواو بێت؛ هەمان thread ی گرتنەوەیە.
     */
    @Volatile
    var rawFrameListener: ((Bitmap, Boolean) -> Unit)? = null

    val isRunning: Boolean get() = display != null

    private val projectionCallback = object : MediaProjection.Callback() {
        override fun onStop() {
            Log.d(TAG, "MediaProjection stopped by system/user")
            stop()
            onProjectionStopped()
        }
    }

    private var curW = 0
    private var curH = 0
    private var sizeCheckAt = 0L

    /**
     * ئەگەر شاشە سوڕایەوە (یوتوب فوڵسکرین ← لاندسکەیپ)، VirtualDisplay ی جێگیر دەمێنێتەوە بە قەبارەی کۆن و ناوەڕۆکی
     * لاندسکەیپ بچووک و لەگەڵ بارە ڕەشەکان لەناو فرەیمی پۆرترەیت دەردەکەوێت (OCR هیچ نابینێت). ئێستا resize() +
     * ImageReader ی نوێ: هەمان VirtualDisplay دەمێنێتەوە (Android 14 ڕێگە نادات دووبارە دروست بکرێت، بەڵام resize ڕێگەپێدراوە).
     */
    private fun checkSize() {
        val now = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
        if (now - sizeCheckAt < 400L) return
        sizeCheckAt = now
        val d = display ?: return
        val wm = appContext.getSystemService(Context.WINDOW_SERVICE) as WindowManager
        val m = DisplayMetrics()
        @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
        wm.defaultDisplay.getRealMetrics(m)
        val scale = if (DeviceProfile.low) SCALE_LOW else SCALE
        val w = (m.widthPixels * scale).toInt().coerceAtLeast(2)
        val h = (m.heightPixels * scale).toInt().coerceAtLeast(2)
        if (w == curW && h == curH) return
        try {
            val nr = ImageReader.newInstance(w, h, PixelFormat.RGBA_8888, 2)
            d.resize(w, h, m.densityDpi)
            d.surface = nr.surface
            val old = reader
            reader = nr
            curW = w
            curH = h
            try { old?.close() } catch (_: Exception) { }
            Log.d(TAG, "Capture resized ${w}x$h")
        } catch (e: Throwable) {
            Log.w(TAG, "resize failed: ${e.message}")
        }
    }

    @Volatile private var capturePaused = false

    private val tick = object : Runnable {
        override fun run() {
            if (released || capturePaused || reader == null) return
            checkSize()
            val raw = rawFrameListener
            // Drain the queue without copying full-screen pixels when nobody
            // needs frames, or while the display is off. Keep VirtualDisplay
            // alive because Android 14 does not allow recreating this session.
            if (!load.interactive || (raw == null && frameListener == null && firstFrameNotified)) {
                try { reader?.acquireLatestImage()?.close() } catch (_: Exception) { }
                handler.postDelayed(this, IDLE_INTERVAL_MS)
                return
            }
            if (raw != null) {
                val before = lastNewFrameAt
                val rb = grab()
                if (rb != null) raw(rb, lastNewFrameAt != before)
                handler.postDelayed(this, activeInterval())
                return
            }
            val listener = frameListener
            val prevAt = lastNewFrameAt
            val b = grab()
            if (b != null && listener != null) {
                val now = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
                val isNew = lastNewFrameAt != prevAt
                // فرەیمی نوێ هات، یان تازە گۆڕانکاری بوو (وەک forceRescan) ← دەستبەجێ بنێرە.
                // دەنا شاشە نەگۆڕاوە و کۆپیکردنی ٦MB هەر ١٥٠ms بێ سوودە؛ لە ڕامی کەمدا تەنها هەر ١ چرکە جارێک.
                val fresh = now - lastNewFrameAt < 1200L || now < kickUntil
                val slowOk = now - lastRepeatAt >= (if (DeviceProfile.low) 900L else 0L)
                if (isNew || fresh || slowOk) {
                    lastRepeatAt = now
                    listener(b.copy(Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888, false))
                }
            }
            handler.postDelayed(this, if (listener != null) activeInterval() else IDLE_INTERVAL_MS)
        }
    }

    private fun activeInterval() = if (liveRefresh) LiveRefresh.captureMs(DeviceProfile.low)
                                 else if (DeviceProfile.low) ACTIVE_INTERVAL_LOW_MS else ACTIVE_INTERVAL_MS

    /** لەسەر هەر thread بانگ بکرێت: بۆ ٣ چرکەی داهاتوو فرەیمی دووبارە بدە (بۆ forceRescan) */
    override fun kick() {
        kickUntil = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + 3000L
    }

    override fun setCapturePaused(paused: Boolean) {
        capturePaused = paused
        if (paused) handler.post {
            handler.removeCallbacks(tick)
            try { display?.surface = null } catch (e: Exception) { Log.w(TAG, "pause capture", e) }
        } else requestFreshFrame {}
    }

    override fun requestFreshFrame(onReady: () -> Unit) {
        capturePaused = false
        kick()
        handler.post {
            val d = display
            if (released || capturePaused || d == null || reader == null || curW <= 0 || curH <= 0) return@post
            // Idle drains may have discarded the current static screen. A new
            // surface requests a fresh render while retaining the same display
            // and MediaProjection consent (also on Android 14).
            last?.recycle()
            last = null
            var replacement: ImageReader? = null
            try {
                val fresh = ImageReader.newInstance(curW, curH, PixelFormat.RGBA_8888, 2)
                replacement = fresh
                d.surface = fresh.surface
                val old = reader
                reader = fresh
                replacement = null
                old?.close()
                lastNewFrameAt = 0L
            } catch (error: Exception) {
                replacement?.close()
                Log.w(TAG, "fresh live frame failed", error)
            }
            onReady()
            handler.removeCallbacks(tick)
            handler.post(tick)
        }
    }

    init {
        // Android 14 داوا دەکات callback پێش دروستکردنی VirtualDisplay تۆمار بکرێت
        projection.registerCallback(projectionCallback, handler)
    }

    override fun start() {
        if (isRunning) return

        val wm = appContext.getSystemService(Context.WINDOW_SERVICE) as WindowManager
        val metrics = DisplayMetrics()
        @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
        wm.defaultDisplay.getRealMetrics(metrics)

        val scale = if (DeviceProfile.low) SCALE_LOW else SCALE
        val width = (metrics.widthPixels * scale).toInt().coerceAtLeast(2)
        val height = (metrics.heightPixels * scale).toInt().coerceAtLeast(2)

        firstFrameNotified = false
        curW = width
        curH = height
        reader = ImageReader.newInstance(width, height, PixelFormat.RGBA_8888, 2)
        display = projection.createVirtualDisplay(
            "manga-translator-capture",
            width, height, metrics.densityDpi,
            DisplayManager.VIRTUAL_DISPLAY_FLAG_AUTO_MIRROR,
            reader!!.surface, null, handler
        )
        handler.post(tick)
        Log.d(TAG, "Capture started ${width}x$height")
    }

    private fun stop() {
        handler.removeCallbacks(tick)
        display?.release()
        display = null
        reader?.close()
        reader = null
    }

    /** دوای `delayMs` دوایین فرەیم (کۆپی) دەدات بە `cb` (لە thread ی گرتنەوە؛ cb دەبێت recycle ی بکات). */
    override fun requestFrame(delayMs: Long, cb: (Bitmap?) -> Unit) {
        handler.postDelayed({
            val b = if (reader != null) grab() else null
            cb(b?.copy(Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888, false))
        }, delayMs)
    }

    /** لە کاتی داخستنی خزمەتگوزاری بانگ بکرێت. */
    override fun release() {
        released = true
        frameListener = null
        rawFrameListener = null
        handler.post {
            stop()
            last?.recycle()
            last = null
            padded?.recycle()
            padded = null
        }
        try {
            projection.unregisterCallback(projectionCallback)
            projection.stop()
        } catch (_: Exception) {
        }
        thread.quitSafely()
    }

    /**
     * تەنها لە thread ی گرتنەوە. فرەیمی نوێ دەخوێنێتەوە؛ ئەگەر نەبوو دوایین فرەیم دەگەڕێنێتەوە.
     * هەمان bitmap (`last`) دووبارە بەکاردێتەوە ئەگەر قەبارە نەگۆڕابێت، بۆ ئەوەی هەر فرەیمێک ١٠-١٢MB زیاتر نەبێتە زبڵ.
     */
    private fun grab(): Bitmap? {
        val r = reader ?: return last
        val image = try {
            r.acquireLatestImage()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            null
        } ?: return last

        try {
            val plane = image.planes[0]
            val pixelStride = plane.pixelStride
            val rowPadding = plane.rowStride - pixelStride * image.width
            val w = image.width
            val h = image.height

            var out = last
            if (out == null || out.isRecycled || out.width != w || out.height != h) {
                out?.recycle()
                out = Bitmap.createBitmap(w, h, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
            }
            val o: Bitmap = out
            if (rowPadding == 0) {
                o.copyPixelsFromBuffer(plane.buffer)
            } else {
                val pw = w + rowPadding / pixelStride
                var pad = padded
                if (pad == null || pad.isRecycled || pad.width != pw || pad.height != h) {
                    pad?.recycle()
                    pad = Bitmap.createBitmap(pw, h, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
                    padded = pad
                }
                pad!!.copyPixelsFromBuffer(plane.buffer)
                Canvas(o).drawBitmap(pad, 0f, 0f, null)
            }
            last = o
            lastNewFrameAt = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()

            if (!firstFrameNotified) {
                firstFrameNotified = true
                onFirstFrame()
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "frame error", e)
        } finally {
            image.close()
        }
        return last
    }

    companion object {
        private const val TAG = "ScreenCapturer"
        private const val SCALE = 0.75f              // ڕێزولیوشنی گرتن
        private const val SCALE_LOW = 0.55f          // ڕامی کەم: ٪٤٦ پیکسێلی کەمتر
        private const val ACTIVE_INTERVAL_LOW_MS = 220L
        private const val ACTIVE_INTERVAL_MS = 150L  // کاتێک وەرگێڕانی خۆکار چالاکە
        private const val IDLE_INTERVAL_MS = 700L    // دەنا
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Rect
import android.os.SystemClock
import android.util.DisplayMetrics
import android.view.WindowManager
import android.view.accessibility.AccessibilityNodeInfo
import android.view.accessibility.AccessibilityWindowInfo

/**
 * خوێندنەوەی دەقی شاشە ڕاستەوخۆ لە دره‌ختی Accessibility (وەک Google Translate): بێ OCR، خێرا،
 * و بۆ هەموو زمانێک (سیریلی، تایلەندی، عیبری، هیندی…) کار دەکات، تەنانەت ئەگەر چەند زمانێک لەسەر شاشە بێت.
 * ئەگەر ئەپەکە دەقی ڕاستەقینە نەدات (مانگا وەک وێنە، یاری) هیچ ناگەڕێنێتەوە و OcrEngine OCR بەکاردێنێت.
 */
object ScreenText {
    private const val MAX_NODES = 4000
    private const val MAX_DEPTH = 60

    /** کەمترین ژمارەی بلۆکی دەق (و پیت) بۆ ئەوەی ئیمزای دەقی متمانەپێکراو بێت. */
    private const val SIG_MIN_BOXES = 3
    private const val SIG_MIN_LETTERS = 30

    /** ئیمزای دەقی بلۆکەکان (بێ شوێن). ٠ = دەقی پێویست نییە بۆ متمانەکردن (وێنە/مانگا). فەنکشنی پاک و تاقیکراو. */
    fun signatureOf(texts: List<String>): Int {
        if (texts.size < SIG_MIN_BOXES) return 0
        if (texts.sumOf { t -> t.count { it.isLetter() } } < SIG_MIN_LETTERS) return 0
        var h = 17
        for (t in texts) h = h * 31 + t.hashCode()
        return if (h == 0) 1 else h
    }

    /**
     * ئیمزای دەقی ئێستای شاشە لە Accessibility. ئەگەر ئەپەکە دەقی ڕاستەقینە نەدات (مانگا وەک وێنە، یاری)
     * یان کەمتر لە ٣ بلۆکی دەق هەبێت، ٠ دەگەڕێتەوە و بانگکەر تەنها پشت بە پیکسێل دەبەستێت.
     */
    private val sigLock = Any()
    @Volatile private var sigAt = 0L
    @Volatile private var sigVal = 0
    @Volatile private var sigPausedUntil = 0L
    private const val SIG_MIN_GAP_MS = 250L    // لەناو ئەم ماوەیە هەمان ئەنجام دەدرێتەوە (باری IPC کەم)
    private const val SIG_SLOW_MS = 300L       // ئەگەر خاوتر بوو...
    private const val SIG_PAUSE_MS = 8_000L    // ... ٨ چرکە ڕادەگیرێت و تەنها پیکسێل بەکاردێت

    fun signature(ctx: Context): Int {
        if (MangaAccessibilityService.instance == null) return 0
        if (SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() < sigPausedUntil) return 0
        synchronized(sigLock) {
            val t0 = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
            if (t0 - sigAt < SIG_MIN_GAP_MS) return sigVal
            val v = try {
                signatureOf(collect(ctx, 1000, 1000, lite = true).map { it.text })
            } catch (_: Throwable) {
                0
            }
            val t1 = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
            sigAt = t1
            sigVal = v
            if (t1 - t0 > SIG_SLOW_MS) sigPausedUntil = t1 + SIG_PAUSE_MS
            return v
        }
    }

    /** بۆکسەکان بە پیکسێلی وێنەی گیراو (frameW × frameH) دەگەڕێنرێنەوە. */
    fun collect(ctx: Context, frameW: Int, frameH: Int, lite: Boolean = false, region: Rect? = null): List<TextBox> {
        val svc = MangaAccessibilityService.instance ?: return emptyList()
        val dm = DisplayMetrics()
        @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
        (ctx.getSystemService(Context.WINDOW_SERVICE) as WindowManager).defaultDisplay.getRealMetrics(dm)
        if (dm.widthPixels <= 0 || dm.heightPixels <= 0) return emptyList()
        val sx = frameW.toFloat() / dm.widthPixels
        val sy = frameH.toFloat() / dm.heightPixels

        val roots = ArrayList<AccessibilityNodeInfo>()
        try {
            for (w in svc.windows.orEmpty()) {
                // lite (ئیمزای دەق): پەنجەرەی ئۆڤەرلەی خۆمان نەپرسرێت؛ ڕۆتەکەی داواکاری دەگەڕێنێتەوە بۆ main thread ی خۆمان
                if (lite && w.type == AccessibilityWindowInfo.TYPE_ACCESSIBILITY_OVERLAY) continue
                w.root?.let { roots.add(it) }
            }
        } catch (_: Throwable) {}
        if (roots.isEmpty()) svc.rootInActiveWindow?.let { roots.add(it) }

        val out = ArrayList<TextBox>()
        val maxNodes = if (lite) 1500 else MAX_NODES
        var count = 0
        val tmp = Rect()
        /** دەگەڕێنێتەوە ژمارەی دەقی دۆزراوە لەم لقە (بۆ ئەوەی دایک contentDescription ـی خۆی نەخاتە سەر منداڵەکان) */
        fun walk(n: AccessibilityNodeInfo, depth: Int): Int {
            if (count++ > maxNodes || depth > MAX_DEPTH) return 0
            if (!n.isVisibleToUser) return 0
            // Explicit region reading does not need unrelated branches of the
            // accessibility tree. Keep ordinary full-screen callers unchanged.
            if (region != null) {
                n.getBoundsInScreen(tmp)
                if (!tmp.isEmpty && ((tmp.right * sx).toInt() <= region.left || (tmp.left * sx).toInt() >= region.right ||
                    (tmp.bottom * sy).toInt() <= region.top || (tmp.top * sy).toInt() >= region.bottom)) return 0
            }
            var found = 0
            for (i in 0 until n.childCount) {
                val c = try { n.getChild(i) } catch (_: Throwable) { null } ?: continue
                found += walk(c, depth + 1)
            }
            val own = n.text?.toString()?.trim().orEmpty()
            // فەیسبووک و ئەپە Litho/React ـەکان دەقی پۆست لە contentDescription دەنووسن نەک text:
            // تەنها ئەو کاتە بەکاردێت کە لقەکە هیچ دەقی تری نییە و کلیک/وێنەی گەورە نییە
            val desc = if (own.isEmpty() && found == 0) n.contentDescription?.toString()?.trim().orEmpty() else ""
            val txt = if (own.isNotEmpty()) own else desc
            // ڕووکاری ئەپ (کات، بەروار، Like/Comment/Share، دۆخی چات…) هەرگیز نەخوێندرێتەوە و وەرنەگێڕدرێت
            val noise = txt.isNotEmpty() &&
                (UiNoise.isNoise(txt, ui = true) || UiNoise.isNoiseId(n.viewIdResourceName, txt.length))
            if (txt.isNotEmpty() && !n.isPassword && !noise) {
                n.getBoundsInScreen(tmp)
                val r = Rect(
                    (tmp.left * sx).toInt().coerceIn(0, frameW), (tmp.top * sy).toInt().coerceIn(0, frameH),
                    (tmp.right * sx).toInt().coerceIn(0, frameW), (tmp.bottom * sy).toInt().coerceIn(0, frameH)
                )
                val explicitlySelected = if (region != null && RegionReadPolicy.isSorani(txt)) {
                    val intersection = Rect()
                    intersection.setIntersect(r, region) && intersection.width().toLong() * intersection.height() * 10 >=
                        r.width().toLong() * r.height() * 8
                } else false
                val tooBig = own.isEmpty() && !explicitlySelected && r.width().toLong() * r.height() > frameW.toLong() * frameH * 0.45
                val letters = txt.count { it.isLetter() }
                if (r.width() > 2 && r.height() > 2 && !tooBig && letters >= 2 &&
                    out.none { TextFilter.overlapsMostly(it.rect, r) && it.text == txt.take(1500) }) {
                    out.add(TextBox(r, txt.take(1500)))
                    found++
                }
            }
            return found
        }
        for (r in roots) {
            if (r.packageName?.toString() == ctx.packageName) continue   // ئۆڤەرلەی خۆمان نەخوێنرێتەوە
            walk(r, 0)
        }
        return out
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.os.SystemClock

/**
 * کاتێک وەرگێڕانی دەستی/ڕووبەر لەسەر شاشەیە، ئەگەر بەکارهێنەر شاشەکەی جووڵاند (scroll، پەڕەی نوێ...)
 * `onScrolled` بانگ دەکات تا وەرگێڕانەکە بسڕدرێتەوە (وەک وەرگێڕانی خۆکار).
 * `notifyOverlayUpdated()` هەر کاتێک ئۆڤەرلەی خۆمان گۆڕا بانگ بکە. onFrame لە thread ی گرتنەوەیە و bmp recycle دەکات.
 */
class ScrollWatcher(
    private val onScrolled: () -> Unit,
    /** ئیمزای دەقی Accessibility (٠ = نەبوو). ئەگەر دەق هەمان بوو، گۆڕانی پیکسێل (ڤیدیۆ، ئەنیمەیشن) بە scroll نازانرێت. */
    private val textSig: () -> Int = { 0 }
) {
    @Volatile private var baseText = 0
    private fun textNow(): Int = try { textSig() } catch (_: Throwable) { 0 }
    @Volatile private var baseline: IntArray? = null
    @Volatile private var changedAt = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
    @Volatile private var needRebaseline = true
    @Volatile private var fired = false
    /** تا وەرگێڕانەکە تەواو نەبووە و لەسەر شاشە نەمابێت، چاودێری ناکرێت (بۆ ئەوەی کاتی وەرگێڕان بە هەڵە نەسڕدرێتەوە) */
    @Volatile private var armed = false
    private var hits = 0

    fun arm() {
        armed = true
        changedAt = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
        needRebaseline = true
        hits = 0
    }

    fun notifyOverlayUpdated() {
        changedAt = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
        needRebaseline = true
    }

    fun onFrame(bmp: Bitmap) {
        if (fired || !armed || SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - changedAt < SETTLE_MS) {
            bmp.recycle()
            return
        }
        val sig = try { ChangeDetector.signature(bmp) } finally { bmp.recycle() }
        val base = baseline
        if (needRebaseline || base == null) {
            baseline = sig
            baseText = textNow()
            needRebaseline = false
            return
        }
        // دەبێت چەند فرەیمێکی یەک لە دوای یەک بگۆڕێت، بۆ ئەوەی گۆڕانی کورتی (ئەنیمەیشن، لۆدینگ) نەبێتە هۆی سڕینەوە
        if (ChangeDetector.distance(sig, base) > THRESHOLD) {
            if (++hits >= HITS_NEEDED) {
                val th = if (baseText != 0) textNow() else 0
                if (th != 0 && th == baseText) {
                    // دەق نەگۆڕاوە: ڤیدیۆ/ئەنیمەیشنە نەک scroll ← وەرگێڕانەکە مەسڕەوە
                    baseline = sig
                    hits = 0
                } else {
                    fired = true
                    onScrolled()
                }
            }
        } else hits = 0
    }

    companion object {
        private const val SETTLE_MS = 450L
        private const val THRESHOLD = 10f
        private const val HITS_NEEDED = 3
    }
}
