package com.mangatranslator.app

import kotlin.math.abs

/** یەک بلۆکی دەق لەناو وێنەی ڕووبەر (پیکسێلی crop). */
data class Blk(val text: String, val l: Int, val t: Int, val r: Int, val b: Int)

/**
 * واتەرمارک و نووسینی جێگیری یاری/ڤیدیۆ (ناوی کەناڵ «MKIceAndFire»، «X=SELECT»...) لە ژێرنووسی زیندوو لادەبات.
 *  ١) یەکسەر: ناوی تاکی وشەیی بە پیتی تێکەڵ (camelCase) یان @user / #tag ← واتەرمارکە.
 *  ٢) فێربوون: بلۆکێک کە لە هەمان شوێن و بە دەقێکی هاوشێوە زیاتر لە [staticMs] (٦ چرکە) بەردەوام بێت ← جێگیرە (ژێرنووس نییە)،
 *     و تا [keepMs] دوای ون بوونیشی هەر لادەبرێت. جیاوازیی OCR (MKIceAndFire / MKceAndFire / Mklceand) هەر وەک هەمان بلۆک دەژمێردرێت.
 * لە یەک thread ی تەنها بەکاربهێنرێت.
 */
class WatermarkFilter(
    private val staticMs: Long = 12_000L,
    private val gapMs: Long = 4_000L,
    private val keepMs: Long = 8_000L
) {
    private class Track(var b: Blk, var first: Long, var last: Long) {
        var isStatic = false
    }

    private val tracks = ArrayList<Track>()

    fun reset() = tracks.clear()

    fun filter(blocks: List<Blk>, now: Long, cw: Int, ch: Int): List<Blk> {
        tracks.removeAll { now - it.last > (if (it.isStatic) keepMs else gapMs) }
        val out = ArrayList<Blk>(blocks.size)
        val used = HashSet<Track>()
        for (b in blocks) {
            if (looksLikeHandle(b.text)) continue
            val tr = tracks.firstOrNull { it !in used && near(it.b, b, cw, ch) && (if (it.isStatic) similarStatic(it.b.text, b.text) else similar(it.b.text, b.text)) }
            if (tr == null) {
                val t = Track(b, now, now)
                tracks.add(t); used.add(t)
                out.add(b)
                continue
            }
            used.add(tr)
            // بەردەوامی: ئەگەر بلۆکەکە ماوەیەک نەبینرا (ژێرنووسێکی دووبارەبووەوە)، ژمێرەکە لە سەرەتاوە دەست پێدەکات
            if (!tr.isStatic && now - tr.last > CONT_MS) tr.first = now
            tr.b = b
            tr.last = now
            if (!tr.isStatic && now - tr.first >= staticMs) tr.isStatic = true
            if (!tr.isStatic) out.add(b)
        }
        return out
    }

    companion object {
        private const val CONT_MS = 1_500L
        private val HANDLE = Regex("^[@#][\\w.]{3,}$|^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]*[a-z][A-Z][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*$")

        /** ناوی کەناڵ/بەکارهێنەر: یەک وشە، بێ بۆشایی، پیتی بچووک و گەورە تێکەڵ */
        fun looksLikeHandle(raw: String): Boolean {
            val s = raw.trim()
            return s.length >= 6 && !s.contains(' ') && HANDLE.matches(s)
        }

        private fun norm(s: String) = s.lowercase().filter { it.isLetterOrDigit() }

        fun similar(a: String, b: String): Boolean {
            val x = norm(a); val y = norm(b)
            if (x.isEmpty() || y.isEmpty()) return false
            if (x == y || x.contains(y) || y.contains(x)) return true
            val m = maxOf(x.length, y.length)
            if (abs(x.length - y.length) > m / 2) return false
            return lev(x, y) <= (m * 0.45f).toInt()
        }

        /** بۆ بلۆکی جێگیر (واتەرمارک): تەنگتر، بۆ ئەوەی ژێرنووسی نوێی هاوشێوە بە هەڵە لانەبرێت */
        fun similarStatic(a: String, b: String): Boolean {
            val x = norm(a); val y = norm(b)
            if (x.isEmpty() || y.isEmpty()) return false
            if (x == y) return true
            val m = maxOf(x.length, y.length)
            if (abs(x.length - y.length) > m / 4) return false
            return lev(x, y) <= (m * 0.3f).toInt()
        }

        private fun lev(a: String, b: String): Int {
            var prev = IntArray(b.length + 1) { it }
            var cur = IntArray(b.length + 1)
            for (i in 1..a.length) {
                cur[0] = i
                for (j in 1..b.length) {
                    val c = if (a[i - 1] == b[j - 1]) 0 else 1
                    cur[j] = minOf(prev[j] + 1, cur[j - 1] + 1, prev[j - 1] + c)
                }
                val t = prev; prev = cur; cur = t
            }
            return prev[b.length]
        }

        fun near(a: Blk, b: Blk, cw: Int, ch: Int): Boolean {
            val dx = abs((a.l + a.r) / 2 - (b.l + b.r) / 2)
            val dy = abs((a.t + a.b) / 2 - (b.t + b.b) / 2)
            return dx <= maxOf(cw / 10, 24) && dy <= maxOf(ch / 5, 14)
        }
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.rules.TemporaryFolder
import java.io.File

class ActivityLogCoreTest {
    @get:Rule val tmp = TemporaryFolder()

    private fun ev(
        n: Int, cat: LogCategory = LogCategory.APPLICATION, sev: LogSeverity = LogSeverity.INFO,
        title: String = "Event $n", time: Long = 1_000L + n, meta: Map<String, String> = emptyMap(),
        description: String = "", error: String = "", stack: String = ""
    ) = LogEvent("id$n", time, cat, sev, title, description, "Comp", "op", "OK", error, stack, "op-$n", "1.0 (1)", "Android 14", meta)

    // ---- codec ----
    @Test fun codecRoundTripKeepsNewlinesBackslashesAndMetadata() {
        val e = ev(1, description = "line1\nline2 \\ end", error = "E: x", stack = "at a.B(C.kt:1)\nat d.E(F.kt:2)",
            meta = mapOf("url" to "https://x.y/z", "durationMs" to "42"))
        val back = EventCodec.decode(EventCodec.encode(e))
        assertEquals(e, back)
    }

    @Test fun codecRejectsCorruptLines() {
        assertNull(EventCodec.decode("garbage"))
        assertNull(EventCodec.decode("a\u001Fb\u001Fc"))
    }

    // ---- persistence ----
    @Test fun eventsSurviveRestart() {
        val f = File(tmp.root, "log/events.log")
        val s1 = EventStore(f)
        assertTrue(s1.append(ev(1)))
        assertTrue(s1.append(ev(2)))
        val loaded = EventStore(f).load()            // نموونەیەکی نوێ = دووبارە دەستپێکردنی ئەپەکە
        assertEquals(listOf("id1", "id2"), loaded.map { it.id })
    }

    @Test fun corruptLinesAreSkippedNotFatal() {
        val f = File(tmp.root, "events.log")
        val s = EventStore(f)
        s.append(ev(1))
        f.appendText("this is not an event\n")
        s.append(ev(2))
        assertEquals(listOf("id1", "id2"), EventStore(f).load().map { it.id })
    }

    // ---- deletion removes from storage, not only from the list ----
    @Test fun rewriteRemovesDeletedEventsFromTheFile() {
        val f = File(tmp.root, "events.log")
        val s = EventStore(f)
        val all = (1..5).map { ev(it) }
        all.forEach { s.append(it) }
        assertTrue(s.rewrite(all.filter { it.id != "id2" && it.id != "id4" }))
        val text = f.readText()
        assertFalse(text.contains("id2")); assertFalse(text.contains("id4"))
        assertEquals(listOf("id1", "id3", "id5"), EventStore(f).load().map { it.id })
    }

    @Test fun clearingEverythingLeavesAnEmptyStore() {
        val f = File(tmp.root, "events.log")
        val s = EventStore(f)
        s.append(ev(1))
        assertTrue(s.rewrite(emptyList()))
        assertTrue(EventStore(f).load().isEmpty())
    }

    // ---- retention ----
    @Test fun oldestEventsAreDroppedWhenTheLimitIsReached() {
        val s = EventStore(File(tmp.root, "events.log"), maxEvents = 100, maxBytes = 10_000_000)
        val list = (1..101).map { ev(it) }
        val t = s.trimmed(list, list.sumOf { s.sizeOf(it) })
        assertNotNull(t)
        assertTrue(t!!.size <= 90)
        assertEquals("id101", t.last().id)         // نوێترین دەمێنێت
        assertFalse(t.any { it.id == "id1" })      // کۆنترین دەسڕێتەوە
    }

    @Test fun byteLimitAlsoTrims() {
        val s = EventStore(File(tmp.root, "events.log"), maxEvents = 100_000, maxBytes = 2_000)
        val list = (1..50).map { ev(it, description = "x".repeat(100)) }
        val t = s.trimmed(list, list.sumOf { s.sizeOf(it) })
        assertNotNull(t)
        assertTrue(t!!.sumOf { s.sizeOf(it) } <= 2_000)
    }

    @Test fun nothingIsTrimmedUnderTheLimits() {
        val s = EventStore(File(tmp.root, "events.log"))
        val list = (1..10).map { ev(it) }
        assertNull(s.trimmed(list, list.sumOf { s.sizeOf(it) }))
    }

    // ---- privacy ----
    @Test fun apiKeysAndTokensAreRedacted() {
        val t = LogSanitizer.clean("failed key=AIzaSyA12345678901234567890123456789012 and Authorization: Bearer abcdef1234567890xyz")
        assertFalse(t.contains("AIza")); assertFalse(t.contains("abcdef1234567890xyz"))
        assertTrue(t.contains("[REDACTED"))
    }

    @Test fun cookiesPasswordsEmailsAndKeystoresAreRedacted() {
        val t = LogSanitizer.clean("Cookie: sid=abc123; other=zzz\npassword=hunter2 mail me@example.com file /sdcard/release.jks")
        assertFalse(t.contains("abc123")); assertFalse(t.contains("hunter2"))
        assertFalse(t.contains("me@example.com")); assertFalse(t.contains("release.jks"))
    }

    @Test fun urlsLoseQueryAndUserinfo() {
        assertEquals("https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini:generateContent?[query removed]",
            LogSanitizer.url("https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini:generateContent?alt=sse&key=SECRET"))
        assertEquals("https://translate.googleapis.com/translate_a/single?[query removed]",
            LogSanitizer.url("https://user:pw@translate.googleapis.com/translate_a/single?client=gtx&q=my%20private%20text"))
        assertFalse(LogSanitizer.clean("GET https://a.b/c?token=XYZ&q=secret%20words ok").contains("secret"))
    }

    @Test fun longValuesAreTruncated() {
        val t = LogSanitizer.clean("a ".repeat(5000), 100)
        assertTrue(t.length <= 120 && t.endsWith("[truncated]"))
    }

    // ---- filters & search ----
    @Test fun categorySeveritySearchFilters() {
        val net = ev(1, LogCategory.NETWORK, LogSeverity.ERROR, "Connection failed", error = "UnknownHostException")
        val app = ev(2, LogCategory.APPLICATION, LogSeverity.INFO, "Application started")
        val crash = ev(3, LogCategory.CRASH, LogSeverity.CRITICAL, "Unhandled exception")
        val warn = ev(4, LogCategory.BACKGROUND, LogSeverity.WARNING, "Download failed")
        assertTrue(LogFilter.matches(net, CategoryFilter.NETWORK, null, ""))
        assertFalse(LogFilter.matches(app, CategoryFilter.NETWORK, null, ""))
        assertTrue(LogFilter.matches(net, CategoryFilter.ERRORS, null, ""))
        assertTrue(LogFilter.matches(crash, CategoryFilter.CRASHES, null, ""))
        assertTrue(LogFilter.matches(crash, CategoryFilter.ERRORS, null, ""))
        assertTrue(LogFilter.matches(warn, CategoryFilter.WARNINGS, null, ""))
        assertTrue(LogFilter.matches(net, CategoryFilter.ALL, LogSeverity.ERROR, ""))
        assertFalse(LogFilter.matches(app, CategoryFilter.ALL, LogSeverity.ERROR, ""))
        assertTrue(LogFilter.matches(net, CategoryFilter.ALL, null, "unknownhost"))
        assertTrue(LogFilter.matches(net, CategoryFilter.ALL, null, "connection FAILED"))
        assertFalse(LogFilter.matches(net, CategoryFilter.ALL, null, "nothing like this"))
    }

    // ---- report format ----
    @Test fun reportIsChronologicalAndOnlyContainsRealFields() {
        val a = ev(1, time = 2_000L, title = "Second")
        val b = ev(2, time = 1_000L, title = "First", cat = LogCategory.NETWORK, sev = LogSeverity.SUCCESS, meta = mapOf("httpStatus" to "200"))
        val r = ActivityReport.format(listOf(a, b), "MyApp", "1.0 (1)", 5_000L)
        assertTrue(r.startsWith("APPLICATION ACTIVITY REPORT"))
        assertTrue(r.contains("Application: MyApp") && r.contains("Version: 1.0 (1)") && r.contains("Total Events: 2"))
        assertTrue(r.indexOf("Event: First") < r.indexOf("Event: Second"))
        assertTrue(r.contains("EVENT 001") && r.contains("EVENT 002"))
        assertTrue(r.contains("httpStatus: 200"))
        assertFalse(r.contains("Stack Trace"))             // نەنووسراوە چونکە نییە
        assertTrue(r.trimEnd().endsWith("END OF REPORT"))
    }

    @Test fun reportShowsStackTraceWhenPresent() {
        val r = ActivityReport.format(listOf(ev(1, stack = "java.io.IOException: boom\n\tat a.B(C.kt:1)")), "A", "1", 1L)
        assertTrue(r.contains("Stack Trace:") && r.contains("java.io.IOException: boom"))
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import java.io.File

/**
 * JVM regex accepts `\p{IsLatin}`, but Android's ICU engine rejects it (PatternSyntaxException in a static
 * initializer → the first use crashes and every later use is NoClassDefFoundError). Use `\p{script=Latin}`, valid on both.
 */
class AndroidRegexCompatTest {
    @Test fun noJvmOnlyUnicodeScriptSyntaxInSources() {
        val root = listOf(File("src/main/java"), File("app/src/main/java")).first { it.exists() }
        val bad = root.walkTopDown().filter { it.extension == "kt" }
            .filter { f -> f.readText().contains(Regex("""\\\\p\{(Is|In)[A-Z]""")) }
            .map { it.name }.toList()
        assertTrue("JVM-only \\p{IsXxx} regex in: $bad", bad.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun latinScriptSyntaxCompiles() {
        Regex("[\\p{script=Latin}0-9]+").matches("abc123")
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import java.io.IOException

class BatchSafetyTest {

    // ---------- Google: باتش ----------

    @Test fun exactCountIsAccepted() {
        assertEquals(listOf("a", "b", "c"), GoogleTranslator.splitBatchResult("a ¤ b ¤ c", 3))
    }

    @Test fun extraPartsAreRejectedNotTruncated() {
        // پێشتر take(expected) دەکرا ← بابڵێک دەچووە ژێر بابڵێکی تر
        assertNull(GoogleTranslator.splitBatchResult("a ¤ b ¤ c ¤ d", 3))
    }

    @Test fun missingPartsAreRejected() {
        assertNull(GoogleTranslator.splitBatchResult("a ¤ b", 3))
        assertNull(GoogleTranslator.splitBatchResult("a b c", 3))
    }

    @Test fun emptyPartIsRejected() {
        assertNull(GoogleTranslator.splitBatchResult("a ¤  ¤ c", 3))
        assertNull(GoogleTranslator.splitBatchResult("   ", 2))
    }

    @Test fun singleItemNeverSplits() {
        assertEquals(listOf("hello ¤ world"), GoogleTranslator.splitBatchResult("hello ¤ world", 1))
    }

    // ---------- Gemini: دەرچوون بە id ----------

    @Test fun outOfOrderIdsStayWithTheirBlock() {
        val raw = """[{"id":2,"kurdish":"سێ"},{"id":0,"kurdish":"یەک"},{"id":1,"kurdish":"دوو"}]"""
        assertEquals(listOf("یەک", "دوو", "سێ"), ArabicGemini.parse(raw, 3))
    }

    @Test fun missingBlockStaysEmptyInsteadOfFailingAll() {
        val raw = """[{"id":0,"kurdish":"یەک"},{"id":2,"kurdish":"سێ"}]"""
        assertEquals(listOf("یەک", "", "سێ"), ArabicGemini.parse(raw, 3))
    }

    @Test fun invalidAndDuplicateIdsAreIgnored() {
        val raw = """[{"id":0,"kurdish":"یەک"},{"id":0,"kurdish":"دووبارە"},{"id":9,"kurdish":"نادروست"},{"id":-1,"kurdish":"x"}]"""
        assertEquals(listOf("یەک", ""), ArabicGemini.parse(raw, 2))
    }

    @Test fun noIdsAtAllThrows() {
        var thrown = false
        try { ArabicGemini.parse("""[{"kurdish":"x"}]""", 1) } catch (_: IOException) { thrown = true }
        assertTrue(thrown)
    }

    @Test fun fencedJsonIsAccepted() {
        assertEquals(listOf("باشە"), ArabicGemini.parse("```json\n[{\"id\":0,\"kurdish\":\"باشە\"}]\n```", 1))
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test
import kotlin.math.*

class FemaleVoiceRecipeTest {
    @Test fun shiftsPitchWithoutChangingUtteranceDurationOrClipping() {
        val rate = 16000
        val x = FloatArray(rate*3) { (.15*sin(2*PI*205*it/rate)).toFloat() }
        val y = FemaleVoiceRecipe.process(x, rate)
        assertEquals(x.size, y.size)
        assertTrue(y.all { it.isFinite() && abs(it) <= .841f })
        val start = rate/2; val end = rate*5/2
        val crossings = (start+1 until end).count { y[it-1] <= 0 && y[it] > 0 }
        val measured = crossings.toDouble()*rate/(end-start)
        assertEquals(205*1.04, measured, 2.0)
        assertEquals(-18.0, FemaleVoiceRecipe.integratedLufs(y, rate), .6)
    }
    @Test fun preservesSilenceAndDoesNotAddFakeBreathNoise() {
        assertArrayEquals(FloatArray(8000), FemaleVoiceRecipe.process(FloatArray(8000),16000),0f)
        assertEquals(0,FemaleVoiceRecipe.process(floatArrayOf(),16000).size)
    }
    @Test fun rejectsNonFinitePcm() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            FemaleVoiceRecipe.process(floatArrayOf(Float.NaN),16000)
        }
    }
    @Test fun keepsBriefSpeechFiniteAndRetainsSignalAtTheEnd() {
        for (length in listOf(1,64,800,16000)) {
            val x=FloatArray(length) { (.1*sin(2*PI*220*it/16000)).toFloat() }
            val y=FemaleVoiceRecipe.process(x,16000)
            assertEquals(length,y.size)
            assertTrue(y.all { it.isFinite() })
            if(length>=800) assertTrue(y.takeLast(length/4).any { abs(it)>.001f })
        }
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test
import java.io.IOException
import java.util.UUID

class GeminiKeysTest {
    private fun keys() = List(3) { UUID.randomUUID().toString() }

    @Test fun parsesSeparatorsAndRemovesDuplicates() {
        val k = keys()
        assertEquals(k, GeminiKeys.parse("${k[0]},${k[1]};${k[0]}\n${k[2]} short"))
    }

    @Test fun eachKeyIsAttemptedOnceEvenWhenOneIsCoolingDown() {
        val k = keys()
        GeminiKeys.rest(k[0], 401)
        val tried = mutableListOf<String>()
        try {
            GeminiKeys.withKeys<Unit>(k.joinToString("\n")) {
                tried += it
                throw ApiException(404, "missing model")
            }
            fail("Expected API failure")
        } catch (e: ApiException) {
            assertEquals(404, e.code)
        }
        assertEquals(3, tried.size)
        assertEquals(k.toSet(), tried.toSet())
        assertNotEquals(k[0], tried.first())
    }

    @Test fun stopsAfterSuccess() {
        val k = keys()
        var calls = 0
        val result = GeminiKeys.withKeys(k.joinToString("\n")) {
            if (++calls == 1) throw ApiException(429, "quota")
            "success"
        }
        assertEquals("success", result)
        assertEquals(2, calls)
    }

    @Test fun missingKeysNeverSendARequest() {
        var called = false
        try {
            GeminiKeys.withKeys(" , short ; ") { called = true }
            fail("Expected missing key failure")
        } catch (_: IOException) { }
        assertFalse(called)
    }

    @Test fun ordinaryIoFailureIsNotRetried() {
        var calls = 0
        val error = IOException("offline")
        try {
            GeminiKeys.withKeys<Unit>(keys().joinToString("\n")) { calls++; throw error }
            fail("Expected IO failure")
        } catch (e: IOException) { assertSame(error, e) }
        assertEquals(1, calls)
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test
import java.util.UUID

class GeminiQuotaPolicyTest {
    @Test fun quotaSensitiveCallsKeep429VisibleForProviderRouting() {
        var calls = 0
        val error = assertThrows(ApiException::class.java) {
            GeminiModels.call<String>(true, quotaSensitive = true) { _, _ -> calls++; throw ApiException(429, "quota") }
        }
        assertEquals(429, error.code)
        assertEquals(1, calls)
    }
    @Test fun legacyArabicModelFallbackRemainsUnchanged() {
        var calls = 0
        assertThrows(ApiException::class.java) {
            GeminiModels.call<String>(true) { _, _ -> calls++; throw ApiException(429, "quota") }
        }
        assertTrue(calls > 1)
    }
    @Test fun anotherValidKeyIsTriedBeforeGoogleFallback() {
        val keys = List(2) { UUID.randomUUID().toString() }
        val attempted = mutableListOf<String>()
        val result = TranslationRouter().run(TranslationProvider.GEMINI_QUOTA_GOOGLE, keys.joinToString("\n"),
            gemini = { GeminiKeys.withKeys(keys.joinToString("\n")) { key ->
                attempted += key
                GeminiModels.call(true, quotaSensitive = true) { _, _ ->
                    if (attempted.size == 1) throw ApiException(429, "quota")
                    "gemini"
                }
            } }, google = { error("The second key works") })
        assertEquals("gemini", result)
        assertEquals(2, attempted.distinct().size)
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class KurdishOcrTextTest {
    @Test fun elongationNeverSplitsAKurdishWord() {
        assertEquals("کوردی سڵاو", KurdishOcrText.clean("کـوردی سـڵاو"))
    }
    @Test fun paragraphsAndLinesSurviveCleanup() {
        assertEquals("سڵاو هاوڕێ\n\nدەقی کوردی", KurdishOcrText.clean("  سڵاو\tهاوڕێ\r\n\r\n  دەقی   کوردی  "))
        assertEquals("سڵاو\nهاوڕێ", KurdishOcrText.clean("سڵاو\u2028هاوڕێ"))
    }
    @Test fun zeroWidthWordSpaceDoesNotJoinSeparateWords() {
        assertEquals("دەقی کوردی", KurdishOcrText.clean("دەقی\u200Bکوردی"))
        assertEquals("دەچم", KurdishOcrText.clean("دە\u200Cچم"))
    }
    @Test fun directionControlsAndBomDoNotRemainInRecognizedWords() {
        assertEquals("سڵاو هاوڕێ", KurdishOcrText.clean("\uFEFF\u2067سڵاو\u2069 \u200Fهاوڕێ\u061C"))
    }
    @Test fun hamzaIsComposedBeforeArabicYehIsNormalized() {
        assertEquals("ئێمە کوردی", KurdishOcrText.clean("ي\u0654ێمە كوردي"))
    }
    @Test fun arabicPresentationFormsBecomeReadableLetters() {
        assertEquals("کوردی", KurdishOcrText.clean("\uFEDB\uFEEE\uFEAD\uFEA9\uFEF1"))
    }
    @Test fun rAndHeavyRAndLAndHeavyLAreNotConflated() {
        val text="ر ڕ ل ڵ تەر تەڕ دڵ"
        assertEquals(text, KurdishOcrText.clean(text))
    }
    @Test fun numbersDosesPercentagesAndScientificUnitsKeepTheirMeaning() {
        val text="٥٫٢ mg/dL، ١٠٠٪، Ca²⁺ و x²"
        assertEquals(text, KurdishOcrText.clean(text))
        assertEquals("٥٪", KurdishOcrText.clean("٥ ٪"))
    }
    @Test fun borrowedNamesAndTechnicalTermsAreNotDictionaryGuesses() {
        assertEquals("کوردی ERPNext و GPT-4", KurdishOcrText.clean("کوردی ERPNext و GPT-4"))
    }
    @Test fun cleanupIsIdempotent() {
        val once=KurdishOcrText.clean("\u200Fکـوردی\n  سڵاو  ، ERPNext")
        assertEquals(once,KurdishOcrText.clean(once))
    }
    @Test fun dictionaryMappingPreservesWhitespaceAndPunctuation() {
        val input="کوردى\n\n  سڵاو، هاوڕێ"
        assertEquals("کوردی\n\n  سڵاو، هاوڕێ", KurdishOcrText.mapWords(input) { if(it=="کوردى") "کوردی" else it })
    }
    @Test fun correctedWordBoxesKeepTheirGeometryAndReadingOrder() {
        val words=listOf(
            MixedOcrFilter.Word("کـوردی",100,0,150,20,90f),
            MixedOcrFilter.Word("دەق",0,0,50,20,90f),
            MixedOcrFilter.Word("سڵاو",100,40,150,60,90f)
        )
        val cleaned=words.map {it.copy(text=KurdishOcrText.clean(it.text))}
        assertEquals("کوردی دەق\nسڵاو", MixedOcrFilter.text(cleaned))
        assertEquals(words.map {it.left to it.top},cleaned.map {it.left to it.top})
        assertEquals(words.map {it.right to it.bottom},cleaned.map {it.right to it.bottom})
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class LineIdentityTest {
    @Test fun identicalLinesAreTheSame() {
        assertTrue(LineIdentity.same("wearegoingtothemarket", "wearegoingtothemarket"))
        assertTrue(LineIdentity.same("no", "no"))
    }

    @Test fun shortDifferentLinesAreNeverRepeats() {
        assertFalse(LineIdentity.same("heis", "sheis"))
        assertFalse(LineIdentity.same("can", "cant"))
        assertFalse(LineIdentity.same("yes", "no"))
    }

    @Test fun oneOcrMistakeInAMediumLineIsStillTheSameLine() {
        assertTrue(LineIdentity.same("wearegoingtothemarket", "wearegoingtothemarkat"))
    }

    @Test fun differentMediumLinesAreNotRepeats() {
        assertFalse(LineIdentity.same("wearegoingtothemarket", "wearegoingtothestation"))
        assertFalse(LineIdentity.same("iwillnotgotothemarket", "iwillgotothemarketnow"))
    }

    @Test fun differentNumbersAreNotRepeats() {
        assertFalse(LineIdentity.same("chapter3beginsnowatonce", "chapter5beginsnowatonce"))
    }

    @Test fun longLinesTolerateSmallOcrNoise() {
        val a = "thisisaverylongsubtitlelinethatgoesonandonaboutthingsthatmatter"
        val b = "thisisaverylongsubtitlelinethatgoesonandonaboutthingsthatmattar"
        assertTrue(LineIdentity.same(a, b))
        assertFalse(LineIdentity.same(a, "thisisaverylongsubtitlelinebutnowitsaboutcompletelydifferentstuffhere"))
    }

    @Test fun ocrLookalikeLettersAreTheSameLine() {
        // I ↔ l، O ↔ 0، rn ↔ m: هەمان ژێرنووس کە OCR کەمێک جیاواز خوێندوویەتەوە
        assertTrue(LineIdentity.same("icantbelieveit", "lcantbelieveit"))
        assertTrue(LineIdentity.same("hellothere", "he1lothere"))
        assertTrue(LineIdentity.same("modern", "modem"))
        assertTrue(LineIdentity.same("goodboy", "g0odboy"))
    }

    @Test fun lookalikeFoldingDoesNotMergeRealDifferences() {
        assertFalse(LineIdentity.same("heis", "sheis"))
        assertFalse(LineIdentity.same("ido", "idont"))
        assertFalse(LineIdentity.same("wewin", "wewon"))
    }

    @Test fun emptyIsNeverTheSame() {
        assertFalse(LineIdentity.same("", ""))
        assertFalse(LineIdentity.same("abc", ""))
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class LiveFastPathRegressionTest {
    @Test fun normalizedRepeatCannotReuseOldOffsetsForGrowingText() {
        val p = LiveSubtitleProgress()
        p.next("HELLO,   EVERYONE!", 0)
        assertTrue(p.next("hello everyone", 10).repeated)
        assertEquals("welcome back", p.next("hello everyone welcome back", 20).text)
    }
    @Test fun rawKeyCacheStillHonorsExpiryAndBlankFrames() {
        val p = LiveSubtitleProgress(memoryMs = 100)
        p.next("Same subtitle", 0)
        assertTrue(p.next("Same subtitle", 50).repeated)
        p.absent()
        assertFalse(p.next("Same subtitle", 151).repeated)
    }
    @Test fun expiredCjkCurrentFrameStillProvidesThePrefix() {
        val p = LiveSubtitleProgress(memoryMs = 100)
        p.next("今天", 0)
        assertEquals("下雨了", p.next("今天下雨了", 1000).text)
    }
    @Test fun formattingFallbackRetainsSoraniNormalization() {
        assertEquals("کوردی", LiveTranslationFilter.clean("**كوردی** ¤\u200e John 42"))
        assertEquals("سڵاو هاوڕێ", LiveTranslationFilter.clean("\tسڵاو\n  هاوڕێ\r"))
        assertEquals("سڵاو، چۆنی؟", LiveTranslationFilter.clean("سڵاو ، چۆنی ؟"))
    }
    @Test fun filterCacheNeverLeaksAnotherCaptionsResult() {
        repeat(100) {
            assertEquals("سڵاو هاوڕێ", LiveTranslationFilter.clean("سڵاو John123 هاوڕێ"))
            assertEquals("چۆنی؟", LiveTranslationFilter.clean("Alex چۆنی؟ 456"))
            assertEquals("سڵاو هاوڕێ", LiveTranslationFilter.clean("سڵاو John123 هاوڕێ"))
        }
    }
    @Test fun alreadyCleanPathKeepsNumeralsAndZeroWidthWordJoiner() {
        val text = "ژمارە ١٢٣ و ۱۲۳، هاو\u200cڕێ؟"
        assertEquals(text, LiveTranslationFilter.clean(text))
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class LiveGeometryTest {

    @Test fun landscapeSwapsPhysicalDimensions() {
        val l = LiveGeometry.screenFor(landscape = true, anyW = 1080, anyH = 2400)
        assertEquals(2400, l.w); assertEquals(1080, l.h)
        val p = LiveGeometry.screenFor(landscape = false, anyW = 2400, anyH = 1080)
        assertEquals(1080, p.w); assertEquals(2400, p.h)
    }

    @Test fun landscapeDefaultBandIsInsideScreenAtTheBottom() {
        val sz = LiveGeometry.screenFor(true, 1080, 2400)
        val b = LiveGeometry.defaultBand(sz.w, sz.h)
        assertTrue(b.left >= 0 && b.right <= sz.w && b.top >= 0 && b.bottom <= sz.h)
        assertTrue(b.right > b.left && b.bottom > b.top)
        assertTrue("باری ژێرنووس لە نیوەی خوارەوەیە", b.top >= sz.h * 0.5f)
        assertTrue("پانیی باکە لانیکەم ٦٠٪", (b.right - b.left) >= sz.w * 0.6f)
    }

    @Test fun portraitDefaultBandIsInsideScreen() {
        val sz = LiveGeometry.screenFor(false, 2400, 1080)
        val b = LiveGeometry.defaultBand(sz.w, sz.h)
        assertTrue(b.left >= 0 && b.right <= sz.w && b.top >= 0 && b.bottom <= sz.h)
        assertTrue(b.right > b.left && b.bottom > b.top)
    }

    @Test fun degenerateSizesAreSafe() {
        val s = LiveGeometry.screenFor(true, 0, 0)
        assertTrue(s.w >= 2 && s.h >= 2)
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class LivePlaybackControlTest {
    @Test fun stoppedCannotResume() {
        val c = LivePlaybackControl<String>()
        assertEquals(LivePlaybackControl.Phase.STOPPED, c.phase)
        assertNull(c.resume())
        assertFalse(c.pause("old"))
        assertFalse(c.accepts(c.generation))
    }
    @Test fun pauseBlocksOldCallbacksAndPreservesLastLine() {
        val c = LivePlaybackControl<Pair<String, String>>()
        val first = c.start("portrait" to "first")
        assertTrue(c.accepts(first))
        assertTrue(c.pause("landscape" to "last sentence"))
        var callbacks = 0
        c.withCurrent(first) { callbacks++ }
        assertEquals(0, callbacks)
        assertEquals("landscape" to "last sentence", c.resume())
        assertFalse(c.accepts(first))
        c.withCurrent(c.generation) { callbacks++ }
        assertEquals(1, callbacks)
        assertNull(c.resume())
    }
    @Test fun repeatedPauseDoesNotOverwriteSavedSelection() {
        val c = LivePlaybackControl<String>()
        c.start("initial")
        assertTrue(c.pause("saved"))
        assertFalse(c.pause("wrong"))
        assertEquals("saved", c.resume())
    }
    @Test fun stopWhilePausedClearsResumeAndRejectsDeferredAttach() {
        val c = LivePlaybackControl<String>()
        val old = c.start("old")
        c.pause("last")
        c.stop()
        assertNull(c.resume())
        c.start("new")
        var attached = false
        c.withCurrent(old) { attached = true }
        assertFalse(attached)
    }
    @Test fun rapidCyclesNeverAcceptEarlierRuns() {
        val c = LivePlaybackControl<Int>()
        val tokens = mutableListOf(c.start(0))
        repeat(50) { i ->
            assertTrue(c.pause(i))
            assertEquals(i, c.resume())
            tokens.forEach { assertFalse(c.accepts(it)) }
            tokens.add(c.generation)
            assertTrue(c.accepts(c.generation))
        }
    }
    @Test fun preservesBothOrientationsWithoutRequiringASelectionAgain() {
        val c = LivePlaybackControl<Map<Boolean, String>>()
        val regions = mapOf(false to "portrait region", true to "landscape region")
        c.start(regions)
        c.pause(regions)
        assertEquals(regions, c.resume())
    }
}

        assertTrue(LiveRefresh.accessibilityMs(true) >= 333)

        assertTrue(LiveRefresh.accessibilityMs(true) < 550)

        assertTrue(OcrGate.shouldRun(false, false, 250, 300, false, false, fastRefresh = true))
        assertFalse(OcrGate.shouldRun(false, false, 250, 300, false, false))
    }
    @Test fun unchangedArabicOcrStillUsesItsExistingThresholds() {
        assertEquals(450L, OcrGate.forceMs(false))
        assertEquals(220L, OcrGate.gapMs(false))
        assertFalse(OcrGate.shouldRun(false, false, 300, 300, false, false))

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class LiveSpeechAttemptTest {
    @Test fun successfulShortWordIsNeverRetriedAfterTextDisappears() {
        val state = LiveSpeechAttempt()
        val queue = SpeechQueue()
        queue.add("باشە.")
        val token = state.begin(queue.take()!!.text)
        assertTrue(state.complete(token)) // even an immediate completion is valid
        assertNull(state.fail(token, sourceVisible = false))
        assertFalse(state.complete(token)) // duplicate callback/watchdog
        assertTrue(queue.isEmpty())
    }
    @Test fun disappearingSubtitleDoesNotCancelCurrentPlayback() {
        val state = LiveSpeechAttempt()
        val token = state.begin("دەنگی ئێستا")
        // Visibility is consulted only on error. No cancellation occurs on blank OCR.
        assertTrue(state.isCurrent(token))
        assertTrue(state.complete(token))
        assertNull(state.fail(token, sourceVisible = false))
    }
    @Test fun genuineFailureRetriesOnlyOnceWhileSourceIsVisible() {
        val state = LiveSpeechAttempt()
        val first = state.begin("باشە.")
        assertEquals("باشە.", state.fail(first, true)!!.retryText)
        assertNull(state.fail(first, true))
        val second = state.begin("باشە.")
        assertNull(state.fail(second, true)!!.retryText)
    }
    @Test fun failureAfterSourceDisappearsDoesNotRestartOldText() {
        val state = LiveSpeechAttempt()
        val token = state.begin("old subtitle")
        assertNull(state.fail(token, false)!!.retryText)
        assertFalse(state.isCurrent(token))
    }
    @Test fun lateCallbacksCannotCompleteTheNextSentence() {
        val state = LiveSpeechAttempt()
        val old = state.begin("first")
        assertTrue(state.complete(old))
        val current = state.begin("second")
        assertFalse(state.complete(old))
        assertNull(state.fail(old, true))
        assertTrue(state.isCurrent(current))
    }
    @Test fun uncertainWatchdogFinishAdvancesWithoutReplay() {
        val state = LiveSpeechAttempt()
        val queue = SpeechQueue(maxChars = 1)
        queue.add("first sentence has enough words."); queue.add("second sentence has enough words.")
        val first = state.begin(queue.take()!!.text)
        assertTrue(state.complete(first)) // playback finished; completion callback is late
        val second = queue.take()!!
        assertEquals("second sentence has enough words.", second.text)
        val next = state.begin(second.text)
        assertNull(state.fail(first, true))
        assertTrue(state.isCurrent(next))
        assertTrue(queue.isEmpty())
    }
    @Test fun stopInvalidatesEveryCallback() {
        val state = LiveSpeechAttempt()
        val token = state.begin("first")
        state.cancel()
        assertFalse(state.complete(token))
        assertNull(state.fail(token, true))
    }
    @Test fun partialPlaybackFailureNeverRequeuesTheSpokenParagraph() {
        val state = LiveSpeechAttempt()
        val token = state.begin("partly spoken paragraph")
        assertNull(state.fail(token, true, retryAllowed = false)!!.retryText)
        assertFalse(state.isCurrent(token))
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class LiveSpeechPartsTest {
    @Test fun completeShortSentenceCanStartBeforeTheNextSentence() {
        assertEquals(listOf("Go!", "We have to leave this place right now."),
            LiveSpeechParts.split("Go! We have to leave this place right now."))
    }
    @Test fun soraniAndCjkSentenceBoundariesWork() {
        assertEquals(listOf("تۆ چۆنی؟", "من باشم."), LiveSpeechParts.split("تۆ چۆنی؟ من باشم."))
        assertEquals(listOf("你好！", "你好吗？"), LiveSpeechParts.split("你好！ 你好吗？"))
    }
    @Test fun namesAndInitialsAreNotSplitAtAbbreviations() {
        assertEquals(listOf("Dr. Smith is here.", "Go!"), LiveSpeechParts.split("Dr. Smith is here. Go!"))
        assertEquals(listOf("U.S. Army arrived.", "Go!"), LiveSpeechParts.split("U.S. Army arrived. Go!"))
    }
    @Test fun longLineCanStartAtANaturalClauseBoundaryWithoutLosingWords() {
        val text = "We need to leave the western gate before the guards get back, " +
            "otherwise everyone in the village will be in serious danger."
        val parts = LiveSpeechParts.split(text)
        assertTrue(parts.size >= 2)
        assertEquals(text, parts.joinToString(" "))
        assertTrue(parts.first().endsWith(','))
    }
    @Test fun singleUnbrokenSentenceIsNotCutAtArbitraryWordGroups() {
        assertEquals(emptyList<String>(), LiveSpeechParts.split("This is one complete sentence without any clause boundary."))
    }
    @Test fun maximumFourPartsKeepsAllSentencesInOrder() {
        val text = "Go! Run! Stop! Come! Leave! Wait!"
        val parts = LiveSpeechParts.split(text)
        assertEquals(4, parts.size)
        assertEquals(text, parts.joinToString(" "))
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Test

class LiveSpeechSpeedTest {
    @Test fun shortLineStaysAtNormalSpeed() {
        assertEquals(1f, LiveSpeechSpeed.boost("سڵاو هاوڕێ."), 0.001f)
    }

    @Test fun mediumLineGetsAModerateBoost() {
        val text = (1..14).joinToString(" ") { "وشە$it" }
        assertEquals(1.5f, LiveSpeechSpeed.boost(text), 0.001f)
    }

    @Test fun longLineCapsAtOnePointFive() {
        val text = (1..35).joinToString(" ") { "وشە$it" }
        assertEquals(1.5f, LiveSpeechSpeed.boost(text), 0.001f)
    }

    @Test fun sixWordsAreOnePointTwoFive() {
        assertEquals(1.25f, LiveSpeechSpeed.boost("یەک دوو سێ چوار پێنج شەش", 1.5f), 0.001f)
    }

    @Test fun eightWordsAreOnePointThreeFive() {
        val text = "Hello everyone and welcome back to Enjoy English Talks"
        assertEquals(1.35f, LiveSpeechSpeed.boost(text), 0.001f)
    }

    @Test fun fiveWordsKeepTheUsersSelectedSpeed() {
        assertEquals(1f, LiveSpeechSpeed.boost("یەک دوو سێ چوار پێنج", 1.5f), 0.001f)
        assertEquals(1.25f, LiveSpeechSpeed.boost("یەک دوو سێ چوار پێنج", baseSpeed = 1.25f), 0.001f)
    }

    @Test fun shortLineNeverLowersOnePointFiveUserSpeed() {
        assertEquals(1f, LiveSpeechSpeed.boost("یەک دوو", baseSpeed = 1.5f), 0.001f)
    }

    @Test fun longLineTargetsOnePointFiveEvenWhenUserSelectedOnePointTwoFive() {
        val text = (1..35).joinToString(" ") { "وشە$it" }
        assertEquals(1.2f, LiveSpeechSpeed.boost(text, baseSpeed = 1.25f), 0.001f)
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class LiveSubtitleProgressTest {
    @Test fun cumulativeFramesEmitOnlyNewParts() {
        val p = LiveSubtitleProgress()
        assertEquals("Hello everyone", p.next("Hello everyone", 0).text)
        assertEquals("welcome", p.next("Hello everyone welcome", 100).text)
        assertEquals("back home.", p.next("Hello everyone welcome back home.", 200).text)
    }
    @Test fun shortAdditionToLongLineIsNeverLostToSimilarity() {
        val p = LiveSubtitleProgress()
        val line = "We have been searching for the old house outside the village all day"
        p.next(line, 0)
        assertEquals("now", p.next("$line now", 100).text)
    }
    @Test fun shortExactRepeatIsSilentEvenAfterBlank() {
        val p = LiveSubtitleProgress()
        p.next("Yes", 0)
        p.absent()
        assertTrue(p.next("YES!", 100).repeated)
    }
    @Test fun repeatedRollingFramesDoNotRestartSpeech() {
        val p = LiveSubtitleProgress()
        p.next("Where are you going?", 0)
        p.next("Where are you going? I will come with you.", 100)
        val result = p.next("I will come with you. Wait for me!", 200)
        assertTrue(result.continuation)
        assertEquals("Wait for me!", result.text)
    }
    @Test fun shortenedFrameDoesNotReplayOldPrefix() {
        val p = LiveSubtitleProgress()
        p.next("Hello everyone welcome back", 0)
        assertTrue(p.next("Hello everyone", 100).repeated)
        assertEquals("today", p.next("Hello everyone welcome back today", 200).text)
    }
    @Test fun caseLineWrapAndPunctuationAreIgnored() {
        val p = LiveSubtitleProgress()
        p.next("HELLO, EVERYONE!", 0)
        assertTrue(p.next("Hello\neveryone", 100).repeated)
        assertEquals("welcome.", p.next("Hello everyone welcome.", 200).text)
    }
    @Test fun unrelatedLineIsImmediateAndNotCutInMiddle() {
        val p = LiveSubtitleProgress()
        p.next("where are you going", 0)
        val line = "Then he asked where are you going again"
        assertEquals(line, p.next(line, 1).text)
    }
    @Test fun commonSingleWordIsNotRollingOverlap() {
        val p = LiveSubtitleProgress()
        p.next("Bring it to the gate", 0)
        assertEquals("gate is closed now", p.next("gate is closed now", 100).text)
    }
    @Test fun differentShortSentencesAreNeverFuzzyDuplicates() {
        val p = LiveSubtitleProgress()
        p.next("I can go", 0)
        assertEquals("I can't go", p.next("I can't go", 100).text)
    }
    @Test fun longCaptionsKeepTheirEndBeyondTwoHundredCharacters() {
        val p = LiveSubtitleProgress()
        val line = "The villagers have waited outside for a long time. ".repeat(6).trim()
        p.next(line, 0)
        assertEquals("Finally he arrived.", p.next("$line Finally he arrived.", 100).text)
    }
    @Test fun completesTruncatedWordWithoutRestartingThePhrase() {
        val p = LiveSubtitleProgress()
        p.next("I will protec", 0)
        assertEquals("protect you.", p.next("I will protect you.", 100).text)
    }
    @Test fun translatedDifferentSourceSameCleanedOutputIsSilent() {
        val p = LiveSubtitleProgress()
        val first = LiveTranslationFilter.clean("بەڵێ John 123")
        val second = LiveTranslationFilter.clean("بەڵێ Alex 456")
        assertFalse(p.next(first, 0, allowOverlap = false).repeated)
        assertTrue(p.next(second, 100, allowOverlap = false).repeated)
    }
    @Test fun independentTranslationsDoNotStripCommonOpeningWords() {
        val p = LiveSubtitleProgress()
        p.next("من ئێرەم", 0, allowOverlap = false)
        assertEquals("من ئێرەم بەڵام تۆ لە کوێیت؟", p.next("من ئێرەم بەڵام تۆ لە کوێیت؟", 100, allowOverlap = false).text)
    }
    @Test fun expiredLineMayBeSpokenInANewScene() {
        val p = LiveSubtitleProgress(100)
        p.next("Hello everyone", 0)
        p.absent()
        assertFalse(p.next("Hello everyone", 101).repeated)
    }
    @Test fun sameVisibleCaptionStaysSilentAfterMemoryWindow() {
        val p = LiveSubtitleProgress(100)
        p.next("Hello everyone", 0)
        assertTrue(p.next("Hello everyone", 101).repeated)
    }
    @Test fun unchangedCaptionCanGrowAfterLongStaticDisplay() {
        val p = LiveSubtitleProgress(100)
        p.next("Welcome", 0)
        assertEquals("back", p.next("Welcome back", 1000).text)
    }
    @Test fun boundedHistoryDoesNotBlockNewLines() {
        val p = LiveSubtitleProgress(capacity = 3)
        repeat(10) { assertFalse(p.next("New subtitle number $it", it.toLong(), allowOverlap = false).repeated) }
        assertFalse(p.next("New subtitle number 0", 11, allowOverlap = false).repeated)
    }
    @Test fun cjkWithoutSpacesEmitsOnlyTheNewCharacters() {
        val p = LiveSubtitleProgress()
        p.next("今天", 0)
        assertEquals("下雨了", p.next("今天下雨了", 100).text)
    }
    @Test fun kurdishCumulativeCaptionsContinueInPlace() {
        val p = LiveSubtitleProgress()
        p.next("سڵاو هاوڕێ", 0)
        assertEquals("چۆنی؟", p.next("سڵاو هاوڕێ چۆنی؟", 100).text)
    }
    @Test fun immediatelyGrowingShortWordIsNotSpokenAgain() {
        val p = LiveSubtitleProgress()
        p.next("Hi", 0)
        assertEquals("there friend", p.next("Hi there friend", 100).text)
    }
    @Test fun repeatedWordsUseTheLongestRollingOverlap() {
        val p = LiveSubtitleProgress()
        p.next("Outside alpha beta alpha beta", 0)
        assertEquals("gamma", p.next("alpha beta alpha beta gamma", 100).text)
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class LiveTokenizerRegressionTest {
    private fun extension(first: String, second: String, expected: String) {
        val p = LiveSubtitleProgress()
        p.next(first, 0)
        val r = p.next(second, 10)
        assertTrue(r.continuation)
        assertEquals(expected, r.text)
    }
    @Test fun contractionsRemainWhole() {
        extension("We're ready", "We're ready let's go!", "let's go!")
    }
    @Test fun combiningMarksAndZeroWidthNonJoinerKeepBoundaries() {
        extension("cafe\u0301 please", "cafe\u0301 please come", "come")
        extension("سڵاو هاو\u200cڕێ", "سڵاو هاو\u200cڕێ چۆنی؟", "چۆنی؟")
    }
    @Test fun supplementaryLettersUseTheFullUnicodeFallback() {
        extension("Hello 𝒜world", "Hello 𝒜world welcome", "welcome")
    }
    @Test fun numericUnicodeCategoriesKeepTheirOriginalTokenPositions() {
        extension("Gate Ⅳ is open", "Gate Ⅳ is open today", "today")
        extension("Gate ½ is open", "Gate ½ is open today", "today")
    }
    @Test fun caseExpansionStillFiltersCombiningMarks() {
        extension("İSTANBUL is ready", "İSTANBUL is ready today", "today")
    }
    @Test fun reusedRollingMatcherHandlesChangingLengths() {
        val p = LiveSubtitleProgress()
        p.next("Outside alpha beta alpha beta", 0)
        assertEquals("gamma", p.next("alpha beta alpha beta gamma", 10).text)
        assertEquals("delta", p.next("beta gamma delta", 20).text)
        assertEquals("epsilon zeta eta theta", p.next("gamma delta epsilon zeta eta theta", 30).text)
    }
    @Test fun refreshingRecentLinesMaintainsExpiryOrder() {
        val p = LiveSubtitleProgress(memoryMs = 100)
        p.next("First subtitle", 0, false)
        p.next("Second subtitle", 20, false)
        assertTrue(p.next("First subtitle", 70, false).repeated)
        p.absent()
        assertFalse(p.next("Second subtitle", 121, false).repeated)
        assertTrue(p.next("First subtitle", 150, false).repeated)
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class LiveTranslationFilterTest {
    @Test fun removesEnglishWordsAndAsciiNumbersFromMiddle() {
        assertEquals("سڵاو هاوڕێ، چۆنی؟", LiveTranslationFilter.clean("سڵاو John هاوڕێ، 123 چۆنی؟"))
    }
    @Test fun contractionsAndIdentifiersLeaveNoLatinFragments() {
        val result = LiveTranslationFilter.clean("من don't و HP100 و player_2 دەبینم")
        assertFalse(result.any { it in 'A'..'Z' || it in 'a'..'z' || it in '0'..'9' })
        assertTrue(result.contains("دەبینم"))
    }
    @Test fun removesFormattedNumbersAndTimes() {
        assertEquals("کات و پارە", LiveTranslationFilter.clean("کات 12:30 و پارە 1,234.56"))
    }
    @Test fun preservesKurdishNumbersAndLetters() {
        assertEquals("ژمارە ١٢٣ و ۱۲۳", LiveTranslationFilter.clean("ژمارە ١٢٣ و ۱۲۳"))
    }
    @Test fun mixedAdjacentScriptsDoNotDestroyKurdish() {
        assertEquals("سڵاو هاوڕێ", LiveTranslationFilter.clean("سڵاوJohn123هاوڕێ"))
    }
    @Test fun cleansEmptyBrackets() {
        assertEquals("سڵاو هاوڕێ", LiveTranslationFilter.clean("سڵاو (John) [123] هاوڕێ"))
    }
    @Test fun latinOnlyDoesNotProduceSpeechOrCaptionNoise() {
        assertEquals("", LiveTranslationFilter.clean("John 123 HP100!"))
        assertEquals("", LiveTranslationFilter.clean("123 ..."))
    }
    @Test fun normalSoraniRemainsUnchanged() {
        assertEquals("سڵاو، چۆنی هاوڕێ؟", LiveTranslationFilter.clean("سڵاو، چۆنی هاوڕێ؟"))
    }
    @Test fun finishNormalizesArabicLettersAndMarkdown() {
        assertEquals("کوردی", LiveTranslationFilter.clean("**كوردي** English 42"))
    }
    @Test fun blankAndSymbolOnlyDoNotReachOutput() {
        assertEquals("", LiveTranslationFilter.clean(""))
        assertEquals("", LiveTranslationFilter.clean("- [123] -"))
    }
    @Test fun idempotentAndRetainsShortWord() {
        val once = LiveTranslationFilter.clean("بەڵێ Yes 42")
        assertEquals("بەڵێ", once)
        assertEquals(once, LiveTranslationFilter.clean(once))
    }
    @Test fun accentedLatinAndCombiningMarksDoNotLeakFragments() {
        assertEquals("سڵاو هاوڕێ", LiveTranslationFilter.clean("سڵاو Pokémon cafe\u0301 هاوڕێ"))
    }
    @Test fun negativeNumbersAndDuplicateSeparatorsAreCleaned() {
        assertEquals("سڵاو، هاوڕێ", LiveTranslationFilter.clean("سڵاو، John، -12 هاوڕێ"))
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class LiveTypingWindowTest {
    private val same: (String, String) -> Boolean = { a, b -> a == b }
    @Test fun fullSubtitleIsImmediateFromTheFirstObservation() {
        val gate = LiveTypingWindow()
        val decision = gate.observe("thewholelineisalreadyvisible", 100, same)
        assertFalse(decision.wait)
        assertFalse(decision.growing)
    }
    @Test fun typewriterStillWaitsButDoesNotDelayNextFullLine() {
        val gate = LiveTypingWindow()
        gate.observe("hello", 100, same)
        assertTrue(gate.observe("hellothere", 200, same).wait)
        assertTrue(gate.observe("hellothere", 300, same).wait)
        assertFalse(gate.observe("runforthegatebeforeitcloses", 400, same).wait)
    }
    @Test fun blankClearsTypingMemory() {
        val gate = LiveTypingWindow()
        gate.observe("hello", 100, same)
        assertTrue(gate.observe("hellothere", 200, same).wait)
        gate.reset()
        assertFalse(gate.observe("hellotherefriend", 300, same).wait)
    }
    @Test fun memoryExpiresAndOcrJitterDoesNotExtendIt() {
        val gate = LiveTypingWindow(1000)
        gate.observe("hello", 100, same)
        gate.observe("hellothere", 200, same)
        val jitter: (String, String) -> Boolean = { _, _ -> true }
        assertTrue(gate.observe("hellothere!", 300, jitter).wait)
        assertFalse(gate.observe("hellothere!", 1300, jitter).wait)
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class MixedOcrFilterTest {
    private fun word(text: String, left: Int, confidence: Float = 90f, latin: Boolean = false, top: Int = 0) =
        MixedOcrFilter.Word(text, left, top, left + 40, top + 20, confidence, latin)

    @Test fun noiseTokenDoesNotEraseTheWholeGoodLine() {
        val text = MixedOcrFilter.text(MixedOcrFilter.nativeWords(listOf(word("سڵاو", 120), word("ئئئئ", 60), word("هاوڕێ", 0))))
        assertEquals("سڵاو هاوڕێ", text)
    }
    @Test fun shortKurdishWordsSurviveWithoutAThreeLetterAnchor() {
        assertEquals("نا", MixedOcrFilter.text(MixedOcrFilter.nativeWords(listOf(word("نا", 0)))))
        assertEquals("لە تۆ", MixedOcrFilter.text(MixedOcrFilter.nativeWords(listOf(word("لە", 80), word("تۆ", 0)))))
    }
    @Test fun weakRealWordBetweenClearWordsIsRetained() {
        val result = MixedOcrFilter.nativeWords(listOf(word("سڵاو", 120), word("لە", 60, 35f), word("تۆ", 0)))
        assertEquals(3, result.size)
    }
    @Test fun isolatedLowConfidenceNumbersAndPunctuationAreRejected() {
        assertTrue(MixedOcrFilter.nativeWords(listOf(word("٩٦", 60, 40f), word("٥٥", 0, 40f))).isEmpty())
        assertTrue(MixedOcrFilter.nativeWords(listOf(word("...", 0))).isEmpty())
    }
    @Test fun numbersInARealSentenceKeepTheirMeaning() {
        assertEquals("ژمارە 2026", MixedOcrFilter.text(MixedOcrFilter.nativeWords(listOf(word("ژمارە", 80), word("2026", 0, 60f)))))
    }
    @Test fun englishProductNameFillsTheMissingSlot() {
        val mixed = MixedOcrFilter.merge(listOf(word("ئێمە", 160), word("بەکاردەهێنین", 0)),
            listOf(word("ERPNext", 80, 96f, true)))
        assertEquals("ئێمە ERPNext بەکاردەهێنین", MixedOcrFilter.text(mixed))
    }
    @Test fun englishRunStaysLeftToRightInsideTheKurdishLine() {
        val mixed = MixedOcrFilter.merge(listOf(word("ئێمە", 240), word("هەیە", 0)),
            listOf(word("Nwebeen", 80, 98f, true), word("ERPNext", 140, 98f, true)))
        assertEquals("ئێمە Nwebeen ERPNext هەیە", MixedOcrFilter.text(mixed))
    }
    @Test fun acronymsDigitsAndCamelCaseAreNotRejectedAsGibberish() {
        for (name in listOf("ERP", "ERPNext", "GPT4", "Nwebeen", "readX", "CO2")) {
            assertTrue(MixedOcrFilter.merge(emptyList(), listOf(word(name, 0, 96f, true))).any { it.text == name })
        }
    }
    @Test fun confidentKurdishDoesNotBecomeALatinHallucination() {
        val merged = MixedOcrFilter.merge(listOf(word("پڕۆگرامەر", 0, 95f)), listOf(word("yojyaJ", 0, 80f, true)))
        assertEquals("پڕۆگرامەر", MixedOcrFilter.text(merged))
    }
    @Test fun strongerEnglishCanReplaceAnUncertainCkbOnlyGuess() {
        val merged = MixedOcrFilter.merge(listOf(word("شەرم", 0, 60f)), listOf(word("ERPNext", 0, 98f, true)))
        assertEquals("ERPNext", MixedOcrFilter.text(merged))
    }
    @Test fun duplicateLatinDetectorBoxesAreNotSpokenTwice() {
        val latin = word("ERPNext", 0, 98f, true)
        assertEquals(1, MixedOcrFilter.merge(emptyList(), listOf(latin, latin)).size)
    }
    @Test fun separateLinesRetainTheirOrder() {
        val words = listOf(word("سڵاو", 0, top = 40), word("ئێمە", 80, top = 0))
        assertEquals("ئێمە\nسڵاو", MixedOcrFilter.text(words))
    }
    @Test fun invalidConfidenceOrGeometryCannotPolluteOutput() {
        assertTrue(MixedOcrFilter.nativeWords(listOf(word("سڵاو", 0, Float.NaN))).isEmpty())
        assertTrue(MixedOcrFilter.merge(emptyList(), listOf(word("ERPNext", 0, Float.NaN, true))).isEmpty())
    }
    @Test fun legitimateRepeatedVowelInsideAWordDoesNotEraseIt() {
        assertEquals("زۆۆۆۆر", MixedOcrFilter.text(MixedOcrFilter.nativeWords(listOf(word("زۆۆۆۆر", 0)))))
    }
    @Test fun leadingDigitNamesKeepTheirLatinSuffix() {
        for (name in listOf("4K", "3D", "5G")) {
            assertEquals(name, MixedOcrFilter.text(MixedOcrFilter.merge(emptyList(), listOf(word(name, 0, 98f, true)))))
        }
    }
    @Test fun ckbNumericPrefixDoesNotEraseTheLetterOf4K() {
        val words = MixedOcrFilter.merge(listOf(word("ژمارە", 80), word("٤", 0, 96f)), listOf(word("4K", 0, 98f, true)))
        assertEquals("ژمارە 4K", MixedOcrFilter.text(words))
    }
    @Test fun latinWordsWithUnavailableConfidenceFillGapsWithoutInventingAScore() {
        val mixed = MixedOcrFilter.merge(listOf(word("ئێمە", 160), word("هەیە", 0)), listOf(word("ERPNext", 80, -1f, true)))
        assertEquals("ئێمە ERPNext هەیە", MixedOcrFilter.text(mixed))
    }
    @Test fun unknownLatinConfidenceCannotOverwriteARealKurdishWord() {
        val mixed = MixedOcrFilter.merge(listOf(word("پڕۆگرامەر", 0, 90f)), listOf(word("yojyaJ", 0, -1f, true)))
        assertEquals("پڕۆگرامەر", MixedOcrFilter.text(mixed))
    }

    @Test fun screenshotSplitDigitsAreConfirmedAsOneLeftToRightNumber() {
        val native = listOf(word("بۆ", 220), word("ماوەی", 160),
            word("8", 100, 55f), word("1", 50, 91f), word("مانگ", 0, 66f))
        val eighteen = MixedOcrFilter.Word("18", 50, 0, 140, 20, 97f, true)
        assertEquals("بۆ ماوەی 18 مانگ", MixedOcrFilter.text(MixedOcrFilter.merge(native, listOf(eighteen))))
    }
    @Test fun screenshotMangaWordCannotBecomeModeratelyConfidentSilo() {
        assertEquals("مانگ", MixedOcrFilter.text(MixedOcrFilter.merge(
            listOf(word("مانگ", 0, 66f)), listOf(word("Silo", 0, 82f, true)))))
    }
    @Test fun screenshotTelephoneSurvivesWithoutKurdishLineAnchor() {
        val phone = word("07765952001", 0, 93f, true)
        assertEquals(phone.text, MixedOcrFilter.text(MixedOcrFilter.merge(emptyList(), listOf(phone))))
    }
    @Test fun latinNumbersNeverReplaceKurdishWaw() {
        assertEquals("و", MixedOcrFilter.text(MixedOcrFilter.merge(
            listOf(word("و", 0, 90f), word("تۆ", 80)), listOf(word("9", 0, 99f, true)))).substringAfter("تۆ "))
    }
    @Test fun priceAndUnknownConfidencePhoneAreKept() {
        for (number in listOf("5,000", "07765952001")) {
            assertEquals(number, MixedOcrFilter.text(MixedOcrFilter.merge(emptyList(), listOf(word(number, 0, -1f, true)))))
        }
        assertTrue(MixedOcrFilter.merge(emptyList(), listOf(word("92", 0, 70f, true))).isEmpty())
    }
    @Test fun screenshotLatinNameAndProductDoNotNeedKurdishAnchors() {
        val english = listOf(word("Darya", 0, 93f, true), word("Muhamad", 90, 92f, true),
            word("Gimeni", 0, 92f, true, 40), word("Pro", 90, 97f, true, 40))
        assertEquals("Darya Muhamad\nGimeni Pro", MixedOcrFilter.text(MixedOcrFilter.merge(emptyList(), english)))
    }
    @Test fun whollyLatinLogoRowReadsLeftToRightAcrossWideGaps() {
        assertEquals("QiCard FIB FastPay", MixedOcrFilter.text(listOf(word("FastPay", 400, latin = true),
            word("QiCard", 0, latin = true), word("FIB", 220, latin = true))))
    }
    @Test fun unpairedStandaloneBracketFromCheckIconIsDropped() {
        assertEquals("سڵاو", MixedOcrFilter.text(MixedOcrFilter.nativeWords(listOf(word(")", 80), word("سڵاو", 0)))))
        assertEquals("( سڵاو )", MixedOcrFilter.text(MixedOcrFilter.nativeWords(
            listOf(word("(", 160), word("سڵاو", 80), word(")", 0)))))
    }
    @Test fun numberHeavyArtworkNeedsMoreThanWeakTwoLetterGuesses() {
        assertTrue(MixedOcrFilter.nativeWords(listOf(word("ێی", 0, 54f), word("متا", 240, 0f), word("٥٥", 80, 92f), word("٥", 160, 78f))).isEmpty())
        assertFalse(MixedOcrFilter.nativeWords(listOf(word("دینار", 0, 60f), word("5,000", 80, 92f), word("98", 160, 78f))).isEmpty())
    }
}

================================================================================
FILE: app/src/test/java/com/mangatranslator/app/ModelFileDownloadTest.kt
================================================================================

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.rules.TemporaryFolder
import java.io.File
import java.io.IOException
import java.net.InetAddress
import java.net.ServerSocket
import java.net.Socket
import java.io.Closeable
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference

class ModelFileDownloadTest {
    @get:Rule val folder = TemporaryFolder()
    private val data = "model contents".toByteArray()

    private fun serve(handler: (HttpExchange) -> Unit, test: (String) -> Unit) {
        val server = ServerSocket(0, 1, InetAddress.getByName("127.0.0.1"))
        server.soTimeout = 5000
        val failure = AtomicReference<Throwable?>(null)
        val thread = Thread {
            try {
                server.accept().use { socket ->
                    socket.soTimeout = 5000
                    HttpExchange(socket).use(handler)
                }
            } catch (error: Throwable) {
                if (!server.isClosed) failure.set(error)
            }
        }
        thread.start()
        try { test("http://127.0.0.1:${server.localPort}/model") }
        finally {
            server.close()
            thread.join(5000)
        }
        failure.get()?.let { throw AssertionError("Test HTTP server failed", it) }
    }

    // Plain Java sockets keep the tests compatible with Android's compile classpath.
    private class Headers {
        private val values = linkedMapOf<String, String>()
        fun add(name: String, value: String) { values[name.lowercase()] = value }
        fun getFirst(name: String): String? = values[name.lowercase()]
        fun entries() = values.entries
    }

    private class HttpExchange(private val socket: Socket) : Closeable {
        val requestHeaders = Headers()
        val responseHeaders = Headers()
        val responseBody get() = socket.getOutputStream()
        init {
            val reader = socket.getInputStream().bufferedReader(Charsets.US_ASCII)
            check(reader.readLine() != null)
            while (true) {
                val line = reader.readLine() ?: break
                if (line.isEmpty()) break
                val colon = line.indexOf(':')
                if (colon > 0) requestHeaders.add(line.substring(0, colon), line.substring(colon + 1).trim())
            }
        }
        fun sendResponseHeaders(code: Int, length: Long) {
            val headers = buildString {
                append("HTTP/1.1 $code Test\r\nContent-Length: $length\r\nConnection: close\r\n")
                for ((name, value) in responseHeaders.entries()) append("$name: $value\r\n")
                append("\r\n")
            }
            responseBody.write(headers.toByteArray(Charsets.US_ASCII))
        }
        override fun close() { socket.close() }
    }

    private fun HttpExchange.respond(code: Int, body: ByteArray) {
        sendResponseHeaders(code, body.size.toLong())
        responseBody.use { it.write(body) }
    }

    @Test fun resumesFromVerifiedOffset() {
        val dst = File(folder.root, "model")
        File(folder.root, "model.part").writeBytes(data.copyOfRange(0, 5))
        var range: String? = null
        serve({
            range = it.requestHeaders.getFirst("Range")
            it.responseHeaders.add("Content-Range", "bytes 5-${data.lastIndex}/${data.size}")
            it.respond(206, data.copyOfRange(5, data.size))
        }) { url -> ModelFileDownload.fetch(url, dst, data.size.toLong()) {} }
        assertEquals("bytes=5-", range)
        assertArrayEquals(data, dst.readBytes())
        assertFalse(File(folder.root, "model.part").exists())
    }

    @Test fun restartsWhenServerIgnoresRange() {
        val dst = File(folder.root, "model")
        File(folder.root, "model.part").writeText("wrong")
        serve({ it.respond(200, data) }) { url -> ModelFileDownload.fetch(url, dst, data.size.toLong()) {} }
        assertArrayEquals(data, dst.readBytes())
    }

    @Test fun rejectsWrongRangeWithoutChangingExistingFiles() {
        val dst = File(folder.root, "model").apply { writeText("installed") }
        val part = File(folder.root, "model.part").apply { writeText("model") }
        serve({
            it.responseHeaders.add("Content-Range", "bytes 0-${data.lastIndex}/${data.size}")
            it.respond(206, data)
        }) { url ->
            assertThrows(IOException::class.java) { ModelFileDownload.fetch(url, dst, data.size.toLong()) {} }
        }
        assertEquals("model", part.readText())
        assertEquals("installed", dst.readText())
    }

    @Test fun truncatedBodyRemainsResumable() {
        val dst = File(folder.root, "model")
        serve({ it.respond(200, data.copyOfRange(0, 5)) }) { url ->
            assertThrows(IOException::class.java) { ModelFileDownload.fetch(url, dst, data.size.toLong()) {} }
        }
        assertFalse(dst.exists())
        assertEquals(5L, File(folder.root, "model.part").length())
    }

    @Test fun oversizedResponseCannotReplaceInstalledModel() {
        val dst = File(folder.root, "model").apply { writeText("installed") }
        serve({ it.respond(200, ByteArray(100)) }) { url ->
            assertThrows(IOException::class.java) { ModelFileDownload.fetch(url, dst, data.size.toLong()) {} }
        }
        assertEquals("installed", dst.readText())
        assertTrue(File(folder.root, "model.part").length() <= data.size)
    }

    @Test fun completedPartIsPublishedWithoutAnotherNetworkRequest() {
        val dst = File(folder.root, "model")
        File(folder.root, "model.part").writeBytes(data)
        ModelFileDownload.fetch("http://127.0.0.1:1/unreachable", dst, data.size.toLong()) {}
        assertArrayEquals(data, dst.readBytes())
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Test

class NameFilterMarkedTest {
    private val names = NameFilter.parse("John\nSarah\nDr. Smith\nئەحمەد")
    private fun marked(text: String, selected: List<String> = names, strict: Boolean = false) =
        NameFilter.strip(text, selected, strict = strict, followedByMarker = true)

    @Test fun eachRequestedMarkerQualifiesAListedName() {
        for (marker in listOf(":", ",", "؛")) {
            assertEquals("Hello.", marked("John${marker} Hello."))
            assertEquals("Hello.", marked("John${marker}Hello."))
        }
    }
    @Test fun appliesAtStartMiddleAndEndButUnmarkedNamesStay() {
        assertEquals("Tell Sarah to come. John is here.", marked("John: Tell Sarah to come. John is here."))
        assertEquals("I heard hello.", marked("I heard John: hello."))
        assertEquals("Hello.", marked("Hello John؛."))
        assertEquals("John", marked("John"))
    }
    @Test fun aMarkerIsRequiredEvenAtTheStartOrForANameAlone() {
        assertEquals("John went home.", marked("John went home."))
        assertEquals("John.", marked("John."))
        assertEquals("", marked("John:"))
        assertEquals("", marked("John,"))
        assertEquals("", marked("John؛"))
    }
    @Test fun doesNotSilentlyAcceptOtherSeparators() {
        for (marker in listOf("-", "–", "—", "|", ";", "،", "!", "؟")) {
            val text = "John$marker Hello."
            assertEquals(text, marked(text))
        }
    }
    @Test fun supportsSpacesTabsAndUnicodeSpacesBeforeTheMarker() {
        assertEquals("Hello.", marked("John : Hello."))
        assertEquals("Hello.", marked("John\t, Hello."))
        assertEquals("Hello.", marked("John\u00a0؛ Hello."))
    }
    @Test fun unlistedNamesAreNeverRemoved() {
        assertEquals("Alex: Hello Sarah.", marked("Alex: Hello Sarah."))
    }
    @Test fun wordBoundariesAndPossessivesRemainProtected() {
        val text = "Johnson: John2, _John؛ John's: John’s, O'John: hello."
        assertEquals(text, marked(text))
    }
    @Test fun caseMultiwordAndUnicodeNamesWork() {
        assertEquals("hello.", marked("jOhN: hello."))
        assertEquals("Hello.", marked("Dr. Smith: Hello."))
        assertEquals("سڵاو.", marked("ئەحمەد؛ سڵاو."))
    }
    @Test fun ignoresLegacyStrictCheckboxAndHasPriorityOverEverywhereFlag() {
        assertEquals("Tell Sarah hello.", marked("Tell John: Sarah hello.", strict = true))
        assertEquals("John went home.", NameFilter.strip("John went home.", names,
            everywhere = true, followedByMarker = true))
    }
    @Test fun switchingScopesCannotReuseTheWrongCompiledRule() {
        assertEquals("Hello.", NameFilter.strip("Hello John.", names, everywhere = true))
        assertEquals("Hello John.", marked("Hello John."))
        assertEquals("Hello.", marked("Hello John؛."))
        assertEquals("Hello.", NameFilter.strip("Hello John.", names, everywhere = true))
    }
    @Test fun namesEnteredWithATrailingMarkerAreHandledInThisScope() {
        assertEquals("Hello.", marked("John؛ Hello.", NameFilter.parse("John؛")))
        assertEquals("John is here.", marked("John is here.", NameFilter.parse("John؛")))
    }
    @Test fun literalRegexCharactersAndRepeatedLabelsWork() {
        assertEquals("Hello AAB: there.", marked("A+B: Hello AAB: there.", listOf("A+B")))
        assertEquals("Hello.", marked("John: Sarah, John؛ Hello."))
        assertEquals("", marked("John: Sarah, ئەحمەد؛"))
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Test

class NameFilterScopeTest {
    private val names = NameFilter.parse("John\nAlex\nSarah")
    private fun all(text: String, chosen: List<String> = names, strict: Boolean = false) =
        NameFilter.strip(text, chosen, strict, everywhere = true)

    @Test fun defaultModeStillKeepsNamesInsideAndAtTheEnd() {
        assertEquals("Tell Sarah to call Alex.", NameFilter.strip("John: Tell Sarah to call Alex.", names))
    }
    @Test fun startModeNeverContinuesRemovingNamesAfterSpeakerSeparator() {
        assertEquals("Sarah is here.", NameFilter.strip("John: Sarah is here.", names))
        assertEquals("Sarah is here.", NameFilter.strip("John - Sarah is here.", names))
    }
    @Test fun everywhereRemovesStartMiddleAndEnd() {
        assertEquals("Tell to call.", all("John: Tell Sarah to call Alex."))
    }
    @Test fun everyOccurrenceIsRemovedWithoutMatchingPartOfAWord() {
        assertEquals("Johnson told Johnny that John2 and _John are here.",
            all("John: Johnson told Johnny that John2 and _John are here."))
        assertEquals("and are here.", all("John and John are here."))
    }
    @Test fun possessivesAndNamesEmbeddedInApostropheWordsStayIntact() {
        assertEquals("John's book and John’s pen belong to O'John.",
            all("John's book and John’s pen belong to O'John."))
    }
    @Test fun caseIsIgnoredEverywhere() {
        assertEquals("Come with and.", all("Come with JOHN and sArAh."))
    }
    @Test fun fullMultiwordNamesMatchBeforeSentenceSplitting() {
        val chosen = NameFilter.parse("Smith\nDr. Smith")
        assertEquals("I met and today.", all("I met Dr. Smith and Smith today.", chosen))
    }
    @Test fun regexCharactersInANameAreLiteral() {
        assertEquals("Call and keep AAB.", all("Call A+B and keep AAB.", listOf("A+B")))
    }
    @Test fun unicodeNamesUseUnicodeWordBoundaries() {
        assertEquals("سڵاو و ئەحمەدی و ئەحمەد٢.",
            all("سڵاو ئەحمەد و ئەحمەدی و ئەحمەد٢.", listOf("ئەحمەد")))
    }
    @Test fun namesOnlyAndPunctuationOnlyRemaindersBecomeEmpty() {
        assertEquals("", all("John, Sarah, Alex."))
        assertEquals("", all("(John)"))
        assertEquals("", all("John: Alex!"))
    }
    @Test fun punctuationAndEmptyNameBracketsAreCleaned() {
        assertEquals("Hello!", all("Hello, John!"))
        assertEquals("Hello!", all("Hello (John)!"))
        assertEquals("My friends.", all("My friends John, Sarah, Alex."))
        assertEquals("Hello!", all("Hello 'John'!"))
    }
    @Test fun strictCheckboxDoesNotLimitEverywhereMode() {
        assertEquals("Tell to come.", all("Tell John to come.", strict = true))
        assertEquals("Tell John to come.", NameFilter.strip("Tell John to come.", names, strict = true))
    }
    @Test fun multipleLinesAndSentencesAreHandled() {
        assertEquals("Hello. How are you?", all("John: Hello.\nSarah: How are you Alex?"))
    }
    @Test fun editedNameListsReplaceTheCompiledMatcher() {
        assertEquals("Tell Sarah.", all("Tell John Sarah.", listOf("John")))
        assertEquals("Tell John.", all("Tell John Sarah.", listOf("Sarah")))
        assertEquals("Tell Sarah.", all("Tell John Sarah.", listOf("John")))
    }
    @Test fun noMatchOrEmptyNamesNeverAlterTheInput() {
        val text = "  Johnson: stay here.\nKeep this line.  "
        assertEquals(text, all(text))
        assertEquals(text, all(text, emptyList()))
        assertEquals(text, all(text, listOf("", " ")))
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Test

class NameFilterTest {

    private val john = listOf("John")

    @Test fun parseTrimsDedupesAndSortsLongestFirst() {
        val l = NameFilter.parse("John:\n sarah \nJOHN\n\nMr Smith")
        assertEquals(listOf("mr smith", "sarah", "john"), l.map { it.lowercase() })
    }

    @Test fun nameAtSentenceStartWithColonIsRemoved() {
        assertEquals("Where are you going?", NameFilter.strip("John: Where are you going?", john))
    }

    @Test fun nameInsideTheSentenceIsKept() {
        assertEquals("Where is John going?", NameFilter.strip("Where is John going?", john))
    }

    @Test fun longerWordsAndPossessivesAreNotTheName() {
        assertEquals("Johnson went home.", NameFilter.strip("Johnson went home.", john))
        assertEquals("John's car is red.", NameFilter.strip("John's car is red.", john))
    }

    @Test fun eachSentenceStartIsChecked() {
        assertEquals("Hello there. How are you?", NameFilter.strip("Hello there. John: How are you?", john))
    }

    @Test fun nameAloneDisappears() {
        assertEquals("", NameFilter.strip("John", john))
        assertEquals("Where?", NameFilter.strip("John. Where?", john))
    }

    @Test fun caseDoesNotMatter() {
        assertEquals("hello", NameFilter.strip("john, hello", john))
    }

    @Test fun literalModeRemovesEvenWithoutSeparator() {
        assertEquals("went home", NameFilter.strip("John went home", john, strict = false))
    }

    @Test fun strictModeNeedsASeparatorOrNameAlone() {
        assertEquals("John went home", NameFilter.strip("John went home", john, strict = true))
        assertEquals("hi", NameFilter.strip("John: hi", john, strict = true))
        assertEquals("", NameFilter.strip("John", john, strict = true))
    }

    @Test fun multiWordNamesWork() {
        assertEquals("Good morning", NameFilter.strip("Mr Smith: Good morning", listOf("Mr Smith")))
    }

    @Test fun twoNamesInARowAreBothRemoved() {
        assertEquals("hi", NameFilter.strip("John Mary: hi", listOf("Mary", "John")))
    }

    @Test fun noNamesMeansNoChange() {
        assertEquals("John: hi", NameFilter.strip("John: hi", emptyList()))
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class OcrGateTest {

    private fun run(
        first: Boolean = false, settled: Boolean = false, sinceChange: Long = 0, sinceOcr: Long = 10_000,
        busy: Boolean = false, kurdish: Boolean = false
    ) = OcrGate.shouldRun(first, settled, sinceChange, sinceOcr, busy, kurdish)

    @Test fun firstOcrRunsImmediatelyEvenIfNotSettled() {
        assertTrue(run(first = true, settled = false, sinceChange = 0, sinceOcr = 0))
    }

    @Test fun busyOcrNeverRunsTwice() {
        assertFalse(run(first = true, busy = true))
        assertFalse(run(settled = true, busy = true))
    }

    @Test fun settledRegionRunsAfterGap() {
        assertTrue(run(settled = true, sinceOcr = 300))
        assertFalse(run(settled = true, sinceOcr = 100))      // < ٢٢٠ms
    }

    @Test fun movingBackgroundIsForcedAfterForceMs() {
        assertFalse(run(settled = false, sinceChange = 300))
        assertTrue(run(settled = false, sinceChange = 450))
    }

    @Test fun kurdishIsFaster() {
        assertTrue(run(settled = false, sinceChange = 250, kurdish = true))
        assertFalse(run(settled = false, sinceChange = 250, kurdish = false))
        assertTrue(run(settled = true, sinceOcr = 150, kurdish = true))
        assertFalse(run(settled = true, sinceOcr = 150, kurdish = false))
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class OrderedReleaseTest {

    @Test fun inOrderItemsAreReleasedImmediately() {
        val r = OrderedRelease<String>()
        assertEquals(listOf("a"), r.put(0, "a"))
        assertEquals(listOf("b"), r.put(1, "b"))
    }

    @Test fun outOfOrderItemsWaitForTheMissingOne() {
        val r = OrderedRelease<String>()
        assertEquals(emptyList<String>(), r.put(1, "b"))
        assertEquals(emptyList<String>(), r.put(2, "c"))
        assertTrue(r.hasGap())
        assertEquals(listOf("a", "b", "c"), r.put(0, "a"))
        assertFalse(r.hasGap())
    }

    @Test fun stuckItemDoesNotBlockLaterOnesForever() {
        val r = OrderedRelease<String>()
        assertEquals(emptyList<String>(), r.put(1, "later"))     // ٠ بەستراوە
        assertTrue(r.hasGap())
        assertEquals(listOf("later"), r.skipGap())               // دوای timeout: ٠ دەپەڕێنرێت
        assertFalse(r.hasGap())
    }

    @Test fun skippedItemIsNotLostWhenItArrivesLate() {
        val r = OrderedRelease<String>()
        r.put(1, "later")
        r.skipGap()
        assertEquals(listOf("late-zero"), r.put(0, "late-zero")) // درەنگ هات: هێشتا دەنووسرێت و دەخوێنرێتەوە
    }

    @Test fun everyItemIsReleasedExactlyOnce() {
        val r = OrderedRelease<Int>()
        val out = ArrayList<Int>()
        // ڕیزبەندی تێکەڵ + یەک ونبوو کە دواتر دێت
        for (o in listOf(3, 1, 4, 2)) out.addAll(r.put(o, o))
        out.addAll(r.skipGap())          // ٠ ونە ← ١..٤ ئازاد دەبن
        out.addAll(r.put(0, 0))          // ٠ درەنگ
        assertEquals(listOf(1, 2, 3, 4, 0), out)
        assertEquals(5, out.toSet().size)
    }

    @Test fun skipGapWithoutGapDoesNothing() {
        val r = OrderedRelease<String>()
        assertEquals(emptyList<String>(), r.skipGap())
        r.put(0, "a")
        assertEquals(emptyList<String>(), r.skipGap())
        assertEquals(1, r.nextOrder())
    }

    @Test fun multipleGapsAreSkippedOneAtATime() {
        val r = OrderedRelease<String>()
        r.put(2, "c")                       // ٠ و ١ هەردووکیان ونن
        assertTrue(r.hasGap())
        assertEquals(emptyList<String>(), r.skipGap())   // ٠ پەڕێنرا، ١ هێشتا ونە
        assertTrue(r.hasGap())
        assertEquals(listOf("c"), r.skipGap())           // ١ پەڕێنرا ← ٢ ئازاد بوو
        assertFalse(r.hasGap())
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.json.JSONObject
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class PiperModelConfigTest {
    @Test fun exportedReferenceConfigSelectsItsEncoderAndExactScales() {
        val text = checkNotNull(javaClass.getResourceAsStream("/reference-voice-config.json"))
            .bufferedReader().use { it.readText() }
        val config = PiperModelConfig.inference(JSONObject(text))
        assertTrue(config.referenceVoice)
        assertTrue(config.blankInterleaved)
        assertTrue(config.useModelTiming)
        assertEquals(0.3f, config.noise, 0f)
        assertEquals(0.3f, config.durationNoise, 0f)
        assertEquals(1f, config.length, 0f)
    }
    @Test fun originalPiperRetainsItsTuning() {
        val config = PiperModelConfig.inference(JSONObject("""{"inference":{"noise_scale":0.8,"noise_w":0.9,"length_scale":1.2}}"""))
        assertFalse(config.referenceVoice)
        assertFalse(config.blankInterleaved)
        assertEquals(0.4f, config.noise, 0f)
        assertEquals(0.55f, config.durationNoise, 0f)
        assertEquals(1.2f * 1.08f, config.length, 0f)
    }
    @Test fun previousTrainedModelsKeepTheirEncodingAndTiming() {
        val config = PiperModelConfig.inference(JSONObject("""{"sequence_style":"blank_interleaved","use_model_timing":true}"""))
        assertTrue(config.blankInterleaved)
        assertTrue(config.useModelTiming)
        assertFalse(config.referenceVoice)
        assertEquals(1f, config.length, 0f)
    }
    @Test fun missingConfigDoesNotRetainThePreviousModelsScales() {
        val config = PiperModelConfig.inference(JSONObject())
        assertEquals(0.4f, config.noise, 0f)
        assertEquals(0.55f, config.durationNoise, 0f)
        assertEquals(1.08f, config.length, 0f)
    }
    @Test fun malformedReferenceScalesFallBackToSafeDefaults() {
        val j = JSONObject().put("format", PiperModelConfig.REFERENCE_FORMAT)
            .put("inference", JSONObject().put("noise_scale", "NaN")
                .put("noise_w", -1).put("length_scale", 100))
        val config = PiperModelConfig.inference(j)
        assertEquals(0.3f, config.noise, 0f)
        assertEquals(0.3f, config.durationNoise, 0f)
        assertEquals(1f, config.length, 0f)
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class PiperPcmQueueTest {
    @Test(timeout = 1000) fun fullQueueCannotLoseCompletionOrAudio() {
        val q = PiperPcmQueue(3)
        val clips = List(3) { floatArrayOf(it.toFloat()) }
        clips.forEach { assertTrue(q.offer(it, 0)) }
        q.finish()
        assertFalse(q.isDrained)
        clips.forEach { assertSame(it, q.poll(0)) }
        assertTrue(q.isDrained)
        assertNull(q.poll(0))
    }
    @Test fun idleConsumerReceivesCompletionWithNoAudio() {
        val q = PiperPcmQueue()
        q.finish()
        assertNull(q.poll(0))
        assertTrue(q.isDrained)
    }
    @Test fun temporaryEmptyQueueDoesNotMeanEndOfSpeech() {
        val q = PiperPcmQueue()
        assertNull(q.poll(0))
        assertFalse(q.isDrained)
        val clip = floatArrayOf(.1f)
        q.offer(clip, 0)
        assertSame(clip, q.poll(0))
        assertFalse(q.isDrained)
    }
}
