package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class PiperPlaybackProgressTest {
    @Test fun fullBufferWithFrozenHeadTimesOut() {
        val p = PiperPlaybackProgress(100)
        assertTrue(p.update(0, 200, true, 0))
        assertTrue(p.update(0, 200, true, 99))
        assertFalse(p.update(0, 200, true, 100))
    }
    @Test fun realPlaybackProgressResetsTheStallDeadline() {
        val p = PiperPlaybackProgress(100)
        p.update(0, 200, true, 0)
        assertTrue(p.update(50, 200, true, 90))
        assertTrue(p.update(100, 200, true, 180))
        assertFalse(p.update(100, 200, true, 280))
    }
    @Test fun synthesizingNextChunkDoesNotCountAsAnAudioStall() {
        val p = PiperPlaybackProgress(100)
        p.update(100, 100, true, 0)
        assertTrue(p.update(100, 100, true, 10_000))
        assertTrue(p.update(100, 200, true, 10_001))
        assertTrue(p.update(150, 200, true, 10_050))
    }
    @Test fun notPlayingHasNoFalseBufferTimeout() {
        val p = PiperPlaybackProgress(100)
        assertTrue(p.update(0, 200, false, 0))
        assertTrue(p.update(0, 200, false, 10_000))
        assertTrue(p.update(0, 200, true, 10_001))
    }
    @Test fun headPositionIsUnsignedAndWrapsWithoutAFalseFinish() {
        val p = PiperPlaybackProgress(100)
        val total = (1L shl 32) + 100
        assertTrue(p.update(-16, total, true, 0))
        assertEquals((1L shl 32) - 16, p.playedFrames)
        assertTrue(p.update(16, total, true, 50))
        assertEquals((1L shl 32) + 16, p.playedFrames)
    }
    @Test fun aSmallBackwardsCounterCannotClaimMorePlayback() {
        val p = PiperPlaybackProgress(100)
        p.update(100, 200, true, 0)
        assertTrue(p.update(90, 200, true, 99))
        assertEquals(100, p.playedFrames)
        assertFalse(p.update(90, 200, true, 100))
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class PiperShortSpeechTest {
    private val rate = 22050
    private fun signal() = FloatArray(2205) { if (it % 2 == 0) .1f else -.1f }

    @Test fun singleWordReturnsImmediatelyWithoutFillerOrMinimumDuration() {
        for (word in listOf("نا", "من", "باشە", "سڵاو", "سوپاس")) {
            val attempted = mutableListOf<String>()
            val audio = signal()
            val result = PiperShortSpeech.render("$word.", word, rate,
                synthesize = { attempted += it; audio }, polish = { it })
            assertSame(audio, result)
            assertEquals(listOf("$word."), attempted)
        }
    }
    @Test fun silentOutputRetriesPunctuationOnly() {
        val attempted = mutableListOf<String>()
        val result = PiperShortSpeech.render("نا.", "نا", rate,
            synthesize = { attempted += it; if (attempted.size == 1) FloatArray(rate * 5) else signal() },
            polish = { it })
        assertTrue(PcmSignal.hasSignal(result, rate))
        assertEquals(listOf("نا.", " نا ."), attempted)
    }
    @Test fun allFailedVariantsReturnEmptyForExistingFallback() {
        var calls = 0
        val result = PiperShortSpeech.render("نا.", "نا", rate,
            synthesize = { calls++; FloatArray(rate) }, polish = { it })
        assertTrue(result.isEmpty())
        assertEquals(4, calls)
    }
    @Test fun nullSynthesisIsRetriedAndPolishingSilenceIsNotAccepted() {
        var calls = 0
        val result = PiperShortSpeech.render("نا.", "نا", rate,
            synthesize = { if (++calls == 1) null else signal() }, polish = { FloatArray(rate) })
        assertTrue(result.isEmpty())
        assertEquals(4, calls)
    }
    @Test fun silenceAndInvalidPcmAreRejectedRegardlessOfDuration() {
        assertFalse(PcmSignal.hasSignal(FloatArray(rate * 5), rate))
        assertFalse(PcmSignal.hasSignal(FloatArray(rate) { Float.NaN }, rate))
        assertFalse(PcmSignal.hasSignal(FloatArray(rate) { Float.POSITIVE_INFINITY }, rate))
        assertFalse(PcmSignal.hasSignal(FloatArray(rate) { 1e-7f }, rate))
        assertFalse(PcmSignal.hasSignal(signal(), 0))
        assertTrue(PcmSignal.hasSignal(signal(), rate))
    }
    @Test fun singleClickDoesNotCountAsSpeech() {
        val click = FloatArray(rate).apply { this[0] = 1f }
        assertFalse(PcmSignal.hasSignal(click, rate))
    }
    @Test fun shortAudioFitsNativeBufferWithoutAddingSpokenWords() {
        assertEquals(4410, PiperPlayback.bufferBytes(4096, rate, 2205))
        assertEquals(4096, PiperPlayback.bufferBytes(4096, rate, 100))
        val pcm = shortArrayOf(11, 22, 33)
        assertArrayEquals(shortArrayOf(11, 22, 33, 0, 0), PiperPlayback.fillFirstBuffer(pcm, 5))
        assertSame(pcm, PiperPlayback.fillFirstBuffer(pcm, 3))
    }
    @Test fun longAudioKeepsTheOriginalBufferSize() {
        assertEquals(rate * 4, PiperPlayback.bufferBytes(4096, rate, rate * 5))
        val pcm = ShortArray(rate * 5)
        assertSame(pcm, PiperPlayback.fillFirstBuffer(pcm, rate * 2))
    }
    @Test fun dcOffsetIsNotMistakenForQuietSpeech() {
        assertFalse(PcmSignal.hasSignal(FloatArray(rate) { .01f }, rate))
        assertTrue(PcmSignal.hasSignal(FloatArray(rate) { i -> .01f + if (i % 2 == 0) .001f else -.001f }, rate))
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test
import kotlin.math.*

class PiperSpeechTimingTest {
    @Test fun userParagraphRetainsEveryWordWithinModelLimits() {
        val text=checkNotNull(javaClass.getResourceAsStream("/latency-example.txt"))
            .bufferedReader().use { it.readText() }
        val chunks=PiperSpeechTiming.chunks(text)
        assertTrue(chunks.isNotEmpty())
        assertTrue(chunks.first().length<=PiperSpeechTiming.FIRST_LIMIT)
        assertTrue(chunks.all { it.length<=PiperSpeechTiming.STEADY_LIMIT })
        assertEquals(text.trim().replace(Regex("\\s+")," "),chunks.joinToString(" "))
        assertTrue(chunks.none { it.isBlank() })
    }
    @Test fun firstPhraseIsShortButFollowingPhrasesDoNotBreakEveryEightyCharacters() {
        val text=List(60) { "هاوڕێ" }.joinToString(" ")
        val chunks=PiperSpeechTiming.chunks(text)
        assertTrue(chunks.first().length<=40)
        assertTrue(chunks.drop(1).any { it.length>100 })
        assertEquals(text,chunks.joinToString(" "))
    }
    @Test fun commasDoNotCauseRepeatedTinyChunks() {
        val text="هاوڕێ، "+List(28) { "باشە،" }.joinToString(" ")
        val chunks=PiperSpeechTiming.chunks(text)
        assertTrue(chunks.first().length>=28)
        assertTrue(chunks.drop(1).dropLast(1).all { it.length>=80 })
    }
    @Test fun pausesFollowSentenceBoundariesRatherThanLength() {
        for (low in listOf(false,true)) {
            for (end in listOf("", " ", "\n", ":", "؛")) {
                assertEquals(0,PiperSpeechTiming.pauseMs("ئەو کارە$end",low))
            }
            for (mark in listOf('.', '،', '؟', '!', '٫', ',', '?')) {
                assertEquals(20,PiperSpeechTiming.pauseMs("ئەو کارە$mark  ",low))
            }
        }
    }
    @Test fun technicalSplitsWithoutPunctuationHaveNoAddedPause() {
        val chunks=PiperSpeechTiming.chunks(List(60) { "هاوڕێ" }.joinToString(" "))
        assertTrue(chunks.size>1)
        assertTrue(chunks.all { PiperSpeechTiming.pauseMs(it,false)==0 })
    }
    @Test fun lineBreaksDoNotIntroduceAnExtraPause() {
        val chunks=PiperSpeechTiming.chunks("هاوڕێ\nچۆنی\nباشە")
        assertEquals(listOf("هاوڕێ چۆنی باشە"),chunks)
        assertTrue(chunks.all { PiperSpeechTiming.pauseMs(it,false)==0 })
    }
    @Test fun edgeTrimmingKeepsInternalPauseAndQuietConsonants() {
        val rate=16000
        val speech=FloatArray(rate) { i -> if(i in 6400..8000) 0f else (.1*sin(2*PI*200*i/rate)).toFloat() }
        // Quiet onset and offset are above the RMS activity threshold.
        for(i in 0 until 800) { speech[i]*=.03f;speech[speech.lastIndex-i]*=.03f }
        val input=FloatArray(4000)+speech+FloatArray(8000)
        val output=PiperSpeechTiming.trimEdges(input,rate)
        assertTrue(output.size<input.size)
        assertTrue(output.size>=speech.size)
        val offset=output.indexOfFirst { abs(it)>1e-5f }
        assertTrue(offset>=0)
        // A complete copy of the original speech, including the pause, must remain.
        val start=output.size-speech.size-640
        assertTrue(start>=0)
        assertArrayEquals(speech,output.copyOfRange(start,start+speech.size),0f)
    }
    @Test fun emptyOrSilentInputDoesNotBecomeAnInvalidBuffer() {
        assertEquals(0,PiperSpeechTiming.trimEdges(floatArrayOf(),16000).size)
        assertArrayEquals(FloatArray(800),PiperSpeechTiming.trimEdges(FloatArray(800),16000),0f)
        assertTrue(PiperSpeechTiming.chunks(" \n ").isEmpty())
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test
import org.json.JSONObject

class PiperTextEncodingTest {
    private val letters = mapOf("س" to 3L, "ڵ" to 4L, "ا" to 5L, "و" to 6L, "ئ" to 16L, "ە" to 1L, "ک" to 10L)
    @Test fun originalPiperIdsRemainUnchanged() {
        val m = letters + mapOf("^" to 1L, "$" to 2L, "_" to 0L)
        assertArrayEquals(longArrayOf(1,3,0,4,0,5,0,6,0,2), PiperTextEncoding.encode("سڵاو", m, false))
    }
    @Test fun mmsMatchesBlankInterleavingWithoutAnExtraEos() {
        val m = letters + mapOf("_" to 0L)
        assertArrayEquals(longArrayOf(0,3,0,4,0,5,0,6,0), PiperTextEncoding.encode("سڵاو", m, true))
    }
    @Test fun nfcKeepsKurdishHamzaCharacterForNewModel() {
        assertArrayEquals(longArrayOf(0,16,0,1,0), PiperTextEncoding.encode("ئە", letters, true))
    }
    @Test fun legacyStillSupportsDecomposedPhonemeIds() {
        val m = mapOf("^" to 1L, "$" to 2L, "_" to 0L, "ي" to 7L, "ٔ" to 8L, "ە" to 9L)
        assertArrayEquals(longArrayOf(1,7,0,8,0,9,0,2), PiperTextEncoding.encode("ئە", m, false))
    }
    @Test fun scriptNormalizationAndNoSpeechInputsRemainSafe() {
        assertArrayEquals(longArrayOf(0,10,0), PiperTextEncoding.encode("ك", letters, true))
        assertNull(PiperTextEncoding.encode("xyz", letters, true))
    }

    private fun referenceMap(): Map<String, Long> {
        val text = checkNotNull(javaClass.getResourceAsStream("/reference-voice-config.json"))
            .bufferedReader().use { it.readText() }
        val map = JSONObject(text).getJSONObject("phoneme_id_map")
        return map.keys().asSequence().associateWith { map.getJSONArray(it).getLong(0) }
    }
    @Test fun referenceVoiceMatchesExportedIdsIncludingHamzaAndKaf() {
        assertArrayEquals(longArrayOf(0,16,0,1,0,10,0),
            PiperTextEncoding.encode("ئەک", referenceMap(), true, true))
    }
    @Test fun referencePunctuationSeparatesWordsInsteadOfJoiningThem() {
        assertArrayEquals(longArrayOf(0,15,0,32,0,2,0,5,0,37,0,16,0,1,0),
            PiperTextEncoding.encode("  سڵاو،\n\tئە  ", referenceMap(), true, true))
    }
    @Test fun referenceCombiningHamzaAndArabicScriptVariantsAreHandled() {
        assertArrayEquals(PiperTextEncoding.encode("ئەک", referenceMap(), true, true),
            PiperTextEncoding.encode("ي\u0654ەك", referenceMap(), true, true))
    }
    @Test fun referenceSpecialTokensAndUnsupportedTextAreNotSpeech() {
        assertNull(PiperTextEncoding.encode("^\$_| 123 😀", referenceMap(), true, true))
    }
}

FILE: app/src/test/java/com/mangatranslator/app/PreparedResourceTest.kt

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test
import java.util.concurrent.*
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger

class PreparedResourceTest {
    private class Resource { var warm=0; var disposed=0 }

    @Test fun repeatedPreparationSchedulesOneResourceAndDoesNoWarmupOnCaller() {
        val tasks=ArrayList<()->Unit>();var created=0
        val pool=PreparedResource<Resource> { it.disposed++ }
        fun prepare()=pool.preload("female#1",{created++;Resource()},{it.warm++},{tasks.add(it)})
        val a=prepare();val b=prepare()
        assertSame(a,b);assertEquals(1,created);assertEquals(1,tasks.size);assertEquals(0,a.warm)
        tasks.single().invoke();assertEquals(1,a.warm)
    }
    @Test fun transferOfWarmEngineDoesNotLoadAgainOrCloseTheReadersResource() {
        val tasks=ArrayList<()->Unit>();val pool=PreparedResource<Resource> {it.disposed++}
        val original=pool.preload("female#1",{Resource()},{it.warm++},{tasks.add(it)})
        tasks.single().invoke()
        val reader=pool.take("female#1") {fail("Duplicate model load");Resource()}
        assertSame(original,reader)
        pool.clear();pool.expire(original)
        assertEquals(1,reader.warm);assertEquals(0,reader.disposed)
    }
    @Test fun immediateActivationSkipsAQueuedDummyWarmup() {
        val tasks=ArrayList<()->Unit>();val pool=PreparedResource<Resource> {it.disposed++}
        val original=pool.preload("female#1",{Resource()},{it.warm++},{tasks.add(it)})
        assertSame(original,pool.take("female#1") {Resource()})
        tasks.single().invoke()
        assertEquals(0,original.warm);assertEquals(0,original.disposed)
    }
    @Test fun changingModelRejectsTheOtherModelsPreparedEngine() {
        val tasks=ArrayList<()->Unit>();val pool=PreparedResource<Resource> {it.disposed++}
        val old=pool.preload("original#1",{Resource()},{it.warm++},{tasks.add(it)})
        val selected=pool.take("female#1") {Resource()}
        assertNotSame(old,selected);assertEquals(1,old.disposed)
        tasks.single().invoke();assertEquals(0,old.warm)
    }
    @Test fun aNewImportEpochInvalidatesThePreparedModel() {
        val tasks=ArrayList<()->Unit>();val pool=PreparedResource<Resource> {it.disposed++}
        val old=pool.preload("female#1",{Resource()},{it.warm++},{tasks.add(it)})
        val fresh=pool.preload("female#2",{Resource()},{it.warm++},{tasks.add(it)})
        tasks.forEach {it()}
        assertEquals(1,old.disposed);assertEquals(0,old.warm);assertEquals(1,fresh.warm)
    }
    @Test fun memoryPressureCancelsUnusedPreparationExactlyOnce() {
        val tasks=ArrayList<()->Unit>();val pool=PreparedResource<Resource> {it.disposed++}
        val unused=pool.preload("female#1",{Resource()},{it.warm++},{tasks.add(it)})
        pool.clear();pool.clear();tasks.single().invoke()
        assertEquals(1,unused.disposed);assertEquals(0,unused.warm)
    }
    @Test fun aStaleExpiryCannotCloseTheNewModel() {
        val pool=PreparedResource<Resource> {it.disposed++}
        val old=pool.preload("original#1",{Resource()},{},{it()})
        val fresh=pool.preload("female#1",{Resource()},{},{it()})
        pool.expire(old)
        assertSame(fresh,pool.take("female#1") {Resource()})
        assertEquals(0,fresh.disposed)
    }
    @Test fun schedulingFailureDisposesTheUnclaimedResource() {
        val pool=PreparedResource<Resource> {it.disposed++};val value=Resource()
        assertThrows(RejectedExecutionException::class.java) {
            pool.preload("female#1",{value},{},{throw RejectedExecutionException()})
        }
        assertEquals(1,value.disposed)
        assertNotSame(value,pool.take("female#1") {Resource()})
    }
    @Test fun simultaneousUiCallbacksDoNotCreateDuplicateWarmups() {
        val created=AtomicInteger();val scheduled=AtomicInteger()
        val pool=PreparedResource<Resource> {it.disposed++}
        val start=CountDownLatch(1);val workers=Executors.newFixedThreadPool(8)
        try {
            val results=(1..8).map {workers.submit<Resource> {
                start.await()
                pool.preload("female#1",{created.incrementAndGet();Resource()},{},{scheduled.incrementAndGet()})
            }}
            start.countDown();val values=results.map {it.get(5,TimeUnit.SECONDS)}
            assertEquals(1,created.get());assertEquals(1,scheduled.get())
            assertTrue(values.all {it===values.first()})
        } finally {workers.shutdownNow()}
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class ReadOnceTest {

    private val norm: (String) -> String = { s -> s.lowercase().filter { it.isLetterOrDigit() } }
    private val sim: (String, String) -> Boolean = { a, b -> a == b }

    private fun strip(text: String, vararg handled: String) =
        ReadOnce.strip(text, handled.toList(), norm, sim)

    @Test fun nextSentenceWrittenWithPreviousOnlyKeepsTheNewPart() {
        val r = strip("Where are you going? I will come with you.", "Where are you going?")
        assertTrue(r.stripped)
        assertEquals("I will come with you.", r.text)
    }

    @Test fun growingSubtitleKeepsOnlyTheNewWords() {
        val r = strip("Hello everyone welcome back", "Hello everyone")
        assertEquals("welcome back", r.text)
    }

    @Test fun punctuationAndCaseDoNotMatter() {
        val r = strip("WHERE ARE YOU GOING I will come", "where are you going?")
        assertTrue(r.stripped)
        assertEquals("I will come", r.text)
    }

    @Test fun twoHandledSentencesAreBothStripped() {
        val r = strip("First sentence here. Second sentence there. Third one new.", "First sentence here.", "Second sentence there.")
        assertEquals("Third one new.", r.text)
        assertEquals(2, r.matched.size)
    }

    @Test fun everythingAlreadyReadLeavesNothing() {
        val r = strip("Where are you going? I will come with you.", "Where are you going?", "I will come with you.")
        assertTrue(r.stripped)
        assertEquals("", r.text)
    }

    @Test fun unrelatedTextIsUntouched() {
        val r = strip("A completely different line", "Where are you going?")
        assertFalse(r.stripped)
        assertEquals("A completely different line", r.text)
    }

    @Test fun onlyThePrefixIsStrippedNotTheMiddle() {
        val r = strip("Then he asked where are you going again", "where are you going")
        assertFalse(r.stripped)
    }

    @Test fun veryShortPreviousTextIsNeverStripped() {
        val r = strip("Yes I did it yesterday", "Yes")
        assertFalse(r.stripped)
        assertEquals("Yes I did it yesterday", r.text)
    }

    @Test fun nothingHandledMeansNothingStripped() {
        assertFalse(strip("Some new line of text").stripped)
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Test

class ReadingOrderTest {

    private data class B(val id: String, val top: Int, val left: Int)

    private fun order(items: List<B>, rtl: Boolean) =
        ReadingOrder.sort(items, frameH = 1200, rtl = rtl, top = { it.top }, left = { it.left }).map { it.id }

    @Test fun rowsComeTopToBottom() {
        val items = listOf(B("low", 600, 0), B("high", 50, 900), B("mid", 300, 400))
        assertEquals(listOf("high", "mid", "low"), order(items, rtl = false))
        assertEquals(listOf("high", "mid", "low"), order(items, rtl = true))
    }

    @Test fun sameRowIsLeftToRightByDefault() {
        val items = listOf(B("right", 50, 700), B("left", 60, 100), B("mid", 40, 400))
        assertEquals(listOf("left", "mid", "right"), order(items, rtl = false))
    }

    @Test fun sameRowIsRightToLeftWhenRtl() {
        val items = listOf(B("right", 50, 700), B("left", 60, 100), B("mid", 40, 400))
        assertEquals(listOf("right", "mid", "left"), order(items, rtl = true))
    }

    @Test fun nextRowAlwaysAfterPreviousRow() {
        // 90 → ڕیزی ٠ ، 150 → ڕیزی ١ (frameH=1200 ← هەر ڕیزێک ١٠٠پیکسێل)
        val items = listOf(B("row1", 150, 0), B("row0", 90, 999))
        assertEquals(listOf("row0", "row1"), order(items, rtl = false))
    }

    @Test fun emptyAndZeroHeightAreSafe() {
        assertEquals(emptyList<String>(), order(emptyList(), rtl = false))
        val r = ReadingOrder.sort(listOf(B("a", 5, 1)), frameH = 0, top = { it.top }, left = { it.left })
        assertEquals(1, r.size)
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class RegionReadPolicyTest {
    companion object {
        const val FIRST = "سڵاو لە تۆش برام، نامە بنێرە ئێمە وەک Nwebeen نوێبین نمونەی ئەپ و ERP پێشترمان هەیە و ERPNext بەکارئەهێنین"
        const val SECOND = "سڵاوی خواتان لێبێ هاوڕێیان\nپێویستم بە پڕۆگرامەری زۆر شارەزاهەیە بۆ دروستکردنی سیستەمێکی ERP و ئەپێک.\nتەنها نمونەی کاری جوان بێ …کێشەی نرخم نییە .\nبێزەحمەت لە کۆمێنت profolio خۆتان دانێن با نمونەی کارەکانتان ببینم"
    }
    @Test fun bothReportedPostsAreNativeWithEveryLatinTermIntact() {
        for (text in listOf(FIRST, SECOND)) {
            assertTrue(RegionReadPolicy.isSorani(text))
            assertEquals(setOf(0), RegionReadPolicy.nativeIndices(listOf(text)))
            assertEquals(text, RegionReadPolicy.visionText(text, "وەرگێڕانی هەڵە"))
        }
    }
    @Test fun separateProductBoxesBelongToTheirSoraniParagraph() {
        val lines = listOf("ئێمە نمونەی ئەپ پێشترمان هەیە", "ERP", "ERPNext", "Nwebeen", "و بەکاری دەهێنین")
        assertEquals(lines.indices.toSet(), RegionReadPolicy.nativeIndices(lines))
    }
    @Test fun separateLowercasePortfolioTermIsKept() {
        assertEquals(setOf(0, 1, 2), RegionReadPolicy.nativeIndices(listOf("خۆتان دانێن با نمونەی کارەکانتان ببینم", "profolio", "سڵاو هاوڕێیان")))
    }
    @Test fun anIndependentEnglishParagraphStillRequiresTranslation() {
        val lines = listOf("سڵاو هاوڕێ", "I need an experienced programmer to build a new application for my business.")
        assertEquals(setOf(0), RegionReadPolicy.nativeIndices(lines))
    }
    @Test fun englishOnlyAndArabicOnlyAreNotTreatedAsNativeSorani() {
        assertFalse(RegionReadPolicy.isSorani("ERPNext is an ERP application"))
        assertFalse(RegionReadPolicy.isSorani("مرحبا بكم نحتاج إلى برنامج جديد"))
        assertTrue(RegionReadPolicy.nativeIndices(listOf("ERPNext", "Nwebeen")).isEmpty())
    }
    @Test fun shortMixedSoraniCanContainALongerProductName() {
        assertTrue(RegionReadPolicy.isSorani("ئەمە ERPNext ـە"))
    }
    @Test fun aKurdishQuotationDoesNotTurnAnEnglishArticleIntoNativeText() {
        assertFalse(RegionReadPolicy.isSorani("The Kurdish word سڵاو means hello in this example."))
    }
    @Test fun foreignVisionTranslationIsStillUsed() {
        assertEquals("وەرگێڕانی کوردی", RegionReadPolicy.visionText("We use ERPNext", "وەرگێڕانی کوردی"))
    }
    @Test fun speechPreparationKeepsTheWholeSoraniBodyAndVoicesAcronyms() {
        val spoken = KurdishSpeechPrep.prepare(FIRST)
        assertTrue(spoken.startsWith("سڵاو لە تۆش برام"))
        assertTrue(spoken.contains("ئی ئار پی"))
        assertTrue(spoken.contains("نمونەی ئەپ"))
        assertTrue(spoken.endsWith("بەکارئەهێنین"))
        assertEquals("ئی ئار پی نێکست", KurdishSpeechPrep.prepare("ERPNext"))
    }
    @Test fun systemVoiceLeavesTheOriginalEnglishTermsInTheUtterance() {
        val text = KurdishVoiceText.toEnglish(FIRST)
        assertTrue(text.contains("Nwebeen"))
        assertTrue(text.contains("ERPNext"))
    }
    @Test fun liveSubtitleCleanupIsNotAppliedToRegionSourceText() {
        assertTrue(RegionReadPolicy.visionText(FIRST, "").contains("ERPNext"))
        assertFalse(LiveTranslationFilter.clean(FIRST).contains("ERPNext"))
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class RegionVisionReadTest {
    private fun parse(original: String?, translated: String, lang: String): RegionItem {
        val obj = JSONObject().put("lang", lang).put("kurdish", translated)
        if (original != null) obj.put("original", original)
        return RegionTranslator.parse(JSONArray().put(obj).toString(), 400, 400).single()
    }
    @Test fun providerCannotReplaceTheReportedPostWithOnlyTranslatedProductNames() {
        val item = parse(RegionReadPolicyTest.FIRST, "سیستەمی پلاندانانی سەرچاوە", "en")
        assertEquals(RegionReadPolicyTest.FIRST, item.kurdish)
        assertTrue(item.alreadyKurdish)
    }
    @Test fun nativeCopyPreservesNewlinesLatinSpellingAndPunctuationExactly() {
        val item = parse(RegionReadPolicyTest.SECOND, "دەقێکی گۆڕاو", "ckb")
        assertEquals(RegionReadPolicyTest.SECOND, item.kurdish)
        assertTrue(item.kurdish.contains("profolio"))
    }
    @Test fun sourceInAnotherLanguageStillGetsTranslated() {
        val item = parse("We need a programmer", "پێویستمان بە پڕۆگرامەرە", "en")
        assertEquals("پێویستمان بە پڕۆگرامەرە", item.kurdish)
        assertFalse(item.alreadyKurdish)
    }
    @Test fun compactOrLegacyResponsesWithoutOriginalStillParse() {
        assertEquals("سڵاو ERPNext", parse(null, "سڵاو ERPNext", "ckb").kurdish)
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotEquals
import org.junit.Test

class ScreenTextSignatureTest {

    private val page = listOf(
        "This is the first long caption of the page",
        "And here is another sentence on the screen",
        "A third block makes the text trustworthy"
    )

    @Test fun fewBlocksAreNotTrusted() {
        assertEquals(0, ScreenText.signatureOf(emptyList()))
        assertEquals(0, ScreenText.signatureOf(page.take(2)))
    }

    @Test fun tooFewLettersAreNotTrusted() {
        assertEquals(0, ScreenText.signatureOf(listOf("Chapter 5", "1/20", "Menu")))
    }

    @Test fun sameTextGivesSameNonZeroSignature() {
        val a = ScreenText.signatureOf(page)
        assertNotEquals(0, a)
        assertEquals(a, ScreenText.signatureOf(page.toList()))
    }

    @Test fun changedTextChangesSignature() {
        val changed = page.toMutableList().also { it[2] = "A different third block appears here now" }
        assertNotEquals(ScreenText.signatureOf(page), ScreenText.signatureOf(changed))
    }

    @Test fun addedBlockChangesSignature() {
        assertNotEquals(ScreenText.signatureOf(page), ScreenText.signatureOf(page + "One more new message arrived"))
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class SpeechMergeTest {
    @Test fun shortSentenceJoinsNext() {
        assertEquals(listOf("باشە من دەچمە ماڵەوە."), SpeechMerge.merge(listOf("باشە", "من دەچمە ماڵەوە")))
    }
    @Test fun trailingShortJoinsPrevious() {
        assertEquals(listOf("من دەچمە ماڵەوە بۆ خوێندن. باشە"), SpeechMerge.merge(listOf("من دەچمە ماڵەوە بۆ خوێندن", "باشە")))
    }
    @Test fun longSentencesUntouched() {
        assertEquals(2, SpeechMerge.merge(listOf("یەک دوو سێ چوار", "پێنج شەش حەوت هەشت")).size)
    }
    @Test fun threeWordsOrLessAreMerged() {
        assertEquals(listOf("یەک دوو سێ پێنج شەش حەوت هەشت."), SpeechMerge.merge(listOf("یەک دوو سێ", "پێنج شەش حەوت هەشت")))
        assertTrue(SpeechMerge.isShort("یەک دوو سێ"))
        assertFalse(SpeechMerge.isShort("یەک دوو سێ چوار"))
    }
    @Test fun brotherExample() {
        val got = SpeechMerge.merge(listOf("براکەم", "ئازایە", "گەورەیە", "براوەیە", "من زۆر خۆشم دەوێت"))
        assertEquals(listOf("براکەم ئازایە گەورەیە براوەیە.", "من زۆر خۆشم دەوێت"), got)
    }
    @Test fun ownOutputIsRecognised() {
        OwnOutput.clear()
        OwnOutput.note("چیاکەمان لە پرۆپاگەندەو ناسازیدا سەریهەڵدا")
        assertTrue(OwnOutput.matches("چیاکەمان لە پرۆپاگەندەو ناسازیدا سەریهەڵدا، MkIceandfire"))
        assertFalse(OwnOutput.matches("Our mountain emerged out of the Chaos"))
    }
    @Test fun kurdishWithoutEnglishIsNotRetranslated() {
        assertFalse(TextFilter.worthTranslating("چیاکەمان لە پرۆپاگەندەو ناسازیدا سەریهەڵدا. MkIceandfire"))
        assertTrue(TextFilter.worthTranslating("ئەمە بۆ user-friendly و hello دەگۆڕێت ڕۆژ"))
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class SpeechPadTest {

    @Test fun shortSentenceGetsTheFillerWord() {
        // «من ئەو وێب ئاپەم» = ١٦ پیت ← ٢٤ دوای زیادکردن
        assertEquals("من ئەو وێب ئاپەم هەرکردم", SpeechPad.pad("من ئەو وێب ئاپەم"))
    }

    @Test fun neverShorterThanMinChars() {
        for (t in listOf("باشە", "نا", "ئەری", "من ئەو وێب ئاپەم", "ئەمە ١٧ پیتە ١٧ پیت")) {
            assertTrue("\"$t\"", SpeechPad.pad(t).length >= 20)
        }
    }

    @Test fun longEnoughSentenceIsUntouched() {
        val t = "ئەمە ڕستەیەکی درێژە و پێویستی بە پڕکردنەوە نییە"
        assertEquals(t, SpeechPad.pad(t))
    }

    @Test fun endPunctuationStaysAtTheEnd() {
        val r = SpeechPad.pad("باشە؟")
        assertTrue(r.startsWith("باشە "))
        assertTrue(r.endsWith("؟"))
        assertTrue(r.length >= 20)
        assertEquals(1, r.count { it == '؟' })
    }

    @Test fun offOrBlankWordChangesNothing() {
        assertEquals("باشە", SpeechPad.pad("باشە", "هەرکردم", 0))
        assertEquals("باشە", SpeechPad.pad("باشە", "  ", 20))
        assertEquals(SpeechPad.pad("باشە"), SpeechPad.pad("  باشە  "))
    }

    @Test fun customWordAndLimit() {
        assertEquals("باشە ئەرێبەرز", SpeechPad.pad("باشە", "ئەرێبەرز", 10))
    }

    // ---------- یاسای حەوت پیت ----------
    @Test fun wordMustHaveAtLeastSevenLetters() {
        assertTrue(SpeechPad.isValidWord("هەرکردم"))          // ٧ پیت
        assertTrue(SpeechPad.isValidWord("  هەرکردم  "))
        assertTrue(SpeechPad.isValidWord("ئەرێبەرز"))        // ٨ پیت
        assertFalse(SpeechPad.isValidWord("هەرکرد"))          // ٦ پیت
        assertFalse(SpeechPad.isValidWord("دەی"))
        assertFalse(SpeechPad.isValidWord("   "))
        assertFalse(SpeechPad.isValidWord(null))
    }

    @Test fun letterCountIgnoresSpacesAndPunctuation() {
        assertEquals(7, SpeechPad.letterCount("هەرکردم"))
        assertEquals(7, SpeechPad.letterCount("هەر. کردم!"))      // ٣ + ٤ پیت؛ بۆشایی و خاڵبەندی ناژمێردرێن
    }

    @Test fun sanitizeFallsBackToDefaultWhenTooShort() {
        assertEquals(SpeechPad.DEFAULT_WORD, SpeechPad.sanitizeWord("دەی"))
        assertEquals(SpeechPad.DEFAULT_WORD, SpeechPad.sanitizeWord(""))
        assertEquals(SpeechPad.DEFAULT_WORD, SpeechPad.sanitizeWord(null))
        assertEquals("ئەرێبەرز", SpeechPad.sanitizeWord(" ئەرێبەرز "))
    }

    @Test fun padNeverUsesAWordShorterThanSeven() {
        // وشەی ٣ پیتی «دەی» بەکارنایەت؛ بنەڕەت دێتە جێی
        assertEquals("باشە هەرکردم", SpeechPad.pad("باشە", "دەی", 10))
    }

    @Test fun defaultWordSatisfiesItsOwnRule() {
        assertTrue(SpeechPad.isValidWord(SpeechPad.DEFAULT_WORD))
    }

    @Test fun punctuationOnlyIsLeftAlone() {
        assertEquals("...", SpeechPad.pad("..."))
        assertEquals("", SpeechPad.pad("   "))
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class SpeechQueueTest {

    private fun drain(q: SpeechQueue): List<SpeechQueue.Batch> {
        val out = ArrayList<SpeechQueue.Batch>()
        while (true) out.add(q.take() ?: break)
        return out
    }

    @Test fun singleLineIsTakenAsIsAtNormalSpeed() {
        val q = SpeechQueue()
        q.add("سڵاو چۆنی")
        val b = q.take()!!
        assertEquals("سڵاو چۆنی", b.text)
        assertEquals(1, b.count)
        assertEquals(1f, b.boost, 0.001f)
        assertTrue(q.isEmpty())
        assertNull(q.take())
    }

    @Test fun punctuationFreeModeDoesNotAddSentencePauses() {
        val q = SpeechQueue(addSentenceEnds = false)
        q.add("سڵاو، چۆنی؟")
        assertEquals("سڵاو، چۆنی؟", q.take()!!.text)
        q.add("یەکەم"); q.add("دووەم")
        assertEquals("یەکەم دووەم", q.take()!!.text)
    }

    @Test fun nothingIsEverDroppedAndOrderIsKept() {
        val q = SpeechQueue(maxChars = 60)
        val lines = (1..200).map { "ئەمە ڕستەی ژمارە $it دەبێت." }
        lines.forEach { q.add(it) }
        val spoken = drain(q).joinToString(" ") { it.text }
        // هەموو ٢٠٠ ڕستە، بەو ڕیزەی هاتوون
        var pos = 0
        for (l in lines) {
            val i = spoken.indexOf(l, pos)
            assertTrue("ونبوو: $l", i >= 0)
            pos = i + l.length
        }
        assertEquals(lines.size, drain(SpeechQueue()).size + lines.size) // drain ی ڕیزی بەتاڵ = ٠
    }

    @Test fun manyLinesAreMergedInOrderWithinLimit() {
        val q = SpeechQueue(maxChars = 300)
        q.add("یەکەم ڕستە زۆر درێژە."); q.add("دووەم ڕستە زۆر درێژە"); q.add("سێیەم ڕستە زۆر درێژە؟")
        val b = q.take()!!
        assertEquals("یەکەم ڕستە زۆر درێژە. دووەم ڕستە زۆر درێژە. سێیەم ڕستە زۆر درێژە؟", b.text)
        assertEquals(3, b.count)
    }

    @Test fun shortSentencesChainThenLongOneFollows() {
        val q = SpeechQueue()
        listOf("براکەم", "ئازایە", "گەورەیە", "براوەیە", "من زۆر خۆشم دەوێت").forEach { q.add(it) }
        val b = q.take()!!
        assertEquals("براکەم ئازایە گەورەیە براوەیە. من زۆر خۆشم دەوێت.", b.text)
        assertEquals(5, b.count)
    }

    @Test fun lonelyShortWaitsForNext() {
        val q = SpeechQueue()
        q.add("براکەم"); q.add("ئازایە")
        assertTrue(q.onlyShort())
        q.add("گەورەیە براوەیە")
        assertTrue(!q.onlyShort())
    }

    @Test fun mergeStopsAtMaxCharsButRemainderStaysQueued() {
        val q = SpeechQueue(maxChars = 50)
        val a = "ا".repeat(30)
        q.add("$a یەک دوو سێ."); q.add("$a یەک دوو سێ."); q.add("$a یەک دوو سێ.")
        val b1 = q.take()!!
        assertEquals(1, b1.count)
        assertEquals(2, q.size())
        assertEquals(1, q.take()!!.count)
        assertEquals(1, q.take()!!.count)
        assertTrue(q.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun overlongSingleLineIsStillSpoken() {
        val q = SpeechQueue(maxChars = 50)
        val long = "ب".repeat(500)
        q.add(long)
        assertEquals(long, q.take()!!.text)
    }

    @Test fun backlogSpeedsUpButIsCapped() {
        val q = SpeechQueue(maxChars = 10, maxBoost = 1.3f)
        for (i in 1..3) q.add("l$i a b c.")
        assertEquals(1.12f, q.take()!!.boost, 0.001f)     // ٣ لە ڕیزدا
        val q2 = SpeechQueue(maxChars = 10, maxBoost = 1.3f)
        for (i in 1..20) q2.add("l$i a b c.")
        assertEquals(1.3f, q2.take()!!.boost, 0.001f)     // سنوور
    }

    @Test fun blankIsIgnored() {
        val q = SpeechQueue()
        q.add("   "); q.add("")
        assertTrue(q.isEmpty())
    }
    @Test fun prefetchPreviewMatchesNextPlaybackWithoutConsumingIt() {
        val q = SpeechQueue()
        q.add("باشە."); q.add("سڵاو.")
        val preview = q.peek()!!
        assertEquals(2, q.size())
        val actual = q.take()!!
        assertEquals(preview.text, actual.text)
        assertEquals(preview.boost, actual.boost, 0.001f)
        assertEquals(preview.count, actual.count)
        assertTrue(q.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun previewSupportsASingleWordAndAnEmptyQueue() {
        val q = SpeechQueue()
        assertNull(q.peek())
        q.add("نا.")
        assertEquals("نا.", q.peek()!!.text)
        assertEquals(1, q.size())
        assertEquals("نا.", q.take()!!.text)
    }

}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Test

class StripLatinTest {
    @Test fun removesEnglishWords() {
        assertEquals("سڵاو چۆنی", TextPrep.stripLatin("سڵاو hello چۆنی"))
        assertEquals("ئەو دەچێت", TextPrep.stripLatin("ئەو OK دەچێت don't"))
    }

    @Test fun keepsDigitsAndPunctuation() {
        assertEquals("ئەمڕۆ 3 کەس هاتن!", TextPrep.stripLatin("ئەمڕۆ 3 کەس هاتن!"))
        assertEquals("چۆنی؟", TextPrep.stripLatin("چۆنی what ؟"))
    }

    @Test fun removesEmptyBracketsLeftBehind() {
        assertEquals("سڵاو", TextPrep.stripLatin("سڵاو (Hello)"))
    }

    @Test fun allEnglishBecomesBlank() {
        assertEquals("", TextPrep.stripLatin("Hello world"))
    }

    @Test fun pureKurdishIsUntouched() {
        val s = "ئەمە دەقێکی کوردییە."
        assertEquals(s, TextPrep.stripLatin(s))
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class SubtitleGuardTest {

    // ---------- دەقی OCR ----------
    @Test fun realTextPasses() {
        for (t in listOf("Hello world", "I'm ok", "Go!", "هەڵبژاردن", "مرحبا بك", "你好", "はい")) {
            assertTrue(t, SubtitleGuard.looksLikeRealText(t))
        }
    }

    @Test fun noiseFails() {
        for (t in listOf("", "   ", "|||", ". .", "1234", "l l I i |", "ptkrs", "aaaa", "ااااا", "一", "--- ~~~ ///")) {
            assertFalse("\"$t\"", SubtitleGuard.looksLikeRealText(t))
        }
    }

    // ---------- وەرگێڕان ----------
    @Test fun normalTranslationIsPlausible() {
        assertTrue(SubtitleGuard.plausibleTranslation("Where are you going?", "تۆ بۆ کوێ دەچیت؟"))
        assertTrue(SubtitleGuard.plausibleTranslation("你好吗", "چۆنیت؟ باشیت؟ من زۆر دڵخۆشم بە بینینت"))
    }

    @Test fun noneAndRefusalsAreRejected() {
        assertFalse(SubtitleGuard.plausibleTranslation("xyz", ""))
        assertFalse(SubtitleGuard.plausibleTranslation("xyz", "<NONE>"))
        assertFalse(SubtitleGuard.plausibleTranslation("xyz", "There is no text in this image"))
        assertFalse(SubtitleGuard.plausibleTranslation("xyz", "I'm sorry, I cannot translate this"))
    }

    @Test fun inventedLongTextIsRejected() {
        val long = "ئەمە دەقێکی زۆر درێژە کە مۆدێل داهێناوە و هیچ پەیوەندییەکی بە سەرچاوەکەوە نییە ".repeat(3)
        assertFalse(SubtitleGuard.plausibleTranslation("Hi", long))
    }

    // ---------- ڕووبەری بێ نووسین ----------
    @Test fun flatRegionHasNoTextEdges() {
        val w = 100; val h = 30
        assertFalse(SubtitleGuard.hasTextLikeEdges(IntArray(w * h) { 20 }, w, h))        // ڕەش
        assertFalse(SubtitleGuard.hasTextLikeEdges(IntArray(w * h) { 130 }, w, h))       // خۆڵەمێشی
        // گرادیێنتی نەرم (دیمەنی ئاسایی) هیچ لێوارێکی بەهێزی نییە
        assertFalse(SubtitleGuard.hasTextLikeEdges(IntArray(w * h) { i -> (i % w) }, w, h))
    }

    @Test fun strokesAreTextLikeEdges() {
        val w = 100; val h = 30
        // نووسینی سپی لەسەر ڕەش: هێڵی ستوونی ٣ پیکسێل هەر ٨ پیکسێل جارێک
        val img = IntArray(w * h) { i -> if ((i % w) % 8 < 3) 240 else 10 }
        assertTrue(SubtitleGuard.hasTextLikeEdges(img, w, h))
    }

    @Test fun tinyOrBrokenInputIsSafe() {
        assertFalse(SubtitleGuard.hasTextLikeEdges(IntArray(1), 1, 1))
        assertFalse(SubtitleGuard.hasTextLikeEdges(IntArray(0), 10, 10))
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Test

class SubtitleMemoryTest {
    private fun load(text: String) = SubtitleMemory.install(SubtitleMemory.parse(text.lineSequence()))

    @Test fun delimiterLinesEitherOrder() {
        load("Hello, how are you? | سڵاو، چۆنی؟\nباشم - I'm fine\nDon't go! => مەڕۆ!")
        assertEquals("سڵاو، چۆنی؟", SubtitleMemory.lookup("hello how are you"))
        assertEquals("باشم", SubtitleMemory.lookup("I'm fine"))
        assertEquals("مەڕۆ!", SubtitleMemory.lookup("DON'T GO"))
    }

    @Test fun twoLinePairs() {
        load("Where are you going?\nتۆ بۆ کوێ دەچیت؟\nI will wait here.\nمن لێرە چاوەڕێ دەکەم.")
        assertEquals("تۆ بۆ کوێ دەچیت؟", SubtitleMemory.lookup("Where are you going"))
        assertEquals("من لێرە چاوەڕێ دەکەم.", SubtitleMemory.lookup("I will wait here"))
    }

    @Test fun srtBlocksWithMultilineText() {
        load(
            "1\n00:00:01,000 --> 00:00:03,000\n<i>This place looks like</i>\nsome kind of palace.\nئەم شوێنە وەک\nکۆشکێک دەچێت.\n\n" +
                "2\n00:00:04,000 --> 00:00:05,000\nWho are you?\nتۆ کێیت؟\n"
        )
        assertEquals("ئەم شوێنە وەک کۆشکێک دەچێت.", SubtitleMemory.lookup("This place looks like some kind of palace."))
        assertEquals("تۆ کێیت؟", SubtitleMemory.lookup("who are you"))
    }

    @Test fun englishDashInsideTextIsNotASplit() {
        load("Well - maybe later | باشە - لەوانەیە دواتر")
        assertEquals("باشە - لەوانەیە دواتر", SubtitleMemory.lookup("Well - maybe later"))
    }

    @Test fun fuzzyToleratesSmallOcrErrors() {
        load("I was sitting at home a second ago | چرکەیەک لەمەوبەر لە ماڵەوە دانیشتبووم")
        assertEquals(
            "چرکەیەک لەمەوبەر لە ماڵەوە دانیشتبووم",
            SubtitleMemory.lookup("I was sitting at horne a second ago")
        )
        assertNull(SubtitleMemory.lookup("This place looks like some kind of European palace"))
    }

    @Test fun shortTextsNeedExactMatch() {
        load("Yes | بەڵێ\nNo way! | نەخێر!")
        assertEquals("بەڵێ", SubtitleMemory.lookup("yes"))
        assertNull(SubtitleMemory.lookup("yet"))
    }

    @Test fun commentsAndGarbageIgnored() {
        load("# تێبینی\n// note\nWEBVTT\n123\n----\nplain english only line")
        assertEquals(0, SubtitleMemory.size)
    }

    @Test fun sentenceLevelLookupFromMultiSentenceBlock() {
        load("00:00:09 --> 00:00:11\nHello everyone. I'm Jake.\nسڵاو هەمووان. من جەیکم.\n")
        assertEquals("من جەیکم.", SubtitleMemory.lookup("I'm Jake."))
        assertEquals("سڵاو هەمووان.", SubtitleMemory.lookup("Hello everyone."))
        assertEquals("سڵاو هەمووان. من جەیکم.", SubtitleMemory.lookup("Hello everyone. I'm Jake."))
    }

    @Test fun sameLineWithoutDelimiter() {
        load("Please subscribe to our channel. تکایە بەشداری بکە لە کەناڵەکەمان.\n")
        assertEquals("تکایە بەشداری بکە لە کەناڵەکەمان.", SubtitleMemory.lookup("please subscribe to our channel"))
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Test
import kotlin.random.Random

class TextPerformanceRegressionTest {
    private fun originalWords(s: String): Int =
        s.trim().split(Regex("\\s+")).count { word -> word.any { it.isLetterOrDigit() } }

    @Test fun wordBoundariesMatchOriginalIncludingUnicode() {
        val samples = listOf("", " \t\n", "hello world", "براکەم ئازایە", "123 ! ? abc",
            "a\u00a0b", "a\u2003b", "a\tb\nc\u000bd\u000ce\rf", "你好、世界", "😀 !!!")
        samples.forEach { assertEquals(it, originalWords(it), SpeechMerge.words(it)) }
    }

    @Test fun randomizedWordCountsMatchOriginal() {
        val random = Random(72)
        val alphabet = "abc123!? براکەم\t\n\r\u000b\u000c\u00a0\u2003你好"
        repeat(3000) {
            val text = buildString { repeat(random.nextInt(250)) { append(alphabet[random.nextInt(alphabet.length)]) } }
            assertEquals(text, originalWords(text), SpeechMerge.words(text))
        }
    }

    @Test fun preparationKeepsFormattingAndCaseBehavior() {
        assertEquals("What are you doing?!", TextPrep.prepare("WHAT ARE\n YOU DOING?!"))
        assertEquals("Hello I am here. I know!", TextPrep.prepare("HELLO I AM HERE. I KNOW!"))
        assertEquals("Hello world", TextPrep.prepare("  Hello\tworld  "))
        assertEquals("کوردی", TextPrep.finish("**كوردی** ¤\u200e"))
        assertEquals("ی ی ک", TextPrep.fixSorani("ي ى ك"))
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Before
import org.junit.Test
import java.util.concurrent.Callable
import java.util.concurrent.Executors

class TranslationCacheTest {
    @Before fun reset() = TranslationCache.clear()

    @Test fun normalizesWhitespaceAndSeparatesLanguages() {
        TranslationCache.put("en", " hello\n world ", " سڵاو ")
        assertEquals("سڵاو", TranslationCache.get("en", "hello world"))
        assertNull(TranslationCache.get("ar", "hello world"))
    }

    @Test fun ignoresEmptySourcesPlaceholdersAndOversizedSources() {
        for (text in listOf("", " \n ", "x".repeat(801))) TranslationCache.put("en", text, "result")
        for (translation in listOf("", " ", "؟", "…")) TranslationCache.put("en", "hello", translation)
        assertEquals(0, TranslationCache.size())
    }

    @Test fun evictsLeastRecentlyUsedEntry() {
        repeat(600) { TranslationCache.put("en", "text$it", "result$it") }
        assertEquals("result0", TranslationCache.get("en", "text0"))
        TranslationCache.put("en", "new", "result")
        assertNull(TranslationCache.get("en", "text1"))
        assertEquals("result0", TranslationCache.get("en", "text0"))
        assertEquals(600, TranslationCache.size())
    }

    @Test fun concurrentAccessStaysBounded() {
        val pool = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(4)
        try {
            val futures = pool.invokeAll((0..3).map { worker -> Callable {
                repeat(1000) {
                    TranslationCache.put("en", "$worker:$it", "result")
                    TranslationCache.get("en", "$worker:$it")
                }
            } })
            futures.forEach { it.get() }
            assertEquals(600, TranslationCache.size())
        } finally { pool.shutdownNow() }
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test
import java.io.IOException

class TranslationRouterTest {
    private val key = "test-key-long-enough"
    private val hybrid = TranslationProvider.GEMINI_QUOTA_GOOGLE

    @Test fun googleModeNeverCallsGeminiEvenWithAKey() {
        val router = TranslationRouter()
        assertEquals("google", router.run(TranslationProvider.GOOGLE, key,
            gemini = { error("Gemini must not run") }, google = { "google" }))
    }
    @Test fun geminiSuccessNeverStartsGoogle() {
        for (mode in listOf(TranslationProvider.GEMINI, hybrid)) {
            assertEquals("gemini", TranslationRouter().run(mode, key,
                gemini = { "gemini" }, google = { error("Google must not run") }))
        }
    }
    @Test fun onlyQuotaCanTriggerSequentialFallback() {
        val events = mutableListOf<String>()
        val result = TranslationRouter().run(hybrid, key,
            gemini = { events += "gemini"; throw ApiException(429, "quota") },
            google = { events += "google"; "ok" })
        assertEquals("ok", result)
        assertEquals(listOf("gemini", "google"), events)
    }
    @Test fun authServerAndModelErrorsNeverFallBack() {
        for (code in listOf(400, 401, 403, 404, 500, 503, 504)) {
            val error = ApiException(code, "failure")
            val thrown = assertThrows(ApiException::class.java) {
                TranslationRouter().run(hybrid, key,
                    gemini = { throw error }, google = { fail("Unexpected Google call"); "bad" })
            }
            assertSame(error, thrown)
        }
    }
    @Test fun offlineAndParseFailuresDoNotTriggerGoogle() {
        for (error in listOf(IOException("offline"), IllegalStateException("bad response"))) {
            val thrown = assertThrows(error.javaClass) {
                TranslationRouter().run(hybrid, key,
                    gemini = { throw error }, google = { fail("Unexpected Google call"); "bad" })
            }
            assertSame(error, thrown)
        }
    }
    @Test fun geminiOnlyNeverFallsBackOnQuota() {
        assertThrows(ApiException::class.java) {
            TranslationRouter().run(TranslationProvider.GEMINI, key,
                gemini = { throw ApiException(429, "quota") }, google = { fail("Unexpected Google call"); "bad" })
        }
    }
    @Test fun missingKeyIsAnErrorNotAnImplicitGoogleChoice() {
        for (mode in listOf(TranslationProvider.GEMINI, hybrid)) {
            assertThrows(IOException::class.java) {
                TranslationRouter().run(mode, "short",
                    gemini = { error("No valid key") }, google = { error("Must not fall back") })
            }
        }
    }
    @Test fun quotaCooldownIsScopedToKeysAndExpires() {
        var clock = 100L
        val router = TranslationRouter({ clock }, 1000)
        router.run(hybrid, key, gemini = { throw ApiException(429, "quota") }, google = { "google" })
        assertEquals("google", router.run(hybrid, key, gemini = { error("Cooldown") }, google = { "google" }))
        assertEquals("gemini", router.run(hybrid, "different-key-long-enough", gemini = { "gemini" }, google = { error("No quota") }))
        clock = 1100
        assertEquals("gemini", router.run(hybrid, key, gemini = { "gemini" }, google = { error("Expired") }))
    }
    @Test fun geminiOnlyIgnoresHybridCooldown() {
        val router = TranslationRouter()
        router.run(hybrid, key, gemini = { throw ApiException(429, "quota") }, google = { "google" })
        assertEquals("gemini", router.run(TranslationProvider.GEMINI, key, gemini = { "gemini" }, google = { error("Gemini-only") }))
    }
    @Test fun negativeMonotonicClockDoesNotCauseUnconfirmedFallback() {
        assertEquals("gemini", TranslationRouter({ -1000L }).run(hybrid, key,
            gemini = { "gemini" }, google = { error("No confirmed quota") }))
    }
    @Test fun quotaAfterPartialBatchTranslatesOnlyMissingBlocks() {
        val emitted = mutableListOf<Pair<Int, String>>()
        val result = TranslationRouter().batch(hybrid, key, listOf("first", "noise", "last"),
            gemini = { emit -> emit(0, "یەکەم"); emit(1, ""); throw ApiException(429, "quota") },
            google = { texts -> assertEquals(listOf("last"), texts); listOf("کۆتایی") },
            onItem = { i, value -> emitted += i to value })
        assertEquals(listOf("یەکەم", "", "کۆتایی"), result)
        assertEquals(listOf(0 to "یەکەم", 1 to "", 2 to "کۆتایی"), emitted)
    }
    @Test fun incompleteGeminiBatchDoesNotUseGoogleOnOtherErrors() {
        assertThrows(IOException::class.java) {
            TranslationRouter().batch(hybrid, key, listOf("first", "second"),
                gemini = { emit -> emit(0, "یەکەم"); throw IOException("incomplete") },
                google = { error("Not a quota failure") }, onItem = { _, _ -> })
        }
    }
    @Test fun providerIdentifiersRoundTripAndUnknownDefaultsToGoogle() {
        for (mode in TranslationProvider.values()) assertEquals(mode, TranslationProvider.fromId(mode.id))
        assertEquals(TranslationProvider.GOOGLE, TranslationProvider.fromId(null))
        assertEquals(TranslationProvider.GOOGLE, TranslationProvider.fromId("invalid"))
    }
    @Test fun warmupCannotContactGoogleBeforeQuotaInGeminiModes() {
        assertTrue(TranslationProvider.GOOGLE.warmGoogle("en"))
        assertFalse(TranslationProvider.GEMINI.warmGoogle("en"))
        assertFalse(hybrid.warmGoogle("en"))
        for (mode in TranslationProvider.values()) assertTrue(mode.warmGoogle("ar"))
    }

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.assertArrayEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import kotlin.math.PI
import kotlin.math.sin
import kotlin.math.sqrt

class VoiceShaperTest {
    private val rate = 22050

    private fun tone(hz: Double): FloatArray =
        FloatArray(rate) { (0.3 * sin(2.0 * PI * hz * it / rate)).toFloat() }

    private fun rms(x: FloatArray): Double {
        var s = 0.0
        for (i in 2000 until x.size) s += x[i].toDouble() * x[i]
        return sqrt(s / (x.size - 2000))
    }

    @Test fun zeroMeansUnchanged() {
        val x = tone(1000.0)
        val y = x.copyOf()
        VoiceShaper.apply(y, y.size, rate, edge = 0, soft = 0)
        assertArrayEquals(x, y, 0f)
    }

    @Test fun softReducesHighKeepsLow() {
        val lowIn = tone(300.0); val highIn = tone(6000.0)
        val low = lowIn.copyOf(); val high = highIn.copyOf()
        VoiceShaper.apply(low, low.size, rate, edge = 0, soft = 100)
        VoiceShaper.apply(high, high.size, rate, edge = 0, soft = 100)
        assertTrue(rms(low) > 0.85 * rms(lowIn))
        assertTrue(rms(high) < 0.5 * rms(highIn))
    }

    @Test fun edgeLiftsHighRelativeToLow() {
        val low = tone(300.0); val high = tone(4000.0)
        VoiceShaper.apply(low, low.size, rate, edge = 100, soft = 0)
        VoiceShaper.apply(high, high.size, rate, edge = 100, soft = 0)
        assertTrue(rms(high) / rms(low) > 1.2)
    }

    @Test fun outputStaysFiniteAndBounded() {
        val x = FloatArray(rate) { if (it % 7 == 0) 1f else -1f }
        VoiceShaper.apply(x, x.size, rate, edge = 100, soft = 100)
        assertTrue(x.all { it.isFinite() && kotlin.math.abs(it) <= 1.5f })
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class WatermarkFilterTest {
    private val lines = listOf("we march at dawn", "where is the king hiding", "I never asked for this fate",
        "bring me the blade now", "the gods have abandoned us", "hold the gate at all costs")

    @Test fun handlesAreDetected() {
        assertTrue(WatermarkFilter.looksLikeHandle("MKIceAndFire"))
        assertTrue(WatermarkFilter.looksLikeHandle("@MKIceAndFire"))
        assertFalse(WatermarkFilter.looksLikeHandle("My Brothers"))
        assertFalse(WatermarkFilter.looksLikeHandle("Hello"))
    }

    @Test fun staticWatermarkIsDroppedButSubtitlesStay() {
        val w = WatermarkFilter()
        var t = 0L
        var kept = emptyList<Blk>()
        for (i in 0 until 40) {
            t += 400
            val sub = Blk(lines[i % lines.size], 300, 1000, 1700, 1060)
            val wm = Blk(if (i % 2 == 0) "Mklceand" else "MKceAnd", 1500, 1100, 1800, 1160)
            kept = w.filter(listOf(sub, wm), t, 2000, 1200)
        }
        assertEquals(1, kept.size)
        assertEquals(lines[39 % lines.size], kept[0].text)
    }

    @Test fun changingSubtitlesAreNeverDropped() {
        val w = WatermarkFilter()
        var t = 0L
        for (i in 0 until 60) {
            t += 400
            assertEquals(1, w.filter(listOf(Blk(lines[i % lines.size], 300, 1000, 1700, 1060)), t, 2000, 1200).size)
        }
    }

    @Test fun longSubtitleThenSimilarNextSubtitleIsNotLost() {
        val w = WatermarkFilter()
        var t = 0L
        // یەک ژێرنووسی درێژ (٢٠ چرکە) لە هەمان شوێن دەمێنێتەوە و جێگیر دەژمێردرێت
        for (i in 0 until 50) { t += 400; w.filter(listOf(Blk("we march at dawn tomorrow", 300, 1000, 1700, 1060)), t, 2000, 1200) }
        // ژێرنووس ون دەبێت، دوای ٩ چرکە ژێرنووسێکی هاوشێوە دێت: نابێت لابچێت
        t += 9_000
        val kept = w.filter(listOf(Blk("we march at dusk tomorrow", 300, 1000, 1700, 1060)), t, 2000, 1200)
        assertEquals(1, kept.size)
    }
}

FILE: benchmarks/BaselineLiveSubtitleProgress.kt

package com.mangatranslator.app

/** Bounded, clock-injected progress for cumulative / rolling live subtitles. */
internal class BaselineLiveSubtitleProgress(private val memoryMs: Long = 20_000L, private val capacity: Int = 40) {
    data class Result(val text: String, val continuation: Boolean, val repeated: Boolean)
    private data class Word(val key: String, val end: Int)
    private data class Seen(val key: String, val words: List<Word>, val at: Long)
    private val recent = ArrayDeque<Seen>()
    private var current: Seen? = null
    private companion object {
        val REPEATED = Result("", false, true)
        val wordPattern = Regex("[\\p{L}\\p{M}\\p{N}\\u200C]+(?:['’][\\p{L}\\p{M}\\p{N}\\u200C]+)*")
    }
    private var lastRaw: String? = null
    private var lastKey = ""
    private fun key(text: String) = text.lowercase().filter { it.isLetterOrDigit() }
    private fun words(text: String) = wordPattern.findAll(text).map { Word(key(it.value), it.range.last + 1) }.toList()

    /** A blank hides the caption but retains recent speech memory. */
    fun absent() { current = null }

    fun next(raw: String, now: Long, allowOverlap: Boolean = true): Result {
        val text = raw.trim()
        val normalized = if (lastRaw == text) lastKey else key(text).also {
            lastRaw = text
            lastKey = it
        }
        if (normalized.isEmpty()) return REPEATED
        while (recent.isNotEmpty() && now - recent.first().at > memoryMs) recent.removeFirst()
        val previous = current
        val duplicate = if (previous?.key == normalized) previous else recent.firstOrNull { it.key == normalized }
        if (duplicate != null) {
            // Matching keys need no regex tokenization. Previous token offsets
            // are never used to cut the incoming string on this return path.
            val item = Seen(normalized, duplicate.words, now)
            current = item
            remember(item)
            return REPEATED
        }
        val incoming = words(text)
        val item = Seen(normalized, incoming, now)
        // Temporarily shortened OCR / typewriter frames cannot replay an
        // already handled prefix. Match whole words, never a partial word.
        if (allowOverlap && previous != null && incoming.size < previous.words.size &&
            prefix(incoming, previous.words, incoming.size) && normalized.length >= 5) {
            return REPEATED
        }
        var consumed = 0
        if (allowOverlap) {
            // Use full observed frames rather than only the last delta, so
            // A -> A B -> A B C always emits A, B, C once.
            for (old in recent) consumed = maxOf(consumed, prefixConsumed(old, incoming, previous, consumed))
            if (previous != null && recent.lastOrNull() !== previous) {
                consumed = maxOf(consumed, prefixConsumed(previous, incoming, previous, consumed))
            }
            if (previous != null && consumed < minOf(previous.words.size, incoming.size)) {
                // Rolling two-line captions may drop their beginning while
                // retaining the end: A B -> B C. Require a meaningful overlap.
                val count = overlap(previous.words, incoming)
                var overlapChars = 0
                for (i in 0 until count) overlapChars += incoming[i].key.length
                if (count >= 2 && overlapChars >= 8) {
                    consumed = maxOf(consumed, count)
                }
            }
        }
        current = item
        remember(item)
        var cutEnd = if (consumed > 0) incoming[consumed - 1].end else 0
        // CJK scripts often have no spaces: character boundaries are valid
        // there, while Latin/Kurdish partial words must remain whole.
        if (allowOverlap && text.any { it.code in 0x2E80..0x9FFF }) {
            for (old in recent) {
                if (old.key.length >= 2 && normalized.length > old.key.length && normalized.startsWith(old.key)) {
                    var letters = 0
                    val boundary = text.indexOfFirst { ch ->
                        if (ch.isLetterOrDigit()) letters++
                        letters == old.key.length
                    } + 1
                    cutEnd = maxOf(cutEnd, boundary)
                }
            }
        }
        if (allowOverlap && previous != null && recent.lastOrNull() !== previous &&
            text.any { it.code in 0x2E80..0x9FFF } && previous.key.length >= 2 &&
            normalized.length > previous.key.length && normalized.startsWith(previous.key)) {
            var letters = 0
            for (i in text.indices) {
                if (text[i].isLetterOrDigit()) letters++
                if (letters == previous.key.length) { cutEnd = maxOf(cutEnd, i + 1); break }
            }
        }
        if (cutEnd == 0) return Result(text, false, false)
        val remainder = text.substring(cutEnd)
            .trimStart { !it.isLetterOrDigit() }
        return Result(remainder, true, remainder.isBlank())
    }
    private fun prefixConsumed(old: Seen, incoming: List<Word>, previous: Seen?, consumed: Int): Int {
        val n = old.words.size
        if (n < incoming.size && n > consumed && (old.key.length >= 5 || old === previous) &&
            prefix(old.words, incoming, n)) return n
        if (n >= 2 && n - 1 > consumed && incoming.size >= n && prefix(old.words, incoming, n - 1) &&
            old.words.last().key.length >= 3 && incoming[n - 1].key.length > old.words.last().key.length &&
            incoming[n - 1].key.startsWith(old.words.last().key)) return n - 1
        return consumed
    }
    /** Longest suffix/prefix in linear time, including repeated-word captions. */
    private fun overlap(old: List<Word>, incoming: List<Word>): Int {
        if (incoming.isEmpty()) return 0
        val failure = IntArray(incoming.size)
        for (i in 1 until incoming.size) {
            var j = failure[i - 1]
            while (j > 0 && incoming[i].key != incoming[j].key) j = failure[j - 1]
            if (incoming[i].key == incoming[j].key) j++
            failure[i] = j
        }
        var matched = 0
        for (word in old) {
            while (matched > 0 && (matched == incoming.size || word.key != incoming[matched].key)) {
                matched = failure[matched - 1]
            }
            if (word.key == incoming[matched].key) matched++
        }
        return matched
    }
    private fun prefix(a: List<Word>, b: List<Word>, count: Int) =
        count > 0 && a.size >= count && b.size >= count && (0 until count).all { a[it].key == b[it].key }
    private fun remember(item: Seen) {
        // Refresh repeated frames without growing memory at capture frequency.
        recent.removeAll { it.key == item.key }
        recent.addLast(item)
        while (recent.size > capacity) recent.removeFirst()
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

/** Live output only: never alter the source used for translation / matching. */
internal object BaselineLiveTranslationFilter {
    // Include contractions, hyphenated words, mixed Latin/number identifiers,
    // numeric separators and units, without consuming adjacent Kurdish text.
    private const val LATIN_DIGIT = "[\\p{IsLatin}0-9]"
    private const val LATIN_MARK_DIGIT = "[\\p{IsLatin}\\p{M}0-9]"
    private val latinOrNumber = Regex("[+\\-]?" + LATIN_DIGIT + LATIN_MARK_DIGIT + "*(?:[.'’:/,_%+\\-]" + LATIN_DIGIT + LATIN_MARK_DIGIT + "*)*[+%]*")
    private val emptyPairs = Regex("\\(\\s*\\)|\\[\\s*]|\\{\\s*}|[\"“«]\\s*[\"”»]")
    private val repeatedSeparators = Regex("([،,؛;:])(?:\\s*[،,؛;:])+")
    private val spaces = Regex("\\s+")
    private val beforePunctuation = Regex("\\s+([،؛:,.!?؟])")
    private val edgeJunk = Regex("^[\\s,،؛:;./\\-–—]+|[\\s,،؛:;/\\-–—]+$")
    private data class Cached(val raw: String, val clean: String)
    @Volatile private var cached: Cached? = null

    fun clean(raw: String): String {
        cached?.let { if (it.raw == raw) return it.clean }
        val clean = if (alreadyClean(raw)) raw else cleanMixed(raw)
        cached = Cached(raw, clean)
        return clean
    }

    /** Common Sorani results need no replacements, regexes or text copies. */
    private fun alreadyClean(text: String): Boolean {
        if (text.isEmpty()) return true
        var content = false
        for (i in text.indices) {
            val c = text[i]
            when {
                c == 'ي' || c == 'ى' || c == 'ك' -> return false
                c in '\u0600'..'\u06ff' -> {
                    if (c.isLetterOrDigit()) content = true
                    else if (c == '،' || c == '؛' || c == '؟') {
                        if ((c == '،' || c == '؛') && (i == 0 || i == text.lastIndex ||
                            text[i - 1] in ",،؛;:")) return false
                    }
                }
                c == ' ' -> {
                    if (i == 0 || i == text.lastIndex || text[i - 1] == ' ' || text[i + 1] in "،؛:,.!?؟") return false
                }
                c in ".!?،؛:,…" -> {
                    if ((i == 0 && c in ",،؛:.") || (i == text.lastIndex && c in ",،؛:")) return false
                    if (c in ",،؛:" && i > 0 && text[i - 1] in ",،؛;:") return false
                }
                c == '\u200c' -> {}
                else -> return false
            }
        }
        return content
    }

    private fun finishIfNeeded(raw: String): String {
        if (raw.isNotEmpty() && (raw.first().isWhitespace() || raw.last().isWhitespace())) return TextPrep.finish(raw)
        for (i in raw.indices) {
            val c = raw[i]
            if (c == 'ي' || c == 'ى' || c == 'ك' || c == '¤' || c == '*' || c == '`' || c == '#' ||
                c in '\u200b'..'\u200f' && c != '\u200c' && c != '\u200d' ||
                c in '\u202a'..'\u202e' || c in '\u2066'..'\u2069' || c == '\ufeff' ||
                c <= ' ' && c != ' ' || c == ' ' && i > 0 && raw[i - 1] == ' ') return TextPrep.finish(raw)
        }
        return raw
    }

    private fun cleanMixed(raw: String): String {
        var text = finishIfNeeded(raw).replace(latinOrNumber, " ")
        if (text.any { it in "([{\"“«" }) text = text.replace(emptyPairs, " ")
        text = text.replace(spaces, " ")
            .replace(beforePunctuation, "$1").replace(repeatedSeparators, "$1")
            .replace(edgeJunk, "").trim()
        return text.takeIf { it.any(Char::isLetterOrDigit) }.orEmpty()
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import kotlin.random.Random
import java.lang.management.ManagementFactory

private var sink = 0L
private fun same(old: BaselineLiveSubtitleProgress.Result, new: LiveSubtitleProgress.Result) {
    check(old.text == new.text && old.continuation == new.continuation && old.repeated == new.repeated) { "$old != $new" }
}
fun main() {
    val random = Random(3007)
    val parts = listOf("سڵاو", "هاوڕێ", "چۆنی؟", "کوردی", "1,200", "John", " ", "  ", "\n", "،", "؛", ":", ".", "ك", "ي", "ى", "١٢٣", "۱۲۳", "[123]", "**", "Pokémon", "\u200e", "\u200c", "؟", "!", "…")
    repeat(20_000) {
        val text = buildString { repeat(random.nextInt(1, 15)) { append(parts.random(random)) } }
        val old = BaselineLiveTranslationFilter.clean(text)
        val new = LiveTranslationFilter.clean(text)
        check(old == new) { "Filter changed: <$text> old=<$old> new=<$new>" }
    }
    repeat(100) {
        val old = BaselineLiveSubtitleProgress()
        val new = LiveSubtitleProgress()
        var text = "Hello everyone"
        var time = 0L
        repeat(200) {
            when (random.nextInt(7)) {
                0 -> { old.absent(); new.absent() }
                1 -> text += " " + listOf("welcome", "back", "friend", "today", "again").random(random)
                2 -> text = text.uppercase()
                3 -> text = listOf("Hi", "Wait for me please", "alpha beta alpha beta", "سڵاو هاوڕێ", "今天").random(random)
                4 -> text = text.split(" ").drop(1).joinToString(" ")
                5 -> text += "."
            }
            time += random.nextLong(1, 400)
            val overlap = random.nextBoolean()
            same(old.next(text, time, overlap), new.next(text, time, overlap))
        }
    }
    val unicodeTokens = listOf("can't", "we’re", "هاو\u200cڕێ", "کوردی", "سڵا\u0651و", "cafe\u0301", "ΟΣ", "İSTANBUL", "Ⅳ", "½", "١٢٣", "你好", "𝒜world", "😀", "\u0301")
    repeat(200) {
        val old = BaselineLiveSubtitleProgress()
        val new = LiveSubtitleProgress()
        val tokens = mutableListOf("Hello")
        var time = 0L
        repeat(100) {
            when (random.nextInt(6)) {
                0 -> { old.absent(); new.absent() }
                1 -> if (tokens.size > 1) tokens.removeAt(0)
                2 -> { tokens.clear(); tokens.add("Hello") }
                else -> tokens.add(unicodeTokens.random(random))
            }
            val text = tokens.joinToString(if (random.nextBoolean()) " " else ", ")
            time += random.nextLong(1, 500)
            val overlap = random.nextBoolean()
            same(old.next(text, time, overlap), new.next(text, time, overlap))
        }
    }
    println("Differential checks: 20,000 filter results + 40,000 subtitle transitions (including Unicode) matched baseline")
    val bean = ManagementFactory.getThreadMXBean() as com.sun.management.ThreadMXBean
    bean.isThreadAllocatedMemoryEnabled = true
    val thread = Thread.currentThread().id
    fun measure(name: String, ops: Int, factory: (Boolean) -> (() -> Unit)) {
        val old = factory(false); val new = factory(true)
        repeat(4) { repeat(maxOf(ops / 5, 20_000)) { old(); new() } }
        val timings = Array(2) { mutableListOf<Double>() }
        val allocations = Array(2) { mutableListOf<Double>() }
        repeat(7) { round ->
            val order = if (round % 2 == 0) intArrayOf(0, 1) else intArrayOf(1, 0)
            for (which in order) {
                val action = if (which == 0) old else new
                val allocated = bean.getThreadAllocatedBytes(thread)
                val start = System.nanoTime()
                repeat(ops) { action() }
                timings[which].add((System.nanoTime() - start).toDouble() / ops)
                allocations[which].add((bean.getThreadAllocatedBytes(thread) - allocated).toDouble() / ops)
            }
        }
        fun median(values: List<Double>) = values.sorted()[values.size / 2]
        val oldNs = median(timings[0]); val newNs = median(timings[1])
        println("%s | %.0f -> %.0f ns/op | %.0f -> %.0f bytes/op | %.2fx".format(name, oldNs, newNs, median(allocations[0]), median(allocations[1]), oldNs/newNs))
    }
    measure("progress repeated", 30_000) { fast ->
        val old = BaselineLiveSubtitleProgress(); val new = LiveSubtitleProgress(); var time = 0L
        ({ val text = "Where are you going? I will come with you."; sink += if (fast) new.next(text, time++).text.length else old.next(text, time++).text.length })
    }
    measure("progress cumulative", 20_000) { fast ->
        var old = BaselineLiveSubtitleProgress(); var new = LiveSubtitleProgress(); var count = 0
        var text = "Hello everyone"; var time = 0L
        ({ if (count++ % 20 == 0) { old = BaselineLiveSubtitleProgress(); new = LiveSubtitleProgress(); text = "Hello everyone" }
           text += " welcome"
           sink += if (fast) new.next(text, time++).text.length else old.next(text, time++).text.length })
    }
    measure("progress Kurdish cumulative", 20_000) { fast ->
        var old = BaselineLiveSubtitleProgress(); var new = LiveSubtitleProgress(); var count = 0
        var text = "سڵاو هاوڕێ"; var time = 0L
        ({ if (count++ % 20 == 0) { old = BaselineLiveSubtitleProgress(); new = LiveSubtitleProgress(); text = "سڵاو هاوڕێ" }
           text += " بەڵێ"
           sink += if (fast) new.next(text, time++).text.length else old.next(text, time++).text.length })
    }
    measure("progress rolling", 20_000) { fast ->
        var old = BaselineLiveSubtitleProgress(); var new = LiveSubtitleProgress(); var count = 0; var time = 0L
        ({ if (count++ % 20 == 0) { old = BaselineLiveSubtitleProgress(); new = LiveSubtitleProgress() }
           val text = "This is subtitle number ${count - 1} This is subtitle number $count"
           sink += if (fast) new.next(text, time++).text.length else old.next(text, time++).text.length })
    }
    println("Benchmark checksum: $sink; desktop JVM microbenchmark, not phone or end-to-end latency")
}

import com.mangatranslator.app.SpeechMerge
import kotlin.system.measureNanoTime

@Volatile var checksum = 0
fun oldWords(s: String) = s.trim().split(Regex("\\s+")).count { word -> word.any { it.isLetterOrDigit() } }
fun main() {
    val inputs = listOf("براکەم ئازایە گەورەیە براوەیە", "Where are you going? I am here!", "你好 世界 123 !", "hello\nworld\tand friends")
    fun run(old: Boolean): Long = measureNanoTime {
        var sum = 0
        repeat(100000) { val s = inputs[it % inputs.size]; sum += if (old) oldWords(s) else SpeechMerge.words(s) }
        checksum = sum
    }
    repeat(4) { run(true); run(false) }
    val old = mutableListOf<Long>(); val updated = mutableListOf<Long>()
    repeat(7) { old += run(true); updated += run(false) }
    println("100000 calls; median of 7 after warmup")
    println("Before: ${old.sorted()[3] / 1000000.0} ms")
    println("After: ${updated.sorted()[3] / 1000000.0} ms")
    println("Microbenchmark only; not an Android end-to-end speed measurement. Checksum: $checksum")
}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""KurdishNamedEntities-main/*.xlsx  ->  app/src/main/assets/kurdish_entities.txt

بەکارهێنان:  python tools/build_entities.py KurdishNamedEntities-main  app/src/main/assets/kurdish_entities.txt
پێویستی: pip install pandas openpyxl

Companies.xlsx بەکار نایەت (زۆربەی لاتینی و بێ ڕێکخستنە)، و ناوی لاتینی/ژمارەدار فڕێ دەدرێن.
نۆرماڵکردن دەبێت هەمان KurdishEntities.norm() ی Kotlin بێت.
"""
import re, sys, glob, os
import pandas as pd

FILES = ["Persons", "Locations", "Villages", "Mountains", "Rivers", "Caves",
         "Schools", "Ministries", "Universities&institues"]

MAP = {"\u0643": "\u06A9", "\u064A": "\u06CC", "\u0649": "\u06CC", "\u0629": "\u06D5",
       "\u06BE": "\u0647", "\u0624": "\u0648", "\u0623": "\u0627", "\u0625": "\u0627",
       "\u0622": "\u0627", "\u0671": "\u0627", "\u0672": "\u0627"}
STRIP = re.compile("[\u200c\u200d\u0640\u064b-\u0652]")
LATIN_OR_DIGIT = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9\u0660-\u0669\u06F0-\u06F9]")
SUFFIX = re.compile(r"\s+یا\s+تێک[هە]ل\s*$")

def norm(s: str) -> str:
    s = "".join(MAP.get(c, c) for c in s)
    s = STRIP.sub("", s)
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s).strip()

def main(src, dst):
    seen, out = set(), []
    for name in FILES:
        path = os.path.join(src, name + ".xlsx")
        col = pd.read_excel(path, header=None).iloc[:, 0].dropna()
        for raw in col:
            for part in re.split(r"[،,]", str(raw)):
                t = norm(part)
                t = SUFFIX.sub("", t)
                if len(t) < 3 or LATIN_OR_DIGIT.search(t) or t in seen:
                    continue
                seen.add(t); out.append(t)
    out.sort()
    with open(dst, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as f:
        f.write("\n".join(out) + "\n")
    print(len(out), "entities ->", dst, os.path.getsize(dst) // 1024, "KB")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2])

========== END OF FILE: tools/build_entities.py ==========

FILE: tools/verify_short_speech.py

"""Local model check. Requires numpy and onnxruntime; never calls a hosted API.

Usage: python tools/verify_short_speech.py MODEL_DIR OUTPUT_DIR
MODEL_DIR must contain the existing model.onnx and model.onnx.json.
"""
import json
import sys
import unicodedata
import wave
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import onnxruntime as ort


def main():
    model_dir, output_dir = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    config = json.loads((model_dir / "model.onnx.json").read_text())
    ids_map = {symbol: values[0] for symbol, values in config["phoneme_id_map"].items()}
    rate = config["audio"]["sample_rate"]
    options = ort.SessionOptions()
    options.intra_op_num_threads = 2
    session = ort.InferenceSession(str(model_dir / "model.onnx"), options, providers=["CPUExecutionProvider"])
    results = []
    texts = ["نا.", "من.", "باشە.", "سڵاو.", "سوپاس.", "تۆ چۆنی.", "من ئەمڕۆ زۆر دڵخۆشم."]
    for text in texts:
        # Match PiperTts.toIds. Encoding is intentionally unchanged by this fix.
        normalized = unicodedata.normalize("NFD", text)
        ids = [ids_map.get("^", 1)]
        for char in normalized:
            if char in ids_map and char not in "^$_":
                ids += [ids_map[char], ids_map.get("_", 0)]
        ids.append(ids_map.get("$", 2))
        for low_latency in [False, True]:
            for speed in [0.5, 1.0, 2.0]:
                effective_speed = max(0.55, speed * (0.9 if low_latency else 0.72))
                feeds = {
                    "input": np.array([ids], dtype=np.int64),
                    "input_lengths": np.array([len(ids)], dtype=np.int64),
                    "scales": np.array([0.4, config["inference"]["length_scale"] * 1.08 / effective_speed, 0.55], dtype=np.float32),
                }
                if "sid" in {item.name for item in session.get_inputs()}:
                    feeds["sid"] = np.array([0], dtype=np.int64)
                audio = session.run(None, feeds)[0].flatten()
                peak = float(np.max(np.abs(audio))) if audio.size else 0
                rms = float(np.sqrt(np.mean(audio * audio))) if audio.size else 0
                valid = bool(np.isfinite(audio).all() and peak >= 0.0001 and rms >= 0.00001 and
                             np.count_nonzero(np.abs(audio) >= 0.0001) >= max(1, rate // 50))
                assert valid, (text, speed, low_latency, peak, rms)
                results.append(dict(text=text, speed=speed, low_latency=low_latency,
                                    seconds=round(audio.size / rate, 4), peak=peak, rms=rms, has_signal=valid))
                if speed == 1.0 and low_latency:
                    stem = text.rstrip(".")
                    audio.astype("<f4").tofile(output_dir / (stem + ".f32"))
                    gain = min(2.5, 0.9 / max(peak, 1e-9), 0.1 / max(rms, 1e-9))
                    with wave.open(str(output_dir / (stem + ".wav")), "wb") as wav:
                        wav.setnchannels(1)
                        wav.setsampwidth(2)
                        wav.setframerate(rate)
                        wav.writeframes((np.clip(audio * gain, -1, 1) * 32767).astype("<i2").tobytes())
    (output_dir / "results.json").write_text(json.dumps(results, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    print(f"PASS: {len(results)} real-model runs without filler. Signal presence does not verify pronunciation or phone playback.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

package com.mangatranslator.app

import java.io.File
import javax.sound.sampled.AudioSystem
import javax.sound.sampled.AudioFormat
import javax.sound.sampled.AudioInputStream
import javax.sound.sampled.AudioFileFormat
import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream
import kotlin.math.*

/** Run the actual Android-independent DSP against an existing mono PCM16 fixture. */
fun main(args: Array<String>) {
    val stream=AudioSystem.getAudioInputStream(File(args[0]))
    val format=stream.format
    require(format.channels==1 && format.sampleSizeInBits==16 && !format.isBigEndian)
    val bytes=stream.use { it.readBytes() }
    val input=FloatArray(bytes.size/2) { i ->
        (((bytes[2*i].toInt() and 255) or (bytes[2*i+1].toInt() shl 8)).toShort().toInt()/32768f)
    }
    val started=System.nanoTime()
    val output=FemaleVoiceRecipe.process(input,format.sampleRate.toInt())
    val elapsed=(System.nanoTime()-started)/1e9
    require(output.size==input.size && output.all { it.isFinite() && abs(it)<1 })
    val pcm=ByteArray(output.size*2)
    output.forEachIndexed { i,v ->
        val n=(v*32767).roundToInt().coerceIn(-32768,32767)
        pcm[2*i]=n.toByte();pcm[2*i+1]=(n shr 8).toByte()
    }
    val audio=AudioInputStream(ByteArrayInputStream(pcm),AudioFormat(format.sampleRate,16,1,true,false),output.size.toLong())
    AudioSystem.write(audio,AudioFileFormat.Type.WAVE,File(args[1]))
    println("{\"samples\":${output.size},\"sample_rate\":${format.sampleRate},\"processing_seconds\":$elapsed,\"estimated_lufs\":${FemaleVoiceRecipe.integratedLufs(output,format.sampleRate.toInt())}}")
}
