package com.mangatranslator.app

import ai.onnxruntime.*
import org.json.*
import java.io.File
import java.nio.*

/** Local server measurements, not an Android timing claim. */
private fun oldChunks(s:String):List<String> {
    val out=ArrayList<String>()
    for(sent in s.split(Regex("(?<=[.!?؟\\n])\\s*")).map { it.trim() }.filter { it.isNotEmpty() }) {
        if(sent.length<=80) {out.add(sent);continue}
        val cur=StringBuilder()
        for(w in sent.split(' ')) {
            if(w.isEmpty())continue
            if(cur.isNotEmpty())cur.append(' ')
            cur.append(w)
            val comma=w.endsWith("،")||w.endsWith(",")||w.endsWith("؛")
            if(cur.length>=80 || (comma && cur.length >= if(out.isEmpty())18 else 35)) {
                out.add(cur.toString());cur.setLength(0)
            }
        }
        if(cur.isNotEmpty()) {
            if(cur.length<8 && out.isNotEmpty())out[out.lastIndex]=out.last()+" "+cur else out.add(cur.toString())
        }
    }
    return out
}
fun main(args:Array<String>) {
    val text=File(args[2]).readText()
    val cfg=JSONObject(File(args[1]).readText());val inf=PiperModelConfig.inference(cfg)
    val jm=cfg.getJSONObject("phoneme_id_map")
    val map=jm.keys().asSequence().associateWith {jm.getJSONArray(it).getLong(0)}
    val env=OrtEnvironment.getEnvironment();val start=System.nanoTime()
    OrtSession.SessionOptions().use { options ->
        options.setIntraOpNumThreads(2);options.setInterOpNumThreads(1)
        env.createSession(args[0],options).use {session ->
            val load=(System.nanoTime()-start)/1e9
            fun synth(text:String):FloatArray {
                val ids=checkNotNull(PiperTextEncoding.encode(text,map,true,true))
                OnnxTensor.createTensor(env,LongBuffer.wrap(ids),longArrayOf(1,ids.size.toLong())).use {input ->
                    OnnxTensor.createTensor(env,LongBuffer.wrap(longArrayOf(ids.size.toLong())),longArrayOf(1)).use {lengths ->
                        OnnxTensor.createTensor(env,FloatBuffer.wrap(floatArrayOf(inf.noise,inf.length,inf.durationNoise)),longArrayOf(3)).use {scales ->
                            session.run(mapOf("input" to input,"input_lengths" to lengths,"scales" to scales)).use {out ->
                                val b=(out[0] as OnnxTensor).floatBuffer;val y=FloatArray(b.remaining());b.get(y);check(y.all {it.isFinite()});return y
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            val warmStart=System.nanoTime();synth("سڵاو.");val warm=(System.nanoTime()-warmStart)/1e9
            val report=JSONObject().put("server_session_load_seconds",load).put("server_warmup_seconds",warm)
                .put("limits","Local JVM/ONNX server timings only. No Android benchmark or listening assessment. Model weights unchanged.")
            for((name,parts) in listOf("previous" to oldChunks(text),"new" to PiperSpeechTiming.chunks(text))) {
                val rows=JSONArray();var inference=0.0;var process=0.0;var addedPause=0;var edgeRemoved=0.0
                for(part in parts) {
                    val t=System.nanoTime();val raw=synth(part);val dt=(System.nanoTime()-t)/1e9
                    val t2=System.nanoTime();val trimmed=if(name=="new")PiperSpeechTiming.trimEdges(raw,16000) else raw
                    val processed=FemaleVoiceRecipe.process(trimmed,16000);val dp=(System.nanoTime()-t2)/1e9
                    val pause=if(name=="new")PiperSpeechTiming.pauseMs(part,false) else if(part.replace(Regex("[.؟!،]"),"").trim().length<40)280 else 100
                    inference+=dt;process+=dp;addedPause+=pause;edgeRemoved+=(raw.size-trimmed.size)/16000.0
                    rows.put(JSONObject().put("text",part).put("characters",part.length).put("inference_seconds",dt)
                        .put("processing_seconds",dp).put("raw_audio_seconds",raw.size/16000.0)
                        .put("processed_audio_seconds",processed.size/16000.0).put("added_pause_ms",pause))
                }
                report.put(name,JSONObject().put("chunks",rows).put("chunk_count",parts.size)
                    .put("inference_seconds",inference).put("processing_seconds",process)
                    .put("added_pause_ms",addedPause).put("boundary_silence_removed_seconds",edgeRemoved))
            }
            File(args[3]).writeText(report.toString(2));println(report.toString(2))
        }
    }
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import ai.onnxruntime.OnnxTensor
import ai.onnxruntime.OrtEnvironment
import ai.onnxruntime.OrtSession
import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject
import java.io.File
import java.nio.FloatBuffer
import java.nio.LongBuffer
import kotlin.math.sqrt

/** JVM integration probe using the actual app encoder and its ONNX Runtime version. */
fun main(args: Array<String>) {
    require(args.size in 3..4) { "model.onnx model.onnx.json report.json [female-recipe]" }
    val femaleRecipe = args.getOrNull(3) == "female-recipe"
    val config = JSONObject(File(args[1]).readText())
    val inference = PiperModelConfig.inference(config)
    check(inference.referenceVoice)
    check(config.getJSONObject("audio").getInt("sample_rate") == 16000)
    val jsonMap = config.getJSONObject("phoneme_id_map")
    val map = jsonMap.keys().asSequence().associateWith { jsonMap.getJSONArray(it).getLong(0) }
    val report = JSONArray()
    val environment = OrtEnvironment.getEnvironment()
    OrtSession.SessionOptions().use { options ->
        options.setIntraOpNumThreads(2)
        options.setInterOpNumThreads(1)
        environment.createSession(args[0], options).use { session ->
            for (text in listOf("نا", "سڵاو", "ئەک", "سوپاس بۆ هاوکاریت.",
                "ئەمڕۆ هەوا خۆشە و دەچین بۆ باخچە.", "سڵاو،\n  هاوڕێ")) {
                val ids = checkNotNull(PiperTextEncoding.encode(text, map, inference.blankInterleaved, true))
                val scales = floatArrayOf(inference.noise, inference.length, inference.durationNoise)
                OnnxTensor.createTensor(environment, LongBuffer.wrap(ids), longArrayOf(1, ids.size.toLong())).use { input ->
                    OnnxTensor.createTensor(environment, LongBuffer.wrap(longArrayOf(ids.size.toLong())), longArrayOf(1)).use { lengths ->
                        OnnxTensor.createTensor(environment, FloatBuffer.wrap(scales), longArrayOf(3)).use { settings ->
                            session.run(mapOf("input" to input, "input_lengths" to lengths, "scales" to settings)).use { output ->
                                val buffer = (output[0] as OnnxTensor).floatBuffer
                                val raw = FloatArray(buffer.remaining()); buffer.get(raw)
                                val samples = if (femaleRecipe) FemaleVoiceRecipe.process(raw, 16000) else raw
                                check(samples.size == raw.size)
                                check(samples.isNotEmpty() && samples.size <= 16000 * 30)
                                check(samples.all { it.isFinite() })
                                val rms = sqrt(samples.sumOf { it.toDouble() * it } / samples.size)
                                check(rms > 1e-5)
                                report.put(JSONObject().put("text", text).put("ids", JSONArray(ids.toList()))
                                    .put("scales", JSONArray(scales.toList())).put("samples", samples.size).put("rms", rms)
                                    .put("female_recipe", femaleRecipe))
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    File(args[2]).writeText(report.toString(2))
    println("App encoder + ONNX Runtime 1.19.2: ${report.length()} successful finite, non-silent checks")
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

import java.io.File
import java.nio.ByteBuffer
import java.nio.ByteOrder

fun main() {
    val files = File("/workspace/voice-investigation/samples").listFiles()!!.filter { it.extension == "f32" }
    check(files.size == 7)
    for (file in files) {
        val buffer = ByteBuffer.wrap(file.readBytes()).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).asFloatBuffer()
        val pcm = FloatArray(buffer.remaining())
        buffer.get(pcm)
        check(PcmSignal.hasSignal(pcm, 22050)) { "Rejected recorded Piper output: ${file.name}" }
        var attempts = 0
        val result = PiperShortSpeech.render(file.nameWithoutExtension + ".", file.nameWithoutExtension, 22050,
            synthesize = { attempts++; pcm }, polish = { it })
        check(result === pcm && attempts == 1)
    }
    check(!PcmSignal.hasSignal(FloatArray(22050) { .01f }, 22050))
    println("PASS: all 7 existing recorded Piper model outputs accepted on the first short-speech attempt; constant DC rejected.")
    println("This validates PCM/short-word handling, not native Android playback or the reported noise.")
}

package com.mangatranslator.app

================================================================================
FILE: verification/photo-ocr/README.md
================================================================================

# Supplied Facebook screenshot — desktop diagnostic

Input dimensions: 1080 × 2400. Selected advert: (100, 770)–(1000, 1830).
The screenshot hash, model hash and exact engine limitations are in manifest.json.

The ckb pass uses the uploaded model with Android-equivalent first-pass grayscale,
contrast, resize and padding (Pillow bilinear, not Android Bitmap scaling).
The Latin pass uses desktop Tesseract eng as a diagnostic surrogate. It does NOT
exercise Android ML Kit. No emulator/device or audio test was performed.

Captured bounding boxes feed the actual Kotlin MixedOcrFilter. before.txt uses the
previous filter; after.txt uses this revision. These are diagnostic outputs, NOT
hand-corrected transcriptions or a promise of identical device output.

Verified changes on the selected advert:
- Preserve Darya Muhamad and Gimeni Pro as recognized Latin names.
- Preserve 18 and the telephone 07765952001.
- Prevent an 82-confidence Latin Silo guess replacing 66-confidence Kurdish مانگ.
- Remove number-heavy rows anchored only by weak two-letter Kurdish guesses.
- Remove isolated unmatched bracket tokens generated from check icons.
- Read a wholly Latin logo row from left to right.

Known remaining recognition errors:
- The large Kurdish headline is not recovered accurately by the provided model.
- A check icon is still recognized as 0 in one row.
- Some Kurdish spelling remains wrong (e.g. تاببەتمندییەکان, دبنار).
- White-on-blue price appears as 5/000 and the IQD logo as 98 in native OCR;
  the desktop Latin pass misses that panel. No arbitrary price rewriting is applied.
- Stylized Zain logo is not reliably recognized; other logo fragments remain.
- Full-screen downscaling loses more detail than selecting just the advert.

No additional OCR passes, AI calls, delays or network requests were introduced by
these filter changes. Device latency has not been measured.

Reproduce diagnostic OCR (Tesseract 5, Python Pillow):
    python run_photo.py /path/to/1000018527.png /tmp/photo-output --tessdata /path/to/tessdata
The tessdata directory must contain the app's ckb.traineddata and an eng.traineddata.

Reproduce recorded-box filtering from project root (Kotlin compiler on PATH):
    kotlinc app/src/main/java/com/mangatranslator/app/MixedOcrFilter.kt verification/photo-ocr/PhotoRunner.kt -include-runtime -d /tmp/photo-filter.jar
    java -jar /tmp/photo-filter.jar

================================================================================
FILE: verification/photo-ocr/run_photo.py
================================================================================

from PIL import Image, ImageOps
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess, csv, json
import argparse
parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('screenshot', type=Path)
parser.add_argument('output', type=Path)
parser.add_argument('--tessdata', type=Path, required=True, help='Directory containing ckb.traineddata and eng.traineddata')
args=parser.parse_args()
root=args.output
root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
original=Image.open(args.screenshot).convert('RGB')
for name,im in [('advert',original.crop((100,770,1000,1830))),('full',original)]:
 m=max(im.size); k=min(2,900/m) if m<700 else 960/m if m>960 else 1
 sz=tuple(max(1,int(v*k)) for v in im.size)
 scaled=im.resize(sz,Image.Resampling.BILINEAR)
 vals=[(r*299+g*587+b*114)//1000 for r,g,b in scaled.getdata()]
 if sum(vals)//len(vals)<110: vals=[255-v for v in vals]
 hist=[0]*256
 for v in vals:hist[v]+=1
 lo=0;acc=0
 while lo<255 and acc+hist[lo]<len(vals)//100:acc+=hist[lo];lo+=1
 hi=255;acc=0
 while hi>0 and acc+hist[hi]<len(vals)//100:acc+=hist[hi];hi-=1
 if hi-lo<30:lo,hi=0,255
 gray=Image.new('L',sz);gray.putdata([max(0,min(255,(v-lo)*255//max(1,hi-lo))) for v in vals])
 prepared=ImageOps.expand(gray,border=12,fill=255); prepared.save(root/(name+'-prepared.png'))
 for lang,source,psm in [('ckb',root/(name+'-prepared.png'),'6'),('eng',root/(name+'.png'),'11')]:
  if lang=='eng': im.save(source)
  out=root/(name+'-'+lang)
  subprocess.run(['tesseract',str(source),str(out),'--tessdata-dir',str(args.tessdata),'-l',lang,'--psm',psm,'-c','tessedit_create_tsv=1','-c','tessedit_create_txt=1'],check=True)
  words=[]
  for w in csv.DictReader(open(str(out)+'.tsv'),delimiter='\t'):
   if not w['text'].strip():continue
   l,t,width,height=[int(w[x]) for x in ['left','top','width','height']]
   if lang=='ckb': l,t,r,b=[int((v-12)/k) for v in [l,t,l+width,t+height]]
   else:r,b=l+width,t+height
   words.append([w['text'],max(0,l),max(0,t),min(im.width,r),min(im.height,b),float(w['conf']),lang=='eng'])
  json.dump(words,open(str(out)+'.json','w'),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
  print(name,lang,Path(str(out)+'.txt').read_text())
